1CO 14:40.text: But everything must be done in a proper and orderly manner.
1CO 14:40.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 14] But everything must be done in a proper and orderly manner.

1CO 15:1.text: Now, brothers, I want to remind you of the gospel I preached to you, which you received, and in which you stand firm.
1CO 15:1.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 15 · The Resurrection of the Dead (1 Corinthians 15)] Now, brothers, I want to remind you of the gospel I preached to you, which you received, and in which you stand firm.

1CO 15:2.text: By this gospel you are saved, if you hold firmly to the word I preached to you. Otherwise, you have believed in vain.
1CO 15:2.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 15 · The Resurrection of the Dead (1 Corinthians 15)] By this gospel you are saved, if you hold firmly to the word I preached to you. Otherwise, you have believed in vain.

1CO 15:3.text: For what I received I passed on to you as of first importance: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures,
1CO 15:3.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 15 · The Resurrection of the Dead (1 Corinthians 15)] For what I received I passed on to you as of first importance: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures,

1CO 15:4.text: that He was buried, that He was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,
1CO 15:4.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 15 · The Resurrection of the Dead (1 Corinthians 15)] that He was buried, that He was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,

1CO 15:5.text: and that He appeared to Cephas and then to the Twelve.
1CO 15:5.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 15 · The Resurrection of the Dead (1 Corinthians 15)] and that He appeared to Cephas and then to the Twelve.

1CO 15:6.text: After that, He appeared to more than five hundred brothers at once, most of whom are still living, though some have fallen asleep.
1CO 15:6.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 15 · The Resurrection of the Dead (1 Corinthians 15)] After that, He appeared to more than five hundred brothers at once, most of whom are still living, though some have fallen asleep.

1CO 15:7.text: Then He appeared to James, then to all the apostles.
1CO 15:7.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 15 · The Resurrection of the Dead (1 Corinthians 15)] Then He appeared to James, then to all the apostles.

1CO 15:8.text: And last of all He appeared to me also, as to one of untimely birth.
1CO 15:8.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 15 · The Resurrection of the Dead (1 Corinthians 15)] And last of all He appeared to me also, as to one of untimely birth.

1CO 15:9.text: For I am the least of the apostles and am unworthy to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.
1CO 15:9.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 15 · The Resurrection of the Dead (1 Corinthians 15)] For I am the least of the apostles and am unworthy to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.

1CO 15:10.text: But by the grace of God I am what I am, and His grace to me was not in vain. No, I worked harder than all of them—yet not I, but the grace of God that was with me.
1CO 15:10.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 15 · The Resurrection of the Dead (1 Corinthians 15)] But by the grace of God I am what I am, and His grace to me was not in vain. No, I worked harder than all of them—yet not I, but the grace of God that was with me.

1CO 15:11.text: Whether, then, it was I or they, this is what we preach, and this is what you believed.
1CO 15:11.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 15 · The Resurrection of the Dead (1 Corinthians 15)] Whether, then, it was I or they, this is what we preach, and this is what you believed.

1CO 15:12.text: But if it is preached that Christ has been raised from the dead, how can some of you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?
1CO 15:12.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 15 · The Resurrection of the Dead (1 Corinthians 15)] But if it is preached that Christ has been raised from the dead, how can some of you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?

1CO 15:13.text: If there is no resurrection of the dead, then not even Christ has been raised.
1CO 15:13.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 15 · The Resurrection of the Dead (1 Corinthians 15)] If there is no resurrection of the dead, then not even Christ has been raised.

1CO 15:14.text: And if Christ has not been raised, our preaching is worthless, and so is your faith.
1CO 15:14.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 15 · The Resurrection of the Dead (1 Corinthians 15)] And if Christ has not been raised, our preaching is worthless, and so is your faith.

1CO 15:15.text: In that case, we are also exposed as false witnesses about God. For we have testified about God that He raised Christ from the dead, but He did not raise Him if in fact the dead are not raised.
1CO 15:15.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 15 · The Resurrection of the Dead (1 Corinthians 15)] In that case, we are also exposed as false witnesses about God. For we have testified about God that He raised Christ from the dead, but He did not raise Him if in fact the dead are not raised.

1CO 15:16.text: For if the dead are not raised, then not even Christ has been raised.
1CO 15:16.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 15 · The Resurrection of the Dead (1 Corinthians 15)] For if the dead are not raised, then not even Christ has been raised.

1CO 15:17.text: And if Christ has not been raised, your faith is futile; you are still in your sins.
1CO 15:17.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 15 · The Resurrection of the Dead (1 Corinthians 15)] And if Christ has not been raised, your faith is futile; you are still in your sins.

1CO 15:18.text: Then those also who have fallen asleep in Christ have perished.
1CO 15:18.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 15 · The Resurrection of the Dead (1 Corinthians 15)] Then those also who have fallen asleep in Christ have perished.

1CO 15:19.text: If our hope in Christ is for this life alone, we are to be pitied more than all men.
1CO 15:19.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 15 · The Resurrection of the Dead (1 Corinthians 15)] If our hope in Christ is for this life alone, we are to be pitied more than all men.

1CO 15:20.text: But Christ has indeed been raised from the dead, the firstfruits of those who have fallen asleep.
1CO 15:20.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 15 · The Resurrection of the Dead (1 Corinthians 15)] But Christ has indeed been raised from the dead, the firstfruits of those who have fallen asleep.

1CO 15:21.text: For since death came through a man, the resurrection of the dead comes also through a man.
1CO 15:21.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 15 · The Resurrection of the Dead (1 Corinthians 15)] For since death came through a man, the resurrection of the dead comes also through a man.

1CO 15:22.text: For as in Adam all die, so in Christ all will be made alive.
1CO 15:22.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 15 · The Resurrection of the Dead (1 Corinthians 15)] For as in Adam all die, so in Christ all will be made alive.

1CO 15:23.text: But each in his own turn: Christ the firstfruits; then at His coming, those who belong to Him.
1CO 15:23.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 15 · The Resurrection of the Dead (1 Corinthians 15)] But each in his own turn: Christ the firstfruits; then at His coming, those who belong to Him.

1CO 15:24.text: Then the end will come, when He hands over the kingdom to God the Father after He has destroyed all dominion, authority, and power.
1CO 15:24.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 15 · The Resurrection of the Dead (1 Corinthians 15)] Then the end will come, when He hands over the kingdom to God the Father after He has destroyed all dominion, authority, and power.

1CO 15:25.text: For He must reign until He has put all His enemies under His feet.
1CO 15:25.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 15 · The Resurrection of the Dead (1 Corinthians 15)] For He must reign until He has put all His enemies under His feet.

1CO 15:26.text: The last enemy to be destroyed is death.
1CO 15:26.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 15 · The Resurrection of the Dead (1 Corinthians 15)] The last enemy to be destroyed is death.

1CO 15:27.text: For “God has put everything under His feet.” Now when it says that everything has been put under Him, this clearly does not include the One who put everything under Him.
1CO 15:27.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 15 · The Resurrection of the Dead (1 Corinthians 15)] For “God has put everything under His feet.” Now when it says that everything has been put under Him, this clearly does not include the One who put everything under Him.

1CO 15:28.text: And when all things have been subjected to Him, then the Son Himself will be made subject to Him who put all things under Him, so that God may be all in all.
1CO 15:28.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 15 · The Resurrection of the Dead (1 Corinthians 15)] And when all things have been subjected to Him, then the Son Himself will be made subject to Him who put all things under Him, so that God may be all in all.

1CO 15:29.text: If these things are not so, what will those do who are baptized for the dead? If the dead are not raised at all, why are people baptized for them?
1CO 15:29.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 15 · The Resurrection of the Dead (1 Corinthians 15)] If these things are not so, what will those do who are baptized for the dead? If the dead are not raised at all, why are people baptized for them?

1CO 15:30.text: And why do we endanger ourselves every hour?
1CO 15:30.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 15 · The Resurrection of the Dead (1 Corinthians 15)] And why do we endanger ourselves every hour?

1CO 15:31.text: I face death every day, brothers, as surely as I boast about you in Christ Jesus our Lord.
1CO 15:31.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 15 · The Resurrection of the Dead (1 Corinthians 15)] I face death every day, brothers, as surely as I boast about you in Christ Jesus our Lord.

1CO 15:32.text: If I fought wild beasts in Ephesus for human motives, what did I gain? If the dead are not raised,  “Let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die.”
1CO 15:32.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 15 · The Resurrection of the Dead (1 Corinthians 15)] If I fought wild beasts in Ephesus for human motives, what did I gain? If the dead are not raised,  “Let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die.”

1CO 15:33.text: Do not be deceived: “Bad company corrupts good character.”
1CO 15:33.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 15 · The Resurrection of the Dead (1 Corinthians 15)] Do not be deceived: “Bad company corrupts good character.”

1CO 15:34.text: Sober up as you ought, and stop sinning; for some of you are ignorant of God. I say this to your shame.
1CO 15:34.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 15 · The Resurrection of the Dead (1 Corinthians 15)] Sober up as you ought, and stop sinning; for some of you are ignorant of God. I say this to your shame.

1CO 15:35.text: But someone will ask, “How are the dead raised? With what kind of body will they come?”
1CO 15:35.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 15 · The Resurrection of the Dead (1 Corinthians 15)] But someone will ask, “How are the dead raised? With what kind of body will they come?”

1CO 15:36.text: You fool! What you sow does not come to life unless it dies.
1CO 15:36.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 15 · The Resurrection of the Dead (1 Corinthians 15)] You fool! What you sow does not come to life unless it dies.

1CO 15:37.text: And what you sow is not the body that will be, but just a seed, perhaps of wheat or something else.
1CO 15:37.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 15 · The Resurrection of the Dead (1 Corinthians 15)] And what you sow is not the body that will be, but just a seed, perhaps of wheat or something else.

1CO 15:38.text: But God gives it a body as He has designed, and to each kind of seed He gives its own body.
1CO 15:38.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 15 · The Resurrection of the Dead (1 Corinthians 15)] But God gives it a body as He has designed, and to each kind of seed He gives its own body.

1CO 15:39.text: Not all flesh is the same: Men have one kind of flesh, animals have another, birds another, and fish another.
1CO 15:39.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 15 · The Resurrection of the Dead (1 Corinthians 15)] Not all flesh is the same: Men have one kind of flesh, animals have another, birds another, and fish another.

1CO 15:40.text: There are also heavenly bodies and earthly bodies. But the splendor of the heavenly bodies is of one degree, and the splendor of the earthly bodies is of another.
1CO 15:40.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 15 · The Resurrection of the Dead (1 Corinthians 15)] There are also heavenly bodies and earthly bodies. But the splendor of the heavenly bodies is of one degree, and the splendor of the earthly bodies is of another.

1CO 15:41.text: The sun has one degree of splendor, the moon another, and the stars another; and star differs from star in splendor.
1CO 15:41.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 15 · The Resurrection of the Dead (1 Corinthians 15)] The sun has one degree of splendor, the moon another, and the stars another; and star differs from star in splendor.

1CO 15:42.text: So will it be with the resurrection of the dead: What is sown is perishable; it is raised imperishable.
1CO 15:42.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 15 · The Resurrection of the Dead (1 Corinthians 15)] So will it be with the resurrection of the dead: What is sown is perishable; it is raised imperishable.

1CO 15:43.text: It is sown in dishonor; it is raised in glory. It is sown in weakness; it is raised in power.
1CO 15:43.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 15 · The Resurrection of the Dead (1 Corinthians 15)] It is sown in dishonor; it is raised in glory. It is sown in weakness; it is raised in power.

1CO 15:44.text: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. If there is a natural body, there is also a spiritual body.
1CO 15:44.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 15 · The Resurrection of the Dead (1 Corinthians 15)] It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. If there is a natural body, there is also a spiritual body.

1CO 15:45.text: So it is written: “The first man Adam became a living being;” the last Adam a life-giving spirit.
1CO 15:45.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 15 · The Resurrection of the Dead (1 Corinthians 15)] So it is written: “The first man Adam became a living being;” the last Adam a life-giving spirit.

1CO 15:46.text: The spiritual, however, was not first, but the natural, and then the spiritual.
1CO 15:46.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 15 · The Resurrection of the Dead (1 Corinthians 15)] The spiritual, however, was not first, but the natural, and then the spiritual.

1CO 15:47.text: The first man was of the dust of the earth, the second man from heaven.
1CO 15:47.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 15 · The Resurrection of the Dead (1 Corinthians 15)] The first man was of the dust of the earth, the second man from heaven.

1CO 15:48.text: As was the earthly man, so also are those who are of the earth; and as is the heavenly man, so also are those who are of heaven.
1CO 15:48.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 15 · The Resurrection of the Dead (1 Corinthians 15)] As was the earthly man, so also are those who are of the earth; and as is the heavenly man, so also are those who are of heaven.

1CO 15:49.text: And just as we have borne the likeness of the earthly man, so also shall we bear the likeness of the heavenly man.
1CO 15:49.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 15 · The Resurrection of the Dead (1 Corinthians 15)] And just as we have borne the likeness of the earthly man, so also shall we bear the likeness of the heavenly man.

1CO 15:50.text: Now I declare to you, brothers, that flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of God, nor does the perishable inherit the imperishable.
1CO 15:50.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 15 · The Resurrection of the Dead (1 Corinthians 15)] Now I declare to you, brothers, that flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of God, nor does the perishable inherit the imperishable.

1CO 15:51.text: Listen, I tell you a mystery: We will not all sleep, but we will all be changed—
1CO 15:51.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 15 · The Resurrection of the Dead (1 Corinthians 15)] Listen, I tell you a mystery: We will not all sleep, but we will all be changed—

1CO 15:52.text: in an instant, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet. For the trumpet will sound, the dead will be raised imperishable, and we will be changed.
1CO 15:52.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 15 · The Resurrection of the Dead (1 Corinthians 15)] in an instant, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet. For the trumpet will sound, the dead will be raised imperishable, and we will be changed.

1CO 15:53.text: For the perishable must be clothed with the imperishable, and the mortal with immortality.
1CO 15:53.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 15 · The Resurrection of the Dead (1 Corinthians 15)] For the perishable must be clothed with the imperishable, and the mortal with immortality.

1CO 15:54.text: When the perishable has been clothed with the imperishable and the mortal with immortality, then the saying that is written will come to pass: “Death has been swallowed up in victory.”
1CO 15:54.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 15 · The Resurrection of the Dead (1 Corinthians 15)] When the perishable has been clothed with the imperishable and the mortal with immortality, then the saying that is written will come to pass: “Death has been swallowed up in victory.”

1CO 15:55.text: “Where, O Death, is your victory? Where, O Death, is your sting?”
1CO 15:55.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 15 · The Resurrection of the Dead (1 Corinthians 15)] “Where, O Death, is your victory? Where, O Death, is your sting?”

1CO 15:56.text: The sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the law.
1CO 15:56.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 15 · The Resurrection of the Dead (1 Corinthians 15)] The sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the law.

1CO 15:57.text: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ!
1CO 15:57.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 15 · The Resurrection of the Dead (1 Corinthians 15)] But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ!

1CO 15:58.text: Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast and immovable. Always excel in the work of the Lord, because you know that your labor in the Lord is not in vain.
1CO 15:58.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 15 · The Resurrection of the Dead (1 Corinthians 15)] Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast and immovable. Always excel in the work of the Lord, because you know that your labor in the Lord is not in vain.

1CO 16:1.text: Now about the collection for the saints, you are to do as I directed the churches of Galatia:
1CO 16:1.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 16 · About Forgiveness] Now about the collection for the saints, you are to do as I directed the churches of Galatia:

1CO 16:2.text: On the first day of every week, each of you should set aside a portion of his income, saving it up, so that when I come no collections will be needed.
1CO 16:2.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 16 · Inheritance] On the first day of every week, each of you should set aside a portion of his income, saving it up, so that when I come no collections will be needed.

1CO 16:3.text: Then, on my arrival, I will send letters with those you recommend to carry your gift to Jerusalem.
1CO 16:3.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 16] Then, on my arrival, I will send letters with those you recommend to carry your gift to Jerusalem.

1CO 16:4.text: And if it is advisable for me to go also, they can travel with me.
1CO 16:4.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 16] And if it is advisable for me to go also, they can travel with me.

1CO 16:5.text: After I go through Macedonia, however, I will come to you; for I will be going through Macedonia.
1CO 16:5.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 16] After I go through Macedonia, however, I will come to you; for I will be going through Macedonia.

1CO 16:6.text: Perhaps I will stay with you awhile, or even spend the winter, so that you can help me on my journey, wherever I go.
1CO 16:6.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 16] Perhaps I will stay with you awhile, or even spend the winter, so that you can help me on my journey, wherever I go.

1CO 16:7.text: For I do not want to see you now only in passing; I hope to spend some time with you, if the Lord permits.
1CO 16:7.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 16] For I do not want to see you now only in passing; I hope to spend some time with you, if the Lord permits.

1CO 16:8.text: But I will stay in Ephesus until Pentecost,
1CO 16:8.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 16] But I will stay in Ephesus until Pentecost,

1CO 16:9.text: because a great door for effective work has opened to me, even though many oppose me.
1CO 16:9.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 16] because a great door for effective work has opened to me, even though many oppose me.

1CO 16:10.text: If Timothy comes, see to it that he has nothing to fear while he is with you, for he is doing the work of the Lord, just as I am.
1CO 16:10.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 16] If Timothy comes, see to it that he has nothing to fear while he is with you, for he is doing the work of the Lord, just as I am.

1CO 16:11.text: No one, then, should treat him with contempt. Send him on his way in peace so that he can return to me, for I am expecting him along with the brothers.
1CO 16:11.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 16] No one, then, should treat him with contempt. Send him on his way in peace so that he can return to me, for I am expecting him along with the brothers.

1CO 16:12.text: Now about our brother Apollos: I strongly urged him to go to you with the brothers. He was not at all inclined to go now, but he will go when he has the opportunity.
1CO 16:12.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 16 · About Forgiveness] Now about our brother Apollos: I strongly urged him to go to you with the brothers. He was not at all inclined to go now, but he will go when he has the opportunity.

1CO 16:13.text: Be on the alert. Stand firm in the faith. Be men of courage. Be strong.
1CO 16:13.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 16 · Faith] Be on the alert. Stand firm in the faith. Be men of courage. Be strong.

1CO 16:14.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 16 · Love] Do everything in love.

1CO 16:15.text: You know that Stephanas and his household were the first converts in Achaia, and they have devoted themselves to the service of the saints. Now I urge you, brothers,
1CO 16:15.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 16 · Family] You know that Stephanas and his household were the first converts in Achaia, and they have devoted themselves to the service of the saints. Now I urge you, brothers,

1CO 16:16.text: to submit to such as these, and to every fellow worker and laborer.
1CO 16:16.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 16] to submit to such as these, and to every fellow worker and laborer.

1CO 16:17.text: I am glad that Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus have arrived, because they have supplied what was lacking from you.
1CO 16:17.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 16] I am glad that Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus have arrived, because they have supplied what was lacking from you.

1CO 16:18.text: For they refreshed my spirit and yours as well. Show your appreciation, therefore, to such men.
1CO 16:18.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 16 · Fruit of the Spirit] For they refreshed my spirit and yours as well. Show your appreciation, therefore, to such men.

1CO 16:19.text: The churches in the province of Asia send you greetings.  Aquila and Prisca greet you warmly in the Lord, and so does the church that meets at their house.
1CO 16:19.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 16 · Church] The churches in the province of Asia send you greetings.  Aquila and Prisca greet you warmly in the Lord, and so does the church that meets at their house.

1CO 16:20.text: All the brothers here send you greetings. Greet one another with a holy kiss.
1CO 16:20.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 16] All the brothers here send you greetings. Greet one another with a holy kiss.

1CO 16:21.text: This greeting is in my own hand—Paul.
1CO 16:21.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 16] This greeting is in my own hand—Paul.

1CO 16:22.text: If anyone does not love the Lord, let him be under a curse. Come, O Lord!
1CO 16:22.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 16 · Love, Curse God] If anyone does not love the Lord, let him be under a curse. Come, O Lord!

1CO 16:23.text: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with you.
1CO 16:23.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 16 · Grace, Jesus Christ] The grace of the Lord Jesus be with you.

1CO 16:24.text: My love be with all of you in Christ Jesus.  Amen.
1CO 16:24.bm25Text: [1 Corinthians · Chapter 16 · Love, Body of Christ] My love be with all of you in Christ Jesus.  Amen.

1JN 1:1.text: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our own eyes, which we have gazed upon and touched with our own hands—this is the Word of life.
1JN 1:1.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 1] That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our own eyes, which we have gazed upon and touched with our own hands—this is the Word of life.

1JN 1:2.text: And this is the life that was revealed; we have seen it and testified to it, and we proclaim to you the eternal life that was with the Father and was revealed to us.
1JN 1:2.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 1 · Eternal Life, God the Father] And this is the life that was revealed; we have seen it and testified to it, and we proclaim to you the eternal life that was with the Father and was revealed to us.

1JN 1:3.text: We proclaim to you what we have seen and heard, so that you also may have fellowship with us. And this fellowship of ours is with the Father and with His Son, Jesus Christ.
1JN 1:3.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 1 · Body of Christ, Fellowship] We proclaim to you what we have seen and heard, so that you also may have fellowship with us. And this fellowship of ours is with the Father and with His Son, Jesus Christ.

1JN 1:4.text: We write these things so that our joy may be complete.
1JN 1:4.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 1] We write these things so that our joy may be complete.

1JN 1:5.text: And this is the message we have heard from Him and announce to you: God is light, and in Him there is no darkness at all.
1JN 1:5.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 1 · Light] And this is the message we have heard from Him and announce to you: God is light, and in Him there is no darkness at all.

1JN 1:6.text: If we say we have fellowship with Him yet walk in the darkness, we lie and do not practice the truth.
1JN 1:6.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 1 · Fellowship] If we say we have fellowship with Him yet walk in the darkness, we lie and do not practice the truth.

1JN 1:7.text: But if we walk in the light as He is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus His Son cleanses us from all sin.
1JN 1:7.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 1 · Fellowship, Jesus Christ] But if we walk in the light as He is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus His Son cleanses us from all sin.

1JN 1:8.text: If we say we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
1JN 1:8.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 1 · Deceive] If we say we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.

1JN 1:9.text: If we confess our sins, He is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
1JN 1:9.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 1 · Forgiveness, Faith] If we confess our sins, He is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

1JN 1:10.text: If we say we have not sinned, we make Him out to be a liar, and His word is not in us.
1JN 1:10.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 1] If we say we have not sinned, we make Him out to be a liar, and His word is not in us.

1JN 2:1.text: My little children, I am writing these things to you so that you will not sin. But if anyone does sin, we have an advocate before the Father—Jesus Christ, the Righteous One.
1JN 2:1.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 2 · Body of Christ, Children] My little children, I am writing these things to you so that you will not sin. But if anyone does sin, we have an advocate before the Father—Jesus Christ, the Righteous One.

1JN 2:2.text: He Himself is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not only for ours but also for the sins of the whole world.
1JN 2:2.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 2] He Himself is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not only for ours but also for the sins of the whole world.

1JN 2:3.text: By this we can be sure that we have come to know Him: if we keep His commandments.
1JN 2:3.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 2 · Law] By this we can be sure that we have come to know Him: if we keep His commandments.

1JN 2:4.text: If anyone says, “I know Him,” but does not keep His commandments, he is a liar, and the truth is not in him.
1JN 2:4.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 2 · Law] If anyone says, “I know Him,” but does not keep His commandments, he is a liar, and the truth is not in him.

1JN 2:5.text: But if anyone keeps His word, the love of God has been truly perfected in him. By this we know that we are in Him:
1JN 2:5.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 2 · Love] But if anyone keeps His word, the love of God has been truly perfected in him. By this we know that we are in Him:

1JN 2:6.text: Whoever claims to abide in Him must walk as Jesus walked.
1JN 2:6.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 2 · Jesus Christ] Whoever claims to abide in Him must walk as Jesus walked.

1JN 2:7.text: Beloved, I am not writing to you a new commandment, but an old one, which you have had from the beginning. This commandment is the message you have heard.
1JN 2:7.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 2 · Love] Beloved, I am not writing to you a new commandment, but an old one, which you have had from the beginning. This commandment is the message you have heard.

1JN 2:8.text: Then again, I am also writing to you a new commandment, which is true in Him and also in you. For the darkness is fading and the true light is already shining.
1JN 2:8.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 2 · Light] Then again, I am also writing to you a new commandment, which is true in Him and also in you. For the darkness is fading and the true light is already shining.

1JN 2:9.text: If anyone claims to be in the light but hates his brother, he is still in the darkness.
1JN 2:9.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 2 · Light] If anyone claims to be in the light but hates his brother, he is still in the darkness.

1JN 2:10.text: Whoever loves his brother remains in the light, and there is no cause of stumbling in him.
1JN 2:10.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 2 · Love, Light] Whoever loves his brother remains in the light, and there is no cause of stumbling in him.

1JN 2:11.text: But whoever hates his brother is in the darkness and walks in the darkness. He does not know where he is going, because the darkness has blinded his eyes.
1JN 2:11.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 2] But whoever hates his brother is in the darkness and walks in the darkness. He does not know where he is going, because the darkness has blinded his eyes.

1JN 2:12.text: I am writing to you, little children, because your sins have been forgiven through His name.
1JN 2:12.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 2 · Forgiveness, Children] I am writing to you, little children, because your sins have been forgiven through His name.

1JN 2:13.text: I am writing to you, fathers, because you know Him who is from the beginning.  I am writing to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one.  I have written to you, children, because you know the Father.
1JN 2:13.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 2 · Children, God the Father] I am writing to you, fathers, because you know Him who is from the beginning.  I am writing to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one.  I have written to you, children, because you know the Father.

1JN 2:14.text: I have written to you, fathers, because you know Him who is from the beginning.  I have written to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God abides in you, and you have overcome the evil one.
1JN 2:14.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 2] I have written to you, fathers, because you know Him who is from the beginning.  I have written to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God abides in you, and you have overcome the evil one.

1JN 2:15.text: Do not love the world or anything in the world. If anyone loves the world, the love of the Father is not in him.
1JN 2:15.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 2 · Love, God the Father] Do not love the world or anything in the world. If anyone loves the world, the love of the Father is not in him.

1JN 2:16.text: For all that is in the world—the desires of the flesh, the desires of the eyes, and the pride of life—is not from the Father but from the world.
1JN 2:16.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 2 · God the Father] For all that is in the world—the desires of the flesh, the desires of the eyes, and the pride of life—is not from the Father but from the world.

1JN 2:17.text: The world is passing away, along with its desires; but whoever does the will of God remains forever.
1JN 2:17.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 2] The world is passing away, along with its desires; but whoever does the will of God remains forever.

1JN 2:18.text: Children, it is the last hour; and just as you have heard that the antichrist is coming, so now many antichrists have appeared. This is how we know it is the last hour.
1JN 2:18.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 2 · Antichrist, Children] Children, it is the last hour; and just as you have heard that the antichrist is coming, so now many antichrists have appeared. This is how we know it is the last hour.

1JN 2:19.text: They went out from us, but they did not belong to us. For if they had belonged to us, they would have remained with us. But their departure made it clear that none of them belonged to us.
1JN 2:19.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 2] They went out from us, but they did not belong to us. For if they had belonged to us, they would have remained with us. But their departure made it clear that none of them belonged to us.

1JN 2:20.text: You, however, have an anointing from the Holy One, and all of you know the truth.
1JN 2:20.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 2 · Anointing] You, however, have an anointing from the Holy One, and all of you know the truth.

1JN 2:21.text: I have not written to you because you lack knowledge of the truth, but because you have it, and because no lie comes from the truth.
1JN 2:21.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 2] I have not written to you because you lack knowledge of the truth, but because you have it, and because no lie comes from the truth.

1JN 2:22.text: Who is the liar, if it is not the one who denies that Jesus is the Christ? This is the antichrist, who denies the Father and the Son.
1JN 2:22.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 2 · Antichrist, Body of Christ] Who is the liar, if it is not the one who denies that Jesus is the Christ? This is the antichrist, who denies the Father and the Son.

1JN 2:23.text: Whoever denies the Son does not have the Father, but whoever confesses the Son has the Father as well.
1JN 2:23.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 2 · God the Father] Whoever denies the Son does not have the Father, but whoever confesses the Son has the Father as well.

1JN 2:24.text: As for you, let what you have heard from the beginning remain in you. If it does, you will also remain in the Son and in the Father.
1JN 2:24.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 2 · God the Father] As for you, let what you have heard from the beginning remain in you. If it does, you will also remain in the Son and in the Father.

1JN 2:25.text: And this is the promise that He Himself made to us: eternal life.
1JN 2:25.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 2 · Covenant, Eternal Life] And this is the promise that He Himself made to us: eternal life.

1JN 2:26.text: I have written these things to you about those who are trying to deceive you.
1JN 2:26.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 2 · About Forgiveness, Deceive] I have written these things to you about those who are trying to deceive you.

1JN 2:27.text: And as for you, the anointing you received from Him remains in you, and you do not need anyone to teach you. But just as His true and genuine anointing teaches you about all things, so remain in Him as you have been taught.
1JN 2:27.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 2 · About Forgiveness, Anointing] And as for you, the anointing you received from Him remains in you, and you do not need anyone to teach you. But just as His true and genuine anointing teaches you about all things, so remain in Him as you have been taught.

1JN 2:28.text: And now, little children, remain in Christ, so that when He appears, we may be confident and unashamed before Him at His coming.
1JN 2:28.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 2 · Body of Christ, Children] And now, little children, remain in Christ, so that when He appears, we may be confident and unashamed before Him at His coming.

1JN 2:29.text: If you know that He is righteous, you also know that everyone who practices righteousness has been born of Him.
1JN 2:29.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 2] If you know that He is righteous, you also know that everyone who practices righteousness has been born of Him.

1JN 3:1.text: Behold what manner of love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God. And that is what we are! The reason the world does not know us is that it did not know Him.
1JN 3:1.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 3 · Love, Children] Behold what manner of love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God. And that is what we are! The reason the world does not know us is that it did not know Him.

1JN 3:2.text: Beloved, we are now children of God, and what we will be has not yet been revealed. We know that when Christ appears, we will be like Him, for we will see Him as He is.
1JN 3:2.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 3 · Love, Body of Christ] Beloved, we are now children of God, and what we will be has not yet been revealed. We know that when Christ appears, we will be like Him, for we will see Him as He is.

1JN 3:3.text: And everyone who has this hope in Him purifies himself, just as Christ is pure.
1JN 3:3.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 3 · Body of Christ, Jesus Christ] And everyone who has this hope in Him purifies himself, just as Christ is pure.

1JN 3:4.text: Everyone who practices sin practices lawlessness as well. Indeed, sin is lawlessness.
1JN 3:4.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 3] Everyone who practices sin practices lawlessness as well. Indeed, sin is lawlessness.

1JN 3:5.text: But you know that Christ appeared to take away sins, and in Him there is no sin.
1JN 3:5.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 3 · Body of Christ, Jesus Christ] But you know that Christ appeared to take away sins, and in Him there is no sin.

1JN 3:6.text: No one who remains in Him keeps on sinning. No one who continues to sin has seen Him or known Him.
1JN 3:6.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 3] No one who remains in Him keeps on sinning. No one who continues to sin has seen Him or known Him.

1JN 3:7.text: Little children, let no one deceive you: The one who practices righteousness is righteous, just as Christ is righteous.
1JN 3:7.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 3 · Body of Christ, Children] Little children, let no one deceive you: The one who practices righteousness is righteous, just as Christ is righteous.

1JN 3:8.text: The one who practices sin is of the devil, because the devil has been sinning from the very start. This is why the Son of God was revealed, to destroy the works of the devil.
1JN 3:8.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 3 · Destroy Canaan, Destroy Canaanites] The one who practices sin is of the devil, because the devil has been sinning from the very start. This is why the Son of God was revealed, to destroy the works of the devil.

1JN 3:9.text: Anyone born of God refuses to practice sin, because God’s seed abides in him; he cannot go on sinning, because he has been born of God.
1JN 3:9.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 3] Anyone born of God refuses to practice sin, because God’s seed abides in him; he cannot go on sinning, because he has been born of God.

1JN 3:10.text: By this the children of God are distinguished from the children of the devil: Anyone who does not practice righteousness is not of God, nor is anyone who does not love his brother.
1JN 3:10.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 3 · Love, Children] By this the children of God are distinguished from the children of the devil: Anyone who does not practice righteousness is not of God, nor is anyone who does not love his brother.

1JN 3:11.text: This is the message you have heard from the beginning: We should love one another.
1JN 3:11.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 3 · Love] This is the message you have heard from the beginning: We should love one another.

1JN 3:12.text: Do not be like Cain, who belonged to the evil one and murdered his brother. And why did Cain slay him? Because his own deeds were evil, while those of his brother were righteous.
1JN 3:12.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 3] Do not be like Cain, who belonged to the evil one and murdered his brother. And why did Cain slay him? Because his own deeds were evil, while those of his brother were righteous.

1JN 3:13.text: So do not be surprised, brothers, if the world hates you.
1JN 3:13.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 3] So do not be surprised, brothers, if the world hates you.

1JN 3:14.text: We know that we have passed from death to life, because we love our brothers. The one who does not love remains in death.
1JN 3:14.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 3 · Love, Death] We know that we have passed from death to life, because we love our brothers. The one who does not love remains in death.

1JN 3:15.text: Everyone who hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that eternal life does not reside in a murderer.
1JN 3:15.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 3 · Eternal Life] Everyone who hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that eternal life does not reside in a murderer.

1JN 3:16.text: By this we know what love is: Jesus laid down His life for us, and we ought to lay down our lives for our brothers.
1JN 3:16.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 3 · Love, Jesus Christ] By this we know what love is: Jesus laid down His life for us, and we ought to lay down our lives for our brothers.

1JN 3:17.text: If anyone with earthly possessions sees his brother in need, but withholds his compassion from him, how can the love of God abide in him?
1JN 3:17.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 3 · Love, Compassion] If anyone with earthly possessions sees his brother in need, but withholds his compassion from him, how can the love of God abide in him?

1JN 3:18.text: Little children, let us love not in word and speech, but in action and truth.
1JN 3:18.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 3 · Love, Children] Little children, let us love not in word and speech, but in action and truth.

1JN 3:19.text: And by this we will know that we belong to the truth, and will assure our hearts in His presence:
1JN 3:19.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 3] And by this we will know that we belong to the truth, and will assure our hearts in His presence:

1JN 3:20.text: Even if our hearts condemn us, God is greater than our hearts, and He knows all things.
1JN 3:20.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 3] Even if our hearts condemn us, God is greater than our hearts, and He knows all things.

1JN 3:21.text: Beloved, if our hearts do not condemn us, we have confidence before God,
1JN 3:21.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 3 · Love, Assurance] Beloved, if our hearts do not condemn us, we have confidence before God,

1JN 3:22.text: and we will receive from Him whatever we ask, because we keep His commandments and do what is pleasing in His sight.
1JN 3:22.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 3 · Law] and we will receive from Him whatever we ask, because we keep His commandments and do what is pleasing in His sight.

1JN 3:23.text: And this is His commandment: that we should believe in the name of His Son, Jesus Christ, and we should love one another just as He commanded us.
1JN 3:23.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 3 · Love, Faith] And this is His commandment: that we should believe in the name of His Son, Jesus Christ, and we should love one another just as He commanded us.

1JN 3:24.text: Whoever keeps His commandments remains in God, and God in him. And by this we know that He remains in us: by the Spirit He has given us.
1JN 3:24.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 3 · Fruit of the Spirit, Law] Whoever keeps His commandments remains in God, and God in him. And by this we know that He remains in us: by the Spirit He has given us.

1JN 4:1.text: Beloved, do not believe every spirit, but test the spirits to see whether they are from God. For many false prophets have gone out into the world.
1JN 4:1.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 4 · Love, Faith] Beloved, do not believe every spirit, but test the spirits to see whether they are from God. For many false prophets have gone out into the world.

1JN 4:2.text: By this you will know the Spirit of God: Every spirit that confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is from God,
1JN 4:2.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 4 · Body of Christ, Fruit of the Spirit] By this you will know the Spirit of God: Every spirit that confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is from God,

1JN 4:3.text: and every spirit that does not confess Jesus is not from God. This is the spirit of the antichrist, which you have heard is coming and which is already in the world at this time.
1JN 4:3.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 4 · Antichrist, Fruit of the Spirit] and every spirit that does not confess Jesus is not from God. This is the spirit of the antichrist, which you have heard is coming and which is already in the world at this time.

1JN 4:4.text: You, little children, are from God and have overcome them, because greater is He who is in you than he who is in the world.
1JN 4:4.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 4 · Children] You, little children, are from God and have overcome them, because greater is He who is in you than he who is in the world.

1JN 4:5.text: They are of the world. That is why they speak from the world’s perspective, and the world listens to them.
1JN 4:5.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 4] They are of the world. That is why they speak from the world’s perspective, and the world listens to them.

1JN 4:6.text: We are from God. Whoever knows God listens to us; whoever is not from God does not listen to us. That is how we know the Spirit of truth and the spirit of deception.
1JN 4:6.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 4 · Deception, Fruit of the Spirit] We are from God. Whoever knows God listens to us; whoever is not from God does not listen to us. That is how we know the Spirit of truth and the spirit of deception.

1JN 4:7.text: Beloved, let us love one another, because love comes from God. Everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.
1JN 4:7.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 4 · Love] Beloved, let us love one another, because love comes from God. Everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.

1JN 4:8.text: Whoever does not love does not know God, because God is love.
1JN 4:8.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 4 · Love] Whoever does not love does not know God, because God is love.

1JN 4:9.text: This is how God’s love was revealed among us: God sent His one and only Son into the world, so that we might live through Him.
1JN 4:9.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 4 · Love] This is how God’s love was revealed among us: God sent His one and only Son into the world, so that we might live through Him.

1JN 4:10.text: And love consists in this: not that we loved God, but that He loved us and sent His Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.
1JN 4:10.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 4 · Love] And love consists in this: not that we loved God, but that He loved us and sent His Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.

1JN 4:11.text: Beloved, if God so loved us, we also ought to love one another.
1JN 4:11.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 4 · Love] Beloved, if God so loved us, we also ought to love one another.

1JN 4:12.text: No one has ever seen God; but if we love one another, God remains in us, and His love is perfected in us.
1JN 4:12.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 4 · Love] No one has ever seen God; but if we love one another, God remains in us, and His love is perfected in us.

1JN 4:13.text: By this we know that we remain in Him, and He in us: He has given us of His Spirit.
1JN 4:13.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 4 · Fruit of the Spirit] By this we know that we remain in Him, and He in us: He has given us of His Spirit.

1JN 4:14.text: And we have seen and testify that the Father has sent His Son to be the Savior of the world.
1JN 4:14.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 4 · God the Father] And we have seen and testify that the Father has sent His Son to be the Savior of the world.

1JN 4:15.text: If anyone confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God abides in him, and he in God.
1JN 4:15.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 4 · Jesus Christ] If anyone confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God abides in him, and he in God.

1JN 4:16.text: And we have come to know and believe the love that God has for us. God is love; whoever abides in love abides in God, and God in him.
1JN 4:16.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 4 · Love, Faith] And we have come to know and believe the love that God has for us. God is love; whoever abides in love abides in God, and God in him.

1JN 4:17.text: In this way, love has been perfected among us, so that we may have confidence on the day of judgment; for in this world we are just like Him.
1JN 4:17.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 4 · Love, Assurance] In this way, love has been perfected among us, so that we may have confidence on the day of judgment; for in this world we are just like Him.

1JN 4:18.text: There is no fear in love, but perfect love drives out fear, because fear involves punishment. The one who fears has not been perfected in love.
1JN 4:18.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 4 · Love] There is no fear in love, but perfect love drives out fear, because fear involves punishment. The one who fears has not been perfected in love.

1JN 4:19.text: We love because He first loved us.
1JN 4:19.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 4 · Love] We love because He first loved us.

1JN 4:20.text: If anyone says, “I love God,” but hates his brother, he is a liar. For anyone who does not love his brother, whom he has seen, cannot love God, whom he has not seen.
1JN 4:20.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 4 · Love] If anyone says, “I love God,” but hates his brother, he is a liar. For anyone who does not love his brother, whom he has seen, cannot love God, whom he has not seen.

1JN 4:21.text: And we have this commandment from Him: Whoever loves God must love his brother as well.
1JN 4:21.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 4 · Love] And we have this commandment from Him: Whoever loves God must love his brother as well.

1JN 5:1.text: Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God, and everyone who loves the Father also loves those born of Him.
1JN 5:1.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 5 · Love, Faith] Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God, and everyone who loves the Father also loves those born of Him.

1JN 5:2.text: By this we know that we love the children of God: when we love God and keep His commandments.
1JN 5:2.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 5 · Love, Children] By this we know that we love the children of God: when we love God and keep His commandments.

1JN 5:3.text: For this is the love of God, that we keep His commandments. And His commandments are not burdensome,
1JN 5:3.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 5 · Love, Law] For this is the love of God, that we keep His commandments. And His commandments are not burdensome,

1JN 5:4.text: because everyone born of God overcomes the world. And this is the victory that has overcome the world: our faith.
1JN 5:4.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 5 · Faith] because everyone born of God overcomes the world. And this is the victory that has overcome the world: our faith.

1JN 5:5.text: Who then overcomes the world? Only he who believes that Jesus is the Son of God.
1JN 5:5.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 5 · Faith, Jesus Christ] Who then overcomes the world? Only he who believes that Jesus is the Son of God.

1JN 5:6.text: This is the One who came by water and blood, Jesus Christ—not by water alone, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit who testifies to this, because the Spirit is the truth.
1JN 5:6.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 5 · Body of Christ, Fruit of the Spirit] This is the One who came by water and blood, Jesus Christ—not by water alone, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit who testifies to this, because the Spirit is the truth.

1JN 5:7.text: For there are three that testify:
1JN 5:7.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 5] For there are three that testify:

1JN 5:8.text: the Spirit, the water, and the blood—and these three are in agreement.
1JN 5:8.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 5 · Fruit of the Spirit] the Spirit, the water, and the blood—and these three are in agreement.

1JN 5:9.text: Even if we accept human testimony, the testimony of God is greater. For this is the testimony that God has given about His Son.
1JN 5:9.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 5 · About Forgiveness] Even if we accept human testimony, the testimony of God is greater. For this is the testimony that God has given about His Son.

1JN 5:10.text: Whoever believes in the Son of God has this testimony within him; whoever does not believe God has made Him out to be a liar, because he has not believed in the testimony that God has given about His Son.
1JN 5:10.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 5 · Faith, About Forgiveness] Whoever believes in the Son of God has this testimony within him; whoever does not believe God has made Him out to be a liar, because he has not believed in the testimony that God has given about His Son.

1JN 5:11.text: And this is that testimony: God has given us eternal life, and this life is in His Son.
1JN 5:11.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 5 · Eternal Life] And this is that testimony: God has given us eternal life, and this life is in His Son.

1JN 5:12.text: Whoever has the Son has life; whoever does not have the Son of God does not have life.
1JN 5:12.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 5 · Jesus Christ] Whoever has the Son has life; whoever does not have the Son of God does not have life.

1JN 5:13.text: I have written these things to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, so that you may know that you have eternal life.
1JN 5:13.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 5 · Faith, Eternal Life] I have written these things to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, so that you may know that you have eternal life.

1JN 5:14.text: And this is the confidence that we have before Him: If we ask anything according to His will, He hears us.
1JN 5:14.bm25Text: [1 John · Chapter 5 · Assurance] And this is the confidence that we have before Him: If we ask anything according to His will, He hears us.

1JN 5:15.text: And if we know that He hears us in whatever we ask, we know that we already possess what we have asked of Him.
