EZK 1:3.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 1] the word of the LORD came directly to Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the River Kebar. And there the LORD’s hand was upon him.

EZK 1:4.text: I looked and saw a whirlwind coming from the north, a great cloud with fire flashing back and forth and brilliant light all around it. In the center of the fire was a gleam like amber,
EZK 1:4.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 1 · Light] I looked and saw a whirlwind coming from the north, a great cloud with fire flashing back and forth and brilliant light all around it. In the center of the fire was a gleam like amber,

EZK 1:5.text: and within it was the form of four living creatures.  And this was their appearance: They had a human form,
EZK 1:5.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 1] and within it was the form of four living creatures.  And this was their appearance: They had a human form,

EZK 1:6.text: but each had four faces and four wings.
EZK 1:6.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 1] but each had four faces and four wings.

EZK 1:7.text: Their legs were straight, and the soles of their feet were like the hooves of a calf, gleaming like polished bronze.
EZK 1:7.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 1] Their legs were straight, and the soles of their feet were like the hooves of a calf, gleaming like polished bronze.

EZK 1:8.text: Under their wings on their four sides they had human hands. All four living creatures had faces and wings,
EZK 1:8.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 1] Under their wings on their four sides they had human hands. All four living creatures had faces and wings,

EZK 1:9.text: and their wings were touching one another. They did not turn as they moved; each one went straight ahead.
EZK 1:9.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 1] and their wings were touching one another. They did not turn as they moved; each one went straight ahead.

EZK 1:10.text: The form of their faces was that of a man, and each of the four had the face of a lion on the right side, the face of an ox on the left side, and also the face of an eagle.
EZK 1:10.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 1] The form of their faces was that of a man, and each of the four had the face of a lion on the right side, the face of an ox on the left side, and also the face of an eagle.

EZK 1:11.text: Such were their faces.  Their wings were spread upward; each had two wings touching the wings of the creature on either side, and two wings covering its body.
EZK 1:11.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 1] Such were their faces.  Their wings were spread upward; each had two wings touching the wings of the creature on either side, and two wings covering its body.

EZK 1:12.text: Each creature went straight ahead. Wherever the spirit would go, they would go, without turning as they moved.
EZK 1:12.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 1 · Fruit of the Spirit] Each creature went straight ahead. Wherever the spirit would go, they would go, without turning as they moved.

EZK 1:13.text: In the midst of the living creatures was the appearance of glowing coals of fire, or of torches. Fire moved back and forth between the living creatures; it was bright, and lightning flashed out of it.
EZK 1:13.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 1] In the midst of the living creatures was the appearance of glowing coals of fire, or of torches. Fire moved back and forth between the living creatures; it was bright, and lightning flashed out of it.

EZK 1:14.text: The creatures were darting back and forth as quickly as flashes of lightning.
EZK 1:14.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 1] The creatures were darting back and forth as quickly as flashes of lightning.

EZK 1:15.text: When I looked at the living creatures, I saw a wheel on the ground beside each creature with its four faces.
EZK 1:15.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 1] When I looked at the living creatures, I saw a wheel on the ground beside each creature with its four faces.

EZK 1:16.text: The workmanship of the wheels looked like the gleam of beryl, and all four had the same likeness. Their workmanship looked like a wheel within a wheel.
EZK 1:16.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 1] The workmanship of the wheels looked like the gleam of beryl, and all four had the same likeness. Their workmanship looked like a wheel within a wheel.

EZK 1:17.text: As they moved, they went in any of the four directions, without pivoting as they moved.
EZK 1:17.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 1] As they moved, they went in any of the four directions, without pivoting as they moved.

EZK 1:18.text: Their rims were high and awesome, and all four rims were full of eyes all around.
EZK 1:18.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 1] Their rims were high and awesome, and all four rims were full of eyes all around.

EZK 1:19.text: So as the living creatures moved, the wheels moved beside them, and when the creatures rose from the ground, the wheels also rose.
EZK 1:19.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 1] So as the living creatures moved, the wheels moved beside them, and when the creatures rose from the ground, the wheels also rose.

EZK 1:20.text: Wherever the spirit would go, they would go, and the wheels would rise alongside them, because the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.
EZK 1:20.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 1 · Fruit of the Spirit] Wherever the spirit would go, they would go, and the wheels would rise alongside them, because the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.

EZK 1:21.text: When the creatures moved, the wheels moved; when the creatures stood still, the wheels stood still; and when the creatures rose from the ground, the wheels rose alongside them, because the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.
EZK 1:21.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 1 · Fruit of the Spirit] When the creatures moved, the wheels moved; when the creatures stood still, the wheels stood still; and when the creatures rose from the ground, the wheels rose alongside them, because the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.

EZK 1:22.text: Spread out above the heads of the living creatures was the likeness of an awesome expanse, gleaming like crystal.
EZK 1:22.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 1] Spread out above the heads of the living creatures was the likeness of an awesome expanse, gleaming like crystal.

EZK 1:23.text: And under the expanse, their wings stretched out toward one another. Each one also had two wings covering its body.
EZK 1:23.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 1] And under the expanse, their wings stretched out toward one another. Each one also had two wings covering its body.

EZK 1:24.text: When the creatures moved, I heard the sound of their wings like the roar of many waters, like the voice of the Almighty, like the tumult of an army.  When they stood still, they lowered their wings.
EZK 1:24.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 1] When the creatures moved, I heard the sound of their wings like the roar of many waters, like the voice of the Almighty, like the tumult of an army.  When they stood still, they lowered their wings.

EZK 1:25.text: And there came a voice from above the expanse over their heads as they stood still with their wings lowered.
EZK 1:25.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 1] And there came a voice from above the expanse over their heads as they stood still with their wings lowered.

EZK 1:26.text: Above the expanse over their heads was the likeness of a throne with the appearance of sapphire, and on the throne high above was a figure like that of a man.
EZK 1:26.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 1] Above the expanse over their heads was the likeness of a throne with the appearance of sapphire, and on the throne high above was a figure like that of a man.

EZK 1:27.text: From what seemed to be His waist up, I saw a gleam like amber, with what looked like fire within it all around. And from what seemed to be His waist down, I saw what looked like fire; and brilliant light surrounded Him.
EZK 1:27.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 1 · Light] From what seemed to be His waist up, I saw a gleam like amber, with what looked like fire within it all around. And from what seemed to be His waist down, I saw what looked like fire; and brilliant light surrounded Him.

EZK 1:28.text: The appearance of the brilliant light all around Him was like that of a rainbow in a cloud on a rainy day. This was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the LORD. And when I saw it, I fell facedown and heard a voice speaking.
EZK 1:28.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 1 · Glory, Light] The appearance of the brilliant light all around Him was like that of a rainbow in a cloud on a rainy day. This was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the LORD. And when I saw it, I fell facedown and heard a voice speaking.

EZK 2:1.text: “Son of man,” He said to me, “stand up on your feet and I will speak to you.”
EZK 2:1.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 2] “Son of man,” He said to me, “stand up on your feet and I will speak to you.”

EZK 2:2.text: And as He spoke to me, the Spirit entered me and set me on my feet, and I heard Him speaking to me.
EZK 2:2.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 2 · Fruit of the Spirit] And as He spoke to me, the Spirit entered me and set me on my feet, and I heard Him speaking to me.

EZK 2:3.text: “Son of man,” He said to me, “I am sending you to the Israelites, to a rebellious nation that has rebelled against Me. To this very day they and their fathers have rebelled against Me.
EZK 2:3.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 2] “Son of man,” He said to me, “I am sending you to the Israelites, to a rebellious nation that has rebelled against Me. To this very day they and their fathers have rebelled against Me.

EZK 2:4.text: They are obstinate and stubborn children. I am sending you to them, and you are to say to them, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says.’
EZK 2:4.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 2 · Children] They are obstinate and stubborn children. I am sending you to them, and you are to say to them, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says.’

EZK 2:5.text: And whether they listen or refuse to listen—for they are a rebellious house—they will know that a prophet has been among them.
EZK 2:5.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 2] And whether they listen or refuse to listen—for they are a rebellious house—they will know that a prophet has been among them.

EZK 2:6.text: But you, son of man, do not be afraid of them or their words. Do not be afraid, though briers and thorns surround you, and you dwell among scorpions. Do not be afraid of their words or dismayed by their presence, though they are a rebellious house.
EZK 2:6.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 2] But you, son of man, do not be afraid of them or their words. Do not be afraid, though briers and thorns surround you, and you dwell among scorpions. Do not be afraid of their words or dismayed by their presence, though they are a rebellious house.

EZK 2:7.text: But speak My words to them, whether they listen or refuse to listen, for they are rebellious.
EZK 2:7.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 2] But speak My words to them, whether they listen or refuse to listen, for they are rebellious.

EZK 2:8.text: And you, son of man, listen to what I tell you. Do not be rebellious like that rebellious house. Open your mouth and eat what I give you.”
EZK 2:8.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 2] And you, son of man, listen to what I tell you. Do not be rebellious like that rebellious house. Open your mouth and eat what I give you.”

EZK 2:9.text: Then I looked and saw a hand reaching out to me, and in it was a scroll,
EZK 2:9.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 2] Then I looked and saw a hand reaching out to me, and in it was a scroll,

EZK 2:10.text: which He unrolled before me. And written on the front and back of it were words of lamentation, mourning, and woe.
EZK 2:10.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 2] which He unrolled before me. And written on the front and back of it were words of lamentation, mourning, and woe.

EZK 3:1.text: “Son of man,” He said to me, “eat what you find here. Eat this scroll, then go and speak to the house of Israel.”
EZK 3:1.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 3 · Israel] “Son of man,” He said to me, “eat what you find here. Eat this scroll, then go and speak to the house of Israel.”

EZK 3:2.text: So I opened my mouth, and He fed me the scroll.
EZK 3:2.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 3] So I opened my mouth, and He fed me the scroll.

EZK 3:3.text: “Son of man,” He said to me, “eat and fill your stomach with this scroll I am giving you.”  So I ate, and it was as sweet as honey in my mouth.
EZK 3:3.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 3 · Generosity] “Son of man,” He said to me, “eat and fill your stomach with this scroll I am giving you.”  So I ate, and it was as sweet as honey in my mouth.

EZK 3:4.text: Then He said to me, “Son of man, go now to the house of Israel and speak My words to them.
EZK 3:4.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 3 · Israel] Then He said to me, “Son of man, go now to the house of Israel and speak My words to them.

EZK 3:5.text: For you are not being sent to a people of unfamiliar speech or difficult language, but to the house of Israel—
EZK 3:5.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 3 · Israel] For you are not being sent to a people of unfamiliar speech or difficult language, but to the house of Israel—

EZK 3:6.text: not to the many peoples of unfamiliar speech and difficult language whose words you cannot understand. Surely if I had sent you to them, they would have listened to you.
EZK 3:6.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 3] not to the many peoples of unfamiliar speech and difficult language whose words you cannot understand. Surely if I had sent you to them, they would have listened to you.

EZK 3:7.text: But the house of Israel will be unwilling to listen to you, since they are unwilling to listen to Me. For the whole house of Israel is hard-headed and hard-hearted.
EZK 3:7.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 3 · Israel] But the house of Israel will be unwilling to listen to you, since they are unwilling to listen to Me. For the whole house of Israel is hard-headed and hard-hearted.

EZK 3:8.text: Behold, I will make your face as hard as their faces, and your forehead as hard as their foreheads.
EZK 3:8.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 3] Behold, I will make your face as hard as their faces, and your forehead as hard as their foreheads.

EZK 3:9.text: I will make your forehead like a diamond, harder than flint. Do not be afraid of them or dismayed at their presence, even though they are a rebellious house.”
EZK 3:9.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 3] I will make your forehead like a diamond, harder than flint. Do not be afraid of them or dismayed at their presence, even though they are a rebellious house.”

EZK 3:10.text: “Son of man,” He added, “listen carefully to all the words I speak to you, and take them to heart.
EZK 3:10.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 3 · Adultery In Heart] “Son of man,” He added, “listen carefully to all the words I speak to you, and take them to heart.

EZK 3:11.text: Go to your people, the exiles; speak to them and tell them, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says,’ whether they listen or refuse to listen.”
EZK 3:11.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 3] Go to your people, the exiles; speak to them and tell them, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says,’ whether they listen or refuse to listen.”

EZK 3:12.text: Then the Spirit lifted me up, and I heard a great rumbling sound behind me: ‘Blessed be the glory of the LORD in His dwelling place!’
EZK 3:12.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 3 · Fruit of the Spirit, Glory] Then the Spirit lifted me up, and I heard a great rumbling sound behind me: ‘Blessed be the glory of the LORD in His dwelling place!’

EZK 3:13.text: It was the sound of the wings of the living creatures brushing against one another and the sound of the wheels beside them, a great rumbling sound.
EZK 3:13.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 3] It was the sound of the wings of the living creatures brushing against one another and the sound of the wheels beside them, a great rumbling sound.

EZK 3:14.text: So the Spirit lifted me up and took me away, and I went in bitterness and in the anger of my spirit, with the strong hand of the LORD upon me.
EZK 3:14.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 3 · Fruit of the Spirit] So the Spirit lifted me up and took me away, and I went in bitterness and in the anger of my spirit, with the strong hand of the LORD upon me.

EZK 3:15.text: I came to the exiles at Tel-abib who dwelt by the River Kebar. And for seven days I sat where they sat and remained there among them, overwhelmed.
EZK 3:15.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 3] I came to the exiles at Tel-abib who dwelt by the River Kebar. And for seven days I sat where they sat and remained there among them, overwhelmed.

EZK 3:16.text: At the end of seven days the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
EZK 3:16.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 3] At the end of seven days the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

EZK 3:17.text: “Son of man, I have made you a watchman for the house of Israel. Whenever you hear a word from My mouth, give them a warning from Me.
EZK 3:17.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 3 · Israel] “Son of man, I have made you a watchman for the house of Israel. Whenever you hear a word from My mouth, give them a warning from Me.

EZK 3:18.text: If I say to the wicked man, ‘You will surely die,’ but you do not warn him or speak out to warn him from his wicked way to save his life, that wicked man will die in his iniquity, and I will hold you responsible for his blood.
EZK 3:18.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 3] If I say to the wicked man, ‘You will surely die,’ but you do not warn him or speak out to warn him from his wicked way to save his life, that wicked man will die in his iniquity, and I will hold you responsible for his blood.

EZK 3:19.text: But if you warn a wicked man and he does not turn from his wickedness and his wicked way, he will die in his iniquity, but you will have saved yourself.
EZK 3:19.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 3] But if you warn a wicked man and he does not turn from his wickedness and his wicked way, he will die in his iniquity, but you will have saved yourself.

EZK 3:20.text: Now if a righteous man turns from his righteousness and commits iniquity, and I put a stumbling block before him, he will die. If you did not warn him, he will die in his sin, and the righteous acts he did will not be remembered. And I will hold you responsible for his blood.
EZK 3:20.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 3] Now if a righteous man turns from his righteousness and commits iniquity, and I put a stumbling block before him, he will die. If you did not warn him, he will die in his sin, and the righteous acts he did will not be remembered. And I will hold you responsible for his blood.

EZK 3:21.text: But if you warn the righteous man not to sin, and he does not sin, he will indeed live because he heeded your warning, and you will have saved yourself.”
EZK 3:21.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 3] But if you warn the righteous man not to sin, and he does not sin, he will indeed live because he heeded your warning, and you will have saved yourself.”

EZK 3:22.text: And there the hand of the LORD was upon me, and He said to me, “Get up, go out to the plain, and there I will speak with you.”
EZK 3:22.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 3] And there the hand of the LORD was upon me, and He said to me, “Get up, go out to the plain, and there I will speak with you.”

EZK 3:23.text: So I got up and went out to the plain, and behold, the glory of the LORD was present there, like the glory I had seen by the River Kebar, and I fell facedown.
EZK 3:23.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 3 · Glory] So I got up and went out to the plain, and behold, the glory of the LORD was present there, like the glory I had seen by the River Kebar, and I fell facedown.

EZK 3:24.text: Then the Spirit entered me and set me on my feet. He spoke with me and said, “Go, shut yourself inside your house.
EZK 3:24.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 3 · Fruit of the Spirit] Then the Spirit entered me and set me on my feet. He spoke with me and said, “Go, shut yourself inside your house.

EZK 3:25.text: And you, son of man, they will tie with ropes, and you will be bound so that you cannot go out among the people.
EZK 3:25.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 3] And you, son of man, they will tie with ropes, and you will be bound so that you cannot go out among the people.

EZK 3:26.text: I will make your tongue stick to the roof of your mouth, and you will be silent and unable to rebuke them, though they are a rebellious house.
EZK 3:26.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 3] I will make your tongue stick to the roof of your mouth, and you will be silent and unable to rebuke them, though they are a rebellious house.

EZK 3:27.text: But when I speak with you, I will open your mouth, and you are to tell them, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says.’ Whoever listens, let him listen; and whoever refuses, let him refuse, for they are a rebellious house.
EZK 3:27.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 3] But when I speak with you, I will open your mouth, and you are to tell them, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says.’ Whoever listens, let him listen; and whoever refuses, let him refuse, for they are a rebellious house.

EZK 4:1.text: “Now you, son of man, take a brick, place it before you, and draw on it the city of Jerusalem.
EZK 4:1.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 4] “Now you, son of man, take a brick, place it before you, and draw on it the city of Jerusalem.

EZK 4:2.text: Then lay siege against it: Construct a siege wall, build a ramp to it, set up camps against it, and place battering rams around it on all sides.
EZK 4:2.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 4] Then lay siege against it: Construct a siege wall, build a ramp to it, set up camps against it, and place battering rams around it on all sides.

EZK 4:3.text: Then take an iron plate and set it up as an iron wall between yourself and the city. Turn your face toward it so that it is under siege, and besiege it. This will be a sign to the house of Israel.
EZK 4:3.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 4 · Israel] Then take an iron plate and set it up as an iron wall between yourself and the city. Turn your face toward it so that it is under siege, and besiege it. This will be a sign to the house of Israel.

EZK 4:4.text: Then lie down on your left side and place the iniquity of the house of Israel upon yourself. You are to bear their iniquity for the number of days you lie on your side.
EZK 4:4.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 4 · Israel] Then lie down on your left side and place the iniquity of the house of Israel upon yourself. You are to bear their iniquity for the number of days you lie on your side.

EZK 4:5.text: For I have assigned to you 390 days, according to the number of years of their iniquity. So you shall bear the iniquity of the house of Israel.
EZK 4:5.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 4 · Israel] For I have assigned to you 390 days, according to the number of years of their iniquity. So you shall bear the iniquity of the house of Israel.

EZK 4:6.text: When you have completed these days, lie down again, but on your right side, and bear the iniquity of the house of Judah. I have assigned to you 40 days, a day for each year.
EZK 4:6.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 4] When you have completed these days, lie down again, but on your right side, and bear the iniquity of the house of Judah. I have assigned to you 40 days, a day for each year.

EZK 4:7.text: You must turn your face toward the siege of Jerusalem with your arm bared, and prophesy against it.
EZK 4:7.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 4] You must turn your face toward the siege of Jerusalem with your arm bared, and prophesy against it.

EZK 4:8.text: Now behold, I will tie you up with ropes so you cannot turn from side to side until you have finished the days of your siege.
EZK 4:8.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 4] Now behold, I will tie you up with ropes so you cannot turn from side to side until you have finished the days of your siege.

EZK 4:9.text: But take wheat, barley, beans, lentils, millet, and spelt; put them in a single container and make them into bread for yourself. This is what you are to eat during the 390 days you lie on your side.
EZK 4:9.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 4] But take wheat, barley, beans, lentils, millet, and spelt; put them in a single container and make them into bread for yourself. This is what you are to eat during the 390 days you lie on your side.

EZK 4:10.text: You are to weigh out twenty shekels of food to eat each day, and you are to eat it at set times.
EZK 4:10.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 4 · End Times] You are to weigh out twenty shekels of food to eat each day, and you are to eat it at set times.

EZK 4:11.text: You are also to measure out a sixth of a hin of water to drink, and you are to drink it at set times.
EZK 4:11.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 4 · End Times] You are also to measure out a sixth of a hin of water to drink, and you are to drink it at set times.

EZK 4:12.text: And you shall eat the food as you would a barley cake, after you bake it over dried human excrement in the sight of the people.”
EZK 4:12.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 4] And you shall eat the food as you would a barley cake, after you bake it over dried human excrement in the sight of the people.”

EZK 4:13.text: Then the LORD said, “This is how the Israelites will eat their defiled bread among the nations to which I will banish them.”
EZK 4:13.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 4] Then the LORD said, “This is how the Israelites will eat their defiled bread among the nations to which I will banish them.”

EZK 4:14.text: “Ah, Lord GOD,” I said, “I have never defiled myself. From my youth until now I have not eaten anything found dead or mauled by wild beasts. No unclean meat has ever entered my mouth.”
EZK 4:14.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 4] “Ah, Lord GOD,” I said, “I have never defiled myself. From my youth until now I have not eaten anything found dead or mauled by wild beasts. No unclean meat has ever entered my mouth.”

EZK 4:15.text: “Look,” He replied, “I will let you use cow dung instead of human excrement, and you may bake your bread over that.”
EZK 4:15.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 4] “Look,” He replied, “I will let you use cow dung instead of human excrement, and you may bake your bread over that.”

EZK 4:16.text: Then He told me, “Son of man, I am going to cut off the supply of food in Jerusalem. They will anxiously eat bread rationed by weight, and in despair they will drink water by measure.
EZK 4:16.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 4] Then He told me, “Son of man, I am going to cut off the supply of food in Jerusalem. They will anxiously eat bread rationed by weight, and in despair they will drink water by measure.

EZK 4:17.text: So they will lack food and water; they will be appalled at the sight of one another wasting away in their iniquity.
EZK 4:17.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 4] So they will lack food and water; they will be appalled at the sight of one another wasting away in their iniquity.

EZK 5:1.text: “As for you, son of man, take a sharp sword, use it as a barber’s razor, and shave your head and beard. Then take a set of scales and divide the hair.
EZK 5:1.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 5] “As for you, son of man, take a sharp sword, use it as a barber’s razor, and shave your head and beard. Then take a set of scales and divide the hair.

EZK 5:2.text: When the days of the siege have ended, you are to burn up a third of the hair inside the city; you are also to take a third and slash it with the sword all around the city; and you are to scatter a third to the wind. For I will unleash a sword behind them.
EZK 5:2.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 5] When the days of the siege have ended, you are to burn up a third of the hair inside the city; you are also to take a third and slash it with the sword all around the city; and you are to scatter a third to the wind. For I will unleash a sword behind them.

EZK 5:3.text: But you are to take a few strands of hair and secure them in the folds of your garment.
EZK 5:3.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 5] But you are to take a few strands of hair and secure them in the folds of your garment.

EZK 5:4.text: Again, take a few of these, throw them into the fire, and burn them. From there a fire will spread to the whole house of Israel.
EZK 5:4.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 5 · Israel] Again, take a few of these, throw them into the fire, and burn them. From there a fire will spread to the whole house of Israel.

EZK 5:5.text: This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘This is Jerusalem, which I have set in the center of the nations, with countries all around her.
EZK 5:5.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 5] This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘This is Jerusalem, which I have set in the center of the nations, with countries all around her.

EZK 5:6.text: But she has rebelled against My ordinances more wickedly than the nations, and against My statutes worse than the countries around her. For her people have rejected My ordinances and have not walked in My statutes.’
EZK 5:6.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 5] But she has rebelled against My ordinances more wickedly than the nations, and against My statutes worse than the countries around her. For her people have rejected My ordinances and have not walked in My statutes.’

EZK 5:7.text: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘You have been more insubordinate than the nations around you; you have not walked in My statutes or kept My ordinances, nor have you even conformed to the ordinances of the nations around you.’
EZK 5:7.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 5] Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘You have been more insubordinate than the nations around you; you have not walked in My statutes or kept My ordinances, nor have you even conformed to the ordinances of the nations around you.’

EZK 5:8.text: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I Myself am against you, Jerusalem, and I will execute judgments among you in the sight of the nations.
EZK 5:8.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 5] Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I Myself am against you, Jerusalem, and I will execute judgments among you in the sight of the nations.

EZK 5:9.text: Because of all your abominations, I will do to you what I have never done before and will never do again.
EZK 5:9.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 5] Because of all your abominations, I will do to you what I have never done before and will never do again.

EZK 5:10.text: As a result, fathers among you will eat their sons, and sons will eat their fathers. I will execute judgments against you and scatter all your remnant to every wind.’
EZK 5:10.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 5] As a result, fathers among you will eat their sons, and sons will eat their fathers. I will execute judgments against you and scatter all your remnant to every wind.’

EZK 5:11.text: Therefore as surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, because you have defiled My sanctuary with all your detestable idols and abominations, I Myself will withdraw My favor; I will not look upon you with pity, nor will I spare you.
EZK 5:11.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 5 · Blessing, Compassion] Therefore as surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, because you have defiled My sanctuary with all your detestable idols and abominations, I Myself will withdraw My favor; I will not look upon you with pity, nor will I spare you.

EZK 5:12.text: A third of your people will die by plague or be consumed by famine within you, a third will fall by the sword outside your walls, and a third I will scatter to every wind and unleash a sword behind them.
EZK 5:12.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 5] A third of your people will die by plague or be consumed by famine within you, a third will fall by the sword outside your walls, and a third I will scatter to every wind and unleash a sword behind them.

EZK 5:13.text: And when My anger is spent and I have vented My wrath against them, I will be appeased. And when I have spent My wrath on them, they will know that I, the LORD, in My zeal have spoken.
EZK 5:13.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 5] And when My anger is spent and I have vented My wrath against them, I will be appeased. And when I have spent My wrath on them, they will know that I, the LORD, in My zeal have spoken.

EZK 5:14.text: I will make you a ruin and a disgrace among the nations around you, in the sight of all who pass by.
EZK 5:14.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 5] I will make you a ruin and a disgrace among the nations around you, in the sight of all who pass by.

EZK 5:15.text: So you will be a reproach and a taunt, a warning and a horror to the nations around you, when I execute judgments against you in anger, wrath, and raging fury. I, the LORD, have spoken.
EZK 5:15.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 5] So you will be a reproach and a taunt, a warning and a horror to the nations around you, when I execute judgments against you in anger, wrath, and raging fury. I, the LORD, have spoken.

EZK 5:16.text: When I shower you with the deadly arrows of famine and destruction that I will send to destroy you, I will intensify the famine against you and cut off your supply of food.
EZK 5:16.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 5 · Destroy Canaan, Destroy Canaanites] When I shower you with the deadly arrows of famine and destruction that I will send to destroy you, I will intensify the famine against you and cut off your supply of food.

EZK 5:17.text: I will send famine and wild beasts against you, and they will leave you childless. Plague and bloodshed will sweep through you, and I will bring a sword against you. I, the LORD, have spoken.”
EZK 5:17.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 5] I will send famine and wild beasts against you, and they will leave you childless. Plague and bloodshed will sweep through you, and I will bring a sword against you. I, the LORD, have spoken.”

EZK 6:1.text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
EZK 6:1.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 6] And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

EZK 6:2.text: “Son of man, set your face against the mountains of Israel and prophesy against them.
EZK 6:2.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 6 · Israel] “Son of man, set your face against the mountains of Israel and prophesy against them.

EZK 6:3.text: You are to say: ‘O mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord GOD! This is what the Lord GOD says to the mountains and hills, to the ravines and valleys: I am about to bring a sword against you, and I will destroy your high places.
EZK 6:3.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 6 · About Forgiveness, Destroy Canaan] You are to say: ‘O mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord GOD! This is what the Lord GOD says to the mountains and hills, to the ravines and valleys: I am about to bring a sword against you, and I will destroy your high places.

EZK 6:4.text: Your altars will be demolished and your incense altars will be smashed; and I will cast down your slain before your idols.
EZK 6:4.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 6 · Idolatry, Idols] Your altars will be demolished and your incense altars will be smashed; and I will cast down your slain before your idols.

EZK 6:5.text: I will lay the corpses of the Israelites before their idols and scatter your bones around your altars.
EZK 6:5.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 6 · Idolatry, Idols] I will lay the corpses of the Israelites before their idols and scatter your bones around your altars.

EZK 6:6.text: Wherever you live, the cities will be laid waste and the high places will be demolished, so that your altars will be laid waste and desecrated, your idols smashed and obliterated, your incense altars cut down, and your works blotted out.
EZK 6:6.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 6 · Idolatry, Idols] Wherever you live, the cities will be laid waste and the high places will be demolished, so that your altars will be laid waste and desecrated, your idols smashed and obliterated, your incense altars cut down, and your works blotted out.

EZK 6:7.text: The slain will fall among you, and you will know that I am the LORD.
EZK 6:7.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 6] The slain will fall among you, and you will know that I am the LORD.

EZK 6:8.text: Yet I will leave a remnant, for some of you will escape the sword when you are scattered among the nations and throughout the lands.
EZK 6:8.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 6] Yet I will leave a remnant, for some of you will escape the sword when you are scattered among the nations and throughout the lands.

EZK 6:9.text: Then in the nations to which they have been carried captive, your survivors will remember Me—how I have been grieved by their adulterous hearts that turned away from Me, and by their eyes that lusted after idols. So they will loathe themselves for the evil they have done and for all their abominations.
EZK 6:9.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 6 · Adulterous, Idolatry] Then in the nations to which they have been carried captive, your survivors will remember Me—how I have been grieved by their adulterous hearts that turned away from Me, and by their eyes that lusted after idols. So they will loathe themselves for the evil they have done and for all their abominations.

EZK 6:10.text: And they will know that I am the LORD; I did not declare in vain that I would bring this calamity upon them.
EZK 6:10.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 6] And they will know that I am the LORD; I did not declare in vain that I would bring this calamity upon them.

EZK 6:11.text: This is what the Lord GOD says: Clap your hands, stomp your feet, and cry out “Alas!” because of all the wicked abominations of the house of Israel, who will fall by sword and famine and plague.
EZK 6:11.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 6 · Israel] This is what the Lord GOD says: Clap your hands, stomp your feet, and cry out “Alas!” because of all the wicked abominations of the house of Israel, who will fall by sword and famine and plague.

EZK 6:12.text: He who is far off will die by the plague, he who is near will fall by the sword, and he who remains will die by famine. So I will vent My fury upon them.
EZK 6:12.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 6] He who is far off will die by the plague, he who is near will fall by the sword, and he who remains will die by famine. So I will vent My fury upon them.

EZK 6:13.text: Then you will know that I am the LORD, when their slain lie among their idols around their altars, on every high hill, on all the mountaintops, and under every green tree and leafy oak—the places where they offered fragrant incense to all their idols.
EZK 6:13.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 6 · Idolatry, Idols] Then you will know that I am the LORD, when their slain lie among their idols around their altars, on every high hill, on all the mountaintops, and under every green tree and leafy oak—the places where they offered fragrant incense to all their idols.

EZK 6:14.text: I will stretch out My hand against them, and wherever they live I will make the land a desolate waste, from the wilderness to Diblah. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’”
EZK 6:14.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 6] I will stretch out My hand against them, and wherever they live I will make the land a desolate waste, from the wilderness to Diblah. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’”

EZK 7:1.text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
EZK 7:1.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 7] And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

EZK 7:2.text: “O son of man, this is what the Lord GOD says to the land of Israel:  ‘The end! The end has come upon the four corners of the land.
EZK 7:2.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 7 · Israel] “O son of man, this is what the Lord GOD says to the land of Israel:  ‘The end! The end has come upon the four corners of the land.

EZK 7:3.text: The end is now upon you, and I will unleash My anger against you. I will judge you according to your ways and repay you for all your abominations.
EZK 7:3.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 7] The end is now upon you, and I will unleash My anger against you. I will judge you according to your ways and repay you for all your abominations.

EZK 7:4.text: I will not look on you with pity, nor will I spare you, but I will punish you for your ways and for the abominations among you.   Then you will know that I am the LORD.’
EZK 7:4.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 7 · Compassion] I will not look on you with pity, nor will I spare you, but I will punish you for your ways and for the abominations among you.   Then you will know that I am the LORD.’

EZK 7:5.text: This is what the Lord GOD says:   ‘Disaster! An unprecedented disaster— behold, it is coming!
EZK 7:5.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 7] This is what the Lord GOD says:   ‘Disaster! An unprecedented disaster— behold, it is coming!

EZK 7:6.text: The end has come! The end has come! It has roused itself against you. Behold, it has come!
EZK 7:6.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 7] The end has come! The end has come! It has roused itself against you. Behold, it has come!

EZK 7:7.text: Doom has come to you, O inhabitants of the land. The time has come; the day is near; there is panic on the mountains instead of shouts of joy.
EZK 7:7.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 7] Doom has come to you, O inhabitants of the land. The time has come; the day is near; there is panic on the mountains instead of shouts of joy.

EZK 7:8.text: Very soon I will pour out My wrath upon you and vent My anger against you; I will judge you according to your ways and repay you for all your abominations.
EZK 7:8.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 7] Very soon I will pour out My wrath upon you and vent My anger against you; I will judge you according to your ways and repay you for all your abominations.

EZK 7:9.text: I will not look on you with pity, nor will I spare you, but I will punish you for your ways and for the abominations among you. Then you will know that it is I, the LORD, who strikes the blow.
EZK 7:9.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 7 · Compassion] I will not look on you with pity, nor will I spare you, but I will punish you for your ways and for the abominations among you. Then you will know that it is I, the LORD, who strikes the blow.

EZK 7:10.text: Behold, the day is here! It has come! Doom has gone out, the rod has budded, arrogance has bloomed.
EZK 7:10.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 7] Behold, the day is here! It has come! Doom has gone out, the rod has budded, arrogance has bloomed.

EZK 7:11.text: Their violence has grown into a rod to punish their wickedness. None of them will remain: none of their multitude, none of their wealth, and nothing of value.
EZK 7:11.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 7] Their violence has grown into a rod to punish their wickedness. None of them will remain: none of their multitude, none of their wealth, and nothing of value.

EZK 7:12.text: The time has come; the day has arrived. Let the buyer not rejoice and the seller not mourn, for wrath is upon the whole multitude.
EZK 7:12.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 7] The time has come; the day has arrived. Let the buyer not rejoice and the seller not mourn, for wrath is upon the whole multitude.

EZK 7:13.text: The seller will surely not recover what he sold while both remain alive. For the vision concerning the whole multitude will not be revoked, and because of their iniquity, not one of them will preserve his life.
EZK 7:13.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 7] The seller will surely not recover what he sold while both remain alive. For the vision concerning the whole multitude will not be revoked, and because of their iniquity, not one of them will preserve his life.

EZK 7:14.text: They have blown the trumpet and made everything ready, but no one goes to war, for My wrath is upon the whole multitude.
EZK 7:14.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 7] They have blown the trumpet and made everything ready, but no one goes to war, for My wrath is upon the whole multitude.

EZK 7:15.text: The sword is outside; plague and famine are within. Those in the country will die by the sword, and those in the city will be devoured by famine and plague.
EZK 7:15.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 7] The sword is outside; plague and famine are within. Those in the country will die by the sword, and those in the city will be devoured by famine and plague.

EZK 7:16.text: The survivors will escape and live in the mountains, moaning like doves of the valley, each for his own iniquity.
EZK 7:16.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 7] The survivors will escape and live in the mountains, moaning like doves of the valley, each for his own iniquity.

EZK 7:17.text: Every hand will go limp, and every knee will turn to water.
EZK 7:17.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 7] Every hand will go limp, and every knee will turn to water.

EZK 7:18.text: They will put on sackcloth, and terror will overwhelm them. Shame will cover all their faces, and all their heads will be shaved.
EZK 7:18.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 7] They will put on sackcloth, and terror will overwhelm them. Shame will cover all their faces, and all their heads will be shaved.

EZK 7:19.text: They will throw their silver into the streets, and their gold will seem unclean. Their silver and gold cannot save them in the day of the wrath of the LORD. They cannot satisfy their appetites or fill their stomachs with wealth, for it became the stumbling block that brought their iniquity.
EZK 7:19.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 7] They will throw their silver into the streets, and their gold will seem unclean. Their silver and gold cannot save them in the day of the wrath of the LORD. They cannot satisfy their appetites or fill their stomachs with wealth, for it became the stumbling block that brought their iniquity.

EZK 7:20.text: His beautiful ornaments they transformed into pride and used them to fashion their vile images and detestable idols. Therefore I will make these into something unclean for them.
EZK 7:20.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 7 · Idolatry, Idols] His beautiful ornaments they transformed into pride and used them to fashion their vile images and detestable idols. Therefore I will make these into something unclean for them.

EZK 7:21.text: And I will hand these things over as plunder to foreigners and loot to the wicked of the earth, who will defile them.
EZK 7:21.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 7] And I will hand these things over as plunder to foreigners and loot to the wicked of the earth, who will defile them.

EZK 7:22.text: I will turn My face away from them, and they will defile My treasured place. Violent men will enter it, and they will defile it.
EZK 7:22.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 7] I will turn My face away from them, and they will defile My treasured place. Violent men will enter it, and they will defile it.

EZK 7:23.text: Forge the chain, for the land is full of crimes of bloodshed, and the city is full of violence.
EZK 7:23.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 7] Forge the chain, for the land is full of crimes of bloodshed, and the city is full of violence.

EZK 7:24.text: So I will bring the most wicked of nations to take possession of their houses. I will end the pride of the mighty, and their holy places will be profaned.
EZK 7:24.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 7] So I will bring the most wicked of nations to take possession of their houses. I will end the pride of the mighty, and their holy places will be profaned.

EZK 7:25.text: Anguish is coming! They will seek peace, but find none.
EZK 7:25.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 7] Anguish is coming! They will seek peace, but find none.

EZK 7:26.text: Disaster upon disaster will come, and rumor after rumor. Then they will seek a vision from a prophet, but instruction from the priests will perish, as will counsel from the elders.
EZK 7:26.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 7 · Leadership] Disaster upon disaster will come, and rumor after rumor. Then they will seek a vision from a prophet, but instruction from the priests will perish, as will counsel from the elders.

EZK 7:27.text: The king will mourn, the prince will be clothed with despair, and the hands of the people of the land will tremble. I will deal with them according to their conduct, and I will judge them by their own standards.   Then they will know that I am the LORD.’”
EZK 7:27.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 7] The king will mourn, the prince will be clothed with despair, and the hands of the people of the land will tremble. I will deal with them according to their conduct, and I will judge them by their own standards.   Then they will know that I am the LORD.’”

EZK 8:1.text: In the sixth year, on the fifth day of the sixth month, I was sitting in my house, and the elders of Judah were sitting before me; and there the hand of the Lord GOD fell upon me.
EZK 8:1.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 8 · Leadership] In the sixth year, on the fifth day of the sixth month, I was sitting in my house, and the elders of Judah were sitting before me; and there the hand of the Lord GOD fell upon me.

EZK 8:2.text: Then I looked and saw a figure like that of a man. From His waist down His appearance was like fire, and from His waist up He was as bright as the gleam of amber.
EZK 8:2.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 8] Then I looked and saw a figure like that of a man. From His waist down His appearance was like fire, and from His waist up He was as bright as the gleam of amber.

EZK 8:3.text: He stretched out what looked like a hand and took me by the hair of my head. Then the Spirit lifted me up between earth and heaven and carried me in visions of God to Jerusalem, to the entrance of the north gate of the inner court, where the idol that provokes jealousy was seated.
EZK 8:3.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 8 · Fruit of the Spirit, Heaven] He stretched out what looked like a hand and took me by the hair of my head. Then the Spirit lifted me up between earth and heaven and carried me in visions of God to Jerusalem, to the entrance of the north gate of the inner court, where the idol that provokes jealousy was seated.

EZK 8:4.text: And there I saw the glory of the God of Israel, like the vision I had seen in the plain.
EZK 8:4.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 8 · Glory, Israel] And there I saw the glory of the God of Israel, like the vision I had seen in the plain.

EZK 8:5.text: “Son of man,” He said to me, “now lift up your eyes to the north.”  So I lifted up my eyes to the north, and in the entrance north of the Altar Gate I saw this idol of jealousy.
EZK 8:5.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 8 · Jealousy] “Son of man,” He said to me, “now lift up your eyes to the north.”  So I lifted up my eyes to the north, and in the entrance north of the Altar Gate I saw this idol of jealousy.

EZK 8:6.text: “Son of man,” He said to me, “do you see what they are doing—the great abominations that the house of Israel is committing—to drive Me far from My sanctuary? Yet you will see even greater abominations.”
EZK 8:6.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 8 · Israel] “Son of man,” He said to me, “do you see what they are doing—the great abominations that the house of Israel is committing—to drive Me far from My sanctuary? Yet you will see even greater abominations.”

EZK 8:7.text: Then He brought me to the entrance to the court, and I looked and saw a hole in the wall.
EZK 8:7.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 8] Then He brought me to the entrance to the court, and I looked and saw a hole in the wall.

EZK 8:8.text: “Son of man,” He told me, “dig through the wall.”  So I dug through the wall and discovered a doorway.
EZK 8:8.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 8] “Son of man,” He told me, “dig through the wall.”  So I dug through the wall and discovered a doorway.

EZK 8:9.text: Then He said to me, “Go in and see the wicked abominations they are committing here.”
EZK 8:9.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 8] Then He said to me, “Go in and see the wicked abominations they are committing here.”

EZK 8:10.text: So I went in and looked, and engraved all around the wall was every kind of crawling creature and detestable beast, along with all the idols of the house of Israel.
EZK 8:10.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 8 · Antichrist, Idolatry] So I went in and looked, and engraved all around the wall was every kind of crawling creature and detestable beast, along with all the idols of the house of Israel.

EZK 8:11.text: Before them stood seventy elders of the house of Israel, with Jaazaniah son of Shaphan standing among them. Each had a censer in his hand, and a fragrant cloud of incense was rising.
EZK 8:11.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 8 · Israel, Leadership] Before them stood seventy elders of the house of Israel, with Jaazaniah son of Shaphan standing among them. Each had a censer in his hand, and a fragrant cloud of incense was rising.

EZK 8:12.text: “Son of man,” He said to me, “do you see what the elders of the house of Israel are doing in the darkness, each at the shrine of his own idol? For they are saying, ‘The LORD does not see us; the LORD has forsaken the land.’”
EZK 8:12.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 8 · Israel, Leadership] “Son of man,” He said to me, “do you see what the elders of the house of Israel are doing in the darkness, each at the shrine of his own idol? For they are saying, ‘The LORD does not see us; the LORD has forsaken the land.’”

EZK 8:13.text: Again, He told me, “You will see them committing even greater abominations.”
EZK 8:13.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 8] Again, He told me, “You will see them committing even greater abominations.”

EZK 8:14.text: Then He brought me to the entrance of the north gate of the house of the LORD, and I saw women sitting there, weeping for Tammuz.
EZK 8:14.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 8 · Biblical Women, Heroic Women] Then He brought me to the entrance of the north gate of the house of the LORD, and I saw women sitting there, weeping for Tammuz.

EZK 8:15.text: “Son of man,” He said to me, “do you see this? Yet you will see even greater abominations than these.”
EZK 8:15.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 8] “Son of man,” He said to me, “do you see this? Yet you will see even greater abominations than these.”

EZK 8:16.text: So He brought me to the inner court of the house of the LORD, and there at the entrance to the temple of the LORD, between the portico and the altar, were about twenty-five men with their backs to the temple of the LORD and their faces toward the east; and they were bowing to the east in worship of the sun.
EZK 8:16.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 8 · About Forgiveness] So He brought me to the inner court of the house of the LORD, and there at the entrance to the temple of the LORD, between the portico and the altar, were about twenty-five men with their backs to the temple of the LORD and their faces toward the east; and they were bowing to the east in worship of the sun.

EZK 8:17.text: “Son of man,” He said to me, “do you see this? Is it not enough for the house of Judah to commit the abominations they are practicing here, that they must also fill the land with violence and continually provoke Me to anger? Look, they are even putting the branch to their nose!
EZK 8:17.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 8] “Son of man,” He said to me, “do you see this? Is it not enough for the house of Judah to commit the abominations they are practicing here, that they must also fill the land with violence and continually provoke Me to anger? Look, they are even putting the branch to their nose!

EZK 8:18.text: Therefore I will respond with wrath. I will not look on them with pity, nor will I spare them. Although they shout loudly in My ears, I will not listen to them.”
EZK 8:18.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 8 · Compassion] Therefore I will respond with wrath. I will not look on them with pity, nor will I spare them. Although they shout loudly in My ears, I will not listen to them.”
