EZK 18:13.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 18] He engages in usury and takes excess interest.   Will this son live? He will not! Since he has committed all these abominations, he will surely die; his blood will be on his own head.

EZK 18:14.text: Now suppose this son has a son who sees all the sins his father has committed, considers them, and does not do likewise:
EZK 18:14.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 18 · God the Father] Now suppose this son has a son who sees all the sins his father has committed, considers them, and does not do likewise:

EZK 18:15.text: He does not eat at the mountain or look to the idols of the house of Israel. He does not defile his neighbor’s wife.
EZK 18:15.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 18 · Idolatry, Idols] He does not eat at the mountain or look to the idols of the house of Israel. He does not defile his neighbor’s wife.

EZK 18:16.text: He does not oppress another, or retain a pledge, or commit robbery. He gives his bread to the hungry and covers the naked with clothing.
EZK 18:16.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 18] He does not oppress another, or retain a pledge, or commit robbery. He gives his bread to the hungry and covers the naked with clothing.

EZK 18:17.text: He withholds his hand from harming the poor and takes no interest or usury. He keeps My ordinances and follows My statutes.   Such a man will not die for his father’s iniquity. He will surely live.
EZK 18:17.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 18 · God the Father] He withholds his hand from harming the poor and takes no interest or usury. He keeps My ordinances and follows My statutes.   Such a man will not die for his father’s iniquity. He will surely live.

EZK 18:18.text: As for his father, he will die for his own iniquity, because he practiced extortion, robbed his brother, and did what was wrong among his people.
EZK 18:18.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 18 · God the Father] As for his father, he will die for his own iniquity, because he practiced extortion, robbed his brother, and did what was wrong among his people.

EZK 18:19.text: Yet you may ask, ‘Why shouldn’t the son bear the iniquity of his father?’  Since the son has done what is just and right, carefully observing all My statutes, he will surely live.
EZK 18:19.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 18 · God the Father] Yet you may ask, ‘Why shouldn’t the son bear the iniquity of his father?’  Since the son has done what is just and right, carefully observing all My statutes, he will surely live.

EZK 18:20.text: The soul who sins is the one who will die. A son will not bear the iniquity of his father, and a father will not bear the iniquity of his son. The righteousness of the righteous man will fall upon him, and the wickedness of the wicked man will fall upon him.
EZK 18:20.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 18 · God the Father] The soul who sins is the one who will die. A son will not bear the iniquity of his father, and a father will not bear the iniquity of his son. The righteousness of the righteous man will fall upon him, and the wickedness of the wicked man will fall upon him.

EZK 18:21.text: But if the wicked man turns from all the sins he has committed, keeps all My statutes, and does what is just and right, he will surely live; he will not die.
EZK 18:21.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 18] But if the wicked man turns from all the sins he has committed, keeps all My statutes, and does what is just and right, he will surely live; he will not die.

EZK 18:22.text: None of the transgressions he has committed will be held against him. Because of the righteousness he has practiced, he will live.
EZK 18:22.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 18] None of the transgressions he has committed will be held against him. Because of the righteousness he has practiced, he will live.

EZK 18:23.text: Do I take any pleasure in the death of the wicked? declares the Lord GOD. Wouldn’t I prefer that he turn from his ways and live?
EZK 18:23.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 18 · Death] Do I take any pleasure in the death of the wicked? declares the Lord GOD. Wouldn’t I prefer that he turn from his ways and live?

EZK 18:24.text: But if a righteous man turns from his righteousness and practices iniquity, committing the same abominations as the wicked, will he live? None of the righteous acts he did will be remembered. Because of the unfaithfulness and sin he has committed, he will die.
EZK 18:24.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 18 · Faith, Adultery] But if a righteous man turns from his righteousness and practices iniquity, committing the same abominations as the wicked, will he live? None of the righteous acts he did will be remembered. Because of the unfaithfulness and sin he has committed, he will die.

EZK 18:25.text: Yet you say, ‘The way of the Lord is not just.’  Hear now, O house of Israel: Is it My way that is unjust? Is it not your ways that are unjust?
EZK 18:25.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 18 · Israel] Yet you say, ‘The way of the Lord is not just.’  Hear now, O house of Israel: Is it My way that is unjust? Is it not your ways that are unjust?

EZK 18:26.text: If a righteous man turns from his righteousness and practices iniquity, he will die for this. He will die because of the iniquity he has committed.
EZK 18:26.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 18] If a righteous man turns from his righteousness and practices iniquity, he will die for this. He will die because of the iniquity he has committed.

EZK 18:27.text: But if a wicked man turns from the wickedness he has committed and does what is just and right, he will save his life.
EZK 18:27.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 18] But if a wicked man turns from the wickedness he has committed and does what is just and right, he will save his life.

EZK 18:28.text: Because he considered and turned from all the transgressions he had committed, he will surely live; he will not die.
EZK 18:28.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 18] Because he considered and turned from all the transgressions he had committed, he will surely live; he will not die.

EZK 18:29.text: Yet the house of Israel says, ‘The way of the Lord is not just.’  Are My ways unjust, O house of Israel? Is it not your ways that are unjust?
EZK 18:29.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 18 · Israel] Yet the house of Israel says, ‘The way of the Lord is not just.’  Are My ways unjust, O house of Israel? Is it not your ways that are unjust?

EZK 18:30.text: Therefore, O house of Israel, I will judge you, each according to his ways, declares the Lord GOD. Repent and turn from all your transgressions, so that your iniquity will not become your downfall.
EZK 18:30.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 18 · Israel] Therefore, O house of Israel, I will judge you, each according to his ways, declares the Lord GOD. Repent and turn from all your transgressions, so that your iniquity will not become your downfall.

EZK 18:31.text: Cast away from yourselves all the transgressions you have committed, and fashion for yourselves a new heart and a new spirit. Why should you die, O house of Israel?
EZK 18:31.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 18 · Adultery In Heart, Fruit of the Spirit] Cast away from yourselves all the transgressions you have committed, and fashion for yourselves a new heart and a new spirit. Why should you die, O house of Israel?

EZK 18:32.text: For I take no pleasure in anyone’s death, declares the Lord GOD. So repent and live!
EZK 18:32.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 18 · Death] For I take no pleasure in anyone’s death, declares the Lord GOD. So repent and live!

EZK 19:1.text: “As for you, take up a lament for the princes of Israel
EZK 19:1.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 19 · Israel] “As for you, take up a lament for the princes of Israel

EZK 19:2.text: and say:  ‘What was your mother? A lioness among the lions! She lay down among the young lions; she reared her cubs.
EZK 19:2.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 19] and say:  ‘What was your mother? A lioness among the lions! She lay down among the young lions; she reared her cubs.

EZK 19:3.text: She brought up one of her cubs, and he became a young lion. After learning to tear his prey, he devoured men.
EZK 19:3.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 19] She brought up one of her cubs, and he became a young lion. After learning to tear his prey, he devoured men.

EZK 19:4.text: When the nations heard of him, he was trapped in their pit. With hooks they led him away to the land of Egypt.
EZK 19:4.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 19] When the nations heard of him, he was trapped in their pit. With hooks they led him away to the land of Egypt.

EZK 19:5.text: When she saw that she had waited in vain, that her hope was lost, she took another of her cubs and made him a young lion.
EZK 19:5.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 19] When she saw that she had waited in vain, that her hope was lost, she took another of her cubs and made him a young lion.

EZK 19:6.text: He prowled among the lions, and became a young lion. After learning to tear his prey, he devoured men.
EZK 19:6.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 19] He prowled among the lions, and became a young lion. After learning to tear his prey, he devoured men.

EZK 19:7.text: He broke down their strongholds and devastated their cities. The land and everything in it shuddered at the sound of his roaring.
EZK 19:7.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 19] He broke down their strongholds and devastated their cities. The land and everything in it shuddered at the sound of his roaring.

EZK 19:8.text: Then the nations set out against him from the provinces on every side. They spread their net over him; he was trapped in their pit.
EZK 19:8.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 19] Then the nations set out against him from the provinces on every side. They spread their net over him; he was trapped in their pit.

EZK 19:9.text: With hooks they caged him and brought him to the king of Babylon. They brought him into captivity so that his roar was heard no longer on the mountains of Israel.
EZK 19:9.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 19 · Israel] With hooks they caged him and brought him to the king of Babylon. They brought him into captivity so that his roar was heard no longer on the mountains of Israel.

EZK 19:10.text: Your mother was like a vine in your vineyard, planted by the water; it was fruitful and full of branches because of the abundant waters.
EZK 19:10.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 19] Your mother was like a vine in your vineyard, planted by the water; it was fruitful and full of branches because of the abundant waters.

EZK 19:11.text: It had strong branches, fit for a ruler’s scepter. It towered high above the thick branches, conspicuous for its height and for its dense foliage.
EZK 19:11.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 19] It had strong branches, fit for a ruler’s scepter. It towered high above the thick branches, conspicuous for its height and for its dense foliage.

EZK 19:12.text: But it was uprooted in fury, cast down to the ground, and the east wind dried up its fruit. Its strong branches were stripped off and they withered; the fire consumed them.
EZK 19:12.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 19 · Fruit of the Spirit] But it was uprooted in fury, cast down to the ground, and the east wind dried up its fruit. Its strong branches were stripped off and they withered; the fire consumed them.

EZK 19:13.text: Now it is planted in the wilderness, in a dry and thirsty land.
EZK 19:13.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 19] Now it is planted in the wilderness, in a dry and thirsty land.

EZK 19:14.text: Fire has gone out from its main branch and devoured its fruit; on it no strong branch remains fit for a ruler’s scepter.’   This is a lament and shall be used as a lament.”
EZK 19:14.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 19 · Fruit of the Spirit] Fire has gone out from its main branch and devoured its fruit; on it no strong branch remains fit for a ruler’s scepter.’   This is a lament and shall be used as a lament.”

EZK 20:1.text: In the seventh year, on the tenth day of the fifth month, some of the elders of Israel came to inquire of the LORD, and they sat down before me.
EZK 20:1.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 20 · Israel, Leadership] In the seventh year, on the tenth day of the fifth month, some of the elders of Israel came to inquire of the LORD, and they sat down before me.

EZK 20:2.text: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
EZK 20:2.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 20] Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

EZK 20:3.text: “Son of man, speak to the elders of Israel and tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: Have you come to inquire of Me? As surely as I live, I will not be consulted by you, declares the Lord GOD.
EZK 20:3.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 20 · Israel, Leadership] “Son of man, speak to the elders of Israel and tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: Have you come to inquire of Me? As surely as I live, I will not be consulted by you, declares the Lord GOD.

EZK 20:4.text: Will you judge them, will you judge them, son of man? Confront them with the abominations of their fathers
EZK 20:4.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 20] Will you judge them, will you judge them, son of man? Confront them with the abominations of their fathers

EZK 20:5.text: and tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: On the day I chose Israel, I swore an oath to the descendants of the house of Jacob and made Myself known to them in the land of Egypt. With an uplifted hand I said to them, ‘I am the LORD your God.’
EZK 20:5.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 20 · Israel] and tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: On the day I chose Israel, I swore an oath to the descendants of the house of Jacob and made Myself known to them in the land of Egypt. With an uplifted hand I said to them, ‘I am the LORD your God.’

EZK 20:6.text: On that day I swore to bring them out of the land of Egypt into a land that I had searched out for them, a land flowing with milk and honey, the glory of all lands.
EZK 20:6.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 20 · Glory] On that day I swore to bring them out of the land of Egypt into a land that I had searched out for them, a land flowing with milk and honey, the glory of all lands.

EZK 20:7.text: And I said to them: ‘Each of you must throw away the abominations before his eyes, and you must not defile yourselves with the idols of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.’
EZK 20:7.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 20 · Idolatry, Idols] And I said to them: ‘Each of you must throw away the abominations before his eyes, and you must not defile yourselves with the idols of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.’

EZK 20:8.text: But they rebelled against Me and refused to listen. None of them cast away the abominations before their eyes, and they did not forsake the idols of Egypt. So I resolved to pour out My wrath upon them and vent My anger against them in the land of Egypt.
EZK 20:8.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 20 · Idolatry, Idols] But they rebelled against Me and refused to listen. None of them cast away the abominations before their eyes, and they did not forsake the idols of Egypt. So I resolved to pour out My wrath upon them and vent My anger against them in the land of Egypt.

EZK 20:9.text: But I acted for the sake of My name, that it should not be profaned in the eyes of the nations among whom they were living, in whose sight I had revealed Myself to Israel by bringing them out of the land of Egypt.
EZK 20:9.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 20 · Israel] But I acted for the sake of My name, that it should not be profaned in the eyes of the nations among whom they were living, in whose sight I had revealed Myself to Israel by bringing them out of the land of Egypt.

EZK 20:10.text: So I brought them out of the land of Egypt and led them into the wilderness.
EZK 20:10.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 20] So I brought them out of the land of Egypt and led them into the wilderness.

EZK 20:11.text: And I gave them My statutes and made known to them My ordinances—for the man who does these things will live by them.
EZK 20:11.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 20] And I gave them My statutes and made known to them My ordinances—for the man who does these things will live by them.

EZK 20:12.text: I also gave them My Sabbaths as a sign between us, so that they would know that I am the LORD who sanctifies them.
EZK 20:12.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 20] I also gave them My Sabbaths as a sign between us, so that they would know that I am the LORD who sanctifies them.

EZK 20:13.text: Yet the house of Israel rebelled against Me in the wilderness. They did not follow My statutes and they rejected My ordinances—though the man who does these things will live by them—and they utterly profaned My Sabbaths. Then I resolved to pour out My wrath upon them and put an end to them in the wilderness.
EZK 20:13.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 20 · Israel] Yet the house of Israel rebelled against Me in the wilderness. They did not follow My statutes and they rejected My ordinances—though the man who does these things will live by them—and they utterly profaned My Sabbaths. Then I resolved to pour out My wrath upon them and put an end to them in the wilderness.

EZK 20:14.text: But I acted for the sake of My name, so that it would not be profaned in the eyes of the nations in whose sight I had brought them out.
EZK 20:14.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 20] But I acted for the sake of My name, so that it would not be profaned in the eyes of the nations in whose sight I had brought them out.

EZK 20:15.text: Moreover, with an uplifted hand I swore to them in the wilderness that I would not bring them into the land that I had given them—a land flowing with milk and honey, the glory of all lands—
EZK 20:15.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 20 · Glory] Moreover, with an uplifted hand I swore to them in the wilderness that I would not bring them into the land that I had given them—a land flowing with milk and honey, the glory of all lands—

EZK 20:16.text: because they kept rejecting My ordinances, refusing to walk in My statutes, and profaning My Sabbaths; for their hearts continually went after their idols.
EZK 20:16.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 20 · Idolatry, Idols] because they kept rejecting My ordinances, refusing to walk in My statutes, and profaning My Sabbaths; for their hearts continually went after their idols.

EZK 20:17.text: Yet I looked on them with pity and did not destroy them or bring them to an end in the wilderness.
EZK 20:17.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 20 · Compassion, Destroy Canaan] Yet I looked on them with pity and did not destroy them or bring them to an end in the wilderness.

EZK 20:18.text: In the wilderness I said to their children: ‘Do not walk in the statutes of your fathers or keep their ordinances or defile yourselves with their idols.
EZK 20:18.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 20 · Children, Idolatry] In the wilderness I said to their children: ‘Do not walk in the statutes of your fathers or keep their ordinances or defile yourselves with their idols.

EZK 20:19.text: I am the LORD your God; walk in My statutes, keep My ordinances, and practice them.
EZK 20:19.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 20] I am the LORD your God; walk in My statutes, keep My ordinances, and practice them.

EZK 20:20.text: Keep My Sabbaths holy, that they may be a sign between us, so that you may know that I am the LORD your God.’
EZK 20:20.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 20] Keep My Sabbaths holy, that they may be a sign between us, so that you may know that I am the LORD your God.’

EZK 20:21.text: But the children rebelled against Me. They did not walk in My statutes or carefully observe My ordinances—though the man who does these things will live by them—and they profaned My Sabbaths. So I resolved to pour out My wrath upon them and vent My anger against them in the wilderness.
EZK 20:21.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 20 · Children] But the children rebelled against Me. They did not walk in My statutes or carefully observe My ordinances—though the man who does these things will live by them—and they profaned My Sabbaths. So I resolved to pour out My wrath upon them and vent My anger against them in the wilderness.

EZK 20:22.text: But I withheld My hand and acted for the sake of My name, so that it would not be profaned in the eyes of the nations in whose sight I had brought them out.
EZK 20:22.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 20] But I withheld My hand and acted for the sake of My name, so that it would not be profaned in the eyes of the nations in whose sight I had brought them out.

EZK 20:23.text: However, with an uplifted hand I swore to them in the wilderness that I would scatter them among the nations and disperse them throughout the lands.
EZK 20:23.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 20] However, with an uplifted hand I swore to them in the wilderness that I would scatter them among the nations and disperse them throughout the lands.

EZK 20:24.text: For they did not practice My ordinances, but they rejected My statutes and profaned My Sabbaths, fixing their eyes on the idols of their fathers.
EZK 20:24.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 20 · Idolatry, Idols] For they did not practice My ordinances, but they rejected My statutes and profaned My Sabbaths, fixing their eyes on the idols of their fathers.

EZK 20:25.text: I also gave them over to statutes that were not good and ordinances by which they could not live.
EZK 20:25.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 20] I also gave them over to statutes that were not good and ordinances by which they could not live.

EZK 20:26.text: And I pronounced them unclean through their gifts—the sacrifice of every firstborn in the fire—so that I might devastate them, in order that they would know that I am the LORD.
EZK 20:26.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 20] And I pronounced them unclean through their gifts—the sacrifice of every firstborn in the fire—so that I might devastate them, in order that they would know that I am the LORD.

EZK 20:27.text: Therefore, son of man, speak to the house of Israel, and tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: In this way also your fathers blasphemed Me by their unfaithfulness against Me.
EZK 20:27.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 20 · Faith, Adultery] Therefore, son of man, speak to the house of Israel, and tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: In this way also your fathers blasphemed Me by their unfaithfulness against Me.

EZK 20:28.text: When I brought them into the land that I swore to give them and they saw any high hill or leafy tree, there they offered their sacrifices, presented offerings that provoked Me, sent up their fragrant incense, and poured out their drink offerings.
EZK 20:28.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 20] When I brought them into the land that I swore to give them and they saw any high hill or leafy tree, there they offered their sacrifices, presented offerings that provoked Me, sent up their fragrant incense, and poured out their drink offerings.

EZK 20:29.text: So I asked them: ‘What is this high place to which you go?’  (And to this day it is called Bamah.)
EZK 20:29.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 20] So I asked them: ‘What is this high place to which you go?’  (And to this day it is called Bamah.)

EZK 20:30.text: Therefore tell the house of Israel that this is what the Lord GOD says: Will you defile yourselves the way your fathers did, prostituting yourselves with their abominations?
EZK 20:30.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 20 · Israel] Therefore tell the house of Israel that this is what the Lord GOD says: Will you defile yourselves the way your fathers did, prostituting yourselves with their abominations?

EZK 20:31.text: When you offer your gifts, sacrificing your sons in the fire, you continue to defile yourselves with all your idols to this day. So should I be consulted by you, O house of Israel? As surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, I will not be consulted by you!
EZK 20:31.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 20 · Idolatry, Idols] When you offer your gifts, sacrificing your sons in the fire, you continue to defile yourselves with all your idols to this day. So should I be consulted by you, O house of Israel? As surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, I will not be consulted by you!

EZK 20:32.text: When you say, ‘Let us be like the nations, like the peoples of the lands, serving wood and stone,’ what you have in mind will never come to pass.
EZK 20:32.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 20] When you say, ‘Let us be like the nations, like the peoples of the lands, serving wood and stone,’ what you have in mind will never come to pass.

EZK 20:33.text: As surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, with a strong hand, an outstretched arm, and outpoured wrath I will rule over you.
EZK 20:33.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 20] As surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, with a strong hand, an outstretched arm, and outpoured wrath I will rule over you.

EZK 20:34.text: With a strong hand, an outstretched arm, and outpoured wrath I will bring you out from the peoples and gather you from the lands to which you have been scattered.
EZK 20:34.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 20] With a strong hand, an outstretched arm, and outpoured wrath I will bring you out from the peoples and gather you from the lands to which you have been scattered.

EZK 20:35.text: And I will bring you into the wilderness of the nations, where I will enter into judgment with you face to face.
EZK 20:35.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 20 · Judgment] And I will bring you into the wilderness of the nations, where I will enter into judgment with you face to face.

EZK 20:36.text: Just as I entered into judgment with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so I will enter into judgment with you, declares the Lord GOD.
EZK 20:36.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 20 · Judgment] Just as I entered into judgment with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so I will enter into judgment with you, declares the Lord GOD.

EZK 20:37.text: I will make you pass under the rod and will bring you into the bond of the covenant.
EZK 20:37.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 20 · Covenant] I will make you pass under the rod and will bring you into the bond of the covenant.

EZK 20:38.text: And I will purge you of those who rebel and transgress against Me. I will bring them out of the land in which they dwell, but they will not enter the land of Israel. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
EZK 20:38.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 20 · Israel] And I will purge you of those who rebel and transgress against Me. I will bring them out of the land in which they dwell, but they will not enter the land of Israel. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

EZK 20:39.text: And as for you, O house of Israel, this is what the Lord GOD says: Go and serve your idols, every one of you. But afterward, you will surely listen to Me, and you will no longer defile My holy name with your gifts and idols.
EZK 20:39.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 20 · Idolatry, Idols] And as for you, O house of Israel, this is what the Lord GOD says: Go and serve your idols, every one of you. But afterward, you will surely listen to Me, and you will no longer defile My holy name with your gifts and idols.

EZK 20:40.text: For on My holy mountain, the high mountain of Israel, declares the Lord GOD, there the whole house of Israel, all of them, will serve Me in the land. There I will accept them and will require your offerings and choice gifts, along with all your holy sacrifices.
EZK 20:40.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 20 · Israel] For on My holy mountain, the high mountain of Israel, declares the Lord GOD, there the whole house of Israel, all of them, will serve Me in the land. There I will accept them and will require your offerings and choice gifts, along with all your holy sacrifices.

EZK 20:41.text: When I bring you from the peoples and gather you from the lands to which you have been scattered, I will accept you as a pleasing aroma. And I will show My holiness through you in the sight of the nations.
EZK 20:41.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 20 · Holiness] When I bring you from the peoples and gather you from the lands to which you have been scattered, I will accept you as a pleasing aroma. And I will show My holiness through you in the sight of the nations.

EZK 32:12.text: I will make your hordes fall by the swords of the mighty, the most ruthless of all nations. They will ravage the pride of Egypt and all her multitudes will be destroyed.
EZK 32:12.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 32] I will make your hordes fall by the swords of the mighty, the most ruthless of all nations. They will ravage the pride of Egypt and all her multitudes will be destroyed.

EZK 32:13.text: I will slaughter all her cattle beside the abundant waters. No human foot will muddy them again, and no cattle hooves will disturb them.
EZK 32:13.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 32] I will slaughter all her cattle beside the abundant waters. No human foot will muddy them again, and no cattle hooves will disturb them.

EZK 32:14.text: Then I will let her waters settle and will make her rivers flow like oil,’ declares the Lord GOD.
EZK 32:14.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 32] Then I will let her waters settle and will make her rivers flow like oil,’ declares the Lord GOD.

EZK 32:15.text: ‘When I make the land of Egypt a desolation and empty it of all that filled it, when I strike down all who live there, then they will know that I am the LORD.’
EZK 32:15.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 32] ‘When I make the land of Egypt a desolation and empty it of all that filled it, when I strike down all who live there, then they will know that I am the LORD.’

EZK 32:16.text: This is the lament they will chant for her; the daughters of the nations will chant it. Over Egypt and all her multitudes they will chant it, declares the Lord GOD.”
EZK 32:16.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 32] This is the lament they will chant for her; the daughters of the nations will chant it. Over Egypt and all her multitudes they will chant it, declares the Lord GOD.”

EZK 32:17.text: In the twelfth year, on the fifteenth day of the month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
EZK 32:17.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 32] In the twelfth year, on the fifteenth day of the month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

EZK 32:18.text: “Son of man, wail for the multitudes of Egypt, and consign her and the daughters of the mighty nations to the depths of the earth with those who descend to the Pit:
EZK 32:18.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 32] “Son of man, wail for the multitudes of Egypt, and consign her and the daughters of the mighty nations to the depths of the earth with those who descend to the Pit:

EZK 32:19.text: Whom do you surpass in beauty? Go down and be placed with the uncircumcised!
EZK 32:19.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 32] Whom do you surpass in beauty? Go down and be placed with the uncircumcised!

EZK 32:20.text: They will fall among those slain by the sword. The sword is appointed! Let them drag her away along with all her multitudes.
EZK 32:20.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 32] They will fall among those slain by the sword. The sword is appointed! Let them drag her away along with all her multitudes.

EZK 32:21.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 32 · About Forgiveness, Death] Mighty chiefs will speak from the midst of Sheol about Egypt and her allies: ‘They have come down and lie with the uncircumcised, with those slain by the sword.’

EZK 32:22.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 32] Assyria is there with her whole company; her graves are all around her. All of them are slain, fallen by the sword.

EZK 32:23.text: Her graves are set in the depths of the Pit, and her company is all around her grave. All of them are slain, fallen by the sword— those who once spread terror in the land of the living.
EZK 32:23.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 32 · Death] Her graves are set in the depths of the Pit, and her company is all around her grave. All of them are slain, fallen by the sword— those who once spread terror in the land of the living.

EZK 32:24.text: Elam is there with all her multitudes around her grave. All of them are slain, fallen by the sword— those who went down uncircumcised to the earth below, who once spread their terror in the land of the living. They bear their disgrace with those who descend to the Pit.
EZK 32:24.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 32 · Death] Elam is there with all her multitudes around her grave. EZK 32:25.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 32] Among the slain they prepare a resting place for Elam with all her hordes, with her graves all around her. They are placed among the slain.

EZK 32:26.text: Meshech and Tubal are there with all their multitudes, with their graves all around them. All of them are uncircumcised, slain by the sword, because they spread their terror in the land of the living.
EZK 32:26.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 32] Meshech and Tubal are there with all their multitudes, with their graves all around them. All of them are uncircumcised, slain by the sword, because they spread their terror in the land of the living.

EZK 32:27.text: They do not lie down with the fallen warriors of old, who went down to Sheol with their weapons of war, whose swords were placed under their heads, whose shields rested on their bones, although the terror of the mighty was once in the land of the living.
EZK 32:27.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 32 · Death] They do not lie down with the fallen warriors of old, who went down to Sheol with their weapons of war, whose swords were placed under their heads, whose shields rested on their bones, although the terror of the mighty was once in the land of the living.

EZK 32:28.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 32] But you too will be shattered and lie down among the uncircumcised, with those slain by the sword.

EZK 32:29.text: Edom is there, and all her kings and princes, who despite their might are laid among those slain by the sword. They lie down with the uncircumcised, with those who descend to the Pit.
EZK 32:29.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 32] Edom is there, and all her kings and princes, who despite their might are laid among those slain by the sword. They lie down with the uncircumcised, with those who descend to the Pit.

EZK 32:30.text: All the leaders of the north and all the Sidonians are there; they went down in disgrace with the slain, despite the terror of their might. They lie uncircumcised with those slain by the sword and bear their shame with those who descend to the Pit.
EZK 32:30.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 32] All the leaders of the north and all the Sidonians are there; they went down in disgrace with the slain, despite the terror of their might. They lie uncircumcised with those slain by the sword and bear their shame with those who descend to the Pit.

EZK 32:31.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 32] Pharaoh will see them and be comforted over all his multitude— Pharaoh and all his army, slain by the sword, declares the Lord GOD.

EZK 32:32.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 32] For I will spread My terror in the land of the living, so that Pharaoh and all his multitude will be laid to rest among the uncircumcised, with those slain by the sword, declares the Lord GOD.”

EZK 33:1.text: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
EZK 33:1.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 33] Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

EZK 33:2.text: “Son of man, speak to your people and tell them: ‘Suppose I bring the sword against a land, and the people of that land choose a man from among them, appointing him as their watchman,
EZK 33:2.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 33] “Son of man, speak to your people and tell them: ‘Suppose I bring the sword against a land, and the people of that land choose a man from among them, appointing him as their watchman,

EZK 33:3.text: and he sees the sword coming against that land and blows the ram’s horn to warn the people.
EZK 33:3.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 33] and he sees the sword coming against that land and blows the ram’s horn to warn the people.

EZK 33:4.text: Then if anyone hears the sound of the horn but fails to heed the warning, and the sword comes and takes him away, his blood will be on his own head.
EZK 33:4.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 33] Then if anyone hears the sound of the horn but fails to heed the warning, and the sword comes and takes him away, his blood will be on his own head.

EZK 33:5.text: Since he heard the sound of the horn but failed to heed the warning, his blood will be on his own head. If he had heeded the warning, he would have saved his life.
EZK 33:5.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 33] Since he heard the sound of the horn but failed to heed the warning, his blood will be on his own head. If he had heeded the warning, he would have saved his life.

EZK 33:6.text: But if the watchman sees the sword coming and fails to blow the horn to warn the people, and the sword comes and takes away a life, then that one will be taken away in his iniquity, but I will hold the watchman accountable for his blood.’
EZK 33:6.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 33] But if the watchman sees the sword coming and fails to blow the horn to warn the people, and the sword comes and takes away a life, then that one will be taken away in his iniquity, but I will hold the watchman accountable for his blood.’

EZK 33:7.text: As for you, O son of man, I have made you a watchman for the house of Israel; so hear the word from My mouth and give them the warning from Me.
EZK 33:7.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 33 · Israel] As for you, O son of man, I have made you a watchman for the house of Israel; so hear the word from My mouth and give them the warning from Me.

EZK 33:8.text: If I say to the wicked, ‘O wicked man, you will surely die,’ but you do not speak out to dissuade him from his way, then that wicked man will die in his iniquity, yet I will hold you accountable for his blood.
EZK 33:8.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 33] If I say to the wicked, ‘O wicked man, you will surely die,’ but you do not speak out to dissuade him from his way, then that wicked man will die in his iniquity, yet I will hold you accountable for his blood.

EZK 33:9.text: But if you warn the wicked man to turn from his way, and he does not turn from it, he will die in his iniquity, but you will have saved your life.
EZK 33:9.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 33] But if you warn the wicked man to turn from his way, and he does not turn from it, he will die in his iniquity, but you will have saved your life.

EZK 33:10.text: Now as for you, son of man, tell the house of Israel that this is what they have said: ‘Our transgressions and our sins are heavy upon us, and we are wasting away because of them! How can we live?’
EZK 33:10.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 33 · Israel] Now as for you, son of man, tell the house of Israel that this is what they have said: ‘Our transgressions and our sins are heavy upon us, and we are wasting away because of them! How can we live?’

EZK 33:11.text: Say to them: ‘As surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, I take no pleasure in the death of the wicked, but rather that the wicked should turn from their ways and live. Turn! Turn from your evil ways! For why should you die, O house of Israel?’
EZK 33:11.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 33 · Death, Israel] Say to them: ‘As surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, I take no pleasure in the death of the wicked, but rather that the wicked should turn from their ways and live. Turn! Turn from your evil ways! For why should you die, O house of Israel?’

EZK 33:12.text: Therefore, son of man, say to your people: ‘The righteousness of the righteous man will not deliver him in the day of his transgression; neither will the wickedness of the wicked man cause him to stumble on the day he turns from his wickedness. Nor will the righteous man be able to survive by his righteousness on the day he sins.’
EZK 33:12.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 33] Therefore, son of man, say to your people: ‘The righteousness of the righteous man will not deliver him in the day of his transgression; neither will the wickedness of the wicked man cause him to stumble on the day he turns from his wickedness. Nor will the righteous man be able to survive by his righteousness on the day he sins.’

EZK 33:13.text: If I tell the righteous man that he will surely live, but he then trusts in his righteousness and commits iniquity, then none of his righteous works will be remembered; he will die because of the iniquity he has committed.
EZK 33:13.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 33 · Faith] If I tell the righteous man that he will surely live, but he then trusts in his righteousness and commits iniquity, then none of his righteous works will be remembered; he will die because of the iniquity he has committed.

EZK 33:14.text: But if I tell the wicked man, ‘You will surely die,’ and he turns from his sin and does what is just and right—
EZK 33:14.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 33] But if I tell the wicked man, ‘You will surely die,’ and he turns from his sin and does what is just and right—

EZK 33:15.text: if he restores a pledge, makes restitution for what he has stolen, and walks in the statutes of life without practicing iniquity—then he will surely live; he will not die.
EZK 33:15.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 33] if he restores a pledge, makes restitution for what he has stolen, and walks in the statutes of life without practicing iniquity—then he will surely live; he will not die.

EZK 33:16.text: None of the sins he has committed will be held against him. He has done what is just and right; he will surely live.
EZK 33:16.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 33] None of the sins he has committed will be held against him. He has done what is just and right; he will surely live.

EZK 33:17.text: Yet your people say, ‘The way of the Lord is not just.’ But it is their way that is not just.
EZK 33:17.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 33] Yet your people say, ‘The way of the Lord is not just.’ But it is their way that is not just.

EZK 33:18.text: If a righteous man turns from his righteousness and commits iniquity, he will die for it.
EZK 33:18.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 33] If a righteous man turns from his righteousness and commits iniquity, he will die for it.

EZK 33:19.text: But if a wicked man turns from his wickedness and does what is just and right, he will live because of this.
EZK 33:19.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 33] But if a wicked man turns from his wickedness and does what is just and right, he will live because of this.

EZK 33:20.text: Yet you say, ‘The way of the Lord is not just.’ But I will judge each of you according to his ways, O house of Israel.”
EZK 33:20.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 33 · Israel] Yet you say, ‘The way of the Lord is not just.’ But I will judge each of you according to his ways, O house of Israel.”

EZK 33:21.text: In the twelfth year of our exile, on the fifth day of the tenth month, a fugitive from Jerusalem came to me and reported, “The city has been taken!”
EZK 33:21.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 33] In the twelfth year of our exile, on the fifth day of the tenth month, a fugitive from Jerusalem came to me and reported, “The city has been taken!”

EZK 33:22.text: Now the evening before the fugitive arrived, the hand of the LORD was upon me, and He opened my mouth before the man came to me in the morning. So my mouth was opened and I was no longer mute.
EZK 33:22.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 33] Now the evening before the fugitive arrived, the hand of the LORD was upon me, and He opened my mouth before the man came to me in the morning. So my mouth was opened and I was no longer mute.

EZK 33:23.text: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
EZK 33:23.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 33] Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

EZK 33:24.text: “Son of man, those living in the ruins in the land of Israel are saying, ‘Abraham was only one man, yet he possessed the land. But we are many; surely the land has been given to us as a possession.’
EZK 33:24.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 33 · Israel] “Son of man, those living in the ruins in the land of Israel are saying, ‘Abraham was only one man, yet he possessed the land. But we are many; surely the land has been given to us as a possession.’

EZK 33:25.text: Therefore tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘You eat meat with the blood in it, lift up your eyes to your idols, and shed blood. Should you then possess the land?
EZK 33:25.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 33 · Idolatry, Idols] Therefore tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘You eat meat with the blood in it, lift up your eyes to your idols, and shed blood. Should you then possess the land?

EZK 33:26.text: You have relied on your swords, you have committed detestable acts, and each of you has defiled his neighbor’s wife. Should you then possess the land?’
EZK 33:26.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 33] You have relied on your swords, you have committed detestable acts, and each of you has defiled his neighbor’s wife. Should you then possess the land?’

EZK 33:27.text: Tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘As surely as I live, those in the ruins will fall by the sword, those in the open field I will give to be devoured by wild animals, and those in the strongholds and caves will die by plague.
EZK 33:27.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 33] Tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘As surely as I live, those in the ruins will fall by the sword, those in the open field I will give to be devoured by wild animals, and those in the strongholds and caves will die by plague.

EZK 33:28.text: I will make the land a desolate waste, and the pride of her strength will come to an end. The mountains of Israel will become desolate, so that no one will pass through.
EZK 33:28.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 33 · Israel] I will make the land a desolate waste, and the pride of her strength will come to an end. The mountains of Israel will become desolate, so that no one will pass through.

EZK 33:29.text: Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I have made the land a desolate waste because of all the abominations they have committed.’
EZK 33:29.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 33] Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I have made the land a desolate waste because of all the abominations they have committed.’

EZK 33:30.text: As for you, son of man, your people are talking about you near the city walls and in the doorways of their houses. One speaks to another, each saying to his brother, ‘Come and hear the message that has come from the LORD!’
EZK 33:30.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 33 · About Forgiveness] As for you, son of man, your people are talking about you near the city walls and in the doorways of their houses. One speaks to another, each saying to his brother, ‘Come and hear the message that has come from the LORD!’

EZK 33:31.text: So My people come to you as usual, sit before you, and hear your words; but they do not put them into practice. Although they express love with their mouths, their hearts pursue dishonest gain.
EZK 33:31.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 33 · Love] So My people come to you as usual, sit before you, and hear your words; but they do not put them into practice. Although they express love with their mouths, their hearts pursue dishonest gain.

EZK 33:32.text: Indeed, you are to them like a singer of love songs with a beautiful voice, who skillfully plays an instrument. They hear your words but do not put them into practice.
EZK 33:32.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 33 · Love] Indeed, you are to them like a singer of love songs with a beautiful voice, who skillfully plays an instrument. They hear your words but do not put them into practice.

EZK 33:33.text: So when it comes to pass—and surely it will come—then they will know that a prophet has been among them.”
EZK 33:33.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 33] So when it comes to pass—and surely it will come—then they will know that a prophet has been among them.”

EZK 34:1.text: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
EZK 34:1.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 34] Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

EZK 34:2.text: “Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel. Prophesy and tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Woe to the shepherds of Israel, who only feed themselves! Should not the shepherds feed their flock?
EZK 34:2.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 34 · Israel] “Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel. Prophesy and tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Woe to the shepherds of Israel, who only feed themselves! Should not the shepherds feed their flock?

EZK 34:3.text: You eat the fat, wear the wool, and butcher the fattened sheep, but you do not feed the flock.
EZK 34:3.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 34] You eat the fat, wear the wool, and butcher the fattened sheep, but you do not feed the flock.

EZK 34:4.text: You have not strengthened the weak, healed the sick, bound up the injured, brought back the strays, or searched for the lost. Instead, you have ruled them with violence and cruelty.
EZK 34:4.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 34] You have not strengthened the weak, healed the sick, bound up the injured, brought back the strays, or searched for the lost. Instead, you have ruled them with violence and cruelty.

EZK 34:5.text: They were scattered for lack of a shepherd, and when they were scattered they became food for all the wild beasts.
EZK 34:5.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 34] They were scattered for lack of a shepherd, and when they were scattered they became food for all the wild beasts.

EZK 34:6.text: My flock went astray on all the mountains and every high hill. They were scattered over the face of all the earth, with no one to search for them or seek them out.’
EZK 34:6.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 34] My flock went astray on all the mountains and every high hill. They were scattered over the face of all the earth, with no one to search for them or seek them out.’

EZK 34:7.text: Therefore, you shepherds, hear the word of the LORD:
EZK 34:7.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 34] Therefore, you shepherds, hear the word of the LORD:

EZK 34:8.text: ‘As surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, because My flock lacks a shepherd and has become prey and food for every wild beast, and because My shepherds did not search for My flock but fed themselves instead,
EZK 34:8.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 34 · Antichrist] ‘As surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, because My flock lacks a shepherd and has become prey and food for every wild beast, and because My shepherds did not search for My flock but fed themselves instead,

EZK 34:9.text: therefore, you shepherds, hear the word of the LORD!’
EZK 34:9.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 34] therefore, you shepherds, hear the word of the LORD!’

EZK 34:10.text: This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I am against the shepherds, and I will demand from them My flock and remove them from tending the flock, so that they can no longer feed themselves. For I will deliver My flock from their mouths, and it will no longer be food for them.’
EZK 34:10.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 34] This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I am against the shepherds, and I will demand from them My flock and remove them from tending the flock, so that they can no longer feed themselves. For I will deliver My flock from their mouths, and it will no longer be food for them.’

EZK 34:11.text: For this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I Myself will search for My flock and seek them out.
EZK 34:11.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 34] For this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I Myself will search for My flock and seek them out.

EZK 34:12.text: As a shepherd looks for his scattered sheep when he is among the flock, so I will look for My flock.  I will rescue them from all the places to which they were scattered on a day of clouds and darkness.
EZK 34:12.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 34] As a shepherd looks for his scattered sheep when he is among the flock, so I will look for My flock.  I will rescue them from all the places to which they were scattered on a day of clouds and darkness.

EZK 34:13.text: I will bring them out from the peoples, gather them from the countries, and bring them into their own land. I will feed them on the mountains of Israel, in the ravines, and in all the settlements of the land.
EZK 34:13.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 34 · Israel] I will bring them out from the peoples, gather them from the countries, and bring them into their own land. I will feed them on the mountains of Israel, in the ravines, and in all the settlements of the land.

EZK 34:14.text: I will feed them in good pasture, and the lofty mountains of Israel will be their grazing land. There they will lie down in a good grazing land; they will feed in rich pasture on the mountains of Israel.
EZK 34:14.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 34 · Israel] I will feed them in good pasture, and the lofty mountains of Israel will be their grazing land. There they will lie down in a good grazing land; they will feed in rich pasture on the mountains of Israel.

EZK 34:15.text: I will tend My flock and make them lie down, declares the Lord GOD.
EZK 34:15.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 34] I will tend My flock and make them lie down, declares the Lord GOD.

EZK 34:16.text: I will seek the lost, bring back the strays, bind up the broken, and strengthen the weak; but the sleek and strong I will destroy. I will shepherd them with justice.’
EZK 34:16.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 34 · Destroy Canaan, Destroy Canaanites] I will seek the lost, bring back the strays, bind up the broken, and strengthen the weak; but the sleek and strong I will destroy. I will shepherd them with justice.’

EZK 34:17.text: This is what the Lord GOD says to you, My flock: ‘I will judge between one sheep and another, between the rams and the goats.
EZK 34:17.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 34] This is what the Lord GOD says to you, My flock: ‘I will judge between one sheep and another, between the rams and the goats.

EZK 34:18.text: Is it not enough for you to feed on the good pasture? Must you also trample the rest of the pasture with your feet? Is it not enough for you to drink the clear waters? Must you also muddy the rest with your feet?
EZK 34:18.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 34] Is it not enough for you to feed on the good pasture? Must you also trample the rest of the pasture with your feet? Is it not enough for you to drink the clear waters? Must you also muddy the rest with your feet?

EZK 34:19.text: Why must My flock feed on what your feet have trampled, and drink what your feet have muddied?’
EZK 34:19.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 34] Why must My flock feed on what your feet have trampled, and drink what your feet have muddied?’

EZK 34:20.text: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says to them: ‘Behold, I Myself will judge between the fat sheep and the lean sheep.
EZK 34:20.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 34] Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says to them: ‘Behold, I Myself will judge between the fat sheep and the lean sheep.

EZK 34:21.text: Since you shove with flank and shoulder, butting all the weak ones with your horns until you have scattered them abroad,

EZK 43:7.text: and He said to me, “Son of man, this is the place of My throne and the place for the soles of My feet, where I will dwell among the Israelites forever. The house of Israel will never again defile My holy name—neither they nor their kings—by their prostitution and by the funeral offerings for their kings at their deaths.

EZK 43:8.text: When they placed their threshold next to My threshold and their doorposts beside My doorposts, with only a wall between Me and them, they defiled My holy name by the abominations they committed. Therefore I have consumed them in My anger.

EZK 43:9.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 43] Now let them remove far from Me their prostitution and the funeral offerings for their kings, and I will dwell among them forever.

EZK 43:10.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 43 · Israel] As for you, son of man, describe the temple to the people of Israel, so that they may be ashamed of their iniquities. Let them measure the plan,

EZK 43:12.text: This is the law of the temple: All its surrounding territory on top of the mountain will be most holy. Yes, this is the law of the temple.
EZK 43:12.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 43] This is the law of the temple: All its surrounding territory on top of the mountain will be most holy. Yes, this is the law of the temple.

EZK 43:13.text: These are the measurements of the altar in long cubits (a cubit and a handbreadth): Its gutter shall be a cubit deep and a cubit wide, with a rim of one span around its edge.  And this is the height of the altar:

EZK 43:14.text: The space from the gutter on the ground to the lower ledge shall be two cubits, and the ledge one cubit wide. The space from the smaller ledge to the larger ledge shall be four cubits, and the ledge one cubit wide.

EZK 43:15.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 43] The altar hearth shall be four cubits high, and four horns shall project upward from the hearth.

EZK 43:16.text: The altar hearth shall be square at its four corners, twelve cubits long and twelve cubits wide.
EZK 43:16.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 43] The altar hearth shall be square at its four corners, twelve cubits long and twelve cubits wide.

EZK 43:17.text: The ledge shall also be square, fourteen cubits long and fourteen cubits wide, with a rim of half a cubit and a gutter of a cubit all around it. The steps of the altar shall face east.”
EZK 43:17.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 43] The ledge shall also be square, fourteen cubits long and fourteen cubits wide, with a rim of half a cubit and a gutter of a cubit all around it. The steps of the altar shall face east.”

EZK 43:18.text: Then He said to me: “Son of man, this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘These are the statutes for the altar on the day it is constructed, so that burnt offerings may be sacrificed on it and blood may be sprinkled on it:

EZK 43:19.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 43 · Family] You are to give a young bull from the herd as a sin offering to the Levitical priests who are of the family of Zadok, who approach Me to minister before Me, declares the Lord GOD.

EZK 43:20.text: You are to take some of its blood and put it on the four horns of the altar, on the four corners of the ledge, and all around the rim; thus you will cleanse the altar and make atonement for it.
EZK 43:20.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 43 · Atonement] You are to take some of its blood and put it on the four horns of the altar, on the four corners of the ledge, and all around the rim; thus you will cleanse the altar and make atonement for it.

EZK 43:21.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 43] Then you are to take away the bull for the sin offering and burn it in the appointed part of the temple area outside the sanctuary.

EZK 43:22.text: On the second day you are to present an unblemished male goat as a sin offering, and the altar is to be cleansed as it was with the bull.
EZK 43:22.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 43] On the second day you are to present an unblemished male goat as a sin offering, and the altar is to be cleansed as it was with the bull.

EZK 43:23.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 43] When you have finished the purification, you are to present a young, unblemished bull and an unblemished ram from the flock.

EZK 43:24.text: You must present them before the LORD; the priests are to sprinkle salt on them and sacrifice them as a burnt offering to the LORD.
EZK 43:24.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 43] You must present them before the LORD; the priests are to sprinkle salt on them and sacrifice them as a burnt offering to the LORD.

EZK 43:25.text: For seven days you are to provide a male goat daily for a sin offering; you are also to provide a young bull and a ram from the flock, both unblemished.
EZK 43:25.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 43] For seven days you are to provide a male goat daily for a sin offering; you are also to provide a young bull and a ram from the flock, both unblemished.

EZK 43:26.text: For seven days the priests are to make atonement for the altar and cleanse it; so they shall consecrate it.
EZK 43:26.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 43 · Atonement] For seven days the priests are to make atonement for the altar and cleanse it; so they shall consecrate it.

EZK 43:27.text: At the end of these days, from the eighth day on, the priests are to present your burnt offerings and peace offerings on the altar. Then I will accept you, declares the Lord GOD.’”
EZK 43:27.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 43] At the end of these days, from the eighth day on, the priests are to present your burnt offerings and peace offerings on the altar. Then I will accept you, declares the Lord GOD.’”

EZK 44:1.text: The man then brought me back to the outer gate of the sanctuary that faced east, but it was shut.
EZK 44:1.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 44] The man then brought me back to the outer gate of the sanctuary that faced east, but it was shut.

EZK 44:2.text: And the LORD said to me, “This gate is to remain shut. It shall not be opened, and no man shall enter through it, because the LORD, the God of Israel, has entered through it. Therefore it will remain shut.
EZK 44:2.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 44 · Israel] And the LORD said to me, “This gate is to remain shut. It shall not be opened, and no man shall enter through it, because the LORD, the God of Israel, has entered through it. Therefore it will remain shut.

EZK 44:3.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 44] Only the prince himself may sit inside the gateway to eat in the presence of the LORD. He must enter by way of the portico of the gateway and go out the same way.”

EZK 44:4.text: Then the man brought me to the front of the temple by way of the north gate. I looked and saw the glory of the LORD filling His temple, and I fell facedown.
EZK 44:4.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 44 · Glory] Then the man brought me to the front of the temple by way of the north gate. I looked and saw the glory of the LORD filling His temple, and I fell facedown.

EZK 44:5.text: The LORD said to me: “Son of man, pay attention; look carefully with your eyes and listen closely with your ears to everything I tell you concerning all the statutes and laws of the house of the LORD. Take careful note of the entrance to the temple, along with all the exits of the sanctuary.

EZK 44:6.text: Tell the rebellious house of Israel that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘I have had enough of all your abominations, O house of Israel.
EZK 44:6.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 44 · Israel] Tell the rebellious house of Israel that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘I have had enough of all your abominations, O house of Israel.

EZK 44:7.text: In addition to all your other abominations, you brought in foreigners uncircumcised in both heart and flesh to occupy My sanctuary; you defiled My temple when you offered My food—the fat and the blood; you broke My covenant.
EZK 44:7.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 44 · Adultery In Heart, Covenant] In addition to all your other abominations, you brought in foreigners uncircumcised in both heart and flesh to occupy My sanctuary; you defiled My temple when you offered My food—the fat and the blood; you broke My covenant.

EZK 44:8.text: And you have not kept charge of My holy things, but have appointed others to keep charge of My sanctuary for you.’
EZK 44:8.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 44] And you have not kept charge of My holy things, but have appointed others to keep charge of My sanctuary for you.’

EZK 44:9.text: This is what the Lord GOD says: No foreigner uncircumcised in heart and flesh may enter My sanctuary—not even a foreigner who lives among the Israelites.
EZK 44:9.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 44 · Adultery In Heart] This is what the Lord GOD says: No foreigner uncircumcised in heart and flesh may enter My sanctuary—not even a foreigner who lives among the Israelites.

EZK 44:10.text: Surely the Levites who wandered away from Me when Israel went astray, and who wandered away from Me after their idols, will bear the consequences of their iniquity.
EZK 44:10.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 44 · Idolatry, Idols] Surely the Levites who wandered away from Me when Israel went astray, and who wandered away from Me after their idols, will bear the consequences of their iniquity.

EZK 44:11.text: Yet they shall be ministers in My sanctuary, having charge of the gates of the temple and ministering there. They shall slaughter the burnt offerings and other sacrifices for the people and stand before them to minister to them.
EZK 44:11.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 44] Yet they shall be ministers in My sanctuary, having charge of the gates of the temple and ministering there. They shall slaughter the burnt offerings and other sacrifices for the people and stand before them to minister to them.

EZK 44:12.text: Because they ministered before their idols and became a stumbling block of iniquity to the house of Israel, therefore I swore with an uplifted hand concerning them that they would bear the consequences of their iniquity, declares the Lord GOD.
EZK 44:12.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 44 · Idolatry, Idols] Because they ministered before their idols and became a stumbling block of iniquity to the house of Israel, therefore I swore with an uplifted hand concerning them that they would bear the consequences of their iniquity, declares the Lord GOD.

EZK 44:13.text: They must not approach Me to serve Me as priests or come near any of My holy things or the most holy things. They will bear the shame of the abominations they have committed.
EZK 44:13.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 44] They must not approach Me to serve Me as priests or come near any of My holy things or the most holy things. They will bear the shame of the abominations they have committed.

EZK 44:14.text: Yet I will appoint them to keep charge of all the work for the temple and everything to be done in it.
EZK 44:14.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 44] Yet I will appoint them to keep charge of all the work for the temple and everything to be done in it.

EZK 44:15.text: But the Levitical priests, who are descended from Zadok and who kept charge of My sanctuary when the Israelites went astray from Me, are to approach Me to minister before Me. They will stand before Me to offer Me fat and blood, declares the Lord GOD.
EZK 44:15.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 44] But the Levitical priests, who are descended from Zadok and who kept charge of My sanctuary when the Israelites went astray from Me, are to approach Me to minister before Me. They will stand before Me to offer Me fat and blood, declares the Lord GOD.

EZK 44:16.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 44] They alone shall enter My sanctuary and draw near to My table to minister before Me. They will keep My charge.

EZK 44:17.text: When they enter the gates of the inner court, they are to wear linen garments; they must not wear anything made of wool when they minister at the gates of the inner court or inside the temple.
EZK 44:17.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 44] When they enter the gates of the inner court, they are to wear linen garments; they must not wear anything made of wool when they minister at the gates of the inner court or inside the temple.

EZK 44:18.text: They are to wear linen turbans on their heads and linen undergarments around their waists. They must not wear anything that makes them perspire.
EZK 44:18.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 44] They are to wear linen turbans on their heads and linen undergarments around their waists. They must not wear anything that makes them perspire.

EZK 44:19.text: When they go out to the outer court, to the people, they are to take off the garments in which they have ministered, leave them in the holy chambers, and dress in other clothes so that they do not transmit holiness to the people with their garments.
EZK 44:19.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 44 · Holiness] When they go out to the outer court, to the people, they are to take off the garments in which they have ministered, leave them in the holy chambers, and dress in other clothes so that they do not transmit holiness to the people with their garments.

EZK 44:20.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 44] They must not shave their heads or let their hair grow long, but must carefully trim their hair.

EZK 44:21.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 44] No priest may drink wine before he enters the inner court.

EZK 44:22.text: And they shall not marry a widow or a divorced woman, but must marry a virgin of the descendants of the house of Israel, or a widow of a priest.
EZK 44:22.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 44 · Israel] And they shall not marry a widow or a divorced woman, but must marry a virgin of the descendants of the house of Israel, or a widow of a priest.

EZK 44:23.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 44] They are to teach My people the difference between the holy and the common, and show them how to discern between the clean and the unclean.

EZK 44:24.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 44] In any dispute, they shall officiate as judges and judge according to My ordinances. They must keep My laws and statutes regarding all My appointed feasts, and they must keep My Sabbaths holy.

EZK 44:25.text: A priest must not defile himself by going near a dead person. However, for a father, a mother, a son, a daughter, a brother, or an unmarried sister, he may do so,

EZK 44:26.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 44] and after he is cleansed, he must count off seven days for himself.

EZK 44:27.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 44] And on the day he goes into the sanctuary, into the inner court, to minister in the sanctuary, he must present his sin offering, declares the Lord GOD.

EZK 44:28.text: In regard to their inheritance, I am their inheritance. You are to give them no possession in Israel, for I am their possession.
EZK 44:28.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 44 · Inheritance, Israel] In regard to their inheritance, I am their inheritance. You are to give them no possession in Israel, for I am their possession.

EZK 44:29.text: They shall eat the grain offerings, the sin offerings, and the guilt offerings. Everything in Israel devoted to the LORD will belong to them.
EZK 44:29.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 44 · Israel] They shall eat the grain offerings, the sin offerings, and the guilt offerings. Everything in Israel devoted to the LORD will belong to them.

EZK 44:30.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 44 · Blessing] The best of all the firstfruits and of every contribution from all your offerings will belong to the priests. You are to give your first batch of dough to the priest, so that a blessing may rest upon your homes.

EZK 44:31.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 44] The priests may not eat any bird or animal found dead or torn by wild beasts.

EZK 45:1.text: “When you divide the land by lot as an inheritance, you are to set aside a portion for the LORD, a holy portion of the land 25,000 cubits long and 20,000 cubits wide. This entire tract of land will be holy.

EZK 45:2.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 45] Within this area there is to be a section for the sanctuary 500 cubits square, with 50 cubits around it for open land.

EZK 45:5.bm25Text: [Ezekiel · Chapter 45] An adjacent area 25,000 cubits long and 10,000 cubits wide shall belong to the Levites who minister in the temple; it will be their possession for towns in which to live.

EZR 4:13.bm25Text: [Ezra · Chapter 4] Let it now be known to the king that if that city is rebuilt and its walls are restored, they will not pay tribute, duty, or toll, and the royal treasury will suffer.

EZR 4:14.bm25Text: [Ezra · Chapter 4] Now because we are in the service of the palace and it is not fitting for us to allow the king to be dishonored, we have sent to inform the king

EZR 4:15.text: that a search should be made of the record books of your fathers. In these books you will discover and verify that the city is a rebellious city, harmful to kings and provinces, inciting sedition from ancient times. That is why this city was destroyed.

EZR 4:21.bm25Text: [Ezra · Chapter 4] Now, therefore, issue an order for these men to stop, so that this city will not be rebuilt until I so order.

EZR 4:22.bm25Text: [Ezra · Chapter 4] See that you do not neglect this matter. Why allow this threat to increase and the royal interests to suffer?

EZR 5:8.text: Let it be known to the king that we went into the province of Judah, to the house of the great God. The people are rebuilding it with large stones, and placing timbers in the walls. This work is being carried out diligently and is prospering in their hands.
