LEV 19:12.text: You must not swear falsely by My name and so profane the name of your God. I am the LORD.
LEV 19:12.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 19] You must not swear falsely by My name and so profane the name of your God. I am the LORD.

LEV 19:13.text: You must not defraud your neighbor or rob him.  You must not withhold until morning the wages due a hired hand.
LEV 19:13.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 19] You must not defraud your neighbor or rob him.  You must not withhold until morning the wages due a hired hand.

LEV 19:14.text: You must not curse the deaf or place a stumbling block before the blind, but you shall fear your God. I am the LORD.
LEV 19:14.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 19 · Curse God] You must not curse the deaf or place a stumbling block before the blind, but you shall fear your God. I am the LORD.

LEV 19:15.text: You must not pervert justice; you must not show partiality to the poor or favoritism to the rich; you are to judge your neighbor fairly.
LEV 19:15.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 19 · Justice] You must not pervert justice; you must not show partiality to the poor or favoritism to the rich; you are to judge your neighbor fairly.

LEV 19:16.text: You must not go about spreading slander among your people.  You must not endanger the life of your neighbor. I am the LORD.
LEV 19:16.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 19 · About Forgiveness] You must not go about spreading slander among your people.  You must not endanger the life of your neighbor. I am the LORD.

LEV 19:17.text: You must not harbor hatred against your brother in your heart. Directly rebuke your neighbor, so that you will not incur guilt on account of him.
LEV 19:17.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 19 · Adultery In Heart] You must not harbor hatred against your brother in your heart. Directly rebuke your neighbor, so that you will not incur guilt on account of him.

LEV 19:18.text: Do not seek revenge or bear a grudge against any of your people, but love your neighbor as yourself. I am the LORD.
LEV 19:18.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 19 · Love] Do not seek revenge or bear a grudge against any of your people, but love your neighbor as yourself. I am the LORD.

LEV 19:19.text: You are to keep My statutes. You shall not crossbreed two different kinds of livestock; you shall not sow your fields with two kinds of seed; and you shall not wear clothing made of two kinds of material.
LEV 19:19.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 19] You are to keep My statutes. You shall not crossbreed two different kinds of livestock; you shall not sow your fields with two kinds of seed; and you shall not wear clothing made of two kinds of material.

LEV 19:20.text: If a man lies carnally with a slave girl promised to another man but who has not been redeemed or given her freedom, there must be due punishment. But they are not to be put to death, because she had not been freed.
LEV 19:20.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 19 · Death, Freedom] If a man lies carnally with a slave girl promised to another man but who has not been redeemed or given her freedom, there must be due punishment. But they are not to be put to death, because she had not been freed.

LEV 19:21.text: The man, however, must bring a ram to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting as his guilt offering to the LORD.
LEV 19:21.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 19] The man, however, must bring a ram to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting as his guilt offering to the LORD.

LEV 19:22.text: The priest shall make atonement on his behalf before the LORD with the ram of the guilt offering for the sin he has committed, and he will be forgiven the sin he has committed.
LEV 19:22.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 19 · Forgiveness, Atonement] The priest shall make atonement on his behalf before the LORD with the ram of the guilt offering for the sin he has committed, and he will be forgiven the sin he has committed.

LEV 19:23.text: When you enter the land and plant any kind of tree for food, you shall regard the fruit as forbidden. For three years it will be forbidden to you and must not be eaten.
LEV 19:23.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 19 · Fruit of the Spirit] When you enter the land and plant any kind of tree for food, you shall regard the fruit as forbidden. For three years it will be forbidden to you and must not be eaten.

LEV 19:24.text: In the fourth year all its fruit must be consecrated as a praise offering to the LORD.
LEV 19:24.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 19 · Fruit of the Spirit] In the fourth year all its fruit must be consecrated as a praise offering to the LORD.

LEV 19:25.text: But in the fifth year you may eat its fruit; thus your harvest will be increased. I am the LORD your God.
LEV 19:25.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 19 · Fruit of the Spirit] But in the fifth year you may eat its fruit; thus your harvest will be increased. I am the LORD your God.

LEV 19:26.text: You must not eat anything with blood still in it.  You must not practice divination or sorcery.
LEV 19:26.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 19] You must not eat anything with blood still in it.  You must not practice divination or sorcery.

LEV 19:27.text: You must not cut off the hair at the sides of your head or clip off the edges of your beard.
LEV 19:27.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 19] You must not cut off the hair at the sides of your head or clip off the edges of your beard.

LEV 19:28.text: You must not make any cuts in your bodies for the dead or put tattoo marks on yourselves. I am the LORD.
LEV 19:28.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 19] You must not make any cuts in your bodies for the dead or put tattoo marks on yourselves. I am the LORD.

LEV 19:29.text: You must not defile your daughter by making her a prostitute, or the land will be prostituted and filled with depravity.
LEV 19:29.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 19] You must not defile your daughter by making her a prostitute, or the land will be prostituted and filled with depravity.

LEV 19:30.text: You must keep My Sabbaths and have reverence for My sanctuary. I am the LORD.
LEV 19:30.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 19] You must keep My Sabbaths and have reverence for My sanctuary. I am the LORD.

LEV 19:31.text: You must not turn to mediums or spiritists; do not seek them out, or you will be defiled by them. I am the LORD your God.
LEV 19:31.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 19] You must not turn to mediums or spiritists; do not seek them out, or you will be defiled by them. I am the LORD your God.

LEV 19:32.text: You are to rise in the presence of the elderly, honor the aged, and fear your God. I am the LORD.
LEV 19:32.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 19] You are to rise in the presence of the elderly, honor the aged, and fear your God. I am the LORD.

LEV 19:33.text: When a foreigner resides with you in your land, you must not oppress him.
LEV 19:33.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 19] When a foreigner resides with you in your land, you must not oppress him.

LEV 19:34.text: You must treat the foreigner living among you as native-born and love him as yourself, for you were foreigners in the land of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.
LEV 19:34.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 19 · Love] You must treat the foreigner living among you as native-born and love him as yourself, for you were foreigners in the land of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.

LEV 19:35.text: You must not use dishonest measures of length, weight, or volume.
LEV 19:35.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 19] You must not use dishonest measures of length, weight, or volume.

LEV 19:36.text: You shall maintain honest scales and weights, an honest ephah, and an honest hin. I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.
LEV 19:36.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 19] You shall maintain honest scales and weights, an honest ephah, and an honest hin. I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.

LEV 19:37.text: You must keep all My statutes and all My ordinances and follow them. I am the LORD.”
LEV 19:37.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 19] You must keep all My statutes and all My ordinances and follow them. I am the LORD.”

LEV 20:1.text: Then the LORD said to Moses,
LEV 20:1.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 20] Then the LORD said to Moses,

LEV 20:2.text: “Tell the Israelites, ‘Any Israelite or foreigner living in Israel who gives any of his children to Molech must be put to death. The people of the land are to stone him.
LEV 20:2.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 20 · Children, Death] “Tell the Israelites, ‘Any Israelite or foreigner living in Israel who gives any of his children to Molech must be put to death. The people of the land are to stone him.

LEV 20:3.text: And I will set My face against that man and cut him off from his people, because by giving his offspring to Molech, he has defiled My sanctuary and profaned My holy name.
LEV 20:3.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 20 · Children, Generosity] And I will set My face against that man and cut him off from his people, because by giving his offspring to Molech, he has defiled My sanctuary and profaned My holy name.

LEV 20:4.text: And if the people of the land ever hide their eyes and fail to put to death the man who gives one of his children to Molech,
LEV 20:4.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 20 · Children, Death] And if the people of the land ever hide their eyes and fail to put to death the man who gives one of his children to Molech,

LEV 20:5.text: then I will set My face against that man and his family and cut off from among their people both him and all who follow him in prostituting themselves with Molech.
LEV 20:5.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 20 · Family] then I will set My face against that man and his family and cut off from among their people both him and all who follow him in prostituting themselves with Molech.

LEV 20:6.text: Whoever turns to mediums or spiritists to prostitute himself with them, I will also set My face against that person and cut him off from his people.
LEV 20:6.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 20] Whoever turns to mediums or spiritists to prostitute himself with them, I will also set My face against that person and cut him off from his people.

LEV 20:7.text: Consecrate yourselves, therefore, and be holy, because I am the LORD your God.
LEV 20:7.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 20] Consecrate yourselves, therefore, and be holy, because I am the LORD your God.

LEV 20:8.text: And you shall keep My statutes and practice them. I am the LORD who sanctifies you.
LEV 20:8.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 20] And you shall keep My statutes and practice them. I am the LORD who sanctifies you.

LEV 20:9.text: If anyone curses his father or mother, he must be put to death. He has cursed his father or mother; his blood shall be upon him.
LEV 20:9.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 20 · Death, God the Father] If anyone curses his father or mother, he must be put to death. He has cursed his father or mother; his blood shall be upon him.

LEV 20:10.text: If a man commits adultery with another man’s wife—with the wife of his neighbor—both the adulterer and the adulteress must surely be put to death.
LEV 20:10.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 20 · Adulterer, Adultery] If a man commits adultery with another man’s wife—with the wife of his neighbor—both the adulterer and the adulteress must surely be put to death.

LEV 20:11.text: If a man lies with his father’s wife, he has uncovered his father’s nakedness. Both must surely be put to death; their blood is upon them.
LEV 20:11.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 20 · Death, God the Father] If a man lies with his father’s wife, he has uncovered his father’s nakedness. Both must surely be put to death; their blood is upon them.

LEV 20:12.text: If a man lies with his daughter-in-law, both must surely be put to death. They have acted perversely; their blood is upon them.
LEV 20:12.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 20 · Covenant, Death] If a man lies with his daughter-in-law, both must surely be put to death. They have acted perversely; their blood is upon them.

LEV 20:13.text: If a man lies with a man as with a woman, they have both committed an abomination. They must surely be put to death; their blood is upon them.
LEV 20:13.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 20 · Death] If a man lies with a man as with a woman, they have both committed an abomination. They must surely be put to death; their blood is upon them.

LEV 20:14.text: If a man marries both a woman and her mother, it is depraved. Both he and they must be burned in the fire, so that there will be no depravity among you.
LEV 20:14.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 20] If a man marries both a woman and her mother, it is depraved. Both he and they must be burned in the fire, so that there will be no depravity among you.

LEV 20:15.text: If a man lies carnally with an animal, he must be put to death. And you are also to kill the animal.
LEV 20:15.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 20 · Death] If a man lies carnally with an animal, he must be put to death. And you are also to kill the animal.

LEV 20:16.text: If a woman approaches any animal to mate with it, you must kill both the woman and the animal. They must surely be put to death; their blood is upon them.
LEV 20:16.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 20 · Death] If a woman approaches any animal to mate with it, you must kill both the woman and the animal. They must surely be put to death; their blood is upon them.

LEV 20:17.text: If a man marries his sister, whether the daughter of his father or of his mother, and they have sexual relations, it is a disgrace. They must be cut off in the sight of their people. He has uncovered the nakedness of his sister; he shall bear his iniquity.
LEV 20:17.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 20 · God the Father] If a man marries his sister, whether the daughter of his father or of his mother, and they have sexual relations, it is a disgrace. They must be cut off in the sight of their people. He has uncovered the nakedness of his sister; he shall bear his iniquity.

LEV 20:18.text: If a man lies with a menstruating woman and has sexual relations with her, he has exposed the source of her flow, and she has uncovered the source of her blood. Both of them must be cut off from among their people.
LEV 20:18.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 20] If a man lies with a menstruating woman and has sexual relations with her, he has exposed the source of her flow, and she has uncovered the source of her blood. Both of them must be cut off from among their people.

LEV 20:19.text: You must not have sexual relations with the sister of your mother or your father, for it is exposing one’s own kin; both shall bear their iniquity.
LEV 20:19.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 20 · God the Father] You must not have sexual relations with the sister of your mother or your father, for it is exposing one’s own kin; both shall bear their iniquity.

LEV 20:20.text: If a man lies with his uncle’s wife, he has uncovered the nakedness of his uncle. They will bear their sin; they shall die childless.
LEV 20:20.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 20] If a man lies with his uncle’s wife, he has uncovered the nakedness of his uncle. They will bear their sin; they shall die childless.

LEV 20:21.text: If a man marries his brother’s wife, it is an act of impurity. He has uncovered the nakedness of his brother; they shall be childless.
LEV 20:21.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 20] If a man marries his brother’s wife, it is an act of impurity. He has uncovered the nakedness of his brother; they shall be childless.

LEV 20:22.text: You are therefore to keep all My statutes and ordinances, so that the land where I am bringing you to live will not vomit you out.
LEV 20:22.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 20] You are therefore to keep all My statutes and ordinances, so that the land where I am bringing you to live will not vomit you out.

LEV 20:23.text: You must not follow the statutes of the nations I am driving out before you. Because they did all these things, I abhorred them.
LEV 20:23.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 20] You must not follow the statutes of the nations I am driving out before you. Because they did all these things, I abhorred them.

LEV 20:24.text: But I have told you that you will inherit their land, since I will give it to you as an inheritance—a land flowing with milk and honey. I am the LORD your God, who has set you apart from the peoples.
LEV 20:24.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 20 · Inheritance] But I have told you that you will inherit their land, since I will give it to you as an inheritance—a land flowing with milk and honey. I am the LORD your God, who has set you apart from the peoples.

LEV 20:25.text: You are therefore to distinguish between clean and unclean animals and birds. Do not become contaminated by any animal or bird, or by anything that crawls on the ground; I have set these apart as unclean for you.
LEV 20:25.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 20] You are therefore to distinguish between clean and unclean animals and birds. Do not become contaminated by any animal or bird, or by anything that crawls on the ground; I have set these apart as unclean for you.

LEV 20:26.text: You are to be holy to Me because I, the LORD, am holy, and I have set you apart from the nations to be My own.
LEV 20:26.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 20] You are to be holy to Me because I, the LORD, am holy, and I have set you apart from the nations to be My own.

LEV 20:27.text: A man or a woman who is a medium or spiritist must surely be put to death. They shall be stoned; their blood is upon them.’”
LEV 20:27.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 20 · Death] A man or a woman who is a medium or spiritist must surely be put to death. They shall be stoned; their blood is upon them.’”

LEV 21:1.text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Speak to Aaron’s sons, the priests, and tell them that a priest is not to defile himself for a dead person among his people,
LEV 21:1.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 21] Then the LORD said to Moses, “Speak to Aaron’s sons, the priests, and tell them that a priest is not to defile himself for a dead person among his people,

LEV 21:2.text: except for his immediate family—his mother, father, son, daughter, or brother,
LEV 21:2.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 21 · Family, God the Father] except for his immediate family—his mother, father, son, daughter, or brother,

LEV 21:3.text: or his unmarried sister who is near to him, since she has no husband.
LEV 21:3.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 21] or his unmarried sister who is near to him, since she has no husband.

LEV 21:4.text: He is not to defile himself for those related to him by marriage, and so profane himself.
LEV 21:4.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 21 · Marriage] He is not to defile himself for those related to him by marriage, and so profane himself.

LEV 21:5.text: Priests must not make bald spots on their heads, shave off the edges of their beards, or make cuts in their bodies.
LEV 21:5.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 21] Priests must not make bald spots on their heads, shave off the edges of their beards, or make cuts in their bodies.

LEV 21:6.text: They must be holy to their God and not profane the name of their God. Because they present to the LORD the offerings made by fire, the food of their God, they must be holy.
LEV 21:6.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 21] They must be holy to their God and not profane the name of their God. Because they present to the LORD the offerings made by fire, the food of their God, they must be holy.

LEV 21:7.text: A priest must not marry a woman defiled by prostitution or divorced by her husband, for the priest is holy to his God.
LEV 21:7.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 21] A priest must not marry a woman defiled by prostitution or divorced by her husband, for the priest is holy to his God.

LEV 21:8.text: You are to regard him as holy, since he presents the food of your God. He shall be holy to you, because I the LORD am holy—I who set you apart.
LEV 21:8.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 21] You are to regard him as holy, since he presents the food of your God. He shall be holy to you, because I the LORD am holy—I who set you apart.

LEV 21:9.text: If a priest’s daughter defiles herself by prostituting herself, she profanes her father; she must be burned in the fire.
LEV 21:9.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 21 · God the Father] If a priest’s daughter defiles herself by prostituting herself, she profanes her father; she must be burned in the fire.

LEV 21:10.text: The priest who is highest among his brothers, who has had the anointing oil poured on his head and has been ordained to wear the priestly garments, must not let his hair hang loose or tear his garments.
LEV 21:10.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 21 · Anointing] The priest who is highest among his brothers, who has had the anointing oil poured on his head and has been ordained to wear the priestly garments, must not let his hair hang loose or tear his garments.

LEV 21:11.text: He must not go near any dead body; he must not defile himself, even for his father or mother.
LEV 21:11.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 21 · God the Father] He must not go near any dead body; he must not defile himself, even for his father or mother.

LEV 21:12.text: He must not leave or desecrate the sanctuary of his God, for the consecration of the anointing oil of his God is on him. I am the LORD.
LEV 21:12.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 21 · Anointing] He must not leave or desecrate the sanctuary of his God, for the consecration of the anointing oil of his God is on him. I am the LORD.

LEV 21:13.text: The woman he marries must be a virgin.
LEV 21:13.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 21] The woman he marries must be a virgin.

LEV 21:14.text: He is not to marry a widow, a divorced woman, or one defiled by prostitution. He is to marry a virgin from his own people,
LEV 21:14.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 21] He is not to marry a widow, a divorced woman, or one defiled by prostitution. He is to marry a virgin from his own people,

LEV 21:15.text: so that he does not defile his offspring among his people, for I am the LORD who sanctifies him.”
LEV 21:15.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 21 · Children] so that he does not defile his offspring among his people, for I am the LORD who sanctifies him.”

LEV 21:16.text: Then the LORD said to Moses,
LEV 21:16.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 21] Then the LORD said to Moses,

LEV 21:17.text: “Say to Aaron, ‘For the generations to come, none of your descendants who has a physical defect may approach to offer the food of his God.
LEV 21:17.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 21] “Say to Aaron, ‘For the generations to come, none of your descendants who has a physical defect may approach to offer the food of his God.

LEV 21:18.text: No man who has any defect may approach—no man who is blind, lame, disfigured, or deformed;
LEV 21:18.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 21] No man who has any defect may approach—no man who is blind, lame, disfigured, or deformed;

LEV 21:19.text: no man who has a broken foot or hand,
LEV 21:19.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 21] no man who has a broken foot or hand,

LEV 21:20.text: or who is a hunchback or dwarf, or who has an eye defect, a festering rash, scabs, or a crushed testicle.
LEV 21:20.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 21] or who is a hunchback or dwarf, or who has an eye defect, a festering rash, scabs, or a crushed testicle.

LEV 21:21.text: No descendant of Aaron the priest who has a defect shall approach to present the offerings made by fire to the LORD. Since he has a defect, he is not to come near to offer the food of his God.
LEV 21:21.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 21] No descendant of Aaron the priest who has a defect shall approach to present the offerings made by fire to the LORD. Since he has a defect, he is not to come near to offer the food of his God.

LEV 21:22.text: He may eat the most holy food of his God as well as the holy food,
LEV 21:22.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 21] He may eat the most holy food of his God as well as the holy food,

LEV 21:23.text: but because he has a defect, he must not go near the veil or approach the altar, so as not to desecrate My sanctuaries. For I am the LORD who sanctifies them.’”
LEV 21:23.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 21] but because he has a defect, he must not go near the veil or approach the altar, so as not to desecrate My sanctuaries. For I am the LORD who sanctifies them.’”

LEV 21:24.text: Moses told this to Aaron and his sons and to all the Israelites.
LEV 21:24.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 21] Moses told this to Aaron and his sons and to all the Israelites.

LEV 22:1.text: Then the LORD said to Moses,
LEV 22:1.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 22] Then the LORD said to Moses,

LEV 22:2.text: “Tell Aaron and his sons to treat with respect the sacred offerings that the Israelites have consecrated to Me, so that they do not profane My holy name. I am the LORD.
LEV 22:2.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 22] “Tell Aaron and his sons to treat with respect the sacred offerings that the Israelites have consecrated to Me, so that they do not profane My holy name. I am the LORD.

LEV 22:3.text: Tell them that for the generations to come, if any of their descendants in a state of uncleanness approaches the sacred offerings that the Israelites consecrate to the LORD, that person must be cut off from My presence. I am the LORD.
LEV 22:3.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 22] Tell them that for the generations to come, if any of their descendants in a state of uncleanness approaches the sacred offerings that the Israelites consecrate to the LORD, that person must be cut off from My presence. I am the LORD.

LEV 22:4.text: If a descendant of Aaron has a skin disease or a discharge, he may not eat the sacred offerings until he is clean. Whoever touches anything defiled by a corpse or by a man who has an emission of semen,
LEV 22:4.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 22] If a descendant of Aaron has a skin disease or a discharge, he may not eat the sacred offerings until he is clean. Whoever touches anything defiled by a corpse or by a man who has an emission of semen,

LEV 22:5.text: or whoever touches a crawling creature or a person that makes him unclean, whatever the uncleanness may be—
LEV 22:5.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 22] or whoever touches a crawling creature or a person that makes him unclean, whatever the uncleanness may be—

LEV 22:6.text: the man who touches any of these will remain unclean until evening. He must not eat from the sacred offerings unless he has bathed himself with water.
LEV 22:6.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 22] the man who touches any of these will remain unclean until evening. He must not eat from the sacred offerings unless he has bathed himself with water.

LEV 22:7.text: When the sun has set, he will become clean, and then he may eat from the sacred offerings, for they are his food.
LEV 22:7.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 22] When the sun has set, he will become clean, and then he may eat from the sacred offerings, for they are his food.

LEV 22:8.text: He must not eat anything found dead or torn by wild animals, which would make him unclean. I am the LORD.
LEV 22:8.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 22] He must not eat anything found dead or torn by wild animals, which would make him unclean. I am the LORD.

LEV 22:9.text: The priests must keep My charge, lest they bear the guilt and die because they profane it. I am the LORD who sanctifies them.
LEV 22:9.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 22] The priests must keep My charge, lest they bear the guilt and die because they profane it. I am the LORD who sanctifies them.

LEV 22:10.text: No one outside a priest’s family may eat the sacred offering, nor may the guest of a priest or his hired hand eat it.
LEV 22:10.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 22 · Family] No one outside a priest’s family may eat the sacred offering, nor may the guest of a priest or his hired hand eat it.

LEV 22:11.text: But if a priest buys a slave with his own money, or if a slave is born in his household, that slave may eat his food.
LEV 22:11.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 22 · Family] But if a priest buys a slave with his own money, or if a slave is born in his household, that slave may eat his food.

LEV 22:12.text: If the priest’s daughter is married to a man other than a priest, she is not to eat of the sacred contributions.
LEV 22:12.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 22] If the priest’s daughter is married to a man other than a priest, she is not to eat of the sacred contributions.

LEV 22:13.text: But if a priest’s daughter with no children becomes widowed or divorced and returns to her father’s house, she may share her father’s food as in her youth. But no outsider may share it.
LEV 22:13.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 22 · Children, God the Father] But if a priest’s daughter with no children becomes widowed or divorced and returns to her father’s house, she may share her father’s food as in her youth. But no outsider may share it.

LEV 22:14.text: If anyone eats a sacred offering in error, he must add a fifth to its value and give the sacred offering to the priest.

LEV 25:6.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 25] Whatever the land yields during the Sabbath year shall be food for you—for yourself, your manservant and maidservant, the hired hand or foreigner who stays with you,

LEV 25:7.text: and for your livestock and the wild animals in your land. All its growth may serve as food.
LEV 25:7.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 25] and for your livestock and the wild animals in your land. All its growth may serve as food.

LEV 25:8.text: And you shall count off seven Sabbaths of years—seven times seven years—so that the seven Sabbaths of years amount to forty-nine years.
LEV 25:8.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 25 · End Times] And you shall count off seven Sabbaths of years—seven times seven years—so that the seven Sabbaths of years amount to forty-nine years.

LEV 25:9.text: Then you are to sound the horn far and wide on the tenth day of the seventh month, the Day of Atonement. You shall sound it throughout your land.
LEV 25:9.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 25 · Atonement] Then you are to sound the horn far and wide on the tenth day of the seventh month, the Day of Atonement. You shall sound it throughout your land.

LEV 25:10.text: So you are to consecrate the fiftieth year and proclaim liberty in the land for all its inhabitants. It shall be your Jubilee, when each of you is to return to his property and to his clan.
LEV 25:10.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 25 · Freedom] So you are to consecrate the fiftieth year and proclaim liberty in the land for all its inhabitants. It shall be your Jubilee, when each of you is to return to his property and to his clan.

LEV 25:11.text: The fiftieth year will be a Jubilee for you; you are not to sow the land or reap its aftergrowth or harvest the untended vines.
LEV 25:11.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 25] The fiftieth year will be a Jubilee for you; you are not to sow the land or reap its aftergrowth or harvest the untended vines.

LEV 25:12.text: For it is a Jubilee; it shall be holy to you. You may eat only the crops taken directly from the field.
LEV 25:12.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 25] For it is a Jubilee; it shall be holy to you. You may eat only the crops taken directly from the field.

LEV 25:13.text: In this Year of Jubilee, each of you shall return to his own property.
LEV 25:13.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 25] In this Year of Jubilee, each of you shall return to his own property.

LEV 25:14.text: If you make a sale to your neighbor or a purchase from him, you must not take advantage of each other.
LEV 25:14.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 25] If you make a sale to your neighbor or a purchase from him, you must not take advantage of each other.

LEV 25:15.text: You are to buy from your neighbor according to the number of years since the last Jubilee; he is to sell to you according to the number of harvest years remaining.
LEV 25:15.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 25] You are to buy from your neighbor according to the number of years since the last Jubilee; he is to sell to you according to the number of harvest years remaining.

LEV 25:16.text: You shall increase the price in proportion to a greater number of years, or decrease it in proportion to a lesser number of years; for he is selling you a given number of harvests.
LEV 25:16.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 25] You shall increase the price in proportion to a greater number of years, or decrease it in proportion to a lesser number of years; for he is selling you a given number of harvests.

LEV 25:17.text: Do not take advantage of each other, but fear your God; for I am the LORD your God.
LEV 25:17.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 25] Do not take advantage of each other, but fear your God; for I am the LORD your God.

LEV 25:18.text: You are to keep My statutes and carefully observe My judgments, so that you may dwell securely in the land.
LEV 25:18.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 25] You are to keep My statutes and carefully observe My judgments, so that you may dwell securely in the land.

LEV 25:19.text: Then the land will yield its fruit, so that you can eat your fill and dwell in safety in the land.
LEV 25:19.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 25 · Fruit of the Spirit] Then the land will yield its fruit, so that you can eat your fill and dwell in safety in the land.

LEV 25:20.text: Now you may wonder, ‘What will we eat in the seventh year if we do not sow or gather our produce?’
LEV 25:20.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 25] Now you may wonder, ‘What will we eat in the seventh year if we do not sow or gather our produce?’

LEV 25:21.text: But I will send My blessing upon you in the sixth year, so that the land will yield a crop sufficient for three years.
LEV 25:21.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 25 · Blessing] But I will send My blessing upon you in the sixth year, so that the land will yield a crop sufficient for three years.

LEV 25:22.text: While you are sowing in the eighth year, you will be eating from the previous harvest, until the ninth year’s harvest comes in.
LEV 25:22.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 25] While you are sowing in the eighth year, you will be eating from the previous harvest, until the ninth year’s harvest comes in.

LEV 25:23.text: The land must not be sold permanently, because it is Mine, and you are but foreigners and residents with Me.
LEV 25:23.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 25] The land must not be sold permanently, because it is Mine, and you are but foreigners and residents with Me.

LEV 25:24.text: Thus for every piece of property you possess, you must provide for the redemption of the land.
LEV 25:24.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 25] Thus for every piece of property you possess, you must provide for the redemption of the land.

LEV 25:25.text: If your brother becomes impoverished and sells some of his property, his nearest of kin may come and redeem what his brother has sold.
LEV 25:25.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 25] If your brother becomes impoverished and sells some of his property, his nearest of kin may come and redeem what his brother has sold.

LEV 25:26.text: Or if a man has no one to redeem it for him, but he prospers and acquires enough to redeem his land,
LEV 25:26.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 25] Or if a man has no one to redeem it for him, but he prospers and acquires enough to redeem his land,

LEV 25:27.text: he shall calculate the years since its sale, repay the balance to the man to whom he sold it, and return to his property.
LEV 25:27.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 25] he shall calculate the years since its sale, repay the balance to the man to whom he sold it, and return to his property.

LEV 25:28.text: But if he cannot obtain enough to repay him, what he sold will remain in possession of the buyer until the Year of Jubilee. In the Jubilee, however, it is to be released, so that he may return to his property.
LEV 25:28.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 25] But if he cannot obtain enough to repay him, what he sold will remain in possession of the buyer until the Year of Jubilee. In the Jubilee, however, it is to be released, so that he may return to his property.

LEV 25:29.text: If a man sells a house in a walled city, he retains his right of redemption until a full year after its sale; during that year it may be redeemed.
LEV 25:29.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 25] If a man sells a house in a walled city, he retains his right of redemption until a full year after its sale; during that year it may be redeemed.

LEV 25:30.text: If it is not redeemed by the end of a full year, then the house in the walled city is permanently transferred to its buyer and his descendants. It is not to be released in the Jubilee.
LEV 25:30.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 25] If it is not redeemed by the end of a full year, then the house in the walled city is permanently transferred to its buyer and his descendants. It is not to be released in the Jubilee.

LEV 25:31.text: But houses in villages with no walls around them are to be considered as open fields. They may be redeemed, and they shall be released in the Jubilee.
LEV 25:31.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 25] But houses in villages with no walls around them are to be considered as open fields. They may be redeemed, and they shall be released in the Jubilee.

LEV 25:32.text: As for the cities of the Levites, the Levites always have the right to redeem their houses in the cities they possess.
LEV 25:32.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 25] As for the cities of the Levites, the Levites always have the right to redeem their houses in the cities they possess.

LEV 25:33.text: So whatever belongs to the Levites may be redeemed—a house sold in a city they possess—and must be released in the Jubilee, because the houses in the cities of the Levites are their possession among the Israelites.
LEV 25:33.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 25] So whatever belongs to the Levites may be redeemed—a house sold in a city they possess—and must be released in the Jubilee, because the houses in the cities of the Levites are their possession among the Israelites.

LEV 25:34.text: But the open pastureland around their cities may not be sold, for this is their permanent possession.
LEV 25:34.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 25] But the open pastureland around their cities may not be sold, for this is their permanent possession.

LEV 25:35.text: Now if your countryman becomes destitute and cannot support himself among you, then you are to help him as you would a foreigner or stranger, so that he can continue to live among you.
LEV 25:35.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 25] Now if your countryman becomes destitute and cannot support himself among you, then you are to help him as you would a foreigner or stranger, so that he can continue to live among you.

LEV 25:36.text: Do not take any interest or profit from him, but fear your God, that your countryman may live among you.
LEV 25:36.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 25] Do not take any interest or profit from him, but fear your God, that your countryman may live among you.

LEV 25:37.text: You must not lend him your silver at interest or sell him your food for profit.
LEV 25:37.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 25] You must not lend him your silver at interest or sell him your food for profit.

LEV 25:38.text: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt to give you the land of Canaan and to be your God.
LEV 25:38.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 25 · Conquest Of Canaan, Destroy Canaan] I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt to give you the land of Canaan and to be your God.

LEV 25:39.text: If a countryman among you becomes destitute and sells himself to you, then you must not force him into slave labor.
LEV 25:39.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 25] If a countryman among you becomes destitute and sells himself to you, then you must not force him into slave labor.

LEV 25:40.text: Let him stay with you as a hired worker or temporary resident; he is to work for you until the Year of Jubilee.
LEV 25:40.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 25] Let him stay with you as a hired worker or temporary resident; he is to work for you until the Year of Jubilee.

LEV 25:41.text: Then he and his children are to be released, and he may return to his clan and to the property of his fathers.
LEV 25:41.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 25 · Children] Then he and his children are to be released, and he may return to his clan and to the property of his fathers.

LEV 25:42.text: Because the Israelites are My servants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt, they are not to be sold as slaves.
LEV 25:42.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 25] Because the Israelites are My servants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt, they are not to be sold as slaves.

LEV 25:43.text: You are not to rule over them harshly, but you shall fear your God.
LEV 25:43.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 25] You are not to rule over them harshly, but you shall fear your God.

LEV 25:44.text: Your menservants and maidservants shall come from the nations around you, from whom you may purchase them.
LEV 25:44.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 25] Your menservants and maidservants shall come from the nations around you, from whom you may purchase them.

LEV 25:45.text: You may also purchase them from the foreigners residing among you or their clans living among you who are born in your land. These may become your property.
LEV 25:45.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 25] You may also purchase them from the foreigners residing among you or their clans living among you who are born in your land. These may become your property.

LEV 25:46.text: You may leave them to your sons after you to inherit as property; you can make them slaves for life. But as for your brothers, the Israelites, no man may rule harshly over his brother.
LEV 25:46.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 25] You may leave them to your sons after you to inherit as property; you can make them slaves for life. But as for your brothers, the Israelites, no man may rule harshly over his brother.

LEV 25:47.text: If a foreigner residing among you prospers, but your countryman dwelling near him becomes destitute and sells himself to the foreigner or to a member of his clan,
LEV 25:47.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 25] If a foreigner residing among you prospers, but your countryman dwelling near him becomes destitute and sells himself to the foreigner or to a member of his clan,

LEV 25:48.text: he retains the right of redemption after he has sold himself. One of his brothers may redeem him:
LEV 25:48.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 25] he retains the right of redemption after he has sold himself. One of his brothers may redeem him:

LEV 25:49.text: either his uncle or cousin or any close relative from his clan may redeem him. Or if he prospers, he may redeem himself.
LEV 25:49.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 25] either his uncle or cousin or any close relative from his clan may redeem him. Or if he prospers, he may redeem himself.

LEV 25:50.text: He and his purchaser will then count the time from the year he sold himself up to the Year of Jubilee. The price of his sale will be determined by the number of years, based on the daily wages of a hired hand.
LEV 25:50.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 25] He and his purchaser will then count the time from the year he sold himself up to the Year of Jubilee. The price of his sale will be determined by the number of years, based on the daily wages of a hired hand.

LEV 25:51.text: If many years remain, he must pay for his redemption in proportion to his purchase price.
LEV 25:51.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 25] If many years remain, he must pay for his redemption in proportion to his purchase price.

LEV 25:52.text: If only a few years remain until the Year of Jubilee, he is to calculate and pay his redemption according to his remaining years.
LEV 25:52.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 25] If only a few years remain until the Year of Jubilee, he is to calculate and pay his redemption according to his remaining years.

LEV 25:53.text: He shall be treated like a man hired from year to year, but a foreign owner must not rule over him harshly in your sight.
LEV 25:53.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 25] He shall be treated like a man hired from year to year, but a foreign owner must not rule over him harshly in your sight.

LEV 25:54.text: Even if he is not redeemed in any of these ways, he and his children shall be released in the Year of Jubilee.
LEV 25:54.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 25 · Children] Even if he is not redeemed in any of these ways, he and his children shall be released in the Year of Jubilee.

LEV 25:55.text: For the Israelites are My servants. They are My servants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.
LEV 25:55.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 25] For the Israelites are My servants. They are My servants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.

LEV 26:1.text: “You must not make idols for yourselves or set up a carved image or sacred pillar; you must not place a sculpted stone in your land to bow down to it. For I am the LORD your God.
LEV 26:1.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 26 · Graven Image, Idolatry] “You must not make idols for yourselves or set up a carved image or sacred pillar; you must not place a sculpted stone in your land to bow down to it. For I am the LORD your God.

LEV 26:2.text: You must keep My Sabbaths and have reverence for My sanctuary. I am the LORD.
LEV 26:2.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 26] You must keep My Sabbaths and have reverence for My sanctuary. I am the LORD.

LEV 26:3.text: If you follow My statutes and carefully keep My commandments,
LEV 26:3.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 26 · Law] If you follow My statutes and carefully keep My commandments,

LEV 26:4.text: I will give you rains in their season, and the land will yield its produce, and the trees of the field will bear their fruit.
LEV 26:4.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 26 · Fruit of the Spirit] I will give you rains in their season, and the land will yield its produce, and the trees of the field will bear their fruit.

LEV 26:5.text: Your threshing will continue until the grape harvest, and the grape harvest will continue until sowing time; you will have your fill of food to eat and will dwell securely in your land.
LEV 26:5.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 26] Your threshing will continue until the grape harvest, and the grape harvest will continue until sowing time; you will have your fill of food to eat and will dwell securely in your land.

LEV 26:6.text: And I will give peace to the land, and you will lie down with nothing to fear. I will rid the land of dangerous animals, and no sword will pass through your land.
LEV 26:6.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 26] And I will give peace to the land, and you will lie down with nothing to fear. I will rid the land of dangerous animals, and no sword will pass through your land.

LEV 26:7.text: You will pursue your enemies, and they will fall by the sword before you.
LEV 26:7.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 26] You will pursue your enemies, and they will fall by the sword before you.

LEV 26:8.text: Five of you will pursue a hundred, and a hundred of you will pursue ten thousand, and your enemies will fall by the sword before you.
LEV 26:8.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 26] Five of you will pursue a hundred, and a hundred of you will pursue ten thousand, and your enemies will fall by the sword before you.

LEV 26:9.text: I will turn toward you and make you fruitful and multiply you, and I will establish My covenant with you.
LEV 26:9.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 26 · Covenant] I will turn toward you and make you fruitful and multiply you, and I will establish My covenant with you.

LEV 26:10.text: You will still be eating the old supply of grain when you need to clear it out to make room for the new.
LEV 26:10.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 26] You will still be eating the old supply of grain when you need to clear it out to make room for the new.

LEV 26:11.text: And I will make My dwelling place among you, and My soul will not despise you.
LEV 26:11.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 26] And I will make My dwelling place among you, and My soul will not despise you.

LEV 26:12.text: I will walk among you and be your God, and you will be My people.
LEV 26:12.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 26] I will walk among you and be your God, and you will be My people.

LEV 26:13.text: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt so that you would no longer be slaves to the Egyptians. I broke the bars of your yoke and enabled you to walk in uprightness.
LEV 26:13.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 26] I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt so that you would no longer be slaves to the Egyptians. I broke the bars of your yoke and enabled you to walk in uprightness.

LEV 26:14.text: If, however, you fail to obey Me and to carry out all these commandments,
LEV 26:14.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 26 · Law] If, however, you fail to obey Me and to carry out all these commandments,

LEV 26:15.text: and if you reject My statutes, despise My ordinances, and neglect to carry out all My commandments, and so break My covenant,
LEV 26:15.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 26 · Covenant, Law] and if you reject My statutes, despise My ordinances, and neglect to carry out all My commandments, and so break My covenant,

LEV 26:16.text: then this is what I will do to you: I will bring upon you sudden terror, wasting disease, and fever that will destroy your sight and drain your life. You will sow your seed in vain, because your enemies will eat it.
LEV 26:16.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 26 · Destroy Canaan, Destroy Canaanites] then this is what I will do to you: I will bring upon you sudden terror, wasting disease, and fever that will destroy your sight and drain your life. You will sow your seed in vain, because your enemies will eat it.

LEV 26:17.text: And I will set My face against you, so that you will be defeated by your enemies. Those who hate you will rule over you, and you will flee when no one pursues you.
LEV 26:17.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 26] And I will set My face against you, so that you will be defeated by your enemies. Those who hate you will rule over you, and you will flee when no one pursues you.

LEV 26:18.text: And if after all this you will not obey Me, I will proceed to punish you sevenfold for your sins.
LEV 26:18.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 26] And if after all this you will not obey Me, I will proceed to punish you sevenfold for your sins.

LEV 26:19.text: I will break down your stubborn pride and make your sky like iron and your land like bronze,
LEV 26:19.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 26] I will break down your stubborn pride and make your sky like iron and your land like bronze,

LEV 26:20.text: and your strength will be spent in vain. For your land will not yield its produce, and the trees of the land will not bear their fruit.
LEV 26:20.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 26 · Fruit of the Spirit] and your strength will be spent in vain. For your land will not yield its produce, and the trees of the land will not bear their fruit.

LEV 26:21.text: If you walk in hostility toward Me and refuse to obey Me, I will multiply your plagues seven times, according to your sins.
LEV 26:21.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 26 · End Times] If you walk in hostility toward Me and refuse to obey Me, I will multiply your plagues seven times, according to your sins.

LEV 26:22.text: I will send wild animals against you to rob you of your children, destroy your livestock, and reduce your numbers, until your roads lie desolate.
LEV 26:22.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 26 · Children, Destroy Canaan] I will send wild animals against you to rob you of your children, destroy your livestock, and reduce your numbers, until your roads lie desolate.

LEV 26:23.text: And if in spite of these things you do not accept My discipline, but continue to walk in hostility toward Me,
LEV 26:23.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 26] And if in spite of these things you do not accept My discipline, but continue to walk in hostility toward Me,

LEV 26:24.text: then I will act with hostility toward you, and I will strike you sevenfold for your sins.
LEV 26:24.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 26] then I will act with hostility toward you, and I will strike you sevenfold for your sins.

LEV 26:25.text: And I will bring a sword against you to execute the vengeance of the covenant. Though you withdraw into your cities, I will send a plague among you, and you will be delivered into the hand of the enemy.
LEV 26:25.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 26 · Covenant] And I will bring a sword against you to execute the vengeance of the covenant. Though you withdraw into your cities, I will send a plague among you, and you will be delivered into the hand of the enemy.

LEV 26:26.text: When I cut off your supply of bread, ten women will bake your bread in a single oven and dole out your bread by weight, so that you will eat but not be satisfied.
LEV 26:26.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 26 · Biblical Women, Heroic Women] When I cut off your supply of bread, ten women will bake your bread in a single oven and dole out your bread by weight, so that you will eat but not be satisfied.

LEV 26:27.text: But if in spite of all this you do not obey Me, but continue to walk in hostility toward Me,
LEV 26:27.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 26] But if in spite of all this you do not obey Me, but continue to walk in hostility toward Me,

LEV 26:28.text: then I will walk in fury against you, and I, even I, will punish you sevenfold for your sins.
LEV 26:28.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 26] then I will walk in fury against you, and I, even I, will punish you sevenfold for your sins.

LEV 26:29.text: You will eat the flesh of your own sons and daughters.
LEV 26:29.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 26] You will eat the flesh of your own sons and daughters.

LEV 26:30.text: I will destroy your high places, cut down your incense altars, and heap your lifeless bodies on the lifeless remains of your idols; and My soul will despise you.
LEV 26:30.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 26 · Destroy Canaan, Destroy Canaanites] I will destroy your high places, cut down your incense altars, and heap your lifeless bodies on the lifeless remains of your idols; and My soul will despise you.

LEV 26:31.text: I will reduce your cities to rubble and lay waste your sanctuaries, and I will refuse to smell the pleasing aroma of your sacrifices.
LEV 26:31.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 26] I will reduce your cities to rubble and lay waste your sanctuaries, and I will refuse to smell the pleasing aroma of your sacrifices.

LEV 26:32.text: And I will lay waste the land, so that your enemies who dwell in it will be appalled.
LEV 26:32.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 26] And I will lay waste the land, so that your enemies who dwell in it will be appalled.

LEV 26:33.text: But I will scatter you among the nations and will draw out a sword after you as your land becomes desolate and your cities are laid waste.
LEV 26:33.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 26] But I will scatter you among the nations and will draw out a sword after you as your land becomes desolate and your cities are laid waste.

LEV 26:34.text: Then the land shall enjoy its Sabbaths all the days it lies desolate, while you are in the land of your enemies. At that time the land will rest and enjoy its Sabbaths.
LEV 26:34.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 26] Then the land shall enjoy its Sabbaths all the days it lies desolate, while you are in the land of your enemies. At that time the land will rest and enjoy its Sabbaths.

LEV 26:35.text: As long as it lies desolate, the land will have the rest it did not receive during the Sabbaths when you lived in it.
LEV 26:35.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 26] As long as it lies desolate, the land will have the rest it did not receive during the Sabbaths when you lived in it.

LEV 26:36.text: As for those of you who survive, I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies, so that even the sound of a windblown leaf will put them to flight. And they will flee as one flees the sword, and fall when no one pursues them.
LEV 26:36.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 26] As for those of you who survive, I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies, so that even the sound of a windblown leaf will put them to flight. And they will flee as one flees the sword, and fall when no one pursues them.

LEV 26:37.text: They will stumble over one another as before the sword, though no one is behind them. So you will not be able to stand against your enemies.
LEV 26:37.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 26] They will stumble over one another as before the sword, though no one is behind them. So you will not be able to stand against your enemies.

LEV 26:38.text: You will perish among the nations, and the land of your enemies will consume you.
LEV 26:38.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 26] You will perish among the nations, and the land of your enemies will consume you.

LEV 26:39.text: Those of you who survive in the lands of your enemies will waste away in their iniquity and will decay in the sins of their fathers.
LEV 26:39.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 26] Those of you who survive in the lands of your enemies will waste away in their iniquity and will decay in the sins of their fathers.

LEV 26:40.text: But if they will confess their iniquity and that of their fathers in the unfaithfulness that they practiced against Me, by which they have also walked in hostility toward Me—
LEV 26:40.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 26 · Faith, Adultery] But if they will confess their iniquity and that of their fathers in the unfaithfulness that they practiced against Me, by which they have also walked in hostility toward Me—

LEV 26:41.text: and I acted with hostility toward them and brought them into the land of their enemies—and if their uncircumcised hearts will be humbled and they will make amends for their iniquity,
LEV 26:41.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 26] and I acted with hostility toward them and brought them into the land of their enemies—and if their uncircumcised hearts will be humbled and they will make amends for their iniquity,

LEV 26:42.text: then I will remember My covenant with Jacob and My covenant with Isaac and My covenant with Abraham, and I will remember the land.
LEV 26:42.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 26 · Covenant, Israel] then I will remember My covenant with Jacob and My covenant with Isaac and My covenant with Abraham, and I will remember the land.

LEV 26:43.text: For the land will be abandoned by them, and it will enjoy its Sabbaths by lying desolate without them. And they will pay the penalty for their iniquity, because they rejected My ordinances and abhorred My statutes.
LEV 26:43.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 26 · Lying] For the land will be abandoned by them, and it will enjoy its Sabbaths by lying desolate without them. And they will pay the penalty for their iniquity, because they rejected My ordinances and abhorred My statutes.

LEV 27:13.bm25Text: [Leviticus · Chapter 27] If, however, the owner decides to redeem the animal, he must add a fifth to its value.

MIC 3:8.bm25Text: [Micah · Chapter 3 · Fruit of the Spirit, Israel] As for me, however, I am filled with power by the Spirit of the LORD, with justice and courage, to declare to Jacob his transgression and to Israel his sin.

MIC 4:7.bm25Text: [Micah · Chapter 4] And I will make the lame into a remnant, and the outcast into a strong nation. Then the LORD will rule over them in Mount Zion from that day and forever.

MIC 4:8.bm25Text: [Micah · Chapter 4] And you, O watchtower of the flock, O stronghold of the Daughter of Zion— the former dominion will be restored to you; sovereignty will come to the Daughter of Jerusalem.”

MIC 4:9.bm25Text: [Micah · Chapter 4] Why do you now cry aloud? Is there no king among you? Has your counselor perished so that anguish grips you like a woman in labor?

MIC 4:11.bm25Text: [Micah · Chapter 4] But now many nations have assembled against you, saying, “Let her be defiled, and let us feast our eyes on Zion.”

MIC 4:12.bm25Text: [Micah · Chapter 4] But they do not know the thoughts of the LORD or understand His plan, for He has gathered them like sheaves to the threshing floor.

MIC 5:5.bm25Text: [Micah · Chapter 5 · The Ruler Born in Bethlehem] And He will be our peace when Assyria invades our land and tramples our citadels. We will raise against it seven shepherds, even eight leaders of men.

MIC 5:6.bm25Text: [Micah · Chapter 5] And they will rule the land of Assyria with the sword, and the land of Nimrod with the blade drawn. So He will deliver us when Assyria invades our land and marches into our borders.

MIC 5:7.bm25Text: [Micah · Chapter 5 · Israel] Then the remnant of Jacob will be in the midst of many peoples like dew from the LORD, like showers on the grass, which do not wait for man or linger for mankind.

MIC 5:9.bm25Text: [Micah · Chapter 5] Your hand will be lifted over your foes, and all your enemies will be cut off.

MIC 5:10.bm25Text: [Micah · Chapter 5] “In that day,” declares the LORD, “I will remove your horses from among you and wreck your chariots.

MIC 5:11.bm25Text: [Micah · Chapter 5] I will remove the cities of your land and tear down all your strongholds.

MIC 5:12.bm25Text: [Micah · Chapter 5] I will cut the sorceries from your hand, and you will have no fortune-tellers.

MIC 5:13.bm25Text: [Micah · Chapter 5] I will also cut off the carved images and sacred pillars from among you, so that you will no longer bow down to the work of your own hands.

MIC 5:14.bm25Text: [Micah · Chapter 5] I will root out the Asherah poles from your midst and demolish your cities.

MIC 5:15.bm25Text: [Micah · Chapter 5] I will take vengeance in anger and wrath upon the nations that have not obeyed Me.”

MIC 6:1.bm25Text: [Micah · Chapter 6] Hear now what the LORD says:  “Arise, plead your case before the mountains, and let the hills hear your voice.

MIC 6:2.bm25Text: [Micah · Chapter 6 · Israel] Hear, O mountains, the LORD’s indictment, you enduring foundations of the earth. For the LORD has a case against His people, and He will argue it against Israel:

MIC 6:3.bm25Text: [Micah · Chapter 6] ‘My people, what have I done to you? Testify against Me how I have wearied you!

MIC 6:4.bm25Text: [Micah · Chapter 6] For I brought you up from the land of Egypt and redeemed you from the house of slavery. I sent Moses before you, as well as Aaron and Miriam.

MIC 6:5.bm25Text: [Micah · Chapter 6] My people, remember what Balak king of Moab counseled and what Balaam son of Beor answered. Remember your journey from Shittim to Gilgal, so that you may acknowledge the righteousness of the LORD.’”

MIC 6:6.bm25Text: [Micah · Chapter 6] With what shall I come before the LORD when I bow before the God on high? Should I come to Him with burnt offerings, with year-old calves?

MIC 6:7.bm25Text: [Micah · Chapter 6 · Fruit of the Spirit] Would the LORD be pleased with thousands of rams, with ten thousand rivers of oil? Shall I present my firstborn for my transgression, the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?

MIC 6:8.bm25Text: [Micah · Chapter 6 · Forgiveness, Love] He has shown you, O man, what is good. And what does the LORD require of you but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?

MIC 6:9.bm25Text: [Micah · Chapter 6] The voice of the LORD calls out to the city (and it is sound wisdom to fear Your name): “Heed the rod and the One who ordained it.

MIC 6:10.bm25Text: [Micah · Chapter 6] Can I forget any longer, O house of the wicked, the treasures of wickedness and the short ephah, which is accursed?

MIC 6:11.bm25Text: [Micah · Chapter 6 · False Gods, False Witness] Can I excuse dishonest scales or bags of false weights?

MIC 6:12.bm25Text: [Micah · Chapter 6] For the wealthy of the city are full of violence, and its residents speak lies; their tongues are deceitful in their mouths.

MIC 6:13.bm25Text: [Micah · Chapter 6] Therefore I am striking you severely, to ruin you because of your sins.

MIC 6:14.bm25Text: [Micah · Chapter 6] You will eat but not be satisfied, and your hunger will remain with you. What you acquire, you will not preserve; and what you save, I will give to the sword.

MIC 6:15.bm25Text: [Micah · Chapter 6] You will sow but not reap; you will press olives but not anoint yourselves with oil; you will tread grapes but not drink the wine.

MIC 6:16.bm25Text: [Micah · Chapter 6] You have kept the statutes of Omri and all the practices of Ahab’s house; you have followed their counsel. Therefore I will make you a desolation, and your inhabitants an object of contempt; you will bear the scorn of the nations.”

MIC 7:1.bm25Text: [Micah · Chapter 7 · Fruit of the Spirit] Woe is me!   For I am like one gathering summer fruit at the gleaning of the vineyard; there is no cluster to eat, no early fig that I crave.

MIC 7:2.bm25Text: [Micah · Chapter 7] The godly man has perished from the earth; there is no one upright among men. They all lie in wait for blood; they hunt one another with a net.

MIC 7:3.bm25Text: [Micah · Chapter 7 · Lust] Both hands are skilled at evil; the prince and the judge demand a bribe. When the powerful utters his evil desire, they all conspire together.

MIC 7:5.bm25Text: [Micah · Chapter 7 · Faith] Do not rely on a friend; do not trust in a companion. Seal the doors of your mouth from her who lies in your arms.

MIC 7:7.bm25Text: [Micah · Chapter 7] But as for me, I will look to the LORD; I will wait for the God of my salvation. My God will hear me.

MIC 7:8.bm25Text: [Micah · Chapter 7 · Light] Do not gloat over me, my enemy! Though I have fallen, I will arise; though I sit in darkness, the LORD will be my light.

MIC 7:9.bm25Text: [Micah · Chapter 7 · Justice, Light] Because I have sinned against Him, I must endure the rage of the LORD, until He argues my case and executes justice for me. He will bring me into the light; I will see His righteousness.

MIC 7:11.bm25Text: [Micah · Chapter 7] The day for rebuilding your walls will come— the day for extending your boundary.

MIC 7:12.bm25Text: [Micah · Chapter 7] On that day they will come to you from Assyria and the cities of Egypt, even from Egypt to the Euphrates, from sea to sea and mountain to mountain.

MIC 7:13.bm25Text: [Micah · Chapter 7 · Fruit of the Spirit] Then the earth will become desolate because of its inhabitants, as the fruit of their deeds.

MIC 7:15.bm25Text: [Micah · Chapter 7] As in the days when you came out of Egypt, I will show My wonders.

MIC 7:16.bm25Text: [Micah · Chapter 7] Nations will see and be ashamed, deprived of all their might. They will put their hands over their mouths, and their ears will become deaf.

MIC 7:17.bm25Text: [Micah · Chapter 7] They will lick the dust like a snake, like reptiles slithering on the ground. They will crawl from their holes in the presence of the LORD our God; they will tremble in fear of You.

MRK 4:8.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 4] Still other seed fell on good soil, where it sprouted, grew up, and produced a crop—one bearing thirtyfold, another sixtyfold, and another a hundredfold.”

MRK 4:10.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 4 · About Forgiveness, Jesus Christ] As soon as Jesus was alone with the Twelve and those around Him, they asked Him about the parable.

MRK 4:12.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 4 · Forgiveness] so that,  ‘they may be ever seeing but never perceiving, and ever hearing but never understanding; otherwise they might turn and be forgiven.’”

MRK 4:13.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 4 · Jesus Christ] Then Jesus said to them, “Do you not understand this parable? Then how will you understand any of the parables?

MRK 4:14.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 4] The farmer sows the word.

MRK 4:15.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 4] Some are like the seeds along the path, where the word is sown. As soon as they hear it, Satan comes and takes away the word that was sown in them.

MRK 4:16.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 4] Some are like the seeds sown on rocky ground. They hear the word and at once receive it with joy.

MRK 4:17.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 4] But they themselves have no root, and they remain for only a season. When trouble or persecution comes because of the word, they quickly fall away.

MRK 4:18.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 4] Others are like the seeds sown among the thorns. They hear the word,

MRK 4:19.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 4 · Lust] but the worries of this life, the deceitfulness of wealth, and the desire for other things come in and choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.

MRK 4:20.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 4] Still others are like the seeds sown on good soil. They hear the word, receive it, and produce a crop—thirtyfold, sixtyfold, or a hundredfold.”

MRK 4:21.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 4 · Jesus Christ, Light] Jesus also said to them, “Does anyone bring in a lamp to put it under a basket or under a bed? Doesn’t he set it on a stand?

MRK 4:22.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 4 · Light] For there is nothing hidden that will not be disclosed, and nothing concealed that will not be brought to light.

MRK 4:23.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 4] If anyone has ears to hear, let him hear.”

MRK 4:24.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 4] He went on to say, “Pay attention to what you hear. With the measure you use, it will be measured to you, and even more will be added to you.

MRK 4:25.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 4] For whoever has will be given more. But whoever does not have, even what he has will be taken away from him.”

MRK 4:26.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 4 · Jesus Christ, Kingdom of God] Jesus also said, “The kingdom of God is like a man who scatters seed on the ground.

MRK 4:27.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 4] Night and day he sleeps and wakes, and the seed sprouts and grows, though he knows not how.

MRK 4:28.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 4] All by itself the earth produces a crop—first the stalk, then the head, then grain that ripens within.

MRK 4:29.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 4] And as soon as the grain is ripe, he swings the sickle, because the harvest has come.”

MRK 4:30.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 4 · Kingdom of God] Then He asked, “To what can we compare the kingdom of God? With what parable shall we present it?

MRK 4:31.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 4] It is like a mustard seed, which is the smallest of all seeds sown upon the earth.

MRK 4:32.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 4] But after it is planted, it grows to be the largest of all garden plants and puts forth great branches, so that the birds of the air nest in its shade.”

MRK 4:33.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 4 · Jesus Christ] With many such parables Jesus spoke the word to them, to the extent that they could understand.

MRK 4:34.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 4 · Apostles] He did not tell them anything without using a parable. But privately He explained everything to His own disciples.

MRK 4:35.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 4 · Apostles, Cross] When that evening came, He said to His disciples, “Let us cross to the other side.”

MRK 4:36.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 4 · Jesus Christ] After they had dismissed the crowd, they took Jesus with them, since He was already in the boat. And there were other boats with Him.

MRK 4:37.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 4] Soon a violent windstorm came up, and the waves were breaking over the boat, so that it was being swamped.

MRK 4:38.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 4 · Jesus Christ] But Jesus was in the stern, sleeping on the cushion. So they woke Him and said, “Teacher, don’t You care that we are perishing?”

MRK 4:39.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 4 · God Commanded Genocide, Jesus Christ] Then Jesus got up and rebuked the wind and the sea. “Silence!” He commanded. “Be still!” And the wind died down, and it was perfectly calm.

MRK 4:40.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 4 · Faith] “Why are you so afraid?” He asked. “Do you still have no faith?”

MRK 4:41.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 4] Overwhelmed with fear, they asked one another, “Who is this, that even the wind and the sea obey Him?”

MRK 5:1.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 5] On the other side of the sea, they arrived in the region of the Gerasenes.

MRK 5:2.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 5 · Fruit of the Spirit, Jesus Christ] As soon as Jesus got out of the boat, He was met by a man with an unclean spirit, who was coming from the tombs.

MRK 5:3.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 5] This man had been living in the tombs and could no longer be restrained, even with chains.

MRK 5:4.text: Though he was often bound with chains and shackles, he had broken the chains and shattered the shackles. Now there was no one with the strength to subdue him.
MRK 5:4.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 5] Though he was often bound with chains and shackles, he had broken the chains and shattered the shackles. Now there was no one with the strength to subdue him.

MRK 5:5.text: Night and day in the tombs and in the mountains he kept crying out and cutting himself with stones.
MRK 5:5.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 5] Night and day in the tombs and in the mountains he kept crying out and cutting himself with stones.

MRK 5:6.text: When the man saw Jesus from a distance, he ran and fell on his knees before Him.
MRK 5:6.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 5 · Jesus Christ] When the man saw Jesus from a distance, he ran and fell on his knees before Him.

MRK 5:7.text: And he shouted in a loud voice, “What do You want with me, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? I beg You before God not to torture me!”
MRK 5:7.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 5 · Jesus Christ] And he shouted in a loud voice, “What do You want with me, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? I beg You before God not to torture me!”

MRK 5:8.text: For Jesus had already declared, “Come out of this man, you unclean spirit!”
MRK 5:8.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 5 · Fruit of the Spirit, Jesus Christ] For Jesus had already declared, “Come out of this man, you unclean spirit!”

MRK 5:9.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 5 · Jesus Christ] “What is your name?” Jesus asked.  “My name is Legion,” he replied, “for we are many.”

MRK 5:10.text: And he begged Jesus repeatedly not to send them out of that region.
MRK 5:10.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 5 · Jesus Christ] And he begged Jesus repeatedly not to send them out of that region.

MRK 5:11.text: There on the nearby hillside a large herd of pigs was feeding.
MRK 5:11.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 5] There on the nearby hillside a large herd of pigs was feeding.

MRK 5:12.text: So the demons begged Jesus, “Send us to the pigs, so that we may enter them.”
MRK 5:12.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 5 · Demons, Jesus Christ] So the demons begged Jesus, “Send us to the pigs, so that we may enter them.”

MRK 5:13.text: He gave them permission, and the unclean spirits came out and went into the pigs, and the herd of about two thousand rushed down the steep bank into the sea and drowned in the water.
MRK 5:13.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 5 · About Forgiveness, Demons] He gave them permission, and the unclean spirits came out and went into the pigs, and the herd of about two thousand rushed down the steep bank into the sea and drowned in the water.

MRK 5:14.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 5] Those tending the pigs ran off and reported this in the town and countryside, and the people went out to see what had happened.

MRK 5:15.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 5 · Demons, Jesus Christ] When they came to Jesus, they saw the man who had been possessed by the legion of demons sitting there, clothed and in his right mind; and they were afraid.

MRK 5:16.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 5] Those who had seen it described what had happened to the demon-possessed man and also to the pigs.

MRK 5:17.text: And the people began to beg Jesus to leave their region.
MRK 5:17.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 5 · Jesus Christ] And the people began to beg Jesus to leave their region.

MRK 5:18.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 5 · Demons] As He was getting into the boat, the man who had been possessed by the demons begged to go with Him.

MRK 5:19.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 5 · Forgiveness, Compassion] But Jesus would not allow him. “Go home to your own people,” He said, “and tell them how much the Lord has done for you, and what mercy He has shown you.”

MRK 5:20.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 5 · Jesus Christ] So the man went away and began to proclaim throughout the Decapolis how much Jesus had done for him. And everyone was amazed.

MRK 5:21.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 5 · Jesus Christ] When Jesus had again crossed by boat to the other side, a large crowd gathered around Him beside the sea.

MRK 5:22.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 5 · Jesus Christ] A synagogue leader named Jairus arrived, and seeing Jesus, he fell at His feet

MRK 5:23.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 5 · Death] and pleaded with Him urgently, “My little daughter is near death. Please come and place Your hands on her, so that she will be healed and live.”

MRK 5:24.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 5 · Jesus Christ] So Jesus went with him, and a large crowd followed and pressed around Him.

MRK 5:25.text: And a woman was there who had suffered from bleeding for twelve years.
MRK 5:25.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 5] And a woman was there who had suffered from bleeding for twelve years.

MRK 5:26.text: She had borne much agony under the care of many physicians and had spent all she had, but to no avail. Instead, her condition had only grown worse.
MRK 5:26.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 5] She had borne much agony under the care of many physicians and had spent all she had, but to no avail. Instead, her condition had only grown worse.

MRK 5:27.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 5 · About Forgiveness, Jesus Christ] When the woman heard about Jesus, she came up through the crowd behind Him and touched His cloak.

MRK 5:28.text: For she kept saying, “If only I touch His garments, I will be healed.”
MRK 5:28.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 5] For she kept saying, “If only I touch His garments, I will be healed.”

MRK 5:29.text: Immediately her bleeding stopped, and she sensed in her body that she was healed of her affliction.
MRK 5:29.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 5] Immediately her bleeding stopped, and she sensed in her body that she was healed of her affliction.

MRK 5:30.text: At once Jesus was aware that power had gone out from Him. Turning to the crowd, He asked, “Who touched My garments?”
MRK 5:30.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 5 · Jesus Christ] At once Jesus was aware that power had gone out from Him. Turning to the crowd, He asked, “Who touched My garments?”

MRK 5:31.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 5 · Apostles] His disciples answered, “You can see the crowd pressing in on You, and yet You ask, ‘Who touched Me?’”

MRK 5:32.text: But He kept looking around to see who had done this.
MRK 5:32.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 5] But He kept looking around to see who had done this.

MRK 5:33.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 5] Then the woman, knowing what had happened to her, came and fell down before Him trembling in fear, and she told Him the whole truth.

MRK 5:34.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 5 · Faith, Jesus Christ] “Daughter,” said Jesus, “your faith has healed you. Go in peace and be free of your affliction.”

MRK 5:35.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 5 · Angels] While He was still speaking, messengers from the house of Jairus arrived and said, “Your daughter is dead; why bother the Teacher anymore?”

MRK 5:36.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 5 · Faith, Jesus Christ] But Jesus overheard their conversation and said to Jairus, “Do not be afraid; just believe.”

MRK 5:37.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 5] And He did not allow anyone to accompany Him except Peter, James, and John the brother of James.

MRK 5:38.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 5 · Jesus Christ] When they arrived at the house of the synagogue leader, Jesus saw the commotion and the people weeping and wailing loudly.
