MRK 5:39.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 5] He went inside and asked, “Why all this commotion and weeping? The child is not dead, but asleep.”

MRK 5:40.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 5 · God the Father] And they laughed at Him.  After He had put them all outside, He took the child’s father and mother and His own companions, and went in to see the child.

MRK 5:41.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 5 · Jesus Christ] Taking her by the hand, Jesus said, “Talitha koum!” which means, “Little girl, I say to you, get up!”

MRK 5:42.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 5] Immediately the girl got up and began to walk around. She was twelve years old, and at once they were utterly astounded.

MRK 5:43.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 5 · About Forgiveness, Jesus Christ] Then Jesus gave strict orders that no one should know about this, and He told them to give her something to eat.

MRK 6:1.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 6 · Apostles, Jesus Christ] Jesus went on from there and came to His hometown, accompanied by His disciples.

MRK 6:3.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 6] Isn’t this the carpenter, the son of Mary and the brother of James, Joses, Judas, and Simon? Aren’t His sisters here with us as well?” And they took offense at Him.

MRK 6:11.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 6] If anyone will not welcome you or listen to you, shake the dust off your feet when you leave that place, as a testimony against them.”

MRK 6:20.bm25Text: [Mark · Chapter 6] because Herod feared John and protected him, knowing that he was a righteous and holy man. When he heard John’s words, he was greatly perplexed; yet he listened to him gladly.

NEH 4:20.bm25Text: [Nehemiah · Chapter 4] Wherever you hear the sound of the horn, rally to us there. Our God will fight for us!”

NEH 4:21.bm25Text: [Nehemiah · Chapter 4] So we continued the work, while half of the men held spears from the break of dawn until the stars came out.

NEH 4:22.bm25Text: [Nehemiah · Chapter 4] At that time I also said to the people, “Let every man and his servant spend the night inside Jerusalem, so that they can stand guard by night and work by day.”

NEH 5:1.bm25Text: [Nehemiah · Chapter 5 · About Forgiveness] About that time there was a great outcry from the people and their wives against their fellow Jews.

NEH 5:2.bm25Text: [Nehemiah · Chapter 5] Some were saying, “We and our sons and daughters are numerous. We must get grain in order to eat and stay alive.”

NEH 5:3.bm25Text: [Nehemiah · Chapter 5] Others were saying, “We are mortgaging our fields, our vineyards, and our homes to get grain during the famine.”

NEH 5:4.bm25Text: [Nehemiah · Chapter 5] Still others were saying, “We have borrowed money to pay the king’s tax on our fields and vineyards.

NEH 5:5.text: We and our children are just like our countrymen and their children, yet we are subjecting our sons and daughters to slavery. Some of our daughters are already enslaved, but we are powerless to redeem them because our fields and vineyards belong to others.”
NEH 5:5.bm25Text: [Nehemiah · Chapter 5 · Children] We and our children are just like our countrymen and their children, yet we are subjecting our sons and daughters to slavery. NEH 5:6.text: When I heard their outcry and these complaints, I became extremely angry,
NEH 5:6.bm25Text: [Nehemiah · Chapter 5] When I heard their outcry and these complaints, I became extremely angry,

NEH 5:8.text: and said, “We have done our best to buy back our Jewish brothers who were sold to foreigners, but now you are selling your own brothers, that they may be sold back to us!”  But they remained silent, for they could find nothing to say.
NEH 5:8.bm25Text: [Nehemiah · Chapter 5] and said, “We have done our best to buy back our Jewish brothers who were sold to foreigners, but now you are selling your own brothers, that they may be sold back to us!”  But they remained silent, for they could find nothing to say.

NEH 5:9.text: So I continued, “What you are doing is not right. Shouldn’t you walk in the fear of our God to avoid the reproach of our foreign enemies?
NEH 5:9.bm25Text: [Nehemiah · Chapter 5] So I continued, “What you are doing is not right. Shouldn’t you walk in the fear of our God to avoid the reproach of our foreign enemies?

NEH 5:10.bm25Text: [Nehemiah · Chapter 5] I, as well as my brothers and my servants, have been lending the people money and grain. Please, let us stop this usury.

NEH 5:11.text: Please restore to them immediately their fields, vineyards, olive groves, and houses, along with the percentage of the money, grain, new wine, and oil that you have been assessing them.”
NEH 5:11.bm25Text: [Nehemiah · Chapter 5] Please restore to them immediately their fields, vineyards, olive groves, and houses, along with the percentage of the money, grain, new wine, and oil that you have been assessing them.”

NEH 5:12.text: “We will restore it,” they replied, “and will require nothing more from them. We will do as you say.”  So I summoned the priests and required of the nobles and officials an oath that they would do what they had promised.
NEH 5:12.bm25Text: [Nehemiah · Chapter 5 · Calling] “We will restore it,” they replied, “and will require nothing more from them. We will do as you say.”  So I summoned the priests and required of the nobles and officials an oath that they would do what they had promised.

NEH 5:13.text: I also shook out the folds of my robe and said, “May God likewise shake out of His house and possession every man who does not keep this promise. May such a man be shaken out and have nothing!”  The whole assembly said, “Amen,” and they praised the LORD. And the people did as they had promised.

NEH 5:14.text: Furthermore, from the day King Artaxerxes appointed me to be their governor in the land of Judah, from his twentieth year until his thirty-second year (twelve years total), neither I nor my brothers ate the food allotted to the governor.

NEH 5:15.text: The governors before me had heavily burdened the people, taking from them bread and wine plus forty shekels of silver. Their servants also oppressed the people, but I did not do this because of my fear of God.

NEH 5:16.bm25Text: [Nehemiah · Chapter 5] Instead, I devoted myself to the construction of the wall, and all my servants were gathered there for the work; we did not acquire any land.

NEH 5:17.bm25Text: [Nehemiah · Chapter 5] There were 150 Jews and officials at my table, besides the guests from the surrounding nations.

NEH 5:18.text: Each day one ox, six choice sheep, and some fowl were prepared for me, and once every ten days an abundance of all kinds of wine was provided. But I did not demand the food allotted to the governor, because the burden on the people was so heavy.

NEH 5:19.bm25Text: [Nehemiah · Chapter 5] Remember me favorably, O my God, for all that I have done for this people.

NEH 9:6.text: You alone are the LORD. You created the heavens, the highest heavens with all their host, the earth and all that is on it, the seas and all that is in them. You give life to all things, and the host of heaven worships You.
NEH 9:6.bm25Text: [Nehemiah · Chapter 9 · Heaven] You alone are the LORD. You created the heavens, the highest heavens with all their host, the earth and all that is on it, the seas and all that is in them. You give life to all things, and the host of heaven worships You.

NEH 9:7.text: You are the LORD, the God who chose Abram, who brought him out of Ur of the Chaldeans and gave him the name Abraham.
NEH 9:7.bm25Text: [Nehemiah · Chapter 9] You are the LORD, the God who chose Abram, who brought him out of Ur of the Chaldeans and gave him the name Abraham.

NEH 9:8.text: You found his heart faithful before You, and made a covenant with him to give the land of the Canaanites and Hittites, of the Amorites and Perizzites, of the Jebusites and Girgashites— to give it to his descendants. You have kept Your promise, because You are righteous.
NEH 9:8.bm25Text: [Nehemiah · Chapter 9 · Faith, Adultery In Heart] You found his heart faithful before You, and made a covenant with him to give the land of the Canaanites and Hittites, of the Amorites and Perizzites, of the Jebusites and Girgashites— to give it to his descendants. NEH 9:9.bm25Text: [Nehemiah · Chapter 9] You saw the affliction of our fathers in Egypt; You heard their cry at the Red Sea.

NEH 9:10.text: You performed signs and wonders against Pharaoh, all his officials, and all the people of his land, for You knew they had acted with arrogance against our fathers. You made a name for Yourself that endures to this day.
NEH 9:10.bm25Text: [Nehemiah · Chapter 9] You performed signs and wonders against Pharaoh, all his officials, and all the people of his land, for You knew they had acted with arrogance against our fathers. You made a name for Yourself that endures to this day.

NEH 9:11.bm25Text: [Nehemiah · Chapter 9] You divided the sea before them, and they crossed through it on dry ground. You hurled their pursuers into the depths like a stone into raging waters.

NEH 9:12.bm25Text: [Nehemiah · Chapter 9 · Light] You led them with a pillar of cloud by day and a pillar of fire by night, to light for them the way in which they should travel.

NEH 9:13.bm25Text: [Nehemiah · Chapter 9 · Heaven, Law] You came down on Mount Sinai and spoke with them from heaven. You gave them just ordinances, true laws, and good statutes and commandments.

NEH 9:14.bm25Text: [Nehemiah · Chapter 9 · Law] You revealed to them Your holy Sabbath and gave them commandments and statutes and laws through Your servant Moses.

NEH 9:15.bm25Text: [Nehemiah · Chapter 9 · Heaven] In their hunger You gave them bread from heaven; in their thirst You brought them water from the rock. You told them to go in and possess the land which You had sworn to give them.

NEH 9:16.bm25Text: [Nehemiah · Chapter 9 · Law] But they and our fathers became arrogant and stiff-necked and did not obey Your commandments.

NEH 9:17.text: They refused to listen and failed to remember the wonders You performed among them. They stiffened their necks and appointed a leader to return them to their bondage in Egypt. But You are a forgiving God, gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and rich in loving devotion, and You did not forsake them.
NEH 9:17.bm25Text: [Nehemiah · Chapter 9 · Forgiveness, Devotion] They refused to listen and failed to remember the wonders You performed among them. NEH 9:20.bm25Text: [Nehemiah · Chapter 9 · Fruit of the Spirit] You gave Your good Spirit to instruct them. You did not withhold Your manna from their mouths, and You gave them water for their thirst.

NEH 9:21.bm25Text: [Nehemiah · Chapter 9] For forty years You sustained them in the wilderness, so that they lacked nothing. Their clothes did not wear out and their feet did not swell.

NEH 9:25.text: They captured fortified cities and fertile land and took houses full of all goods, wells already dug, vineyards, olive groves, and fruit trees in abundance. So they ate and were filled; they grew fat and delighted in Your great goodness.
NEH 9:25.bm25Text: [Nehemiah · Chapter 9 · Fruit of the Spirit] They captured fortified cities and fertile land and took houses full of all goods, wells already dug, vineyards, olive groves, and fruit trees in abundance. NUM 8:5.text: Again the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
NUM 8:5.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 8] Again the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

NUM 8:6.text: “Take the Levites from among the Israelites and make them ceremonially clean.
NUM 8:6.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 8] “Take the Levites from among the Israelites and make them ceremonially clean.

NUM 8:7.text: This is what you must do to cleanse them: Sprinkle them with the water of purification. Have them shave their whole bodies and wash their clothes, and so purify themselves.
NUM 8:7.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 8] This is what you must do to cleanse them: Sprinkle them with the water of purification. Have them shave their whole bodies and wash their clothes, and so purify themselves.

NUM 8:8.text: Then have them take a young bull with its grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil, and you are to take a second young bull for a sin offering.
NUM 8:8.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 8] Then have them take a young bull with its grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil, and you are to take a second young bull for a sin offering.

NUM 8:9.text: Bring the Levites before the Tent of Meeting and assemble the whole congregation of Israel.
NUM 8:9.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 8 · Israel] Bring the Levites before the Tent of Meeting and assemble the whole congregation of Israel.

NUM 8:10.text: You are to present the Levites before the LORD and have the Israelites lay their hands upon them.
NUM 8:10.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 8] You are to present the Levites before the LORD and have the Israelites lay their hands upon them.

NUM 8:11.text: Aaron is to present the Levites before the LORD as a wave offering from the sons of Israel, so that they may perform the service of the LORD.
NUM 8:11.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 8 · Israel] Aaron is to present the Levites before the LORD as a wave offering from the sons of Israel, so that they may perform the service of the LORD.

NUM 8:12.text: And the Levites are to lay their hands on the heads of the bulls, and offer to the LORD one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering, to make atonement for the Levites.
NUM 8:12.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 8 · Atonement] And the Levites are to lay their hands on the heads of the bulls, and offer to the LORD one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering, to make atonement for the Levites.

NUM 8:13.text: You are to have the Levites stand before Aaron and his sons and then present them before the LORD as a wave offering.
NUM 8:13.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 8] You are to have the Levites stand before Aaron and his sons and then present them before the LORD as a wave offering.

NUM 8:14.text: In this way you shall separate the Levites from the rest of the Israelites, and the Levites will belong to Me.
NUM 8:14.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 8] In this way you shall separate the Levites from the rest of the Israelites, and the Levites will belong to Me.

NUM 8:15.text: After you have cleansed them and presented them as a wave offering, they may come to serve at the Tent of Meeting.
NUM 8:15.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 8] After you have cleansed them and presented them as a wave offering, they may come to serve at the Tent of Meeting.

NUM 8:16.text: For the Levites have been wholly given to Me from among the sons of Israel. I have taken them for Myself in place of all who come first from the womb, the firstborn of all the sons of Israel.
NUM 8:16.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 8 · Israel] For the Levites have been wholly given to Me from among the sons of Israel. I have taken them for Myself in place of all who come first from the womb, the firstborn of all the sons of Israel.

NUM 8:17.text: For every firstborn male in Israel is Mine, both man and beast. I set them apart for Myself on the day I struck down all the firstborn in the land of Egypt.
NUM 8:17.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 8 · Antichrist, Israel] For every firstborn male in Israel is Mine, both man and beast. I set them apart for Myself on the day I struck down all the firstborn in the land of Egypt.

NUM 8:18.text: But I have taken the Levites in place of all the firstborn among the sons of Israel.
NUM 8:18.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 8 · Israel] But I have taken the Levites in place of all the firstborn among the sons of Israel.

NUM 8:19.text: And I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and his sons from among the Israelites, to perform the service for the Israelites at the Tent of Meeting and to make atonement on their behalf, so that no plague will come against the Israelites when they approach the sanctuary.”
NUM 8:19.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 8 · Atonement] And I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and his sons from among the Israelites, to perform the service for the Israelites at the Tent of Meeting and to make atonement on their behalf, so that no plague will come against the Israelites when they approach the sanctuary.”

NUM 8:20.text: So Moses, Aaron, and the whole congregation of Israel did with the Levites everything that the LORD had commanded Moses they should do.
NUM 8:20.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 8 · God Commanded Genocide, Israel] So Moses, Aaron, and the whole congregation of Israel did with the Levites everything that the LORD had commanded Moses they should do.

NUM 8:21.text: The Levites purified themselves and washed their clothes, and Aaron presented them as a wave offering before the LORD. Aaron also made atonement for them to cleanse them.
NUM 8:21.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 8 · Atonement] The Levites purified themselves and washed their clothes, and Aaron presented them as a wave offering before the LORD. Aaron also made atonement for them to cleanse them.

NUM 8:22.text: After that, the Levites came to perform their service at the Tent of Meeting in the presence of Aaron and his sons. Thus they did with the Levites just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
NUM 8:22.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 8 · God Commanded Genocide] After that, the Levites came to perform their service at the Tent of Meeting in the presence of Aaron and his sons. Thus they did with the Levites just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

NUM 8:23.text: And the LORD said to Moses,
NUM 8:23.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 8] And the LORD said to Moses,

NUM 8:24.text: “This applies to the Levites: Men twenty-five years of age or older shall enter to perform the service in the work at the Tent of Meeting.
NUM 8:24.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 8] “This applies to the Levites: Men twenty-five years of age or older shall enter to perform the service in the work at the Tent of Meeting.

NUM 8:25.text: But at the age of fifty, they must retire from performing the work and no longer serve.
NUM 8:25.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 8] But at the age of fifty, they must retire from performing the work and no longer serve.

NUM 8:26.text: After that, they may assist their brothers in fulfilling their duties at the Tent of Meeting, but they themselves are not to do the work. This is how you are to assign responsibilities to the Levites.”
NUM 8:26.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 8] After that, they may assist their brothers in fulfilling their duties at the Tent of Meeting, but they themselves are not to do the work. This is how you are to assign responsibilities to the Levites.”

NUM 9:1.text: In the first month of the second year after Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, the LORD spoke to Moses in the Wilderness of Sinai:
NUM 9:1.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 9 · Israel] In the first month of the second year after Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, the LORD spoke to Moses in the Wilderness of Sinai:

NUM 9:2.text: “The Israelites are to observe the Passover at its appointed time.
NUM 9:2.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 9] “The Israelites are to observe the Passover at its appointed time.

NUM 9:3.text: You are to observe it at the appointed time, at twilight on the fourteenth day of this month, in accordance with its statutes and ordinances.”
NUM 9:3.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 9] You are to observe it at the appointed time, at twilight on the fourteenth day of this month, in accordance with its statutes and ordinances.”

NUM 9:4.text: So Moses told the Israelites to observe the Passover,
NUM 9:4.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 9] So Moses told the Israelites to observe the Passover,

NUM 9:5.text: and they did so in the Wilderness of Sinai, at twilight on the fourteenth day of the first month. The Israelites did everything just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
NUM 9:5.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 9 · God Commanded Genocide] and they did so in the Wilderness of Sinai, at twilight on the fourteenth day of the first month. The Israelites did everything just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

NUM 9:6.text: But there were some men who were unclean due to a dead body, so they could not observe the Passover on that day. And they came before Moses and Aaron that same day
NUM 9:6.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 9] But there were some men who were unclean due to a dead body, so they could not observe the Passover on that day. And they came before Moses and Aaron that same day

NUM 9:7.text: and said to Moses, “We are unclean because of a dead body, but why should we be excluded from presenting the LORD’s offering with the other Israelites at the appointed time?”
NUM 9:7.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 9] and said to Moses, “We are unclean because of a dead body, but why should we be excluded from presenting the LORD’s offering with the other Israelites at the appointed time?”

NUM 9:8.text: “Wait here until I find out what the LORD commands concerning you,” Moses replied.
NUM 9:8.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 9] “Wait here until I find out what the LORD commands concerning you,” Moses replied.

NUM 9:9.text: Then the LORD said to Moses,
NUM 9:9.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 9] Then the LORD said to Moses,

NUM 9:10.text: “Tell the Israelites: ‘When any one of you or your descendants is unclean because of a dead body, or is away on a journey, he may still observe the Passover to the LORD.
NUM 9:10.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 9] “Tell the Israelites: ‘When any one of you or your descendants is unclean because of a dead body, or is away on a journey, he may still observe the Passover to the LORD.

NUM 9:11.text: Such people are to observe it at twilight on the fourteenth day of the second month. They are to eat the lamb, together with unleavened bread and bitter herbs;
NUM 9:11.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 9] Such people are to observe it at twilight on the fourteenth day of the second month. They are to eat the lamb, together with unleavened bread and bitter herbs;

NUM 9:12.text: they may not leave any of it until morning or break any of its bones. They must observe the Passover according to all its statutes.
NUM 9:12.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 9] they may not leave any of it until morning or break any of its bones. They must observe the Passover according to all its statutes.

NUM 9:13.text: But if a man who is ceremonially clean and is not on a journey still fails to observe the Passover, he must be cut off from his people, because he did not present the LORD’s offering at its appointed time. That man will bear the consequences of his sin.
NUM 9:13.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 9] But if a man who is ceremonially clean and is not on a journey still fails to observe the Passover, he must be cut off from his people, because he did not present the LORD’s offering at its appointed time. That man will bear the consequences of his sin.

NUM 9:14.text: If a foreigner dwelling among you wants to observe the Passover to the LORD, he is to do so according to the Passover statute and its ordinances. You are to apply the same statute to both the foreigner and the native of the land.’”
NUM 9:14.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 9] If a foreigner dwelling among you wants to observe the Passover to the LORD, he is to do so according to the Passover statute and its ordinances. You are to apply the same statute to both the foreigner and the native of the land.’”

NUM 9:15.text: On the day that the tabernacle, the Tent of the Testimony, was set up, the cloud covered it and appeared like fire above the tabernacle from evening until morning.
NUM 9:15.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 9] On the day that the tabernacle, the Tent of the Testimony, was set up, the cloud covered it and appeared like fire above the tabernacle from evening until morning.

NUM 9:16.text: It remained that way continually; the cloud would cover the tabernacle by day, and at night it would appear like fire.
NUM 9:16.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 9] It remained that way continually; the cloud would cover the tabernacle by day, and at night it would appear like fire.

NUM 9:17.text: Whenever the cloud was lifted from above the Tent, the Israelites would set out, and wherever the cloud settled, there the Israelites would camp.
NUM 9:17.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 9] Whenever the cloud was lifted from above the Tent, the Israelites would set out, and wherever the cloud settled, there the Israelites would camp.

NUM 9:18.text: At the LORD’s command the Israelites set out, and at the LORD’s command they camped. As long as the cloud remained over the tabernacle, they remained encamped.
NUM 9:18.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 9] At the LORD’s command the Israelites set out, and at the LORD’s command they camped. As long as the cloud remained over the tabernacle, they remained encamped.

NUM 9:19.text: Even when the cloud lingered over the tabernacle for many days, the Israelites kept the LORD’s charge and did not set out.
NUM 9:19.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 9] Even when the cloud lingered over the tabernacle for many days, the Israelites kept the LORD’s charge and did not set out.

NUM 9:20.text: Sometimes the cloud remained over the tabernacle for only a few days, and they would camp at the LORD’s command and set out at the LORD’s command.
NUM 9:20.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 9] Sometimes the cloud remained over the tabernacle for only a few days, and they would camp at the LORD’s command and set out at the LORD’s command.

NUM 9:21.text: Sometimes the cloud remained only from evening until morning, and when it lifted in the morning, they would set out. Whether it was by day or by night, when the cloud was taken up, they would set out.
NUM 9:21.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 9 · Ascension] Sometimes the cloud remained only from evening until morning, and when it lifted in the morning, they would set out. Whether it was by day or by night, when the cloud was taken up, they would set out.

NUM 9:22.text: Whether the cloud lingered for two days, a month, or longer, the Israelites camped and did not set out as long as the cloud remained over the tabernacle; but when it was lifted, they would set out.
NUM 9:22.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 9] Whether the cloud lingered for two days, a month, or longer, the Israelites camped and did not set out as long as the cloud remained over the tabernacle; but when it was lifted, they would set out.

NUM 9:23.text: They camped at the LORD’s command, and they set out at the LORD’s command; they carried out the LORD’s charge according to His command through Moses.
NUM 9:23.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 9] They camped at the LORD’s command, and they set out at the LORD’s command; they carried out the LORD’s charge according to His command through Moses.

NUM 10:1.text: Then the LORD said to Moses,
NUM 10:1.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 10] Then the LORD said to Moses,

NUM 10:2.text: “Make two trumpets of hammered silver to be used for calling the congregation and for having the camps set out.
NUM 10:2.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 10 · Calling] “Make two trumpets of hammered silver to be used for calling the congregation and for having the camps set out.

NUM 10:3.text: When both are sounded, the whole congregation is to assemble before you at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
NUM 10:3.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 10] When both are sounded, the whole congregation is to assemble before you at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

NUM 10:4.text: But if only one is sounded, then the leaders, the heads of the clans of Israel, are to gather before you.
NUM 10:4.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 10 · Israel] But if only one is sounded, then the leaders, the heads of the clans of Israel, are to gather before you.

NUM 10:5.text: When you sound short blasts, the camps that lie on the east side are to set out.
NUM 10:5.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 10] When you sound short blasts, the camps that lie on the east side are to set out.

NUM 10:6.text: When you sound the short blasts a second time, the camps that lie on the south side are to set out. The blasts are to signal them to set out.
NUM 10:6.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 10] When you sound the short blasts a second time, the camps that lie on the south side are to set out. The blasts are to signal them to set out.

NUM 10:7.text: To convene the assembly, you are to sound long blasts, not short ones.
NUM 10:7.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 10 · Church] To convene the assembly, you are to sound long blasts, not short ones.

NUM 10:8.text: The sons of Aaron, the priests, are to sound the trumpets. This shall be a permanent statute for you and the generations to come.
NUM 10:8.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 10] The sons of Aaron, the priests, are to sound the trumpets. This shall be a permanent statute for you and the generations to come.

NUM 10:9.text: When you enter into battle in your land against an adversary who attacks you, sound short blasts on the trumpets, and you will be remembered before the LORD your God and saved from your enemies.
NUM 10:9.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 10] When you enter into battle in your land against an adversary who attacks you, sound short blasts on the trumpets, and you will be remembered before the LORD your God and saved from your enemies.

NUM 10:10.text: And on your joyous occasions, your appointed feasts, and the beginning of each month, you are to blow the trumpets over your burnt offerings and fellowship offerings to serve as a reminder for you before your God. I am the LORD your God.”
NUM 10:10.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 10 · Fellowship] And on your joyous occasions, your appointed feasts, and the beginning of each month, you are to blow the trumpets over your burnt offerings and fellowship offerings to serve as a reminder for you before your God. I am the LORD your God.”

NUM 10:11.text: On the twentieth day of the second month of the second year, the cloud was lifted from above the tabernacle of the Testimony,
NUM 10:11.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 10] On the twentieth day of the second month of the second year, the cloud was lifted from above the tabernacle of the Testimony,

NUM 10:12.text: and the Israelites set out from the Wilderness of Sinai, traveling from place to place until the cloud settled in the Wilderness of Paran.
NUM 10:12.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 10] and the Israelites set out from the Wilderness of Sinai, traveling from place to place until the cloud settled in the Wilderness of Paran.

NUM 10:13.text: They set out this first time according to the LORD’s command through Moses.
NUM 10:13.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 10] They set out this first time according to the LORD’s command through Moses.

NUM 10:14.text: First, the divisions of the camp of Judah set out under their standard, with Nahshon son of Amminadab in command.
NUM 10:14.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 10] First, the divisions of the camp of Judah set out under their standard, with Nahshon son of Amminadab in command.

NUM 10:15.text: Nethanel son of Zuar was over the division of the tribe of Issachar,
NUM 10:15.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 10] Nethanel son of Zuar was over the division of the tribe of Issachar,

NUM 10:16.text: and Eliab son of Helon was over the division of the tribe of Zebulun.
NUM 10:16.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 10] and Eliab son of Helon was over the division of the tribe of Zebulun.

NUM 10:17.text: Then the tabernacle was taken down, and the Gershonites and the Merarites set out, transporting it.
NUM 10:17.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 10] Then the tabernacle was taken down, and the Gershonites and the Merarites set out, transporting it.

NUM 10:18.text: Then the divisions of the camp of Reuben set out under their standard, with Elizur son of Shedeur in command.
NUM 10:18.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 10] Then the divisions of the camp of Reuben set out under their standard, with Elizur son of Shedeur in command.

NUM 10:19.text: Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai was over the division of the tribe of Simeon,
NUM 10:19.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 10] Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai was over the division of the tribe of Simeon,

NUM 10:20.text: and Eliasaph son of Deuel was over the division of the tribe of Gad.
NUM 10:20.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 10] and Eliasaph son of Deuel was over the division of the tribe of Gad.

NUM 10:21.text: Then the Kohathites set out, transporting the holy objects; the tabernacle was to be set up before their arrival.
NUM 10:21.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 10] Then the Kohathites set out, transporting the holy objects; the tabernacle was to be set up before their arrival.

NUM 10:22.text: Next, the divisions of the camp of Ephraim set out under their standard, with Elishama son of Ammihud in command.
NUM 10:22.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 10] Next, the divisions of the camp of Ephraim set out under their standard, with Elishama son of Ammihud in command.

NUM 10:23.text: Gamaliel son of Pedahzur was over the division of the tribe of Manasseh,
NUM 10:23.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 10] Gamaliel son of Pedahzur was over the division of the tribe of Manasseh,

NUM 10:24.text: and Abidan son of Gideoni was over the division of the tribe of Benjamin.
NUM 10:24.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 10] and Abidan son of Gideoni was over the division of the tribe of Benjamin.

NUM 10:25.text: Finally, the divisions of the camp of Dan set out under their standard, serving as the rear guard for all units, with Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai in command.
NUM 10:25.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 10] Finally, the divisions of the camp of Dan set out under their standard, serving as the rear guard for all units, with Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai in command.

NUM 10:26.text: Pagiel son of Ocran was over the division of the tribe of Asher,
NUM 10:26.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 10] Pagiel son of Ocran was over the division of the tribe of Asher,

NUM 10:27.text: and Ahira son of Enan was over the division of the tribe of Naphtali.
NUM 10:27.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 10] and Ahira son of Enan was over the division of the tribe of Naphtali.

NUM 10:28.text: This was the order of march for the Israelite divisions as they set out.
NUM 10:28.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 10] This was the order of march for the Israelite divisions as they set out.

NUM 10:29.text: Then Moses said to Hobab, the son of Moses’ father-in-law Reuel the Midianite, “We are setting out for the place of which the LORD said: ‘I will give it to you.’ Come with us, and we will treat you well, for the LORD has promised good things to Israel.”
NUM 10:29.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 10 · God the Father, Israel] Then Moses said to Hobab, the son of Moses’ father-in-law Reuel the Midianite, “We are setting out for the place of which the LORD said: ‘I will give it to you.’ Come with us, and we will treat you well, for the LORD has promised good things to Israel.”

NUM 10:30.text: “I will not go,” Hobab replied. “Instead, I am going back to my own land and my own people.”
NUM 10:30.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 10] “I will not go,” Hobab replied. “Instead, I am going back to my own land and my own people.”

NUM 10:31.text: “Please do not leave us,” Moses said, “since you know where we should camp in the wilderness, and you can serve as our eyes.
NUM 10:31.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 10] “Please do not leave us,” Moses said, “since you know where we should camp in the wilderness, and you can serve as our eyes.

NUM 10:32.text: If you come with us, we will share with you whatever good things the LORD gives us.”
NUM 10:32.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 10] If you come with us, we will share with you whatever good things the LORD gives us.”

NUM 10:33.text: So they set out on a three-day journey from the mountain of the LORD, with the ark of the covenant of the LORD traveling ahead of them for those three days to seek a resting place for them.
NUM 10:33.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 10 · Covenant] So they set out on a three-day journey from the mountain of the LORD, with the ark of the covenant of the LORD traveling ahead of them for those three days to seek a resting place for them.

NUM 10:34.text: And the cloud of the LORD was over them by day when they set out from the camp.
NUM 10:34.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 10] And the cloud of the LORD was over them by day when they set out from the camp.

NUM 10:35.text: Whenever the ark set out, Moses would say,  “Rise up, O LORD! May Your enemies be scattered; may those who hate You flee before You.”
NUM 10:35.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 10] Whenever the ark set out, Moses would say,  “Rise up, O LORD! May Your enemies be scattered; may those who hate You flee before You.”

NUM 10:36.text: And when it came to rest, he would say:  “Return, O LORD, to the countless thousands of Israel.”
NUM 10:36.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 10 · Israel] And when it came to rest, he would say:  “Return, O LORD, to the countless thousands of Israel.”

NUM 11:1.text: Soon the people began to complain about their hardship in the hearing of the LORD, and when He heard them, His anger was kindled, and fire from the LORD blazed among them and consumed the outskirts of the camp.
NUM 11:1.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 11 · About Forgiveness] Soon the people began to complain about their hardship in the hearing of the LORD, and when He heard them, His anger was kindled, and fire from the LORD blazed among them and consumed the outskirts of the camp.

NUM 11:2.text: And the people cried out to Moses, and he prayed to the LORD, and the fire died down.
NUM 11:2.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 11] And the people cried out to Moses, and he prayed to the LORD, and the fire died down.

NUM 11:3.text: So that place was called Taberah, because the fire of the LORD had burned among them.
NUM 11:3.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 11] So that place was called Taberah, because the fire of the LORD had burned among them.

NUM 11:4.text: Meanwhile, the rabble among them had a strong craving for other food, and again the Israelites wept and said, “Who will feed us meat?
NUM 11:4.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 11] Meanwhile, the rabble among them had a strong craving for other food, and again the Israelites wept and said, “Who will feed us meat?

NUM 11:5.text: We remember the fish we ate freely in Egypt, along with the cucumbers, melons, leeks, onions, and garlic.
NUM 11:5.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 11] We remember the fish we ate freely in Egypt, along with the cucumbers, melons, leeks, onions, and garlic.

NUM 11:6.text: But now our appetite is gone; there is nothing to see but this manna!”
NUM 11:6.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 11] But now our appetite is gone; there is nothing to see but this manna!”

NUM 11:7.text: Now the manna resembled coriander seed, and its appearance was like that of gum resin.
NUM 11:7.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 11] Now the manna resembled coriander seed, and its appearance was like that of gum resin.

NUM 11:8.text: The people walked around and gathered it, ground it on a handmill or crushed it in a mortar, then boiled it in a cooking pot or shaped it into cakes. It tasted like pastry baked with fine oil.
NUM 11:8.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 11] The people walked around and gathered it, ground it on a handmill or crushed it in a mortar, then boiled it in a cooking pot or shaped it into cakes. It tasted like pastry baked with fine oil.

NUM 11:9.text: When the dew fell on the camp at night, the manna would fall with it.
NUM 11:9.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 11] When the dew fell on the camp at night, the manna would fall with it.

NUM 11:10.text: Then Moses heard the people of family after family weeping at the entrances to their tents, and the anger of the LORD was kindled greatly, and Moses was also displeased.
NUM 11:10.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 11 · Family] Then Moses heard the people of family after family weeping at the entrances to their tents, and the anger of the LORD was kindled greatly, and Moses was also displeased.

NUM 11:11.text: So Moses asked the LORD, “Why have You brought this trouble on Your servant? Why have I not found favor in Your sight, that You have laid upon me the burden of all these people?
NUM 11:11.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 11 · Blessing] So Moses asked the LORD, “Why have You brought this trouble on Your servant? Why have I not found favor in Your sight, that You have laid upon me the burden of all these people?

NUM 11:12.text: Did I conceive all these people? Did I give them birth, so that You should tell me, ‘Carry them in your bosom, as a nurse carries an infant,’ to the land that You swore to give their fathers?
NUM 11:12.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 11] Did I conceive all these people? Did I give them birth, so that You should tell me, ‘Carry them in your bosom, as a nurse carries an infant,’ to the land that You swore to give their fathers?

NUM 11:13.text: Where can I get meat for all these people? For they keep crying out to me, ‘Give us meat to eat!’
NUM 11:13.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 11] Where can I get meat for all these people? For they keep crying out to me, ‘Give us meat to eat!’

NUM 11:14.text: I cannot carry all these people by myself; it is too burdensome for me.
NUM 11:14.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 11] I cannot carry all these people by myself; it is too burdensome for me.

NUM 11:15.text: If this is how You are going to treat me, please kill me right now—if I have found favor in Your eyes—and let me not see my own wretchedness.”
NUM 11:15.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 11 · Blessing] If this is how You are going to treat me, please kill me right now—if I have found favor in Your eyes—and let me not see my own wretchedness.”

NUM 11:16.text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Bring Me seventy of the elders of Israel known to you as leaders and officers of the people. Bring them to the Tent of Meeting and have them stand there with you.
NUM 11:16.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 11 · Israel, Leadership] Then the LORD said to Moses, “Bring Me seventy of the elders of Israel known to you as leaders and officers of the people. Bring them to the Tent of Meeting and have them stand there with you.

NUM 11:17.text: And I will come down and speak with you there, and I will take some of the Spirit that is on you and put that Spirit on them. They will help you bear the burden of the people, so that you do not have to bear it by yourself.
NUM 11:17.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 11 · Fruit of the Spirit] And I will come down and speak with you there, and I will take some of the Spirit that is on you and put that Spirit on them. They will help you bear the burden of the people, so that you do not have to bear it by yourself.

NUM 11:18.text: And say to the people: Consecrate yourselves for tomorrow, and you will eat meat, because you have cried out in the hearing of the LORD, saying: ‘Who will feed us meat? For we were better off in Egypt!’ Therefore the LORD will give you meat, and you will eat.
NUM 11:18.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 11] And say to the people: Consecrate yourselves for tomorrow, and you will eat meat, because you have cried out in the hearing of the LORD, saying: ‘Who will feed us meat? For we were better off in Egypt!’ Therefore the LORD will give you meat, and you will eat.

NUM 11:19.text: You will eat it not for one or two days, nor for five or ten or twenty days,
NUM 11:19.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 11] You will eat it not for one or two days, nor for five or ten or twenty days,

NUM 11:20.text: but for a whole month—until it comes out of your nostrils and makes you nauseous—because you have rejected the LORD, who is among you, and have cried out before Him, saying, ‘Why did we ever leave Egypt?’”
NUM 11:20.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 11] but for a whole month—until it comes out of your nostrils and makes you nauseous—because you have rejected the LORD, who is among you, and have cried out before Him, saying, ‘Why did we ever leave Egypt?’”

NUM 11:21.text: But Moses replied, “Here I am among 600,000 men on foot, yet You say, ‘I will give them meat, and they will eat for a month.’
NUM 11:21.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 11] But Moses replied, “Here I am among 600,000 men on foot, yet You say, ‘I will give them meat, and they will eat for a month.’

NUM 11:22.text: If all our flocks and herds were slaughtered for them, would they have enough? Or if all the fish in the sea were caught for them, would they have enough?”
NUM 11:22.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 11] If all our flocks and herds were slaughtered for them, would they have enough? Or if all the fish in the sea were caught for them, would they have enough?”

NUM 11:23.text: The LORD answered Moses, “Is the LORD’s arm too short? Now you will see whether or not My word will come to pass.”
NUM 11:23.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 11] The LORD answered Moses, “Is the LORD’s arm too short? Now you will see whether or not My word will come to pass.”

NUM 11:24.text: So Moses went out and relayed to the people the words of the LORD, and he gathered seventy of the elders of the people and had them stand around the tent.
NUM 11:24.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 11 · Leadership] So Moses went out and relayed to the people the words of the LORD, and he gathered seventy of the elders of the people and had them stand around the tent.

NUM 11:25.text: Then the LORD came down in the cloud and spoke to him, and He took some of the Spirit that was on Moses and placed that Spirit on the seventy elders. As the Spirit rested on them, they prophesied—but they never did so again.
NUM 11:25.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 11 · Fruit of the Spirit, Leadership] Then the LORD came down in the cloud and spoke to him, and He took some of the Spirit that was on Moses and placed that Spirit on the seventy elders. As the Spirit rested on them, they prophesied—but they never did so again.

NUM 11:26.text: Two men, however, had remained in the camp—one named Eldad and the other Medad—and the Spirit rested on them. They were among those listed, but they had not gone out to the tent, and they prophesied in the camp.
NUM 11:26.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 11 · Fruit of the Spirit] Two men, however, had remained in the camp—one named Eldad and the other Medad—and the Spirit rested on them. They were among those listed, but they had not gone out to the tent, and they prophesied in the camp.

NUM 11:27.text: A young man ran and reported to Moses, “Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp.”
NUM 11:27.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 11] A young man ran and reported to Moses, “Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp.”

NUM 11:28.text: Joshua son of Nun, the attendant to Moses since youth, spoke up and said, “Moses, my lord, stop them!”
NUM 11:28.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 11] Joshua son of Nun, the attendant to Moses since youth, spoke up and said, “Moses, my lord, stop them!”

NUM 11:29.text: But Moses replied, “Are you jealous on my account? I wish that all the LORD’s people were prophets and that the LORD would place His Spirit on them!”
NUM 11:29.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 11 · Fruit of the Spirit] But Moses replied, “Are you jealous on my account? I wish that all the LORD’s people were prophets and that the LORD would place His Spirit on them!”

NUM 11:30.text: Then Moses returned to the camp, along with the elders of Israel.
NUM 11:30.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 11 · Israel, Leadership] Then Moses returned to the camp, along with the elders of Israel.

NUM 11:31.text: Now a wind sent by the LORD came up, drove in quail from the sea, and brought them near the camp, about two cubits above the surface of the ground, for a day’s journey in every direction around the camp.
NUM 11:31.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 11 · About Forgiveness, Guidance] Now a wind sent by the LORD came up, drove in quail from the sea, and brought them near the camp, about two cubits above the surface of the ground, for a day’s journey in every direction around the camp.

NUM 11:32.text: All that day and night, and all the next day, the people stayed up gathering the quail. No one gathered less than ten homers, and they spread them out all around the camp.
NUM 11:32.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 11] All that day and night, and all the next day, the people stayed up gathering the quail. No one gathered less than ten homers, and they spread them out all around the camp.

NUM 11:33.text: But while the meat was still between their teeth, before it was chewed, the anger of the LORD burned against the people, and the LORD struck them with a severe plague.
NUM 11:33.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 11] But while the meat was still between their teeth, before it was chewed, the anger of the LORD burned against the people, and the LORD struck them with a severe plague.

NUM 11:34.text: So they called that place Kibroth-hattaavah, because there they buried the people who had craved other food.
NUM 11:34.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 11] So they called that place Kibroth-hattaavah, because there they buried the people who had craved other food.

NUM 11:35.text: From Kibroth-hattaavah the people moved on to Hazeroth, where they remained for some time.
NUM 11:35.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 11] From Kibroth-hattaavah the people moved on to Hazeroth, where they remained for some time.

NUM 12:1.text: Then Miriam and Aaron criticized Moses because of the Cushite woman he had married, for he had taken a Cushite wife.
NUM 12:1.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 12] Then Miriam and Aaron criticized Moses because of the Cushite woman he had married, for he had taken a Cushite wife.

NUM 12:2.text: “Does the LORD speak only through Moses?” they said. “Does He not also speak through us?” And the LORD heard this.
NUM 12:2.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 12] “Does the LORD speak only through Moses?” they said. “Does He not also speak through us?” And the LORD heard this.

NUM 12:3.text: Now Moses was a very humble man, more so than any man on the face of the earth.
NUM 12:3.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 12] Now Moses was a very humble man, more so than any man on the face of the earth.

NUM 12:4.text: And suddenly the LORD said to Moses, Aaron, and Miriam, “You three, come out to the Tent of Meeting.” So the three went out,
NUM 12:4.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 12] And suddenly the LORD said to Moses, Aaron, and Miriam, “You three, come out to the Tent of Meeting.” So the three went out,

NUM 12:5.text: and the LORD came down in a pillar of cloud, stood at the entrance to the Tent, and summoned Aaron and Miriam. When both of them had stepped forward,
NUM 12:5.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 12 · Calling] and the LORD came down in a pillar of cloud, stood at the entrance to the Tent, and summoned Aaron and Miriam. When both of them had stepped forward,

NUM 12:6.text: He said, “Hear now My words:  If there is a prophet among you, I, the LORD, will reveal Myself to him in a vision; I will speak to him in a dream.
NUM 12:6.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 12] He said, “Hear now My words:  If there is a prophet among you, I, the LORD, will reveal Myself to him in a vision; I will speak to him in a dream.

NUM 12:7.text: But this is not so with My servant Moses; he is faithful in all My house.
NUM 12:7.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 12 · Faith] But this is not so with My servant Moses; he is faithful in all My house.

NUM 12:8.text: I speak with him face to face, clearly and not in riddles; he sees the form of the LORD.   Why then were you unafraid to speak against My servant Moses?”
NUM 12:8.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 12] I speak with him face to face, clearly and not in riddles; he sees the form of the LORD.   Why then were you unafraid to speak against My servant Moses?”

NUM 12:9.text: So the anger of the LORD burned against them, and He departed.
NUM 12:9.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 12] So the anger of the LORD burned against them, and He departed.

NUM 12:10.text: As the cloud lifted from above the Tent, suddenly Miriam became leprous, white as snow. Aaron turned toward her, saw that she was leprous,
NUM 12:10.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 12] As the cloud lifted from above the Tent, suddenly Miriam became leprous, white as snow. Aaron turned toward her, saw that she was leprous,

NUM 12:11.text: and said to Moses, “My lord, please do not hold against us this sin we have so foolishly committed.
NUM 12:11.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 12] and said to Moses, “My lord, please do not hold against us this sin we have so foolishly committed.

NUM 12:12.text: Please do not let her be like a stillborn infant whose flesh is half consumed when he comes out of his mother’s womb.”
NUM 12:12.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 12] Please do not let her be like a stillborn infant whose flesh is half consumed when he comes out of his mother’s womb.”

NUM 12:13.text: So Moses cried out to the LORD, “O God, please heal her!”
NUM 12:13.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 12] So Moses cried out to the LORD, “O God, please heal her!”

NUM 12:14.text: But the LORD answered Moses, “If her father had but spit in her face, would she not have been in disgrace for seven days? Let her be confined outside the camp for seven days; after that she may be brought back in.”
NUM 12:14.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 12 · God the Father] But the LORD answered Moses, “If her father had but spit in her face, would she not have been in disgrace for seven days? Let her be confined outside the camp for seven days; after that she may be brought back in.”

NUM 12:15.text: So Miriam was confined outside the camp for seven days, and the people did not move on until she was brought in again.
NUM 12:15.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 12] So Miriam was confined outside the camp for seven days, and the people did not move on until she was brought in again.

NUM 12:16.text: After that, the people set out from Hazeroth and camped in the Wilderness of Paran.
NUM 12:16.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 12] After that, the people set out from Hazeroth and camped in the Wilderness of Paran.

NUM 13:1.text: And the LORD said to Moses,
NUM 13:1.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 13] And the LORD said to Moses,

NUM 13:2.text: “Send out for yourself men to spy out the land of Canaan, which I am giving to the Israelites. From each of their fathers’ tribes send one man who is a leader among them.”
NUM 13:2.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 13 · Conquest Of Canaan, Destroy Canaan] “Send out for yourself men to spy out the land of Canaan, which I am giving to the Israelites. From each of their fathers’ tribes send one man who is a leader among them.”

NUM 13:3.text: So at the consent of the LORD, Moses sent them out from the Wilderness of Paran. All the men were leaders of the Israelites,
NUM 13:3.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 13] So at the consent of the LORD, Moses sent them out from the Wilderness of Paran. All the men were leaders of the Israelites,

NUM 13:4.text: and these were their names:  From the tribe of Reuben, Shammua son of Zaccur;
NUM 13:4.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 13] and these were their names:  From the tribe of Reuben, Shammua son of Zaccur;

NUM 13:5.text: from the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat son of Hori;
NUM 13:5.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 13] from the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat son of Hori;

NUM 13:6.text: from the tribe of Judah, Caleb son of Jephunneh;
NUM 13:6.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 13] from the tribe of Judah, Caleb son of Jephunneh;

NUM 13:7.text: from the tribe of Issachar, Igal son of Joseph;
NUM 13:7.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 13] from the tribe of Issachar, Igal son of Joseph;

NUM 13:8.text: from the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea son of Nun;
NUM 13:8.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 13] from the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea son of Nun;

NUM 13:9.text: from the tribe of Benjamin, Palti son of Raphu;
NUM 13:9.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 13] from the tribe of Benjamin, Palti son of Raphu;

NUM 13:10.text: from the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel son of Sodi;
NUM 13:10.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 13] from the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel son of Sodi;

NUM 13:11.text: from the tribe of Manasseh (a tribe of Joseph), Gaddi son of Susi;
NUM 13:11.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 13] from the tribe of Manasseh (a tribe of Joseph), Gaddi son of Susi;

NUM 13:12.text: from the tribe of Dan, Ammiel son of Gemalli;
NUM 13:12.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 13] from the tribe of Dan, Ammiel son of Gemalli;

NUM 13:13.text: from the tribe of Asher, Sethur son of Michael;
NUM 13:13.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 13] from the tribe of Asher, Sethur son of Michael;

NUM 13:14.text: from the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi son of Vophsi;
NUM 13:14.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 13] from the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi son of Vophsi;

NUM 13:15.text: and from the tribe of Gad, Geuel son of Machi.
NUM 13:15.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 13] and from the tribe of Gad, Geuel son of Machi.

NUM 13:16.text: These were the names of the men Moses sent to spy out the land; and Moses gave to Hoshea son of Nun the name Joshua.
NUM 13:16.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 13] These were the names of the men Moses sent to spy out the land; and Moses gave to Hoshea son of Nun the name Joshua.

NUM 13:17.text: When Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, he told them, “Go up through the Negev and into the hill country.
NUM 13:17.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 13 · Conquest Of Canaan, Destroy Canaan] When Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, he told them, “Go up through the Negev and into the hill country.

NUM 13:18.text: See what the land is like and whether its people are strong or weak, few or many.
NUM 13:18.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 13] See what the land is like and whether its people are strong or weak, few or many.

NUM 13:19.text: Is the land where they live good or bad? Are the cities where they dwell open camps or fortifications?
NUM 13:19.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 13] Is the land where they live good or bad? Are the cities where they dwell open camps or fortifications?

NUM 13:20.text: Is the soil fertile or unproductive? Are there trees in it or not? Be courageous, and bring back some of the fruit of the land.” (It was the season for the first ripe grapes.)
NUM 13:20.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 13 · Fruit of the Spirit] Is the soil fertile or unproductive? Are there trees in it or not? Be courageous, and bring back some of the fruit of the land.” (It was the season for the first ripe grapes.)

NUM 13:21.text: So they went up and spied out the land from the Wilderness of Zin as far as Rehob, toward Lebo-hamath.
NUM 13:21.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 13] So they went up and spied out the land from the Wilderness of Zin as far as Rehob, toward Lebo-hamath.

NUM 13:22.text: They went up through the Negev and came to Hebron, where Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the descendants of Anak, dwelled. It had been built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.
NUM 13:22.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 13] They went up through the Negev and came to Hebron, where Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the descendants of Anak, dwelled. It had been built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.

NUM 13:23.text: When they came to the Valley of Eshcol, they cut down a branch with a single cluster of grapes, which they carried on a pole between two men. They also took some pomegranates and figs.
NUM 13:23.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 13] When they came to the Valley of Eshcol, they cut down a branch with a single cluster of grapes, which they carried on a pole between two men. They also took some pomegranates and figs.

NUM 13:24.text: Because of the cluster of grapes the Israelites cut there, that place was called the Valley of Eshcol.
NUM 13:24.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 13] Because of the cluster of grapes the Israelites cut there, that place was called the Valley of Eshcol.

NUM 13:25.text: After forty days the men returned from spying out the land,
NUM 13:25.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 13] After forty days the men returned from spying out the land,

NUM 13:26.text: and they went back to Moses, Aaron, and the whole congregation of Israel in the Wilderness of Paran at Kadesh. They brought back a report for the whole congregation and showed them the fruit of the land.
NUM 13:26.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 13 · Fruit of the Spirit, Israel] and they went back to Moses, Aaron, and the whole congregation of Israel in the Wilderness of Paran at Kadesh. They brought back a report for the whole congregation and showed them the fruit of the land.

NUM 13:27.text: And they gave this account to Moses: “We went into the land to which you sent us, and indeed, it is flowing with milk and honey. Here is some of its fruit!
NUM 13:27.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 13 · Fruit of the Spirit] And they gave this account to Moses: “We went into the land to which you sent us, and indeed, it is flowing with milk and honey. Here is some of its fruit!

NUM 13:28.text: Nevertheless, the people living in the land are strong, and the cities are large and fortified. We even saw the descendants of Anak there.
NUM 13:28.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 13] Nevertheless, the people living in the land are strong, and the cities are large and fortified. We even saw the descendants of Anak there.

NUM 13:29.text: The Amalekites live in the land of the Negev; the Hittites, Jebusites, and Amorites live in the hill country; and the Canaanites live by the sea and along the Jordan.”
NUM 13:29.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 13 · Destroy Canaanites, Destroy The Canaanites] The Amalekites live in the land of the Negev; the Hittites, Jebusites, and Amorites live in the hill country; and the Canaanites live by the sea and along the Jordan.”

NUM 13:30.text: Then Caleb quieted the people before Moses and said, “We must go up and take possession of the land, for we can certainly conquer it!”
NUM 13:30.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 13] Then Caleb quieted the people before Moses and said, “We must go up and take possession of the land, for we can certainly conquer it!”

NUM 13:31.text: But the men who had gone up with him replied, “We cannot go up against the people, for they are stronger than we are!”
NUM 13:31.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 13] But the men who had gone up with him replied, “We cannot go up against the people, for they are stronger than we are!”

NUM 13:32.text: So they gave the Israelites a bad report about the land that they had spied out: “The land we explored devours its inhabitants, and all the people we saw there are great in stature.
NUM 13:32.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 13 · About Forgiveness] So they gave the Israelites a bad report about the land that they had spied out: “The land we explored devours its inhabitants, and all the people we saw there are great in stature.

NUM 13:33.text: We even saw the Nephilim there—the descendants of Anak that come from the Nephilim! We seemed like grasshoppers in our own sight, and we must have seemed the same to them!”
NUM 13:33.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 13] We even saw the Nephilim there—the descendants of Anak that come from the Nephilim! We seemed like grasshoppers in our own sight, and we must have seemed the same to them!”

NUM 14:1.text: Then the whole congregation lifted up their voices and cried out, and that night the people wept.
NUM 14:1.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 14] Then the whole congregation lifted up their voices and cried out, and that night the people wept.

NUM 14:2.text: All the Israelites grumbled against Moses and Aaron, and the whole congregation said to them, “If only we had died in the land of Egypt, or if only we had died in this wilderness!
NUM 14:2.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 14] All the Israelites grumbled against Moses and Aaron, and the whole congregation said to them, “If only we had died in the land of Egypt, or if only we had died in this wilderness!

NUM 14:3.text: Why is the LORD bringing us into this land to fall by the sword? Our wives and children will become plunder. Would it not be better for us to go back to Egypt?”
NUM 14:3.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 14 · Children] Why is the LORD bringing us into this land to fall by the sword? Our wives and children will become plunder. Would it not be better for us to go back to Egypt?”

NUM 14:4.text: So they said to one another, “Let us appoint a leader and return to Egypt.”
NUM 14:4.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 14] So they said to one another, “Let us appoint a leader and return to Egypt.”

NUM 14:5.text: Then Moses and Aaron fell facedown before the whole assembly of the congregation of Israel.
NUM 14:5.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 14 · Church, Israel] Then Moses and Aaron fell facedown before the whole assembly of the congregation of Israel.

NUM 14:6.text: Joshua son of Nun and Caleb son of Jephunneh, who were among those who had spied out the land, tore their clothes
NUM 14:6.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 14] Joshua son of Nun and Caleb son of Jephunneh, who were among those who had spied out the land, tore their clothes

NUM 14:7.text: and said to the whole congregation of Israel, “The land we passed through and explored is an exceedingly good land.
NUM 14:7.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 14 · Israel] and said to the whole congregation of Israel, “The land we passed through and explored is an exceedingly good land.

NUM 14:8.text: If the LORD delights in us, He will bring us into this land, a land flowing with milk and honey, and He will give it to us.
NUM 14:8.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 14] If the LORD delights in us, He will bring us into this land, a land flowing with milk and honey, and He will give it to us.

NUM 14:9.text: Only do not rebel against the LORD, and do not be afraid of the people of the land, for they will be like bread for us. Their protection has been removed, and the LORD is with us. Do not be afraid of them!”
NUM 14:9.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 14] Only do not rebel against the LORD, and do not be afraid of the people of the land, for they will be like bread for us. Their protection has been removed, and the LORD is with us. Do not be afraid of them!”

NUM 14:10.text: But the whole congregation threatened to stone Joshua and Caleb.  Then the glory of the LORD appeared to all the Israelites at the Tent of Meeting.
NUM 14:10.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 14 · Glory] But the whole congregation threatened to stone Joshua and Caleb.  Then the glory of the LORD appeared to all the Israelites at the Tent of Meeting.

NUM 14:11.text: And the LORD said to Moses, “How long will this people treat Me with contempt? How long will they refuse to believe in Me, despite all the signs I have performed among them?
NUM 14:11.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 14 · Faith] And the LORD said to Moses, “How long will this people treat Me with contempt? How long will they refuse to believe in Me, despite all the signs I have performed among them?

NUM 14:12.text: I will strike them with a plague and destroy them—and I will make you into a nation greater and mightier than they are.”
NUM 14:12.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 14 · Destroy Canaan, Destroy Canaanites] I will strike them with a plague and destroy them—and I will make you into a nation greater and mightier than they are.”

NUM 14:13.text: But Moses said to the LORD, “The Egyptians will hear of it, for by Your strength You brought this people from among them.
NUM 14:13.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 14] But Moses said to the LORD, “The Egyptians will hear of it, for by Your strength You brought this people from among them.

NUM 14:14.text: And they will tell it to the inhabitants of this land. They have already heard that You, O LORD, are in the midst of this people, that You, O LORD, have been seen face to face, that Your cloud stands over them, and that You go before them in a pillar of cloud by day and a pillar of fire by night.
NUM 14:14.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 14] And they will tell it to the inhabitants of this land. They have already heard that You, O LORD, are in the midst of this people, that You, O LORD, have been seen face to face, that Your cloud stands over them, and that You go before them in a pillar of cloud by day and a pillar of fire by night.

NUM 14:15.text: If You kill this people as one man, the nations who have heard of Your fame will say,
NUM 14:15.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 14] If You kill this people as one man, the nations who have heard of Your fame will say,

NUM 14:16.text: ‘Because the LORD was unable to bring this people into the land He swore to give them, He has slaughtered them in the wilderness.’
NUM 14:16.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 14] ‘Because the LORD was unable to bring this people into the land He swore to give them, He has slaughtered them in the wilderness.’

NUM 14:17.text: So now I pray, may the power of my Lord be magnified, just as You have declared:
NUM 14:17.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 14] So now I pray, may the power of my Lord be magnified, just as You have declared:

NUM 14:18.text: ‘The LORD is slow to anger and abounding in loving devotion, forgiving iniquity and transgression. Yet He will by no means leave the guilty unpunished; He will visit the iniquity of the fathers upon their children to the third and fourth generation.’
NUM 14:18.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 14 · Forgiveness, Children] ‘The LORD is slow to anger and abounding in loving devotion, forgiving iniquity and transgression. Yet He will by no means leave the guilty unpunished; He will visit the iniquity of the fathers upon their children to the third and fourth generation.’

NUM 14:19.text: Pardon, I pray, the iniquity of this people, in keeping with the greatness of Your loving devotion, just as You have forgiven them ever since they left Egypt.”
NUM 14:19.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 14 · Forgiveness, Devotion] Pardon, I pray, the iniquity of this people, in keeping with the greatness of Your loving devotion, just as You have forgiven them ever since they left Egypt.”

NUM 14:20.text: “I have pardoned them as you requested,” the LORD replied.

NUM 34:3.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 34] Your southern border will extend from the Wilderness of Zin along the border of Edom. On the east, your southern border will run from the end of the Salt Sea,
