NUM 35:1.text: Again the LORD spoke to Moses on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho:
NUM 35:1.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 35] Again the LORD spoke to Moses on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho:

NUM 35:2.text: “Command the Israelites to give, from the inheritance they will possess, cities for the Levites to live in and pasturelands around the cities.
NUM 35:2.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 35 · Inheritance] “Command the Israelites to give, from the inheritance they will possess, cities for the Levites to live in and pasturelands around the cities.

NUM 35:3.text: The cities will be for them to live in, and the pasturelands will be for their herds, their flocks, and all their other livestock.
NUM 35:3.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 35] The cities will be for them to live in, and the pasturelands will be for their herds, their flocks, and all their other livestock.

NUM 35:4.text: The pasturelands around the cities you are to give the Levites will extend a thousand cubits from the wall on every side.
NUM 35:4.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 35] The pasturelands around the cities you are to give the Levites will extend a thousand cubits from the wall on every side.

NUM 35:5.text: You are also to measure two thousand cubits outside the city on the east, two thousand on the south, two thousand on the west, and two thousand on the north, with the city in the center. These areas will serve as larger pasturelands for the cities.
NUM 35:5.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 35] You are also to measure two thousand cubits outside the city on the east, two thousand on the south, two thousand on the west, and two thousand on the north, with the city in the center. These areas will serve as larger pasturelands for the cities.

NUM 35:6.text: Six of the cities you give the Levites are to be appointed as cities of refuge, to which a manslayer may flee. In addition to these, give the Levites forty-two other cities.
NUM 35:6.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 35] Six of the cities you give the Levites are to be appointed as cities of refuge, to which a manslayer may flee. In addition to these, give the Levites forty-two other cities.

NUM 35:7.text: The total number of cities you give the Levites will be forty-eight, with their corresponding pasturelands.
NUM 35:7.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 35] The total number of cities you give the Levites will be forty-eight, with their corresponding pasturelands.

NUM 35:8.text: The cities that you apportion from the territory of the Israelites should be given to the Levites in proportion to the inheritance of each tribe: more from a larger tribe and less from a smaller one.”
NUM 35:8.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 35 · Inheritance] The cities that you apportion from the territory of the Israelites should be given to the Levites in proportion to the inheritance of each tribe: more from a larger tribe and less from a smaller one.”

NUM 35:9.text: Then the LORD said to Moses,
NUM 35:9.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 35] Then the LORD said to Moses,

NUM 35:10.text: “Speak to the Israelites and tell them: When you cross the Jordan into the land of Canaan,
NUM 35:10.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 35 · Conquest Of Canaan, Cross] “Speak to the Israelites and tell them: When you cross the Jordan into the land of Canaan,

NUM 35:11.text: designate cities to serve as your cities of refuge, so that a person who kills someone unintentionally may flee there.
NUM 35:11.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 35] designate cities to serve as your cities of refuge, so that a person who kills someone unintentionally may flee there.

NUM 35:12.text: You are to have these cities as a refuge from the avenger, so that the manslayer will not die until he stands trial before the assembly.
NUM 35:12.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 35 · Church] You are to have these cities as a refuge from the avenger, so that the manslayer will not die until he stands trial before the assembly.

NUM 35:13.text: The cities you select will be your six cities of refuge.
NUM 35:13.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 35] The cities you select will be your six cities of refuge.

NUM 35:14.text: Select three cities across the Jordan and three in the land of Canaan as cities of refuge.
NUM 35:14.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 35 · Conquest Of Canaan, Destroy Canaan] Select three cities across the Jordan and three in the land of Canaan as cities of refuge.

NUM 35:15.text: These six cities will serve as a refuge for the Israelites and for the foreigner or stranger among them, so that anyone who kills a person unintentionally may flee there.
NUM 35:15.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 35] These six cities will serve as a refuge for the Israelites and for the foreigner or stranger among them, so that anyone who kills a person unintentionally may flee there.

NUM 35:16.text: If, however, anyone strikes a person with an iron object and kills him, he is a murderer; the murderer must surely be put to death.
NUM 35:16.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 35 · Death] If, however, anyone strikes a person with an iron object and kills him, he is a murderer; the murderer must surely be put to death.

NUM 35:17.text: Or if anyone has in his hand a stone of deadly size, and he strikes and kills another, he is a murderer; the murderer must surely be put to death.
NUM 35:17.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 35 · Death] Or if anyone has in his hand a stone of deadly size, and he strikes and kills another, he is a murderer; the murderer must surely be put to death.

NUM 35:18.text: If anyone has in his hand a deadly object of wood, and he strikes and kills another, he is a murderer; the murderer must surely be put to death.
NUM 35:18.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 35 · Death] If anyone has in his hand a deadly object of wood, and he strikes and kills another, he is a murderer; the murderer must surely be put to death.

NUM 35:19.text: The avenger of blood is to put the murderer to death; when he finds him, he is to kill him.
NUM 35:19.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 35 · Death] The avenger of blood is to put the murderer to death; when he finds him, he is to kill him.

NUM 35:20.text: Likewise, if anyone maliciously pushes another or intentionally throws an object at him and kills him,
NUM 35:20.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 35] Likewise, if anyone maliciously pushes another or intentionally throws an object at him and kills him,

NUM 35:21.text: or if in hostility he strikes him with his hand and he dies, the one who struck him must surely be put to death; he is a murderer. When the avenger of blood finds the murderer, he is to kill him.
NUM 35:21.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 35 · Death] or if in hostility he strikes him with his hand and he dies, the one who struck him must surely be put to death; he is a murderer. When the avenger of blood finds the murderer, he is to kill him.

NUM 35:22.text: But if anyone pushes a person suddenly, without hostility, or throws an object at him unintentionally,
NUM 35:22.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 35] But if anyone pushes a person suddenly, without hostility, or throws an object at him unintentionally,

NUM 35:23.text: or without looking drops a heavy stone that kills him, but he was not an enemy and did not intend to harm him,
NUM 35:23.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 35] or without looking drops a heavy stone that kills him, but he was not an enemy and did not intend to harm him,

NUM 35:24.text: then the congregation must judge between the slayer and the avenger of blood according to these ordinances.
NUM 35:24.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 35] then the congregation must judge between the slayer and the avenger of blood according to these ordinances.

NUM 35:25.text: The assembly is to protect the manslayer from the hand of the avenger of blood. Then the assembly will return him to the city of refuge to which he fled, and he must live there until the death of the high priest, who was anointed with the holy oil.
NUM 35:25.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 35 · Church, Death] The assembly is to protect the manslayer from the hand of the avenger of blood. Then the assembly will return him to the city of refuge to which he fled, and he must live there until the death of the high priest, who was anointed with the holy oil.

NUM 35:26.text: But if the manslayer ever goes outside the limits of the city of refuge to which he fled
NUM 35:26.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 35] But if the manslayer ever goes outside the limits of the city of refuge to which he fled

NUM 35:27.text: and the avenger of blood finds him outside of his city of refuge and kills him, then the avenger will not be guilty of bloodshed
NUM 35:27.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 35] and the avenger of blood finds him outside of his city of refuge and kills him, then the avenger will not be guilty of bloodshed

NUM 35:28.text: because the manslayer must remain in his city of refuge until the death of the high priest. Only after the death of the high priest may he return to the land he owns.
NUM 35:28.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 35 · Death] because the manslayer must remain in his city of refuge until the death of the high priest. Only after the death of the high priest may he return to the land he owns.

NUM 35:29.text: This will be a statutory ordinance for you for the generations to come, wherever you live.
NUM 35:29.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 35] This will be a statutory ordinance for you for the generations to come, wherever you live.

NUM 35:30.text: If anyone kills a person, the murderer is to be put to death on the testimony of the witnesses. But no one is to be put to death based on the testimony of a lone witness.
NUM 35:30.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 35 · Death, False Witness] If anyone kills a person, the murderer is to be put to death on the testimony of the witnesses. But no one is to be put to death based on the testimony of a lone witness.

NUM 35:31.text: You are not to accept a ransom for the life of a murderer who deserves to die; he must surely be put to death.
NUM 35:31.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 35 · Death] You are not to accept a ransom for the life of a murderer who deserves to die; he must surely be put to death.

NUM 35:32.text: Nor should you accept a ransom for the person who flees to a city of refuge and allow him to return and live on his own land before the death of the high priest.
NUM 35:32.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 35 · Death] Nor should you accept a ransom for the person who flees to a city of refuge and allow him to return and live on his own land before the death of the high priest.

NUM 35:33.text: Do not pollute the land where you live, for bloodshed pollutes the land, and no atonement can be made for the land on which the blood is shed, except by the blood of the one who shed it.
NUM 35:33.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 35 · Atonement] Do not pollute the land where you live, for bloodshed pollutes the land, and no atonement can be made for the land on which the blood is shed, except by the blood of the one who shed it.

NUM 35:34.text: Do not defile the land where you live and where I dwell. For I, the LORD, dwell among the Israelites.”
NUM 35:34.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 35] Do not defile the land where you live and where I dwell. For I, the LORD, dwell among the Israelites.”

NUM 36:1.text: Now the family heads of the clan of Gilead son of Machir son of Manasseh, one of the clans of Joseph, approached Moses and the leaders who were the heads of the Israelite families and addressed them,
NUM 36:1.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 36 · Family] Now the family heads of the clan of Gilead son of Machir son of Manasseh, one of the clans of Joseph, approached Moses and the leaders who were the heads of the Israelite families and addressed them,

NUM 36:2.text: saying, “When the LORD commanded my lord to give the land as an inheritance to the Israelites by lot, He also commanded him to give the inheritance of our brother Zelophehad to his daughters.
NUM 36:2.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 36 · God Commanded Genocide, Inheritance] saying, “When the LORD commanded my lord to give the land as an inheritance to the Israelites by lot, He also commanded him to give the inheritance of our brother Zelophehad to his daughters.

NUM 36:3.text: But if they marry any of the men from the other tribes of Israel, their inheritance will be withdrawn from the portion of our fathers and added to the tribe into which they marry. So our allotted inheritance would be taken away.
NUM 36:3.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 36 · Inheritance, Israel] But if they marry any of the men from the other tribes of Israel, their inheritance will be withdrawn from the portion of our fathers and added to the tribe into which they marry. So our allotted inheritance would be taken away.

NUM 36:4.text: And when the Jubilee for the Israelites comes, their inheritance will be added to the tribe into which they marry and taken away from the tribe of our fathers.”
NUM 36:4.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 36 · Inheritance] And when the Jubilee for the Israelites comes, their inheritance will be added to the tribe into which they marry and taken away from the tribe of our fathers.”

NUM 36:5.text: So at the word of the LORD, Moses commanded the Israelites: “The tribe of the sons of Joseph speaks correctly.
NUM 36:5.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 36 · God Commanded Genocide] So at the word of the LORD, Moses commanded the Israelites: “The tribe of the sons of Joseph speaks correctly.

NUM 36:6.text: This is what the LORD has commanded concerning the daughters of Zelophehad: They may marry anyone they please, provided they marry within a clan of the tribe of their father.
NUM 36:6.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 36 · God Commanded Genocide, God the Father] This is what the LORD has commanded concerning the daughters of Zelophehad: They may marry anyone they please, provided they marry within a clan of the tribe of their father.

NUM 36:7.text: No inheritance in Israel may be transferred from tribe to tribe, because each of the Israelites is to retain the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.
NUM 36:7.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 36 · Inheritance, Israel] No inheritance in Israel may be transferred from tribe to tribe, because each of the Israelites is to retain the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.

NUM 36:8.text: Every daughter who possesses an inheritance from any Israelite tribe must marry within a clan of the tribe of her father, so that every Israelite will possess the inheritance of his fathers.
NUM 36:8.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 36 · God the Father, Inheritance] Every daughter who possesses an inheritance from any Israelite tribe must marry within a clan of the tribe of her father, so that every Israelite will possess the inheritance of his fathers.

NUM 36:9.text: No inheritance may be transferred from one tribe to another, for each tribe of Israel must retain its inheritance.”
NUM 36:9.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 36 · Inheritance, Israel] No inheritance may be transferred from one tribe to another, for each tribe of Israel must retain its inheritance.”

NUM 36:10.text: So the daughters of Zelophehad did as the LORD had commanded Moses.
NUM 36:10.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 36 · God Commanded Genocide] So the daughters of Zelophehad did as the LORD had commanded Moses.

NUM 36:11.text: Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married to cousins on their father’s side.
NUM 36:11.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 36 · God the Father] Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married to cousins on their father’s side.

NUM 36:12.text: They married within the clans of the descendants of Manasseh son of Joseph, and their inheritance remained within the tribe of their father’s clan.
NUM 36:12.bm25Text: [Numbers · Chapter 36 · God the Father, Inheritance] They married within the clans of the descendants of Manasseh son of Joseph, and their inheritance remained within the tribe of their father’s clan.

NUM 36:13.text: These are the commandments and ordinances that the LORD gave the Israelites through Moses on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho.

OBA 1:1.text: This is the vision of Obadiah:  This is what the Lord GOD says about Edom—   We have heard a message from the LORD; an envoy has been sent among the nations to say, “Rise up, and let us go to battle against her!”—
OBA 1:1.bm25Text: [Obadiah · Chapter 1 · About Forgiveness] This is the vision of Obadiah:  This is what the Lord GOD says about Edom—   We have heard a message from the LORD; an envoy has been sent among the nations to say, “Rise up, and let us go to battle against her!”—

OBA 1:2.text: “Behold, I will make you small among the nations; you will be deeply despised.
OBA 1:2.bm25Text: [Obadiah · Chapter 1] “Behold, I will make you small among the nations; you will be deeply despised.

OBA 1:3.text: The pride of your heart has deceived you, O dwellers in the clefts of the rocks whose habitation is the heights, who say in your heart, ‘Who can bring me down to the ground?’
OBA 1:3.bm25Text: [Obadiah · Chapter 1 · Adultery In Heart] The pride of your heart has deceived you, O dwellers in the clefts of the rocks whose habitation is the heights, who say in your heart, ‘Who can bring me down to the ground?’

OBA 1:4.text: Though you soar like the eagle and make your nest among the stars, even from there I will bring you down,” declares the LORD.
OBA 1:4.bm25Text: [Obadiah · Chapter 1] Though you soar like the eagle and make your nest among the stars, even from there I will bring you down,” declares the LORD.

OBA 1:5.text: “If thieves came to you, if robbers by night— oh, how you will be ruined— would they not steal only what they wanted? If grape gatherers came to you, would they not leave some gleanings?
OBA 1:5.bm25Text: [Obadiah · Chapter 1] “If thieves came to you, if robbers by night— oh, how you will be ruined— would they not steal only what they wanted? If grape gatherers came to you, would they not leave some gleanings?

OBA 1:6.text: But how Esau will be pillaged, his hidden treasures sought out!
OBA 1:6.bm25Text: [Obadiah · Chapter 1] But how Esau will be pillaged, his hidden treasures sought out!

OBA 1:7.text: All the men allied with you will drive you to the border; the men at peace with you will deceive and overpower you. Those who eat your bread will set a trap for you without your awareness of it.
OBA 1:7.bm25Text: [Obadiah · Chapter 1 · Deceive] All the men allied with you will drive you to the border; the men at peace with you will deceive and overpower you. Those who eat your bread will set a trap for you without your awareness of it.

OBA 1:8.text: In that day, declares the LORD, will I not destroy the wise men of Edom and the men of understanding in the mountains of Esau?
OBA 1:8.bm25Text: [Obadiah · Chapter 1 · Destroy Canaan, Destroy Canaanites] In that day, declares the LORD, will I not destroy the wise men of Edom and the men of understanding in the mountains of Esau?

OBA 1:9.text: Then your mighty men, O Teman, will be terrified, so that everyone in the mountains of Esau will be cut down in the slaughter.
OBA 1:9.bm25Text: [Obadiah · Chapter 1] Then your mighty men, O Teman, will be terrified, so that everyone in the mountains of Esau will be cut down in the slaughter.

OBA 1:10.text: Because of the violence against your brother Jacob, you will be covered with shame and cut off forever.
OBA 1:10.bm25Text: [Obadiah · Chapter 1 · Israel] Because of the violence against your brother Jacob, you will be covered with shame and cut off forever.

OBA 1:11.text: On the day you stood aloof while strangers carried off his wealth and foreigners entered his gate and cast lots for Jerusalem, you were just like one of them.
OBA 1:11.bm25Text: [Obadiah · Chapter 1] On the day you stood aloof while strangers carried off his wealth and foreigners entered his gate and cast lots for Jerusalem, you were just like one of them.

OBA 1:12.text: But you should not gloat in that day, your brother’s day of misfortune, nor rejoice over the people of Judah in the day of their destruction, nor boast proudly in the day of their distress.
OBA 1:12.bm25Text: [Obadiah · Chapter 1 · Devote To Destruction] But you should not gloat in that day, your brother’s day of misfortune, nor rejoice over the people of Judah in the day of their destruction, nor boast proudly in the day of their distress.

OBA 1:13.text: You should not enter the gate of My people in the day of their disaster, nor gloat over their affliction in the day of their disaster, nor loot their wealth in the day of their disaster.
OBA 1:13.bm25Text: [Obadiah · Chapter 1] You should not enter the gate of My people in the day of their disaster, nor gloat over their affliction in the day of their disaster, nor loot their wealth in the day of their disaster.

OBA 1:14.text: Nor should you stand at the crossroads to cut off their fugitives, nor deliver up their survivors in the day of their distress.
OBA 1:14.bm25Text: [Obadiah · Chapter 1] Nor should you stand at the crossroads to cut off their fugitives, nor deliver up their survivors in the day of their distress.

OBA 1:15.text: For the Day of the LORD is near for all the nations. As you have done, it will be done to you; your recompense will return upon your own head.
OBA 1:15.bm25Text: [Obadiah · Chapter 1] For the Day of the LORD is near for all the nations. As you have done, it will be done to you; your recompense will return upon your own head.

OBA 1:16.text: For as you drank on My holy mountain, so all the nations will drink continually. They will drink and gulp it down; they will be as if they had never existed.
OBA 1:16.bm25Text: [Obadiah · Chapter 1] For as you drank on My holy mountain, so all the nations will drink continually. They will drink and gulp it down; they will be as if they had never existed.

OBA 1:17.text: But on Mount Zion there will be deliverance, and it will be holy, and the house of Jacob will reclaim their possession.
OBA 1:17.bm25Text: [Obadiah · Chapter 1 · Israel] But on Mount Zion there will be deliverance, and it will be holy, and the house of Jacob will reclaim their possession.

OBA 1:18.text: Then the house of Jacob will be a blazing fire, and the house of Joseph a burning flame; but the house of Esau will be stubble— Jacob will set it ablaze and consume it. Therefore no survivor will remain from the house of Esau.” For the LORD has spoken.
OBA 1:18.bm25Text: [Obadiah · Chapter 1 · Israel] Then the house of Jacob will be a blazing fire, and the house of Joseph a burning flame; but the house of Esau will be stubble— Jacob will set it ablaze and consume it. Therefore no survivor will remain from the house of Esau.” For the LORD has spoken.

OBA 1:19.text: Those from the Negev will possess the mountains of Esau; those from the foothills will possess the land of the Philistines. They will occupy the fields of Ephraim and Samaria, and Benjamin will possess Gilead.
OBA 1:19.bm25Text: [Obadiah · Chapter 1] Those from the Negev will possess the mountains of Esau; those from the foothills will possess the land of the Philistines. They will occupy the fields of Ephraim and Samaria, and Benjamin will possess Gilead.

OBA 1:20.text: And the exiles of this host of the Israelites will possess the land of the Canaanites as far as Zarephath; and the exiles from Jerusalem who are in Sepharad will possess the cities of the Negev.
OBA 1:20.bm25Text: [Obadiah · Chapter 1 · Destroy Canaanites, Destroy The Canaanites] And the exiles of this host of the Israelites will possess the land of the Canaanites as far as Zarephath; and the exiles from Jerusalem who are in Sepharad will possess the cities of the Negev.

OBA 1:21.text: The deliverers will ascend Mount Zion to rule over the mountains of Esau.   And the kingdom will belong to the LORD.
OBA 1:21.bm25Text: [Obadiah · Chapter 1 · Kingdom of God] The deliverers will ascend Mount Zion to rule over the mountains of Esau.   And the kingdom will belong to the LORD.

PHM 1:1.text: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother,  To Philemon our beloved fellow worker,
PHM 1:1.bm25Text: [Philemon · Chapter 1 · Love, Body of Christ] Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother,  To Philemon our beloved fellow worker,

PHM 1:2.text: to Apphia our sister, to Archippus our fellow soldier, and to the church that meets at your house:
PHM 1:2.bm25Text: [Philemon · Chapter 1 · Church] to Apphia our sister, to Archippus our fellow soldier, and to the church that meets at your house:

PHM 1:3.text: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
PHM 1:3.bm25Text: [Philemon · Chapter 1 · Body of Christ, God the Father] Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

PHM 1:4.text: I always thank my God, remembering you in my prayers,
PHM 1:4.bm25Text: [Philemon · Chapter 1] I always thank my God, remembering you in my prayers,

PHM 1:5.text: because I hear about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all the saints.
PHM 1:5.bm25Text: [Philemon · Chapter 1 · Love, Faith] because I hear about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all the saints.

PHM 1:6.text: I pray that your partnership in the faith may become effective as you fully acknowledge every good thing that is ours in Christ.
PHM 1:6.bm25Text: [Philemon · Chapter 1 · Faith, Body of Christ] I pray that your partnership in the faith may become effective as you fully acknowledge every good thing that is ours in Christ.

PHM 1:7.text: I take great joy and encouragement in your love, because you, brother, have refreshed the hearts of the saints.
PHM 1:7.bm25Text: [Philemon · Chapter 1 · Love, Comfort] I take great joy and encouragement in your love, because you, brother, have refreshed the hearts of the saints.

PHM 1:8.text: So although in Christ I am bold enough to order you to do what is proper,
PHM 1:8.bm25Text: [Philemon · Chapter 1 · Body of Christ, Jesus Christ] So although in Christ I am bold enough to order you to do what is proper,

PHM 1:9.text: I prefer to appeal on the basis of love. For I, Paul, am now aged, and a prisoner of Christ Jesus as well.
PHM 1:9.bm25Text: [Philemon · Chapter 1 · Love, Body of Christ] I prefer to appeal on the basis of love. For I, Paul, am now aged, and a prisoner of Christ Jesus as well.

PHM 1:10.text: I appeal to you for my child Onesimus, whose father I became while I was in chains.
PHM 1:10.bm25Text: [Philemon · Chapter 1 · God the Father] I appeal to you for my child Onesimus, whose father I became while I was in chains.

PHM 1:11.text: Formerly he was useless to you, but now he has become useful both to you and to me.
PHM 1:11.bm25Text: [Philemon · Chapter 1] Formerly he was useless to you, but now he has become useful both to you and to me.

PHM 1:12.text: I am sending back to you him who is my very heart.
PHM 1:12.bm25Text: [Philemon · Chapter 1 · Adultery In Heart] I am sending back to you him who is my very heart.

PHM 1:13.text: I would have liked to keep him with me, so that on your behalf he could minister to me in my chains for the gospel.
PHM 1:13.bm25Text: [Philemon · Chapter 1 · Gospel] I would have liked to keep him with me, so that on your behalf he could minister to me in my chains for the gospel.

PHM 1:14.text: But I did not want to do anything without your consent, so that your goodness will not be out of compulsion, but by your own free will.
PHM 1:14.bm25Text: [Philemon · Chapter 1] But I did not want to do anything without your consent, so that your goodness will not be out of compulsion, but by your own free will.

PHM 1:15.text: For perhaps this is why he was separated from you for a while, so that you might have him back for good—
PHM 1:15.bm25Text: [Philemon · Chapter 1] For perhaps this is why he was separated from you for a while, so that you might have him back for good—

PHM 1:16.text: no longer as a slave, but better than a slave, as a beloved brother. He is especially beloved to me, but even more so to you, both in person and in the Lord.
PHM 1:16.bm25Text: [Philemon · Chapter 1 · Love] no longer as a slave, but better than a slave, as a beloved brother. He is especially beloved to me, but even more so to you, both in person and in the Lord.

PHM 1:17.text: So if you consider me a partner, receive him as you would receive me.
PHM 1:17.bm25Text: [Philemon · Chapter 1] So if you consider me a partner, receive him as you would receive me.

PHM 1:18.text: But if he has wronged you in any way or owes you anything, charge it to my account.
PHM 1:18.bm25Text: [Philemon · Chapter 1] But if he has wronged you in any way or owes you anything, charge it to my account.

PHM 1:19.text: I, Paul, write this with my own hand. I will repay it—not to mention that you owe me your very self.
PHM 1:19.bm25Text: [Philemon · Chapter 1] I, Paul, write this with my own hand. I will repay it—not to mention that you owe me your very self.

PHM 1:20.text: Yes, brother, let me have some benefit from you in the Lord. Refresh my heart in Christ.
PHM 1:20.bm25Text: [Philemon · Chapter 1 · Adultery In Heart, Body of Christ] Yes, brother, let me have some benefit from you in the Lord. Refresh my heart in Christ.

PHM 1:21.text: Confident of your obedience, I write to you, knowing that you will do even more than I ask.
PHM 1:21.bm25Text: [Philemon · Chapter 1] Confident of your obedience, I write to you, knowing that you will do even more than I ask.

PHM 1:22.text: In the meantime, prepare a guest room for me, because I hope that through your prayers I will be restored to you.
PHM 1:22.bm25Text: [Philemon · Chapter 1] In the meantime, prepare a guest room for me, because I hope that through your prayers I will be restored to you.

PHM 1:23.text: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, sends you greetings,
PHM 1:23.bm25Text: [Philemon · Chapter 1 · Body of Christ, Jesus Christ] Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, sends you greetings,

PHM 1:24.text: as do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my fellow workers.
PHM 1:24.bm25Text: [Philemon · Chapter 1] as do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my fellow workers.

PHM 1:25.text: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit.
PHM 1:25.bm25Text: [Philemon · Chapter 1 · Body of Christ, Fruit of the Spirit] The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit.

PHP 1:1.text: Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus,  To all the saints in Christ Jesus at Philippi, together with the overseers and deacons:
PHP 1:1.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 1 · Body of Christ, Jesus Christ] Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus,  To all the saints in Christ Jesus at Philippi, together with the overseers and deacons:

PHP 1:2.text: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
PHP 1:2.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 1 · Body of Christ, God the Father] Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

PHP 1:3.text: I thank my God every time I remember you.
PHP 1:3.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 1] I thank my God every time I remember you.

PHP 1:4.text: In every prayer for all of you, I always pray with joy,
PHP 1:4.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 1] In every prayer for all of you, I always pray with joy,

PHP 1:5.text: because of your partnership in the gospel from the first day until now,
PHP 1:5.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 1 · Gospel] because of your partnership in the gospel from the first day until now,

PHP 1:6.text: being confident of this, that He who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion until the day of Christ Jesus.
PHP 1:6.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 1 · Body of Christ, Jesus Christ] being confident of this, that He who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion until the day of Christ Jesus.

PHP 1:7.text: It is right for me to feel this way about all of you, since I have you in my heart. For in my chains and in my defense and confirmation of the gospel, you are all partners in grace with me.
PHP 1:7.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 1 · About Forgiveness, Adultery In Heart] It is right for me to feel this way about all of you, since I have you in my heart. For in my chains and in my defense and confirmation of the gospel, you are all partners in grace with me.

PHP 1:8.text: God is my witness how I long for all of you with the affection of Christ Jesus.
PHP 1:8.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 1 · Body of Christ, False Witness] God is my witness how I long for all of you with the affection of Christ Jesus.

PHP 1:9.text: And this is my prayer: that your love may abound more and more in knowledge and depth of insight,
PHP 1:9.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 1 · Love] And this is my prayer: that your love may abound more and more in knowledge and depth of insight,

PHP 1:10.text: so that you may be able to test and prove what is best and may be pure and blameless for the day of Christ,
PHP 1:10.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 1 · Body of Christ, Jesus Christ] so that you may be able to test and prove what is best and may be pure and blameless for the day of Christ,

PHP 1:11.text: filled with the fruit of righteousness that comes through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.
PHP 1:11.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 1 · Body of Christ, Fruit of the Spirit] filled with the fruit of righteousness that comes through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.

PHP 1:12.text: Now I want you to know, brothers, that my circumstances have actually served to advance the gospel.
PHP 1:12.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 1 · Gospel] Now I want you to know, brothers, that my circumstances have actually served to advance the gospel.

PHP 1:13.text: As a result, it has become clear throughout the whole palace guard and to everyone else that I am in chains for Christ.
PHP 1:13.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 1 · Body of Christ, Jesus Christ] As a result, it has become clear throughout the whole palace guard and to everyone else that I am in chains for Christ.

PHP 1:14.text: And most of the brothers, confident in the Lord by my chains, now dare more greatly to speak the word without fear.
PHP 1:14.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 1] And most of the brothers, confident in the Lord by my chains, now dare more greatly to speak the word without fear.

PHP 1:15.text: It is true that some preach Christ out of envy and rivalry, but others out of goodwill.
PHP 1:15.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 1 · Body of Christ, Jealousy] It is true that some preach Christ out of envy and rivalry, but others out of goodwill.

PHP 1:16.text: The latter do so in love, knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the gospel.
PHP 1:16.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 1 · Love, Gospel] The latter do so in love, knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the gospel.

PHP 1:17.text: The former, however, preach Christ out of selfish ambition, not sincerely, supposing that they can add to the distress of my chains.
PHP 1:17.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 1 · Body of Christ, Jesus Christ] The former, however, preach Christ out of selfish ambition, not sincerely, supposing that they can add to the distress of my chains.

PHP 1:18.text: What then is the issue? Just this: that in every way, whether by false motives or true, Christ is preached. And in this I rejoice. Yes, and I will continue to rejoice,
PHP 1:18.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 1 · Body of Christ, False Gods] What then is the issue? Just this: that in every way, whether by false motives or true, Christ is preached. And in this I rejoice. Yes, and I will continue to rejoice,

PHP 1:19.text: because I know that through your prayers and the provision of the Spirit of Jesus Christ, my distress will turn out for my deliverance.
PHP 1:19.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 1 · Body of Christ, Fruit of the Spirit] because I know that through your prayers and the provision of the Spirit of Jesus Christ, my distress will turn out for my deliverance.

PHP 1:20.text: I eagerly expect and hope that I will in no way be ashamed, but will have complete boldness so that now as always Christ will be exalted in my body, whether by life or by death.
PHP 1:20.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 1 · Ascension, Body of Christ] I eagerly expect and hope that I will in no way be ashamed, but will have complete boldness so that now as always Christ will be exalted in my body, whether by life or by death.

PHP 1:21.text: For to me, to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
PHP 1:21.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 1 · Body of Christ, Jesus Christ] For to me, to live is Christ, and to die is gain.

PHP 1:22.text: But if I go on living in the body, this will mean fruitful labor for me. So what shall I choose? I do not know.
PHP 1:22.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 1] But if I go on living in the body, this will mean fruitful labor for me. So what shall I choose? I do not know.

PHP 1:23.text: I am torn between the two. I desire to depart and be with Christ, which is far better indeed.
PHP 1:23.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 1 · Body of Christ, Jesus Christ] I am torn between the two. I desire to depart and be with Christ, which is far better indeed.

PHP 1:24.text: But it is more necessary for you that I remain in the body.
PHP 1:24.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 1] But it is more necessary for you that I remain in the body.

PHP 1:25.text: Convinced of this, I know that I will remain and will continue with all of you for your progress and joy in the faith,
PHP 1:25.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 1 · Faith] Convinced of this, I know that I will remain and will continue with all of you for your progress and joy in the faith,

PHP 1:26.text: so that through my coming to you again your exultation in Christ Jesus will resound on account of me.
PHP 1:26.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 1 · Body of Christ, Jesus Christ] so that through my coming to you again your exultation in Christ Jesus will resound on account of me.

PHP 1:27.text: Nevertheless, conduct yourselves in a manner worthy of the gospel of Christ. Then, whether I come and see you or only hear about you in my absence, I will know that you stand firm in one spirit, contending side by side for the faith of the gospel,
PHP 1:27.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 1 · Faith, About Forgiveness] Nevertheless, conduct yourselves in a manner worthy of the gospel of Christ. Then, whether I come and see you or only hear about you in my absence, I will know that you stand firm in one spirit, contending side by side for the faith of the gospel,

PHP 1:28.text: without being frightened in any way by those who oppose you. This is a clear sign of their destruction but of your salvation, and it is from God.
PHP 1:28.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 1 · Devote To Destruction] without being frightened in any way by those who oppose you. This is a clear sign of their destruction but of your salvation, and it is from God.

PHP 1:29.text: For it has been granted to you on behalf of Christ not only to believe in Him, but also to suffer for Him,
PHP 1:29.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 1 · Faith, Body of Christ] For it has been granted to you on behalf of Christ not only to believe in Him, but also to suffer for Him,

PHP 1:30.text: since you are encountering the same struggle you saw I had, and now hear that I still have.
PHP 1:30.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 1] since you are encountering the same struggle you saw I had, and now hear that I still have.

PHP 2:1.text: Therefore if you have any encouragement in Christ, if any comfort from His love, if any fellowship with the Spirit, if any affection and compassion,
PHP 2:1.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 2 · Love, Body of Christ] Therefore if you have any encouragement in Christ, if any comfort from His love, if any fellowship with the Spirit, if any affection and compassion,

PHP 2:2.text: then make my joy complete by being like-minded, having the same love, being united in spirit and purpose.
PHP 2:2.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 2 · Love, Fruit of the Spirit] then make my joy complete by being like-minded, having the same love, being united in spirit and purpose.

PHP 2:3.text: Do nothing out of selfish ambition or empty pride, but in humility consider others more important than yourselves.
PHP 2:3.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 2 · Humility] Do nothing out of selfish ambition or empty pride, but in humility consider others more important than yourselves.

PHP 2:4.text: Each of you should look not only to your own interests, but also to the interests of others.
PHP 2:4.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 2] Each of you should look not only to your own interests, but also to the interests of others.

PHP 2:5.text: Let this mind be in you which was also in Christ Jesus:
PHP 2:5.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 2 · The Christ Hymn / Kenosis] Let this mind be in you which was also in Christ Jesus:

PHP 2:6.text: Who, existing in the form of God, did not consider equality with God something to be grasped,
PHP 2:6.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 2 · The Christ Hymn / Kenosis] Who, existing in the form of God, did not consider equality with God something to be grasped,

PHP 2:7.text: but emptied Himself, taking the form of a servant, being made in human likeness.
PHP 2:7.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 2 · The Christ Hymn / Kenosis] but emptied Himself, taking the form of a servant, being made in human likeness.

PHP 2:8.text: And being found in appearance as a man, He humbled Himself and became obedient to death— even death on a cross.
PHP 2:8.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 2 · The Christ Hymn / Kenosis] And being found in appearance as a man, He humbled Himself and became obedient to death— even death on a cross.

PHP 2:9.text: Therefore God exalted Him to the highest place and gave Him the name above all names,
PHP 2:9.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 2 · The Christ Hymn / Kenosis] Therefore God exalted Him to the highest place and gave Him the name above all names,

PHP 2:10.text: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, in heaven and on earth and under the earth,
PHP 2:10.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 2 · The Christ Hymn / Kenosis] that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, in heaven and on earth and under the earth,

PHP 2:11.text: and every tongue confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
PHP 2:11.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 2 · The Christ Hymn / Kenosis] and every tongue confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

PHP 2:12.text: Therefore, my beloved, just as you have always obeyed, not only in my presence, but now even more in my absence, continue to work out your salvation with fear and trembling.
PHP 2:12.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 2 · Love] Therefore, my beloved, just as you have always obeyed, not only in my presence, but now even more in my absence, continue to work out your salvation with fear and trembling.

PHP 2:13.text: For it is God who works in you to will and to act on behalf of His good purpose.
PHP 2:13.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 2] For it is God who works in you to will and to act on behalf of His good purpose.

PHP 2:14.text: Do everything without complaining or arguing,
PHP 2:14.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 2] Do everything without complaining or arguing,

PHP 2:15.text: so that you may be blameless and pure, children of God without fault in a crooked and perverse generation, in which you shine as lights in the world
PHP 2:15.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 2 · Children] so that you may be blameless and pure, children of God without fault in a crooked and perverse generation, in which you shine as lights in the world

PHP 2:16.text: as you hold forth the word of life, in order that I may boast on the day of Christ that I did not run or labor in vain.
PHP 2:16.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 2 · Body of Christ, Jesus Christ] as you hold forth the word of life, in order that I may boast on the day of Christ that I did not run or labor in vain.

PHP 2:17.text: But even if I am being poured out like a drink offering on the sacrifice and service of your faith, I am glad and rejoice with all of you.
PHP 2:17.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 2 · Faith] But even if I am being poured out like a drink offering on the sacrifice and service of your faith, I am glad and rejoice with all of you.

PHP 2:18.text: So you too should be glad and rejoice with me.
PHP 2:18.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 2] So you too should be glad and rejoice with me.

PHP 2:19.text: Now I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon, that I also may be cheered when I learn how you are doing.
PHP 2:19.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 2 · Jesus Christ] Now I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon, that I also may be cheered when I learn how you are doing.

PHP 2:20.text: I have nobody else like him who will genuinely care for your needs.
PHP 2:20.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 2] I have nobody else like him who will genuinely care for your needs.

PHP 2:21.text: For all the others look after their own interests, not those of Jesus Christ.
PHP 2:21.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 2 · Body of Christ, Jesus Christ] For all the others look after their own interests, not those of Jesus Christ.

PHP 2:22.text: But you know Timothy’s proven worth, that as a child with his father he has served with me to advance the gospel.
PHP 2:22.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 2 · God the Father, Gospel] But you know Timothy’s proven worth, that as a child with his father he has served with me to advance the gospel.

PHP 2:23.text: So I hope to send him as soon as I see what happens with me.
PHP 2:23.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 2] So I hope to send him as soon as I see what happens with me.

PHP 2:24.text: And I trust in the Lord that I myself will come soon.
PHP 2:24.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 2 · Faith] And I trust in the Lord that I myself will come soon.

PHP 2:25.text: But I thought it necessary to send back to you Epaphroditus, my brother, fellow worker, and fellow soldier, who is also your messenger and minister to my needs.
PHP 2:25.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 2] But I thought it necessary to send back to you Epaphroditus, my brother, fellow worker, and fellow soldier, who is also your messenger and minister to my needs.

PHP 2:26.text: For he has been longing for all of you and is distressed because you heard he was ill.
PHP 2:26.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 2] For he has been longing for all of you and is distressed because you heard he was ill.

PHP 2:27.text: He was sick indeed, nearly unto death. But God had mercy on him, and not only on him but also on me, to spare me sorrow upon sorrow.
PHP 2:27.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 2 · Forgiveness, Compassion] He was sick indeed, nearly unto death. But God had mercy on him, and not only on him but also on me, to spare me sorrow upon sorrow.

PHP 2:28.text: Therefore I am all the more eager to send him, so that when you see him again you may rejoice, and I may be less anxious.
PHP 2:28.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 2] Therefore I am all the more eager to send him, so that when you see him again you may rejoice, and I may be less anxious.

PHP 2:29.text: Welcome him in the Lord with great joy, and honor men like him,
PHP 2:29.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 2] Welcome him in the Lord with great joy, and honor men like him,

PHP 2:30.text: because he nearly died for the work of Christ, risking his life to make up for your deficit of service to me.
PHP 2:30.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 2 · Body of Christ, Jesus Christ] because he nearly died for the work of Christ, risking his life to make up for your deficit of service to me.

PHP 3:1.text: Finally, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord. It is no trouble for me to write the same things to you again, and it is a safeguard for you.
PHP 3:1.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 3] Finally, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord. It is no trouble for me to write the same things to you again, and it is a safeguard for you.

PHP 3:2.text: Watch out for those dogs, those workers of evil, those mutilators of the flesh!
PHP 3:2.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 3] Watch out for those dogs, those workers of evil, those mutilators of the flesh!

PHP 3:3.text: For it is we who are the circumcision, we who worship by the Spirit of God, who glory in Christ Jesus, and who put no confidence in the flesh—
PHP 3:3.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 3 · Assurance, Body of Christ] For it is we who are the circumcision, we who worship by the Spirit of God, who glory in Christ Jesus, and who put no confidence in the flesh—

PHP 3:4.text: though I myself could have such confidence.  If anyone else thinks he has grounds for confidence in the flesh, I have more:
PHP 3:4.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 3 · Assurance] though I myself could have such confidence.  If anyone else thinks he has grounds for confidence in the flesh, I have more:

PHP 3:5.text: circumcised on the eighth day, of the people of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin; a Hebrew of Hebrews; as to the law, a Pharisee;
PHP 3:5.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 3 · Israel] circumcised on the eighth day, of the people of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin; a Hebrew of Hebrews; as to the law, a Pharisee;

PHP 3:6.text: as to zeal, persecuting the church; as to righteousness in the law, faultless.
PHP 3:6.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 3 · Church] as to zeal, persecuting the church; as to righteousness in the law, faultless.

PHP 3:7.text: But whatever was gain to me I count as loss for the sake of Christ.
PHP 3:7.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 3 · Body of Christ, Jesus Christ] But whatever was gain to me I count as loss for the sake of Christ.

PHP 3:8.text: More than that, I count all things as loss compared to the surpassing excellence of knowing Christ Jesus my Lord, for whom I have lost all things. I consider them rubbish, that I may gain Christ
PHP 3:8.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 3 · Body of Christ, Jesus Christ] More than that, I count all things as loss compared to the surpassing excellence of knowing Christ Jesus my Lord, for whom I have lost all things. I consider them rubbish, that I may gain Christ

PHP 3:9.text: and be found in Him, not having my own righteousness from the law, but that which is through faith in Christ, the righteousness from God on the basis of faith.
PHP 3:9.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 3 · Faith, Body of Christ] and be found in Him, not having my own righteousness from the law, but that which is through faith in Christ, the righteousness from God on the basis of faith.

PHP 3:10.text: I want to know Christ and the power of His resurrection and the fellowship of His sufferings, being conformed to Him in His death,
PHP 3:10.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 3 · Body of Christ, Death] I want to know Christ and the power of His resurrection and the fellowship of His sufferings, being conformed to Him in His death,

PHP 3:11.text: and so, somehow, to attain to the resurrection from the dead.
PHP 3:11.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 3] and so, somehow, to attain to the resurrection from the dead.

PHP 3:12.text: Not that I have already obtained all this, or have already been made perfect, but I press on to take hold of that for which Christ Jesus took hold of me.
PHP 3:12.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 3 · Body of Christ, Jesus Christ] Not that I have already obtained all this, or have already been made perfect, but I press on to take hold of that for which Christ Jesus took hold of me.

PHP 3:13.text: Brothers, I do not consider myself yet to have taken hold of it. But one thing I do: Forgetting what is behind and straining toward what is ahead,
PHP 3:13.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 3] Brothers, I do not consider myself yet to have taken hold of it. But one thing I do: Forgetting what is behind and straining toward what is ahead,

PHP 3:14.text: I press on toward the goal to win the prize of God’s heavenly calling in Christ Jesus.
PHP 3:14.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 3 · Body of Christ, Calling] I press on toward the goal to win the prize of God’s heavenly calling in Christ Jesus.

PHP 3:15.text: All of us who are mature should embrace this point of view. And if you think differently about some issue, God will reveal this to you as well.
PHP 3:15.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 3 · About Forgiveness] All of us who are mature should embrace this point of view. And if you think differently about some issue, God will reveal this to you as well.

PHP 3:16.text: Nevertheless, we must live up to what we have already attained.
PHP 3:16.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 3] Nevertheless, we must live up to what we have already attained.

PHP 3:17.text: Join one another in following my example, brothers, and carefully observe those who walk according to the pattern we set for you.
PHP 3:17.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 3] Join one another in following my example, brothers, and carefully observe those who walk according to the pattern we set for you.

PHP 3:18.text: For as I have often told you before, and now say again even with tears: Many live as enemies of the cross of Christ.
PHP 3:18.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 3 · Body of Christ, Cross] For as I have often told you before, and now say again even with tears: Many live as enemies of the cross of Christ.

PHP 3:19.text: Their end is destruction, their god is their belly, and their glory is in their shame. Their minds are set on earthly things.
PHP 3:19.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 3 · Devote To Destruction, Glory] Their end is destruction, their god is their belly, and their glory is in their shame. Their minds are set on earthly things.

PHP 3:20.text: But our citizenship is in heaven, and we eagerly await a Savior from there, the Lord Jesus Christ,
PHP 3:20.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 3 · Body of Christ, Heaven] But our citizenship is in heaven, and we eagerly await a Savior from there, the Lord Jesus Christ,

PHP 3:21.text: who, by the power that enables Him to subject all things to Himself, will transform our lowly bodies to be like His glorious body.
PHP 3:21.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 3] who, by the power that enables Him to subject all things to Himself, will transform our lowly bodies to be like His glorious body.

PHP 4:1.text: Therefore, my brothers, whom I love and long for, my joy and crown, that is how you must stand firm in the Lord, my beloved.
PHP 4:1.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 4 · Love] Therefore, my brothers, whom I love and long for, my joy and crown, that is how you must stand firm in the Lord, my beloved.

PHP 4:2.text: I urge Euodia and Syntyche to agree with each other in the Lord.
PHP 4:2.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 4] I urge Euodia and Syntyche to agree with each other in the Lord.

PHP 4:3.text: Yes, and I ask you, my true yokefellow, to help these women who have labored with me for the gospel, along with Clement and the rest of my fellow workers, whose names are in the Book of Life.
PHP 4:3.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 4 · Biblical Women, Gospel] Yes, and I ask you, my true yokefellow, to help these women who have labored with me for the gospel, along with Clement and the rest of my fellow workers, whose names are in the Book of Life.

PHP 4:4.text: Rejoice in the Lord always. I will say it again: Rejoice!
PHP 4:4.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 4] Rejoice in the Lord always. I will say it again: Rejoice!

PHP 4:5.text: Let your gentleness be apparent to all. The Lord is near.
PHP 4:5.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 4 · Gentleness] Let your gentleness be apparent to all. The Lord is near.

PHP 4:6.text: Be anxious for nothing, but in everything, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God.
PHP 4:6.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 4 · Gratitude] Be anxious for nothing, but in everything, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God.

PHP 4:7.text: And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.
PHP 4:7.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 4 · Body of Christ, Jesus Christ] And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.

PHP 4:8.text: Finally, brothers, whatever is true, whatever is honorable, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable—if anything is excellent or praiseworthy—think on these things.
PHP 4:8.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 4 · Love] Finally, brothers, whatever is true, whatever is honorable, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable—if anything is excellent or praiseworthy—think on these things.

PHP 4:9.text: Whatever you have learned or received or heard from me, or seen in me, put it into practice. And the God of peace will be with you.
PHP 4:9.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 4] Whatever you have learned or received or heard from me, or seen in me, put it into practice. And the God of peace will be with you.

PHP 4:10.text: Now I rejoice greatly in the Lord that at last you have revived your concern for me. You were indeed concerned, but you had no opportunity to show it.
PHP 4:10.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 4] Now I rejoice greatly in the Lord that at last you have revived your concern for me. You were indeed concerned, but you had no opportunity to show it.

PHP 4:11.text: I am not saying this out of need, for I have learned to be content regardless of my circumstances.
PHP 4:11.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 4] I am not saying this out of need, for I have learned to be content regardless of my circumstances.

PHP 4:12.text: I know how to live humbly, and I know how to abound. I am accustomed to any and every situation—to being filled and being hungry, to having plenty and having need.
PHP 4:12.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 4] I know how to live humbly, and I know how to abound. I am accustomed to any and every situation—to being filled and being hungry, to having plenty and having need.

PHP 4:13.text: I can do all things through Christ who gives me strength.
PHP 4:13.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 4 · Body of Christ, Jesus Christ] I can do all things through Christ who gives me strength.

PHP 4:14.text: Nevertheless, you have done well to share in my affliction.
PHP 4:14.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 4] Nevertheless, you have done well to share in my affliction.

PHP 4:15.text: And as you Philippians know, in the early days of the gospel, when I left Macedonia, no church but you partnered with me in the matter of giving and receiving.
PHP 4:15.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 4 · Church, Generosity] And as you Philippians know, in the early days of the gospel, when I left Macedonia, no church but you partnered with me in the matter of giving and receiving.

PHP 4:16.text: For even while I was in Thessalonica, you provided for my needs again and again.
PHP 4:16.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 4] For even while I was in Thessalonica, you provided for my needs again and again.

PHP 4:17.text: Not that I am seeking a gift, but I am looking for the fruit that may be credited to your account.
PHP 4:17.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 4 · Fruit of the Spirit] Not that I am seeking a gift, but I am looking for the fruit that may be credited to your account.

PHP 4:18.text: I have all I need and more, now that I have received your gifts from Epaphroditus. They are a fragrant offering, an acceptable sacrifice, well-pleasing to God.
PHP 4:18.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 4] I have all I need and more, now that I have received your gifts from Epaphroditus. They are a fragrant offering, an acceptable sacrifice, well-pleasing to God.

PHP 4:19.text: And my God will supply all your needs according to His glorious riches in Christ Jesus.
PHP 4:19.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 4 · Body of Christ, Jesus Christ] And my God will supply all your needs according to His glorious riches in Christ Jesus.

PHP 4:20.text: To our God and Father be glory forever and ever. Amen.
PHP 4:20.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 4 · Glory, God the Father] To our God and Father be glory forever and ever. Amen.

PHP 4:21.text: Greet all the saints in Christ Jesus.  The brothers who are with me send you greetings.
PHP 4:21.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 4 · Body of Christ, Jesus Christ] Greet all the saints in Christ Jesus.  The brothers who are with me send you greetings.

PHP 4:22.text: All the saints send you greetings, especially those from the household of Caesar.
PHP 4:22.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 4 · Family] All the saints send you greetings, especially those from the household of Caesar.

PHP 4:23.text: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit.
PHP 4:23.bm25Text: [Philippians · Chapter 4 · Body of Christ, Fruit of the Spirit] The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit.

PRO 1:1.text: These are the proverbs of Solomon son of David, king of Israel,
PRO 1:1.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 1 · Israel] These are the proverbs of Solomon son of David, king of Israel,

PRO 1:2.text: for gaining wisdom and discipline, for comprehending words of insight,
PRO 1:2.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 1] for gaining wisdom and discipline, for comprehending words of insight,

PRO 1:3.text: and for receiving instruction in wise living and in righteousness, justice, and equity.
PRO 1:3.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 1 · Justice] and for receiving instruction in wise living and in righteousness, justice, and equity.

PRO 1:4.text: To impart prudence to the simple and knowledge and discretion to the young,
PRO 1:4.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 1] To impart prudence to the simple and knowledge and discretion to the young,

PRO 1:5.text: let the wise listen and gain instruction, and the discerning acquire wise counsel
PRO 1:5.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 1] let the wise listen and gain instruction, and the discerning acquire wise counsel

PRO 1:6.text: by understanding the proverbs and parables, the sayings and riddles of the wise.
PRO 1:6.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 1] by understanding the proverbs and parables, the sayings and riddles of the wise.

PRO 1:7.text: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge, but fools despise wisdom and discipline.
PRO 1:7.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 1] The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge, but fools despise wisdom and discipline.

PRO 1:8.text: Listen, my son, to your father’s instruction, and do not forsake the teaching of your mother.
PRO 1:8.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 1 · God the Father] Listen, my son, to your father’s instruction, and do not forsake the teaching of your mother.

PRO 1:9.text: For they are a garland of grace on your head and a pendant around your neck.
PRO 1:9.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 1 · Grace] For they are a garland of grace on your head and a pendant around your neck.

PRO 1:10.text: My son, if sinners entice you, do not yield to them.
PRO 1:10.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 1] My son, if sinners entice you, do not yield to them.

PRO 1:11.text: If they say, “Come along, let us lie in wait for blood, let us ambush the innocent without cause,
PRO 1:11.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 1] If they say, “Come along, let us lie in wait for blood, let us ambush the innocent without cause,

PRO 1:12.text: let us swallow them alive like Sheol, and whole like those descending into the Pit.
PRO 1:12.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 1 · Death] let us swallow them alive like Sheol, and whole like those descending into the Pit.

PRO 1:13.text: We will find all manner of precious goods; we will fill our houses with plunder.
PRO 1:13.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 1] We will find all manner of precious goods; we will fill our houses with plunder.

PRO 1:14.text: Throw in your lot with us; let us all share one purse”—
PRO 1:14.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 1] Throw in your lot with us; let us all share one purse”—

PRO 1:15.text: my son, do not walk the road with them or set foot upon their path.
PRO 1:15.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 1] my son, do not walk the road with them or set foot upon their path.

PRO 1:16.text: For their feet run to evil, and they are swift to shed blood.
PRO 1:16.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 1] For their feet run to evil, and they are swift to shed blood.

PRO 1:17.text: How futile it is to spread the net where any bird can see it!
PRO 1:17.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 1] How futile it is to spread the net where any bird can see it!

PRO 1:18.text: But they lie in wait for their own blood; they ambush their own lives.
PRO 1:18.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 1] But they lie in wait for their own blood; they ambush their own lives.

PRO 1:19.text: Such is the fate of all who are greedy, whose unjust gain takes the lives of its possessors.
PRO 1:19.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 1] Such is the fate of all who are greedy, whose unjust gain takes the lives of its possessors.

PRO 1:20.text: Wisdom calls out in the street, she lifts her voice in the square;
PRO 1:20.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 1] Wisdom calls out in the street, she lifts her voice in the square;

PRO 1:21.text: in the main concourse she cries aloud, at the city gates she makes her speech:
PRO 1:21.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 1] in the main concourse she cries aloud, at the city gates she makes her speech:

PRO 1:22.text: “How long, O simple ones, will you love your simple ways? How long will scoffers delight in their scorn and fools hate knowledge?
PRO 1:22.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 1 · Love] “How long, O simple ones, will you love your simple ways? How long will scoffers delight in their scorn and fools hate knowledge?

PRO 1:23.text: If you had repented at my rebuke, then surely I would have poured out my spirit on you; I would have made my words known to you.
PRO 1:23.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 1 · Fruit of the Spirit] If you had repented at my rebuke, then surely I would have poured out my spirit on you; I would have made my words known to you.

PRO 1:24.text: Because you refused my call, and no one took my outstretched hand,
PRO 1:24.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 1] Because you refused my call, and no one took my outstretched hand,

PRO 1:25.text: because you neglected all my counsel, and wanted none of my correction,
PRO 1:25.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 1] because you neglected all my counsel, and wanted none of my correction,

PRO 1:26.text: in turn I will mock your calamity; I will sneer when terror strikes you,
PRO 1:26.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 1] in turn I will mock your calamity; I will sneer when terror strikes you,

PRO 1:27.text: when your dread comes like a storm, and your destruction like a whirlwind, when distress and anguish overwhelm you.
PRO 1:27.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 1 · Devote To Destruction, Fear] when your dread comes like a storm, and your destruction like a whirlwind, when distress and anguish overwhelm you.

PRO 1:28.text: Then they will call on me, but I will not answer; they will earnestly seek me, but will not find me.
PRO 1:28.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 1] Then they will call on me, but I will not answer; they will earnestly seek me, but will not find me.

PRO 1:29.text: For they hated knowledge and chose not to fear the LORD.
PRO 1:29.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 1] For they hated knowledge and chose not to fear the LORD.

PRO 1:30.text: They accepted none of my counsel; they despised all my reproof.
PRO 1:30.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 1] They accepted none of my counsel; they despised all my reproof.

PRO 1:31.text: So they will eat the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own devices.
PRO 1:31.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 1 · Fruit of the Spirit] So they will eat the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own devices.

PRO 1:32.text: For the waywardness of the simple will slay them, and the complacency of fools will destroy them.
PRO 1:32.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 1 · Destroy Canaan, Destroy Canaanites] For the waywardness of the simple will slay them, and the complacency of fools will destroy them.

PRO 1:33.text: But whoever listens to me will dwell in safety, secure from the fear of evil.”
PRO 1:33.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 1] But whoever listens to me will dwell in safety, secure from the fear of evil.”

PRO 2:1.text: My son, if you accept my words and hide my commandments within you,
PRO 2:1.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 2 · Law] My son, if you accept my words and hide my commandments within you,

PRO 2:2.text: if you incline your ear to wisdom and direct your heart to understanding,
PRO 2:2.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 2 · Adultery In Heart] if you incline your ear to wisdom and direct your heart to understanding,

PRO 2:3.text: if you truly call out to insight and lift your voice to understanding,
PRO 2:3.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 2] if you truly call out to insight and lift your voice to understanding,

PRO 2:4.text: if you seek it like silver and search it out like hidden treasure,
PRO 2:4.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 2] if you seek it like silver and search it out like hidden treasure,

PRO 2:5.text: then you will discern the fear of the LORD and discover the knowledge of God.
PRO 2:5.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 2] then you will discern the fear of the LORD and discover the knowledge of God.

PRO 2:6.text: For the LORD gives wisdom; from His mouth come knowledge and understanding.
PRO 2:6.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 2] For the LORD gives wisdom; from His mouth come knowledge and understanding.

PRO 2:7.text: He stores up sound wisdom for the upright; He is a shield to those who walk with integrity,
PRO 2:7.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 2] He stores up sound wisdom for the upright; He is a shield to those who walk with integrity,

PRO 2:8.text: to guard the paths of justice and protect the way of His saints.
PRO 2:8.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 2 · Justice] to guard the paths of justice and protect the way of His saints.

PRO 2:9.text: Then you will discern righteousness and justice and equity—every good path.
PRO 2:9.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 2 · Justice] Then you will discern righteousness and justice and equity—every good path.

PRO 2:10.text: For wisdom will enter your heart, and knowledge will delight your soul.
PRO 2:10.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 2 · Adultery In Heart] For wisdom will enter your heart, and knowledge will delight your soul.

PRO 2:11.text: Discretion will watch over you, and understanding will guard you,
PRO 2:11.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 2] Discretion will watch over you, and understanding will guard you,

PRO 2:12.text: to deliver you from the way of evil, from the man who speaks perversity,
PRO 2:12.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 2] to deliver you from the way of evil, from the man who speaks perversity,

PRO 2:13.text: from those who leave the straight paths to walk in the ways of darkness,
PRO 2:13.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 2] from those who leave the straight paths to walk in the ways of darkness,

PRO 2:14.text: from those who enjoy doing evil and rejoice in the twistedness of evil,
PRO 2:14.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 2] from those who enjoy doing evil and rejoice in the twistedness of evil,

PRO 2:15.text: whose paths are crooked and whose ways are devious.
PRO 2:15.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 2] whose paths are crooked and whose ways are devious.

PRO 2:16.text: It will rescue you from the forbidden woman, from the stranger with seductive words
PRO 2:16.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 2] It will rescue you from the forbidden woman, from the stranger with seductive words

PRO 2:17.text: who abandons the partner of her youth and forgets the covenant of her God.
PRO 2:17.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 2 · Covenant] who abandons the partner of her youth and forgets the covenant of her God.

PRO 2:18.text: For her house sinks down to death, and her tracks to the departed spirits.
PRO 2:18.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 2 · Death] For her house sinks down to death, and her tracks to the departed spirits.

PRO 2:19.text: None who go to her return or negotiate the paths of life.
PRO 2:19.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 2] None who go to her return or negotiate the paths of life.

PRO 2:20.text: So you will follow in the ways of the good, and keep to the paths of the righteous.
PRO 2:20.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 2] So you will follow in the ways of the good, and keep to the paths of the righteous.

PRO 2:21.text: For the upright will inhabit the land, and the blameless will remain in it;
PRO 2:21.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 2] For the upright will inhabit the land, and the blameless will remain in it;

PRO 2:22.text: but the wicked will be cut off from the land, and the unfaithful will be uprooted.

PRO 7:5.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 7] that they may keep you from the adulteress, from the stranger with seductive words.

PRO 7:6.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 7] For at the window of my house I looked through the lattice.

PRO 7:7.text: I saw among the simple, I noticed among the youths, a young man lacking judgment,

PRO 7:8.text: crossing the street near her corner, strolling down the road to her house,

PRO 7:9.text: at twilight, as the day was fading into the dark of the night.
PRO 7:9.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 7] at twilight, as the day was fading into the dark of the night.

PRO 7:10.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 7 · Adultery In Heart] Then a woman came out to meet him, with the attire of a harlot and cunning of heart.

PRO 7:11.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 7] She is loud and defiant; her feet do not remain at home.

PRO 7:12.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 7] Now in the street, now in the squares, she lurks at every corner.

PRO 7:14.text: “I have made my peace offerings; today I have paid my vows.
PRO 7:14.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 7] “I have made my peace offerings; today I have paid my vows.

PRO 7:15.text: So I came out to meet you; I sought you, and I have found you.
PRO 7:15.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 7] So I came out to meet you; I sought you, and I have found you.

PRO 7:16.text: I have decked my bed with coverings, with colored linen from Egypt.
PRO 7:16.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 7] I have decked my bed with coverings, with colored linen from Egypt.

PRO 7:17.text: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, with aloes, and with cinnamon.
PRO 7:17.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 7] I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, with aloes, and with cinnamon.

PRO 7:18.text: Come, let us take our fill of love till morning. Let us delight in loving caresses!
PRO 7:18.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 7 · Love] Come, let us take our fill of love till morning. Let us delight in loving caresses!

PRO 7:19.text: For my husband is not at home; he has gone on a long journey.
PRO 7:19.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 7] For my husband is not at home; he has gone on a long journey.

PRO 7:20.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 7] He took with him a bag of money and will not return till the moon is full.”

PRO 7:21.text: With her great persuasion she entices him; with her flattering lips she lures him.
PRO 7:21.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 7] With her great persuasion she entices him; with her flattering lips she lures him.

PRO 7:22.text: He follows her on impulse, like an ox going to the slaughter, like a deer bounding into a trap,
PRO 7:22.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 7] He follows her on impulse, like an ox going to the slaughter, like a deer bounding into a trap,

PRO 7:23.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 7] until an arrow pierces his liver, like a bird darting into a snare— not knowing it will cost him his life.

PRO 7:24.text: Now, my sons, listen to me, and attend to the words of my mouth.
PRO 7:24.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 7] Now, my sons, listen to me, and attend to the words of my mouth.

PRO 7:25.text: Do not let your heart turn aside to her ways; do not stray into her paths.
PRO 7:25.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 7 · Adultery In Heart] Do not let your heart turn aside to her ways; do not stray into her paths.

PRO 7:26.text: For she has brought many down to death; her slain are many in number.
PRO 7:26.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 7 · Death] For she has brought many down to death; her slain are many in number.

PRO 7:27.text: Her house is the road to Sheol, descending to the chambers of death.
PRO 7:27.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 7 · Death] Her house is the road to Sheol, descending to the chambers of death.

PRO 8:1.text: Does not wisdom call out, and understanding raise her voice?
PRO 8:1.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 8] Does not wisdom call out, and understanding raise her voice?

PRO 8:2.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 8] On the heights overlooking the road, at the crossroads she takes her stand.

PRO 8:3.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 8] Beside the gates to the city, at the entrances she cries out:
