PRO 8:4.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 8] “To you, O men, I call out, and my cry is to the sons of men.

PRO 8:5.text: O simple ones, learn to be shrewd; O fools, gain understanding.
PRO 8:5.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 8] O simple ones, learn to be shrewd; O fools, gain understanding.

PRO 8:6.text: Listen, for I speak of noble things, and the opening of my lips will reveal right.
PRO 8:6.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 8] Listen, for I speak of noble things, and the opening of my lips will reveal right.

PRO 8:7.text: For my mouth will speak the truth, and wickedness is detestable to my lips.
PRO 8:7.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 8] For my mouth will speak the truth, and wickedness is detestable to my lips.

PRO 8:8.text: All the words of my mouth are righteous; none are crooked or perverse.
PRO 8:8.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 8] All the words of my mouth are righteous; none are crooked or perverse.

PRO 8:9.text: They are all plain to the discerning, and upright to those who find knowledge.
PRO 8:9.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 8] They are all plain to the discerning, and upright to those who find knowledge.

PRO 8:10.text: Receive my instruction instead of silver, and knowledge rather than pure gold.
PRO 8:10.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 8] Receive my instruction instead of silver, and knowledge rather than pure gold.

PRO 8:11.text: For wisdom is more precious than rubies, and nothing you desire compares with her.
PRO 8:11.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 8 · Lust] For wisdom is more precious than rubies, and nothing you desire compares with her.

PRO 8:12.text: I, wisdom, dwell together with prudence, and I find knowledge and discretion.
PRO 8:12.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 8] I, wisdom, dwell together with prudence, and I find knowledge and discretion.

PRO 8:13.text: To fear the LORD is to hate evil; I hate arrogant pride, evil conduct, and perverse speech.
PRO 8:13.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 8] To fear the LORD is to hate evil; I hate arrogant pride, evil conduct, and perverse speech.

PRO 8:14.text: Counsel and sound judgment are mine; I have insight and strength.
PRO 8:14.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 8 · Judgment] Counsel and sound judgment are mine; I have insight and strength.

PRO 8:15.text: By me kings reign, and rulers enact just laws;
PRO 8:15.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 8] By me kings reign, and rulers enact just laws;

PRO 8:16.text: By me princes rule, and all nobles who govern justly.
PRO 8:16.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 8] By me princes rule, and all nobles who govern justly.

PRO 8:17.text: I love those who love me, and those who seek me early shall find me.
PRO 8:17.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 8 · Love] I love those who love me, and those who seek me early shall find me.

PRO 8:18.text: With me are riches and honor, enduring wealth and righteousness.
PRO 8:18.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 8] With me are riches and honor, enduring wealth and righteousness.

PRO 8:19.text: My fruit is better than gold, pure gold, and my harvest surpasses choice silver.
PRO 8:19.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 8 · Fruit of the Spirit] My fruit is better than gold, pure gold, and my harvest surpasses choice silver.

PRO 8:20.text: I walk in the way of righteousness, along the paths of justice,
PRO 8:20.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 8 · Justice] I walk in the way of righteousness, along the paths of justice,

PRO 8:21.text: bestowing wealth on those who love me and making their treasuries full.
PRO 8:21.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 8 · Love] bestowing wealth on those who love me and making their treasuries full.

PRO 8:22.text: The LORD created me as His first course, before His works of old.
PRO 8:22.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 8] The LORD created me as His first course, before His works of old.

PRO 8:23.text: From everlasting I was established, from the beginning, before the earth began.
PRO 8:23.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 8] From everlasting I was established, from the beginning, before the earth began.

PRO 8:24.text: When there were no watery depths, I was brought forth, when no springs were overflowing with water.
PRO 8:24.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 8] When there were no watery depths, I was brought forth, when no springs were overflowing with water.

PRO 8:25.text: Before the mountains were settled, before the hills, I was brought forth,
PRO 8:25.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 8] Before the mountains were settled, before the hills, I was brought forth,

PRO 8:26.text: before He made the land or fields, or any of the dust of the earth.
PRO 8:26.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 8] before He made the land or fields, or any of the dust of the earth.

PRO 8:27.text: I was there when He established the heavens, when He inscribed a circle on the face of the deep,
PRO 8:27.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 8] I was there when He established the heavens, when He inscribed a circle on the face of the deep,

PRO 8:28.text: when He established the clouds above, when the fountains of the deep gushed forth,
PRO 8:28.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 8] when He established the clouds above, when the fountains of the deep gushed forth,

PRO 8:29.text: when He set a boundary for the sea, so that the waters would not surpass His command, when He marked out the foundations of the earth.
PRO 8:29.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 8] when He set a boundary for the sea, so that the waters would not surpass His command, when He marked out the foundations of the earth.

PRO 8:30.text: Then I was a skilled craftsman at His side, and His delight day by day, rejoicing always in His presence.
PRO 8:30.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 8 · Joy] Then I was a skilled craftsman at His side, and His delight day by day, rejoicing always in His presence.

PRO 8:31.text: I was rejoicing in His whole world, delighting together in the sons of men.
PRO 8:31.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 8 · Joy] I was rejoicing in His whole world, delighting together in the sons of men.

PRO 8:32.text: Now therefore, my sons, listen to me, for blessed are those who keep my ways.
PRO 8:32.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 8 · Beatitudes] Now therefore, my sons, listen to me, for blessed are those who keep my ways.

PRO 8:33.text: Listen to instruction and be wise; do not ignore it.
PRO 8:33.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 8] Listen to instruction and be wise; do not ignore it.

PRO 8:34.text: Blessed is the man who listens to me, watching daily at my doors, waiting at the posts of my doorway.
PRO 8:34.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 8] Blessed is the man who listens to me, watching daily at my doors, waiting at the posts of my doorway.

PRO 8:35.text: For whoever finds me finds life and obtains the favor of the LORD.
PRO 8:35.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 8 · Blessing] For whoever finds me finds life and obtains the favor of the LORD.

PRO 8:36.text: But he who fails to find me harms himself; all who hate me love death.”
PRO 8:36.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 8 · Love, Death] But he who fails to find me harms himself; all who hate me love death.”

PRO 9:1.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 9] Wisdom has built her house; she has carved out her seven pillars.

PRO 9:2.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 9] She has prepared her meat and mixed her wine; she has also set her table.

PRO 9:5.text: “Come, eat my bread and drink the wine I have mixed.
PRO 9:5.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 9] “Come, eat my bread and drink the wine I have mixed.

PRO 9:6.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 9] Leave your folly behind, and you will live; walk in the way of understanding.”

PRO 9:7.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 9] He who corrects a mocker brings shame on himself; he who rebukes a wicked man taints himself.

PRO 9:8.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 9 · Love] Do not rebuke a mocker, or he will hate you; rebuke a wise man, and he will love you.

PRO 9:9.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 9] Instruct a wise man, and he will be wiser still; teach a righteous man, and he will increase his learning.

PRO 9:10.text: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom, and knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.
PRO 9:10.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 9] The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom, and knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.

PRO 9:11.text: For through wisdom your days will be multiplied, and years will be added to your life.
PRO 9:11.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 9] For through wisdom your days will be multiplied, and years will be added to your life.

PRO 9:12.text: If you are wise, you are wise to your own advantage; but if you scoff, you alone will bear the consequences.
PRO 9:12.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 9] If you are wise, you are wise to your own advantage; but if you scoff, you alone will bear the consequences.

PRO 9:13.text: The woman named Folly is loud; she is naive and knows nothing.
PRO 9:13.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 9] The woman named Folly is loud; she is naive and knows nothing.

PRO 9:14.text: She sits at the door of her house, on a seat in the heights of the city,
PRO 9:14.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 9] She sits at the door of her house, on a seat in the heights of the city,

PRO 9:15.text: calling out to those who pass by, who make their paths straight.
PRO 9:15.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 9 · Calling] calling out to those who pass by, who make their paths straight.

PRO 9:16.text: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here!” she says to him who lacks judgment.
PRO 9:16.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 9 · Judgment] “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here!” she says to him who lacks judgment.

PRO 9:17.text: “Stolen water is sweet, and bread eaten in secret is tasty!”
PRO 9:17.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 9] “Stolen water is sweet, and bread eaten in secret is tasty!”

PRO 9:18.text: But they do not know that the dead are there, that her guests are in the depths of Sheol.
PRO 9:18.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 9 · Death] But they do not know that the dead are there, that her guests are in the depths of Sheol.

PRO 10:2.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 10 · Death] Ill-gotten treasures profit nothing, but righteousness brings deliverance from death.

PRO 10:3.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 10] The LORD does not let the righteous go hungry, but He denies the craving of the wicked.

PRO 10:4.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 10] Idle hands make one poor, but diligent hands bring wealth.

PRO 10:5.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 10] He who gathers in summer is a wise son, but he who sleeps during harvest is a disgraceful son.

PRO 10:6.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 10] Blessings are on the head of the righteous, but the mouth of the wicked conceals violence.

PRO 10:7.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 10 · Blessing] The memory of the righteous is a blessing, but the name of the wicked will rot.

PRO 10:9.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 10] He who walks in integrity walks securely, but he who perverts his ways will be found out.

PRO 10:10.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 10] He who winks the eye causes grief, and foolish lips will come to ruin.

PRO 10:11.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 10] The mouth of the righteous is a fountain of life, but the mouth of the wicked conceals violence.

PRO 10:12.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 10 · Love] Hatred stirs up dissension, but love covers all transgressions.

PRO 10:13.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 10 · Judgment] Wisdom is found on the lips of the discerning, but a rod is for the back of him who lacks judgment.

PRO 10:15.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 10] The wealth of the rich man is his fortified city, but poverty is the ruin of the poor.

PRO 10:16.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 10] The labor of the righteous leads to life, but the gain of the wicked brings punishment.

PRO 10:17.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 10] Whoever heeds instruction is on the path to life, but he who ignores reproof goes astray.

PRO 10:18.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 10 · Lying] The one who conceals hatred has lying lips, and whoever spreads slander is a fool.

PRO 10:19.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 10] When words are many, sin is unavoidable, but he who restrains his lips is wise.

PRO 10:20.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 10 · Adultery In Heart] The tongue of the righteous is choice silver, but the heart of the wicked has little worth.

PRO 10:21.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 10 · Judgment] The lips of the righteous feed many, but fools die for lack of judgment.

PRO 10:22.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 10 · Blessing] The blessing of the LORD enriches, and He adds no sorrow to it.

PRO 10:23.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 10] The fool delights in shameful conduct, but a man of understanding has wisdom.

PRO 10:24.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 10 · Lust] What the wicked man dreads will overtake him, but the desire of the righteous will be granted.

PRO 10:25.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 10] When the whirlwind passes, the wicked are no more, but the righteous are secure forever.

PRO 10:28.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 10] The hope of the righteous is joy, but the expectations of the wicked will perish.

PRO 10:31.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 10] The mouth of the righteous brings forth wisdom, but a perverse tongue will be cut out.

PRO 31:7.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 31] Let him drink and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.

PRO 31:8.text: Open your mouth for those with no voice, for the cause of all the dispossessed.
PRO 31:8.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 31] Open your mouth for those with no voice, for the cause of all the dispossessed.

PRO 31:9.text: Open your mouth, judge righteously, and defend the cause of the poor and needy.
PRO 31:9.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 31] Open your mouth, judge righteously, and defend the cause of the poor and needy.

PRO 31:10.text: A wife of noble character, who can find? She is far more precious than rubies.
PRO 31:10.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 31 · The Wife of Noble Character (Proverbs 31)] A wife of noble character, who can find? She is far more precious than rubies.

PRO 31:11.text: The heart of her husband trusts in her, and he lacks nothing of value.
PRO 31:11.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 31 · The Wife of Noble Character (Proverbs 31)] The heart of her husband trusts in her, and he lacks nothing of value.

PRO 31:12.text: She brings him good and not harm all the days of her life.
PRO 31:12.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 31 · The Wife of Noble Character (Proverbs 31)] She brings him good and not harm all the days of her life.

PRO 31:13.text: She selects wool and flax and works with eager hands.
PRO 31:13.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 31 · The Wife of Noble Character (Proverbs 31)] She selects wool and flax and works with eager hands.

PRO 31:14.text: She is like the merchant ships, bringing her food from afar.
PRO 31:14.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 31 · The Wife of Noble Character (Proverbs 31)] She is like the merchant ships, bringing her food from afar.

PRO 31:15.text: She rises while it is still night to provide food for her household and portions for her maidservants.
PRO 31:15.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 31 · The Wife of Noble Character (Proverbs 31)] She rises while it is still night to provide food for her household and portions for her maidservants.

PRO 31:16.text: She appraises a field and buys it; from her earnings she plants a vineyard.
PRO 31:16.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 31 · The Wife of Noble Character (Proverbs 31)] She appraises a field and buys it; from her earnings she plants a vineyard.

PRO 31:17.text: She girds herself with strength and shows that her arms are strong.
PRO 31:17.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 31 · The Wife of Noble Character (Proverbs 31)] She girds herself with strength and shows that her arms are strong.

PRO 31:18.text: She sees that her gain is good, and her lamp is not extinguished at night.
PRO 31:18.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 31 · The Wife of Noble Character (Proverbs 31)] She sees that her gain is good, and her lamp is not extinguished at night.

PRO 31:19.text: She stretches out her hands to the distaff and grasps the spindle with her fingers.
PRO 31:19.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 31 · The Wife of Noble Character (Proverbs 31)] She stretches out her hands to the distaff and grasps the spindle with her fingers.

PRO 31:20.text: She opens her arms to the poor and reaches out her hands to the needy.
PRO 31:20.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 31 · The Wife of Noble Character (Proverbs 31)] She opens her arms to the poor and reaches out her hands to the needy.

PRO 31:21.text: When it snows, she has no fear for her household, for they are all clothed in scarlet.
PRO 31:21.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 31 · The Wife of Noble Character (Proverbs 31)] When it snows, she has no fear for her household, for they are all clothed in scarlet.

PRO 31:22.text: She makes coverings for her bed; her clothing is fine linen and purple.
PRO 31:22.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 31 · The Wife of Noble Character (Proverbs 31)] She makes coverings for her bed; her clothing is fine linen and purple.

PRO 31:23.text: Her husband is known at the city gate, where he sits among the elders of the land.
PRO 31:23.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 31 · The Wife of Noble Character (Proverbs 31)] Her husband is known at the city gate, where he sits among the elders of the land.

PRO 31:24.text: She makes linen garments and sells them; she delivers sashes to the merchants.
PRO 31:24.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 31 · The Wife of Noble Character (Proverbs 31)] She makes linen garments and sells them; she delivers sashes to the merchants.

PRO 31:25.text: Strength and honor are her clothing, and she can laugh at the days to come.
PRO 31:25.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 31 · The Wife of Noble Character (Proverbs 31)] Strength and honor are her clothing, and she can laugh at the days to come.

PRO 31:26.text: She opens her mouth with wisdom, and faithful instruction is on her tongue.
PRO 31:26.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 31 · The Wife of Noble Character (Proverbs 31)] She opens her mouth with wisdom, and faithful instruction is on her tongue.

PRO 31:27.text: She watches over the affairs of her household and does not eat the bread of idleness.
PRO 31:27.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 31 · The Wife of Noble Character (Proverbs 31)] She watches over the affairs of her household and does not eat the bread of idleness.

PRO 31:28.text: Her children rise up and call her blessed; her husband praises her as well:
PRO 31:28.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 31 · The Wife of Noble Character (Proverbs 31)] Her children rise up and call her blessed; her husband praises her as well:

PRO 31:29.text: “Many daughters have done noble things, but you surpass them all!”
PRO 31:29.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 31 · The Wife of Noble Character (Proverbs 31)] “Many daughters have done noble things, but you surpass them all!”

PRO 31:30.text: Charm is deceptive and beauty is fleeting, but a woman who fears the LORD is to be praised.
PRO 31:30.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 31 · The Wife of Noble Character (Proverbs 31)] Charm is deceptive and beauty is fleeting, but a woman who fears the LORD is to be praised.

PRO 31:31.text: Give her the fruit of her hands, and let her works praise her at the gates.
PRO 31:31.bm25Text: [Proverbs · Chapter 31 · The Wife of Noble Character (Proverbs 31)] Give her the fruit of her hands, and let her works praise her at the gates.

PSA 1:1.text: Blessed is the man who does not walk in the counsel of the wicked, or set foot on the path of sinners, or sit in the seat of mockers.
PSA 1:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 1] Blessed is the man who does not walk in the counsel of the wicked, or set foot on the path of sinners, or sit in the seat of mockers.

PSA 1:2.text: But his delight is in the Law of the LORD, and on His law he meditates day and night.
PSA 1:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 1] But his delight is in the Law of the LORD, and on His law he meditates day and night.

PSA 1:3.text: He is like a tree planted by streams of water, yielding its fruit in season, whose leaf does not wither, and who prospers in all he does.
PSA 1:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 1 · Fruit of the Spirit] He is like a tree planted by streams of water, yielding its fruit in season, whose leaf does not wither, and who prospers in all he does.

PSA 1:4.text: Not so the wicked! For they are like chaff driven off by the wind.
PSA 1:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 1] Not so the wicked! For they are like chaff driven off by the wind.

PSA 1:5.text: Therefore the wicked will not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the assembly of the righteous.
PSA 1:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 1 · Church, Judgment] Therefore the wicked will not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the assembly of the righteous.

PSA 1:6.text: For the LORD guards the path of the righteous, but the way of the wicked will perish.
PSA 1:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 1] For the LORD guards the path of the righteous, but the way of the wicked will perish.

PSA 2:1.text: Why do the nations rage and the peoples plot in vain?
PSA 2:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 2] Why do the nations rage and the peoples plot in vain?

PSA 2:2.text: The kings of the earth take their stand and the rulers gather together, against the LORD and against His Anointed One:
PSA 2:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 2] The kings of the earth take their stand and the rulers gather together, against the LORD and against His Anointed One:

PSA 2:3.text: “Let us break Their chains and cast away Their cords.”
PSA 2:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 2] “Let us break Their chains and cast away Their cords.”

PSA 2:4.text: The One enthroned in heaven laughs; the Lord taunts them.
PSA 2:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 2 · Heaven] The One enthroned in heaven laughs; the Lord taunts them.

PSA 2:5.text: Then He rebukes them in His anger, and terrifies them in His fury:
PSA 2:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 2] Then He rebukes them in His anger, and terrifies them in His fury:

PSA 2:6.text: “I have installed My King on Zion, upon My holy mountain.”
PSA 2:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 2] “I have installed My King on Zion, upon My holy mountain.”

PSA 2:7.text: I will proclaim the decree spoken to Me by the LORD: “You are My Son; today I have become Your Father.
PSA 2:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 2 · God the Father] I will proclaim the decree spoken to Me by the LORD: “You are My Son; today I have become Your Father.

PSA 2:8.text: Ask Me, and I will make the nations Your inheritance, the ends of the earth Your possession.
PSA 2:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 2 · Inheritance] Ask Me, and I will make the nations Your inheritance, the ends of the earth Your possession.

PSA 2:9.text: You will break them with an iron scepter; You will shatter them like pottery.”
PSA 2:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 2] You will break them with an iron scepter; You will shatter them like pottery.”

PSA 2:10.text: Therefore be wise, O kings; be admonished, O judges of the earth.
PSA 2:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 2] Therefore be wise, O kings; be admonished, O judges of the earth.

PSA 2:11.text: Serve the LORD with fear, and rejoice with trembling.
PSA 2:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 2] Serve the LORD with fear, and rejoice with trembling.

PSA 2:12.text: Kiss the Son, lest He be angry and you perish in your rebellion, when His wrath ignites in an instant.   Blessed are all who take refuge in Him.
PSA 2:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 2 · Beatitudes] Kiss the Son, lest He be angry and you perish in your rebellion, when His wrath ignites in an instant.   Blessed are all who take refuge in Him.

PSA 3:1.text: O LORD, how my foes have increased! How many rise up against me!
PSA 3:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 3] O LORD, how my foes have increased! How many rise up against me!

PSA 3:2.text: Many say of me, “God will not deliver him.” Selah
PSA 3:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 3] Many say of me, “God will not deliver him.” Selah

PSA 3:3.text: But You, O LORD, are a shield around me, my glory, and the One who lifts my head.
PSA 3:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 3 · Glory] But You, O LORD, are a shield around me, my glory, and the One who lifts my head.

PSA 3:4.text: To the LORD I cry aloud, and He answers me from His holy mountain. Selah
PSA 3:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 3] To the LORD I cry aloud, and He answers me from His holy mountain. Selah

PSA 3:5.text: I lie down and sleep; I wake again, for the LORD sustains me.
PSA 3:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 3] I lie down and sleep; I wake again, for the LORD sustains me.

PSA 3:6.text: I will not fear the myriads set against me on every side.
PSA 3:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 3] I will not fear the myriads set against me on every side.

PSA 3:7.text: Arise, O LORD! Save me, O my God! Strike all my enemies on the jaw; break the teeth of the wicked.
PSA 3:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 3] Arise, O LORD! Save me, O my God! Strike all my enemies on the jaw; break the teeth of the wicked.

PSA 3:8.text: Salvation belongs to the LORD; may Your blessing be on Your people. Selah
PSA 3:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 3 · Blessing] Salvation belongs to the LORD; may Your blessing be on Your people. Selah

PSA 4:1.text: Answer me when I call, O God of my righteousness! You have relieved my distress; show me grace and hear my prayer.
PSA 4:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 4 · Grace] Answer me when I call, O God of my righteousness! You have relieved my distress; show me grace and hear my prayer.

PSA 4:2.text: How long, O men, will my honor be maligned? How long will you love vanity and seek after lies? Selah
PSA 4:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 4 · Love] How long, O men, will my honor be maligned? How long will you love vanity and seek after lies? Selah

PSA 4:3.text: Know that the LORD has set apart the godly for Himself; the LORD hears when I call to Him.
PSA 4:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 4 · Holiness] Know that the LORD has set apart the godly for Himself; the LORD hears when I call to Him.

PSA 4:4.text: Be angry, yet do not sin; on your bed, search your heart and be still. Selah
PSA 4:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 4 · Adultery In Heart] Be angry, yet do not sin; on your bed, search your heart and be still. Selah

PSA 4:5.text: Offer the sacrifices of the righteous and trust in the LORD.
PSA 4:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 4 · Faith] Offer the sacrifices of the righteous and trust in the LORD.

PSA 4:6.text: Many ask, “Who can show us the good?” Shine the light of Your face upon us, O LORD.
PSA 4:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 4 · Light] Many ask, “Who can show us the good?” Shine the light of Your face upon us, O LORD.

PSA 4:7.text: You have filled my heart with more joy than when grain and new wine abound.
PSA 4:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 4 · Adultery In Heart] You have filled my heart with more joy than when grain and new wine abound.

PSA 4:8.text: I will lie down and sleep in peace, for You alone, O LORD, make me dwell in safety.
PSA 4:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 4] I will lie down and sleep in peace, for You alone, O LORD, make me dwell in safety.

PSA 5:1.text: Give ear to my words, O LORD; consider my groaning.
PSA 5:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 5] Give ear to my words, O LORD; consider my groaning.

PSA 5:2.text: Attend to the sound of my cry, my King and my God, for to You I pray.
PSA 5:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 5] Attend to the sound of my cry, my King and my God, for to You I pray.

PSA 5:3.text: In the morning, O LORD, You hear my voice; at daybreak I lay my plea before You and wait in expectation.
PSA 5:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 5 · Hope] In the morning, O LORD, You hear my voice; at daybreak I lay my plea before You and wait in expectation.

PSA 5:4.text: For You are not a God who delights in wickedness; no evil can dwell with You.
PSA 5:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 5] For You are not a God who delights in wickedness; no evil can dwell with You.

PSA 5:5.text: The boastful cannot stand in Your presence; You hate all workers of iniquity.
PSA 5:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 5] The boastful cannot stand in Your presence; You hate all workers of iniquity.

PSA 5:6.text: You destroy those who tell lies; the LORD abhors the man of bloodshed and deceit.
PSA 5:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 5 · Deceit, Destroy Canaan] You destroy those who tell lies; the LORD abhors the man of bloodshed and deceit.

PSA 5:7.text: But I will enter Your house by the abundance of Your loving devotion; in reverence I will bow down toward Your holy temple.
PSA 5:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 5 · Devotion] But I will enter Your house by the abundance of Your loving devotion; in reverence I will bow down toward Your holy temple.

PSA 5:8.text: Lead me, O LORD, in Your righteousness because of my enemies; make straight Your way before me.
PSA 5:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 5] Lead me, O LORD, in Your righteousness because of my enemies; make straight Your way before me.

PSA 5:9.text: For not a word they speak can be trusted; destruction lies within them. Their throats are open graves; their tongues practice deceit.
PSA 5:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 5 · Faith, Deceit] For not a word they speak can be trusted; destruction lies within them. Their throats are open graves; their tongues practice deceit.

PSA 5:10.text: Declare them guilty, O God; let them fall by their own devices. Drive them out for their many transgressions, for they have rebelled against You.
PSA 5:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 5] Declare them guilty, O God; let them fall by their own devices. Drive them out for their many transgressions, for they have rebelled against You.

PSA 5:11.text: But let all who take refuge in You rejoice; let them ever shout for joy. May You shelter them, that those who love Your name may rejoice in You.
PSA 5:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 5 · Love] But let all who take refuge in You rejoice; let them ever shout for joy. May You shelter them, that those who love Your name may rejoice in You.

PSA 5:12.text: For surely You, O LORD, bless the righteous; You surround them with the shield of Your favor.
PSA 5:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 5 · Blessing] For surely You, O LORD, bless the righteous; You surround them with the shield of Your favor.

PSA 6:1.text: O LORD, do not rebuke me in Your anger or discipline me in Your wrath.
PSA 6:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 6] O LORD, do not rebuke me in Your anger or discipline me in Your wrath.

PSA 6:2.text: Be merciful to me, O LORD, for I am frail; heal me, O LORD, for my bones are in agony.
PSA 6:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 6] Be merciful to me, O LORD, for I am frail; heal me, O LORD, for my bones are in agony.

PSA 6:3.text: My soul is deeply distressed. How long, O LORD, how long?
PSA 6:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 6] My soul is deeply distressed. How long, O LORD, how long?

PSA 6:4.text: Turn, O LORD, and deliver my soul; save me because of Your loving devotion.
PSA 6:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 6 · Devotion] Turn, O LORD, and deliver my soul; save me because of Your loving devotion.

PSA 6:5.text: For there is no mention of You in death; who can praise You from Sheol?
PSA 6:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 6 · Death] For there is no mention of You in death; who can praise You from Sheol?

PSA 6:6.text: I am weary from groaning; all night I flood my bed with weeping and drench my couch with tears.
PSA 6:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 6] I am weary from groaning; all night I flood my bed with weeping and drench my couch with tears.

PSA 6:7.text: My eyes fail from grief; they grow dim because of all my foes.
PSA 6:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 6] My eyes fail from grief; they grow dim because of all my foes.

PSA 6:8.text: Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity, for the LORD has heard my weeping.
PSA 6:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 6] Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity, for the LORD has heard my weeping.

PSA 6:9.text: The LORD has heard my cry for mercy; the LORD accepts my prayer.
PSA 6:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 6 · Forgiveness, Compassion] The LORD has heard my cry for mercy; the LORD accepts my prayer.

PSA 6:10.text: All my enemies will be ashamed and dismayed; they will turn back in sudden disgrace.
PSA 6:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 6] All my enemies will be ashamed and dismayed; they will turn back in sudden disgrace.

PSA 7:1.text: O LORD my God, I take refuge in You; save me and deliver me from all my pursuers,
PSA 7:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 7] O LORD my God, I take refuge in You; save me and deliver me from all my pursuers,

PSA 7:2.text: or they will shred my soul like a lion and tear me to pieces with no one to rescue me.
PSA 7:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 7] or they will shred my soul like a lion and tear me to pieces with no one to rescue me.

PSA 7:3.text: O LORD my God, if I have done this, if injustice is on my hands,
PSA 7:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 7] O LORD my God, if I have done this, if injustice is on my hands,

PSA 7:4.text: if I have rewarded my ally with evil, if I have plundered my foe without cause,
PSA 7:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 7] if I have rewarded my ally with evil, if I have plundered my foe without cause,

PSA 7:5.text: then may my enemy pursue me and overtake me; may he trample me to the ground and leave my honor in the dust. Selah
PSA 7:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 7] then may my enemy pursue me and overtake me; may he trample me to the ground and leave my honor in the dust. Selah

PSA 7:6.text: Arise, O LORD, in Your anger; rise up against the fury of my enemies. Awake, my God, and ordain judgment.
PSA 7:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 7 · Judgment] Arise, O LORD, in Your anger; rise up against the fury of my enemies. Awake, my God, and ordain judgment.

PSA 7:7.text: Let the assembled peoples gather around You; take Your seat over them on high.
PSA 7:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 7] Let the assembled peoples gather around You; take Your seat over them on high.

PSA 7:8.text: The LORD judges the peoples; vindicate me, O LORD, according to my righteousness and integrity.
PSA 7:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 7] The LORD judges the peoples; vindicate me, O LORD, according to my righteousness and integrity.

PSA 7:9.text: Put an end to the evil of the wicked, but establish the righteous, O righteous God who searches hearts and minds.
PSA 7:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 7] Put an end to the evil of the wicked, but establish the righteous, O righteous God who searches hearts and minds.

PSA 7:10.text: My shield is with God, who saves the upright in heart.
PSA 7:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 7 · Adultery In Heart] My shield is with God, who saves the upright in heart.

PSA 7:11.text: God is a righteous judge and a God who feels indignation each day.
PSA 7:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 7] God is a righteous judge and a God who feels indignation each day.

PSA 7:12.text: If one does not repent, God will sharpen His sword; He has bent and strung His bow.
PSA 7:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 7] If one does not repent, God will sharpen His sword; He has bent and strung His bow.

PSA 7:13.text: He has prepared His deadly weapons; He ordains His arrows with fire.
PSA 7:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 7] He has prepared His deadly weapons; He ordains His arrows with fire.

PSA 7:14.text: Behold, the wicked man travails with evil; he conceives trouble and births falsehood.
PSA 7:14.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 7 · Falsehood] Behold, the wicked man travails with evil; he conceives trouble and births falsehood.

PSA 7:15.text: He has dug a hole and hollowed it out; he has fallen into a pit of his own making.
PSA 7:15.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 7] He has dug a hole and hollowed it out; he has fallen into a pit of his own making.

PSA 7:16.text: His trouble recoils on himself, and his violence falls on his own head.
PSA 7:16.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 7] His trouble recoils on himself, and his violence falls on his own head.

PSA 7:17.text: I will thank the LORD for His righteousness and sing praise to the name of the LORD Most High.
PSA 7:17.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 7] I will thank the LORD for His righteousness and sing praise to the name of the LORD Most High.

PSA 8:1.text: O LORD, our Lord, how majestic is Your name in all the earth!   You have set Your glory above the heavens.
PSA 8:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 8 · Glory] O LORD, our Lord, how majestic is Your name in all the earth!   You have set Your glory above the heavens.

PSA 8:2.text: From the mouths of children and infants You have ordained praise on account of Your adversaries, to silence the enemy and avenger.
PSA 8:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 8 · Children] From the mouths of children and infants You have ordained praise on account of Your adversaries, to silence the enemy and avenger.

PSA 8:3.text: When I behold Your heavens, the work of Your fingers, the moon and the stars, which You have set in place—
PSA 8:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 8] When I behold Your heavens, the work of Your fingers, the moon and the stars, which You have set in place—

PSA 8:4.text: what is man that You are mindful of him, or the son of man that You care for him?
PSA 8:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 8] what is man that You are mindful of him, or the son of man that You care for him?

PSA 8:5.text: You made him a little lower than the angels; You crowned him with glory and honor.
PSA 8:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 8 · Angels, Glory] You made him a little lower than the angels; You crowned him with glory and honor.

PSA 8:6.text: You made him ruler of the works of Your hands; You have placed everything under his feet:
PSA 8:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 8] You made him ruler of the works of Your hands; You have placed everything under his feet:

PSA 8:7.text: all sheep and oxen, and even the beasts of the field,
PSA 8:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 8] all sheep and oxen, and even the beasts of the field,

PSA 8:8.text: the birds of the air and the fish of the sea, all that swim the paths of the seas.
PSA 8:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 8] the birds of the air and the fish of the sea, all that swim the paths of the seas.

PSA 8:9.text: O LORD, our Lord, how majestic is Your name in all the earth!
PSA 8:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 8] O LORD, our Lord, how majestic is Your name in all the earth!

PSA 9:1.text: I will give thanks to the LORD with all my heart; I will recount all Your wonders.
PSA 9:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 9 · Adultery In Heart] I will give thanks to the LORD with all my heart; I will recount all Your wonders.

PSA 9:2.text: I will be glad and rejoice in You; I will sing praise to Your name, O Most High.
PSA 9:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 9] I will be glad and rejoice in You; I will sing praise to Your name, O Most High.

PSA 9:3.text: When my enemies retreat, they stumble and perish before You.
PSA 9:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 9] When my enemies retreat, they stumble and perish before You.

PSA 9:4.text: For You have upheld my just cause; You sit on Your throne judging righteously.
PSA 9:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 9] For You have upheld my just cause; You sit on Your throne judging righteously.

PSA 9:5.text: You have rebuked the nations; You have destroyed the wicked; You have erased their name forever and ever.
PSA 9:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 9] You have rebuked the nations; You have destroyed the wicked; You have erased their name forever and ever.

PSA 18:17.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 18] He rescued me from my powerful enemy, from foes too mighty for me.

PSA 18:18.text: They confronted me in my day of calamity, but the LORD was my support.
PSA 18:18.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 18] They confronted me in my day of calamity, but the LORD was my support.

PSA 18:19.text: He brought me out into the open; He rescued me because He delighted in me.
PSA 18:19.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 18] He brought me out into the open; He rescued me because He delighted in me.

PSA 18:20.text: The LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness; He has repaid me according to the cleanness of my hands.
PSA 18:20.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 18] The LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness; He has repaid me according to the cleanness of my hands.

PSA 18:21.text: For I have kept the ways of the LORD and have not wickedly departed from my God.
PSA 18:21.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 18] For I have kept the ways of the LORD and have not wickedly departed from my God.

PSA 18:22.text: For all His ordinances are before me; I have not disregarded His statutes.
PSA 18:22.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 18] For all His ordinances are before me; I have not disregarded His statutes.

PSA 18:23.text: And I have been blameless before Him and kept myself from iniquity.
PSA 18:23.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 18] And I have been blameless before Him and kept myself from iniquity.

PSA 18:24.text: So the LORD has repaid me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in His sight.
PSA 18:24.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 18] So the LORD has repaid me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in His sight.

PSA 18:25.text: To the faithful You show Yourself faithful, to the blameless You show Yourself blameless;
PSA 18:25.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 18 · Faith] To the faithful You show Yourself faithful, to the blameless You show Yourself blameless;

PSA 18:26.text: to the pure You show Yourself pure, but to the crooked You show Yourself shrewd.
PSA 18:26.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 18] to the pure You show Yourself pure, but to the crooked You show Yourself shrewd.

PSA 18:27.text: For You save an afflicted people, but You humble those with haughty eyes.
PSA 18:27.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 18] For You save an afflicted people, but You humble those with haughty eyes.

PSA 18:28.text: For You, O LORD, light my lamp; my God lights up my darkness.
PSA 18:28.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 18 · Light] For You, O LORD, light my lamp; my God lights up my darkness.

PSA 18:29.text: For in You I can charge an army, and with my God I can scale a wall.
PSA 18:29.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 18] For in You I can charge an army, and with my God I can scale a wall.

PSA 18:30.text: As for God, His way is perfect; the word of the LORD is flawless. He is a shield to all who take refuge in Him.
PSA 18:30.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 18] As for God, His way is perfect; the word of the LORD is flawless. He is a shield to all who take refuge in Him.

PSA 18:31.text: For who is God besides the LORD? And who is the Rock except our God?
PSA 18:31.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 18] For who is God besides the LORD? And who is the Rock except our God?

PSA 18:32.text: It is God who arms me with strength and makes my way clear.
PSA 18:32.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 18] It is God who arms me with strength and makes my way clear.

PSA 18:33.text: He makes my feet like those of a deer and stations me upon the heights.
PSA 18:33.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 18] He makes my feet like those of a deer and stations me upon the heights.

PSA 18:34.text: He trains my hands for battle; my arms can bend a bow of bronze.
PSA 18:34.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 18] He trains my hands for battle; my arms can bend a bow of bronze.

PSA 18:35.text: You have given me Your shield of salvation; Your right hand upholds me, and Your gentleness exalts me.
PSA 18:35.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 18 · Gentleness] You have given me Your shield of salvation; Your right hand upholds me, and Your gentleness exalts me.

PSA 18:36.text: You broaden the path beneath me so that my ankles do not give way.
PSA 18:36.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 18] You broaden the path beneath me so that my ankles do not give way.

PSA 18:37.text: I pursued my enemies and overtook them; I did not turn back until they were consumed.
PSA 18:37.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 18] I pursued my enemies and overtook them; I did not turn back until they were consumed.

PSA 18:38.text: I crushed them so they could not rise; they have fallen under my feet.
PSA 18:38.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 18] I crushed them so they could not rise; they have fallen under my feet.

PSA 18:39.text: You have armed me with strength for battle; You have subdued my foes beneath me.
PSA 18:39.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 18] You have armed me with strength for battle; You have subdued my foes beneath me.

PSA 18:40.text: You have made my enemies retreat before me; I put an end to those who hated me.
PSA 18:40.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 18] You have made my enemies retreat before me; I put an end to those who hated me.

PSA 18:41.text: They cried for help, but there was no one to save them— to the LORD, but He did not answer.
PSA 18:41.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 18] They cried for help, but there was no one to save them— to the LORD, but He did not answer.

PSA 18:42.text: I ground them as dust in the face of the wind; I trampled them like mud in the streets.
PSA 18:42.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 18] I ground them as dust in the face of the wind; I trampled them like mud in the streets.

PSA 18:43.text: You have delivered me from the strife of the people; You have made me the head of nations; a people I had not known shall serve me.
PSA 18:43.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 18] You have delivered me from the strife of the people; You have made me the head of nations; a people I had not known shall serve me.

PSA 18:44.text: When they hear me, they obey me; foreigners cower before me.
PSA 18:44.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 18] When they hear me, they obey me; foreigners cower before me.

PSA 18:45.text: Foreigners lose heart and come trembling from their strongholds.
PSA 18:45.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 18 · Adultery In Heart] Foreigners lose heart and come trembling from their strongholds.

PSA 18:46.text: The LORD lives, and blessed be my Rock! And may the God of my salvation be exalted—
PSA 18:46.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 18 · Ascension] The LORD lives, and blessed be my Rock! And may the God of my salvation be exalted—

PSA 18:47.text: the God who avenges me and subdues nations beneath me,
PSA 18:47.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 18] the God who avenges me and subdues nations beneath me,

PSA 18:48.text: who delivers me from my enemies. You exalt me above my foes; You rescue me from violent men.
PSA 18:48.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 18] who delivers me from my enemies. You exalt me above my foes; You rescue me from violent men.

PSA 18:49.text: Therefore I will praise You, O LORD, among the nations; I will sing praises to Your name.
PSA 18:49.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 18] Therefore I will praise You, O LORD, among the nations; I will sing praises to Your name.

PSA 18:50.text: Great salvation He brings to His king. He shows loving devotion to His anointed, to David and his descendants forever.
PSA 18:50.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 18 · Devotion] Great salvation He brings to His king. He shows loving devotion to His anointed, to David and his descendants forever.

PSA 19:1.text: The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of His hands.
PSA 19:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 19 · Glory] The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of His hands.

PSA 19:2.text: Day after day they pour forth speech; night after night they reveal knowledge.
PSA 19:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 19] Day after day they pour forth speech; night after night they reveal knowledge.

PSA 19:3.text: Without speech or language, without a sound to be heard,
PSA 19:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 19] Without speech or language, without a sound to be heard,

PSA 19:4.text: their voice has gone out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world.   In the heavens He has pitched a tent for the sun.
PSA 19:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 19] their voice has gone out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world.   In the heavens He has pitched a tent for the sun.

PSA 19:5.text: Like a bridegroom emerging from his chamber, like a champion rejoicing to run his course,
PSA 19:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 19 · Joy] Like a bridegroom emerging from his chamber, like a champion rejoicing to run his course,

PSA 19:6.text: it rises at one end of the heavens and runs its circuit to the other; nothing is deprived of its warmth.
PSA 19:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 19] it rises at one end of the heavens and runs its circuit to the other; nothing is deprived of its warmth.

PSA 19:7.text: The Law of the LORD is perfect, reviving the soul; the testimony of the LORD is trustworthy, making wise the simple.
PSA 19:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 19 · Faith] The Law of the LORD is perfect, reviving the soul; the testimony of the LORD is trustworthy, making wise the simple.

PSA 19:8.text: The precepts of the LORD are right, bringing joy to the heart; the commandments of the LORD are radiant, giving light to the eyes.
PSA 19:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 19 · Adultery In Heart, Generosity] The precepts of the LORD are right, bringing joy to the heart; the commandments of the LORD are radiant, giving light to the eyes.

PSA 19:9.text: The fear of the LORD is pure, enduring forever; the judgments of the LORD are true, being altogether righteous.
PSA 19:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 19] The fear of the LORD is pure, enduring forever; the judgments of the LORD are true, being altogether righteous.

PSA 19:10.text: They are more precious than gold, than much pure gold; they are sweeter than honey, than honey from the comb.
PSA 19:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 19] They are more precious than gold, than much pure gold; they are sweeter than honey, than honey from the comb.

PSA 19:11.text: By them indeed Your servant is warned; in keeping them is great reward.
PSA 19:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 19] By them indeed Your servant is warned; in keeping them is great reward.

PSA 19:12.text: Who can discern his own errors? Cleanse me from my hidden faults.
PSA 19:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 19] Who can discern his own errors? Cleanse me from my hidden faults.

PSA 19:13.text: Keep Your servant also from willful sins; may they not rule over me. Then I will be blameless and cleansed of great transgression.
PSA 19:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 19] Keep Your servant also from willful sins; may they not rule over me. Then I will be blameless and cleansed of great transgression.

PSA 19:14.text: May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be pleasing in Your sight, O LORD, my Rock and my Redeemer.
PSA 19:14.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 19 · Adultery In Heart] May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be pleasing in Your sight, O LORD, my Rock and my Redeemer.

PSA 20:1.text: May the LORD answer you in the day of trouble; may the name of the God of Jacob protect you.
PSA 20:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 20 · Israel] May the LORD answer you in the day of trouble; may the name of the God of Jacob protect you.

PSA 20:2.text: May He send you help from the sanctuary and sustain you from Zion.
PSA 20:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 20] May He send you help from the sanctuary and sustain you from Zion.

PSA 20:3.text: May He remember all your gifts and look favorably on your burnt offerings. Selah
PSA 20:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 20] May He remember all your gifts and look favorably on your burnt offerings. Selah

PSA 20:4.text: May He give you the desires of your heart and make all your plans succeed.
PSA 20:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 20 · Adultery In Heart] May He give you the desires of your heart and make all your plans succeed.

PSA 20:5.text: May we shout for joy at your victory and raise a banner in the name of our God. May the LORD grant all your petitions.
PSA 20:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 20] May we shout for joy at your victory and raise a banner in the name of our God. May the LORD grant all your petitions.

PSA 20:6.text: Now I know that the LORD saves His anointed; He answers him from His holy heaven with the saving power of His right hand.
PSA 20:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 20 · Heaven] Now I know that the LORD saves His anointed; He answers him from His holy heaven with the saving power of His right hand.

PSA 20:7.text: Some trust in chariots and others in horses, but we trust in the name of the LORD our God.
PSA 20:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 20 · Faith] Some trust in chariots and others in horses, but we trust in the name of the LORD our God.

PSA 20:8.text: They collapse and fall, but we rise up and stand firm.
PSA 20:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 20] They collapse and fall, but we rise up and stand firm.

PSA 20:9.text: O LORD, save the king. Answer us on the day we call.
PSA 20:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 20] O LORD, save the king. Answer us on the day we call.

PSA 21:1.text: O LORD, the king rejoices in Your strength. How greatly he exults in Your salvation!
PSA 21:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 21] O LORD, the king rejoices in Your strength. How greatly he exults in Your salvation!

PSA 21:2.text: You have granted his heart’s desire and have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah
PSA 21:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 21 · Adultery In Heart, Lust] You have granted his heart’s desire and have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah

PSA 21:3.text: For You welcomed him with rich blessings; You placed on his head a crown of pure gold.
PSA 21:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 21] For You welcomed him with rich blessings; You placed on his head a crown of pure gold.

PSA 21:4.text: He asked You for life, and You granted it— length of days, forever and ever.
PSA 21:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 21] He asked You for life, and You granted it— length of days, forever and ever.

PSA 21:5.text: Great is his glory in Your salvation; You bestow on him splendor and majesty.
PSA 21:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 21 · Glory] Great is his glory in Your salvation; You bestow on him splendor and majesty.

PSA 21:6.text: For You grant him blessings forever; You cheer him with joy in Your presence.
PSA 21:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 21] For You grant him blessings forever; You cheer him with joy in Your presence.

PSA 21:7.text: For the king trusts in the LORD; through the loving devotion of the Most High, he will not be shaken.
PSA 21:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 21 · Faith, Devotion] For the king trusts in the LORD; through the loving devotion of the Most High, he will not be shaken.

PSA 21:8.text: Your hand will apprehend all Your enemies; Your right hand will seize those who hate You.
PSA 21:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 21] Your hand will apprehend all Your enemies; Your right hand will seize those who hate You.

PSA 21:9.text: You will place them in a fiery furnace at the time of Your appearing.   In His wrath the LORD will engulf them, and the fire will consume them.
PSA 21:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 21] You will place them in a fiery furnace at the time of Your appearing.   In His wrath the LORD will engulf them, and the fire will consume them.

PSA 21:10.text: You will wipe their descendants from the earth, and their offspring from the sons of men.
PSA 21:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 21 · Children] You will wipe their descendants from the earth, and their offspring from the sons of men.

PSA 21:11.text: Though they intend You harm, the schemes they devise will not prevail.
PSA 21:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 21] Though they intend You harm, the schemes they devise will not prevail.

PSA 21:12.text: For You will put them to flight when Your bow is trained upon them.
PSA 21:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 21] For You will put them to flight when Your bow is trained upon them.

PSA 21:13.text: Be exalted, O LORD, in Your strength; we will sing and praise Your power.
PSA 21:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 21 · Ascension] Be exalted, O LORD, in Your strength; we will sing and praise Your power.

PSA 22:1.text: My God, my God, why have You forsaken me? Why are You so far from saving me, so far from my words of groaning?
PSA 22:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 22] My God, my God, why have You forsaken me? Why are You so far from saving me, so far from my words of groaning?

PSA 22:2.text: I cry out by day, O my God, but You do not answer, and by night, but I have no rest.
PSA 22:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 22] I cry out by day, O my God, but You do not answer, and by night, but I have no rest.

PSA 22:3.text: Yet You are holy, enthroned on the praises of Israel.
PSA 22:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 22 · Israel] Yet You are holy, enthroned on the praises of Israel.

PSA 22:4.text: In You our fathers trusted; they trusted and You delivered them.
PSA 22:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 22 · Faith] In You our fathers trusted; they trusted and You delivered them.

PSA 22:5.text: They cried out to You and were set free; they trusted in You and were not disappointed.
PSA 22:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 22 · Faith] They cried out to You and were set free; they trusted in You and were not disappointed.

PSA 22:6.text: But I am a worm and not a man, scorned by men and despised by the people.
PSA 22:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 22] But I am a worm and not a man, scorned by men and despised by the people.

PSA 22:7.text: All who see me mock me; they sneer and shake their heads:
PSA 22:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 22] All who see me mock me; they sneer and shake their heads:

PSA 22:8.text: “He trusts in the LORD, let the LORD deliver him; let the LORD rescue him, since He delights in him.”
PSA 22:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 22 · Faith] “He trusts in the LORD, let the LORD deliver him; let the LORD rescue him, since He delights in him.”

PSA 22:9.text: Yet You brought me forth from the womb; You made me secure at my mother’s breast.
PSA 22:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 22] Yet You brought me forth from the womb; You made me secure at my mother’s breast.

PSA 22:10.text: From birth I was cast upon You; from my mother’s womb You have been my God.
PSA 22:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 22] From birth I was cast upon You; from my mother’s womb You have been my God.

PSA 22:11.text: Be not far from me, for trouble is near and there is no one to help.
PSA 22:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 22] Be not far from me, for trouble is near and there is no one to help.

PSA 22:12.text: Many bulls surround me; strong bulls of Bashan encircle me.
PSA 22:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 22] Many bulls surround me; strong bulls of Bashan encircle me.

PSA 22:13.text: They open their jaws against me like lions that roar and maul.
PSA 22:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 22] They open their jaws against me like lions that roar and maul.

PSA 22:14.text: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are disjointed. My heart is like wax; it melts away within me.
PSA 22:14.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 22 · Adultery In Heart] I am poured out like water, and all my bones are disjointed. My heart is like wax; it melts away within me.

PSA 22:15.text: My strength is dried up like a potsherd, and my tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You lay me in the dust of death.
PSA 22:15.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 22 · Death] My strength is dried up like a potsherd, and my tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You lay me in the dust of death.

PSA 22:16.text: For dogs surround me; a band of evil men encircles me; they have pierced my hands and feet.
PSA 22:16.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 22] For dogs surround me; a band of evil men encircles me; they have pierced my hands and feet.

PSA 22:17.text: I can count all my bones; they stare and gloat over me.
PSA 22:17.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 22] I can count all my bones; they stare and gloat over me.

PSA 22:18.text: They divide my garments among them and cast lots for my clothing.
PSA 22:18.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 22] They divide my garments among them and cast lots for my clothing.

PSA 22:19.text: But You, O LORD, be not far off; O my Strength, come quickly to help me.
PSA 22:19.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 22] But You, O LORD, be not far off; O my Strength, come quickly to help me.

PSA 22:20.text: Deliver my soul from the sword, my precious life from the power of wild dogs.
PSA 22:20.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 22] Deliver my soul from the sword, my precious life from the power of wild dogs.

PSA 22:21.text: Save me from the mouth of the lion; at the horns of the wild oxen You have answered me!
PSA 22:21.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 22] Save me from the mouth of the lion; at the horns of the wild oxen You have answered me!

PSA 22:22.text: I will proclaim Your name to my brothers; I will praise You in the assembly.
PSA 22:22.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 22 · Church] I will proclaim Your name to my brothers; I will praise You in the assembly.

PSA 22:23.text: You who fear the LORD, praise Him! All descendants of Jacob, honor Him! All offspring of Israel, revere Him!
PSA 22:23.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 22 · Children, Israel] You who fear the LORD, praise Him! All descendants of Jacob, honor Him! All offspring of Israel, revere Him!

PSA 22:24.text: For He has not despised or detested the torment of the afflicted. He has not hidden His face from him, but has attended to his cry for help.
PSA 22:24.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 22] For He has not despised or detested the torment of the afflicted. He has not hidden His face from him, but has attended to his cry for help.

PSA 22:25.text: My praise for You resounds in the great assembly; I will fulfill my vows before those who fear You.
PSA 22:25.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 22 · Church] My praise for You resounds in the great assembly; I will fulfill my vows before those who fear You.

PSA 22:26.text: The poor will eat and be satisfied; those who seek the LORD will praise Him. May your hearts live forever!
PSA 22:26.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 22] The poor will eat and be satisfied; those who seek the LORD will praise Him. May your hearts live forever!

PSA 22:27.text: All the ends of the earth will remember and turn to the LORD. All the families of the nations will bow down before Him.
PSA 22:27.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 22] All the ends of the earth will remember and turn to the LORD. All the families of the nations will bow down before Him.

PSA 22:28.text: For dominion belongs to the LORD and He rules over the nations.
PSA 22:28.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 22] For dominion belongs to the LORD and He rules over the nations.

PSA 22:29.text: All the rich of the earth will feast and worship; all who go down to the dust will kneel before Him— even those unable to preserve their lives.
PSA 22:29.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 22] All the rich of the earth will feast and worship; all who go down to the dust will kneel before Him— even those unable to preserve their lives.

PSA 22:30.text: Posterity will serve Him; they will declare the Lord to a new generation.
PSA 22:30.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 22] Posterity will serve Him; they will declare the Lord to a new generation.

PSA 22:31.text: They will come and proclaim His righteousness to a people yet unborn— all that He has done.
PSA 22:31.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 22] They will come and proclaim His righteousness to a people yet unborn— all that He has done.

PSA 23:1.text: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
PSA 23:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 23 · The Lord is My Shepherd (Psalm 23)] The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.

PSA 23:2.text: He makes me lie down in green pastures; He leads me beside quiet waters.
PSA 23:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 23 · The Lord is My Shepherd (Psalm 23)] He makes me lie down in green pastures; He leads me beside quiet waters.

PSA 23:3.text: He restores my soul; He guides me in the paths of righteousness for the sake of His name.
PSA 23:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 23 · The Lord is My Shepherd (Psalm 23)] He restores my soul; He guides me in the paths of righteousness for the sake of His name.

PSA 23:4.text: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for You are with me; Your rod and Your staff, they comfort me.
PSA 23:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 23 · The Lord is My Shepherd (Psalm 23)] Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for You are with me; Your rod and Your staff, they comfort me.

PSA 23:5.text: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil; my cup overflows.
PSA 23:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 23 · The Lord is My Shepherd (Psalm 23)] You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil; my cup overflows.

PSA 23:6.text: Surely goodness and mercy will follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the house of the LORD forever.
PSA 23:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 23 · The Lord is My Shepherd (Psalm 23)] Surely goodness and mercy will follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the house of the LORD forever.

PSA 24:1.text: The earth is the LORD’s, and the fullness thereof, the world and all who dwell therein.
PSA 24:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 24] The earth is the LORD’s, and the fullness thereof, the world and all who dwell therein.

PSA 24:2.text: For He has founded it upon the seas and established it upon the waters.
PSA 24:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 24] For He has founded it upon the seas and established it upon the waters.

PSA 24:3.text: Who may ascend the hill of the LORD? Who may stand in His holy place?
PSA 24:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 24] Who may ascend the hill of the LORD? Who may stand in His holy place?

PSA 24:4.text: He who has clean hands and a pure heart, who does not lift up his soul to an idol or swear deceitfully.
PSA 24:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 24 · Adultery In Heart] He who has clean hands and a pure heart, who does not lift up his soul to an idol or swear deceitfully.

PSA 24:5.text: He will receive blessing from the LORD and vindication from the God of his salvation.
PSA 24:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 24 · Blessing] He will receive blessing from the LORD and vindication from the God of his salvation.

PSA 24:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 24 · Israel] Such is the generation of those who seek Him, who seek Your face, O God of Jacob. Selah

PSA 24:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 24 · Glory] Lift up your heads, O gates! Be lifted up, O ancient doors, that the King of Glory may enter!

PSA 24:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 24 · Glory] Who is this King of Glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.

PSA 24:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 24 · Glory] Lift up your heads, O gates! Be lifted up, O ancient doors, that the King of Glory may enter!
