PSA 25:1.text: To You, O LORD, I lift up my soul;
PSA 25:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 25] To You, O LORD, I lift up my soul;

PSA 25:2.text: in You, my God, I trust. Do not let me be put to shame; do not let my enemies exult over me.
PSA 25:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 25 · Faith] in You, my God, I trust. Do not let me be put to shame; do not let my enemies exult over me.

PSA 25:3.text: Surely none who wait for You will be put to shame; but those who are faithless without cause will be disgraced.
PSA 25:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 25 · Faith] Surely none who wait for You will be put to shame; but those who are faithless without cause will be disgraced.

PSA 25:4.text: Show me Your ways, O LORD; teach me Your paths.
PSA 25:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 25] Show me Your ways, O LORD; teach me Your paths.

PSA 25:5.text: Guide me in Your truth and teach me, for You are the God of my salvation; all day long I wait for You.
PSA 25:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 25] Guide me in Your truth and teach me, for You are the God of my salvation; all day long I wait for You.

PSA 25:6.text: Remember, O LORD, Your compassion and loving devotion, for they are from age to age.
PSA 25:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 25 · Compassion, Devotion] Remember, O LORD, Your compassion and loving devotion, for they are from age to age.

PSA 25:7.text: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my rebellious acts; remember me according to Your loving devotion, because of Your goodness, O LORD.
PSA 25:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 25 · Devotion] Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my rebellious acts; remember me according to Your loving devotion, because of Your goodness, O LORD.

PSA 25:8.text: Good and upright is the LORD; therefore He shows sinners the way.
PSA 25:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 25] Good and upright is the LORD; therefore He shows sinners the way.

PSA 25:9.text: He guides the humble in what is right and teaches them His way.
PSA 25:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 25] He guides the humble in what is right and teaches them His way.

PSA 25:10.text: All the LORD’s ways are loving and faithful to those who keep His covenant and His decrees.
PSA 25:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 25 · Faith, Covenant] All the LORD’s ways are loving and faithful to those who keep His covenant and His decrees.

PSA 25:11.text: For the sake of Your name, O LORD, forgive my iniquity, for it is great.
PSA 25:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 25 · Forgiveness] For the sake of Your name, O LORD, forgive my iniquity, for it is great.

PSA 25:12.text: Who is the man who fears the LORD? He will instruct him in the path chosen for him.
PSA 25:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 25 · Election] Who is the man who fears the LORD? He will instruct him in the path chosen for him.

PSA 25:13.text: His soul will dwell in prosperity, and his descendants will inherit the land.
PSA 25:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 25 · Blessing] His soul will dwell in prosperity, and his descendants will inherit the land.

PSA 25:14.text: The LORD confides in those who fear Him, and reveals His covenant to them.
PSA 25:14.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 25 · Covenant] The LORD confides in those who fear Him, and reveals His covenant to them.

PSA 25:15.text: My eyes are always on the LORD, for He will free my feet from the mesh.
PSA 25:15.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 25] My eyes are always on the LORD, for He will free my feet from the mesh.

PSA 25:16.text: Turn to me and be gracious, for I am lonely and afflicted.
PSA 25:16.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 25] Turn to me and be gracious, for I am lonely and afflicted.

PSA 25:17.text: The troubles of my heart increase; free me from my distress.
PSA 25:17.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 25 · Adultery In Heart] The troubles of my heart increase; free me from my distress.

PSA 25:18.text: Consider my affliction and trouble, and take away all my sins.
PSA 25:18.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 25] Consider my affliction and trouble, and take away all my sins.

PSA 25:19.text: Consider my enemies, for they are many, and they hate me with vicious hatred.
PSA 25:19.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 25] Consider my enemies, for they are many, and they hate me with vicious hatred.

PSA 25:20.text: Guard my soul and deliver me; let me not be put to shame, for I take refuge in You.
PSA 25:20.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 25] Guard my soul and deliver me; let me not be put to shame, for I take refuge in You.

PSA 25:21.text: May integrity and uprightness preserve me, because I wait for You.
PSA 25:21.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 25] May integrity and uprightness preserve me, because I wait for You.

PSA 25:22.text: Redeem Israel, O God, from all its distress.
PSA 25:22.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 25 · Israel] Redeem Israel, O God, from all its distress.

PSA 26:1.text: Vindicate me, O LORD!   For I have walked with integrity; I have trusted in the LORD without wavering.
PSA 26:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 26 · Faith] Vindicate me, O LORD!   For I have walked with integrity; I have trusted in the LORD without wavering.

PSA 26:2.text: Test me, O LORD, and try me; examine my heart and mind.
PSA 26:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 26 · Adultery In Heart] Test me, O LORD, and try me; examine my heart and mind.

PSA 26:3.text: For Your loving devotion is before my eyes, and I have walked in Your truth.
PSA 26:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 26 · Devotion] For Your loving devotion is before my eyes, and I have walked in Your truth.

PSA 26:4.text: I do not sit with deceitful men, nor keep company with hypocrites.
PSA 26:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 26] I do not sit with deceitful men, nor keep company with hypocrites.

PSA 26:5.text: I hate the mob of evildoers, and refuse to sit with the wicked.
PSA 26:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 26] I hate the mob of evildoers, and refuse to sit with the wicked.

PSA 26:6.text: I wash my hands in innocence that I may go about Your altar, O LORD,
PSA 26:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 26 · About Forgiveness] I wash my hands in innocence that I may go about Your altar, O LORD,

PSA 26:7.text: to raise my voice in thanksgiving and declare all Your wonderful works.
PSA 26:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 26 · Gratitude] to raise my voice in thanksgiving and declare all Your wonderful works.

PSA 26:8.text: O LORD, I love the house where You dwell, the place where Your glory resides.
PSA 26:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 26 · Love, Glory] O LORD, I love the house where You dwell, the place where Your glory resides.

PSA 26:9.text: Do not take my soul away with sinners, or my life with men of bloodshed,
PSA 26:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 26] Do not take my soul away with sinners, or my life with men of bloodshed,

PSA 26:10.text: in whose hands are wicked schemes, whose right hands are full of bribes.
PSA 26:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 26] in whose hands are wicked schemes, whose right hands are full of bribes.

PSA 26:11.text: But I will walk with integrity; redeem me and be merciful to me.
PSA 26:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 26] But I will walk with integrity; redeem me and be merciful to me.

PSA 26:12.text: My feet stand on level ground; in the congregations I will bless the LORD.
PSA 26:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 26] My feet stand on level ground; in the congregations I will bless the LORD.

PSA 27:1.text: The LORD is my light and my salvation— whom shall I fear? The LORD is the stronghold of my life— whom shall I dread?
PSA 27:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 27 · Fear, Light] The LORD is my light and my salvation— whom shall I fear? The LORD is the stronghold of my life— whom shall I dread?

PSA 27:2.text: When the wicked came upon me to devour my flesh, my enemies and foes stumbled and fell.
PSA 27:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 27] When the wicked came upon me to devour my flesh, my enemies and foes stumbled and fell.

PSA 27:3.text: Though an army encamps around me, my heart will not fear; though a war breaks out against me, I will keep my trust.
PSA 27:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 27 · Faith, Adultery In Heart] Though an army encamps around me, my heart will not fear; though a war breaks out against me, I will keep my trust.

PSA 27:4.text: One thing I have asked of the LORD; this is what I desire: to dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to gaze on the beauty of the LORD and seek Him in His temple.
PSA 27:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 27 · Lust] One thing I have asked of the LORD; this is what I desire: to dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to gaze on the beauty of the LORD and seek Him in His temple.

PSA 27:5.text: For in the day of trouble He will hide me in His shelter; He will conceal me under the cover of His tent; He will set me high upon a rock.
PSA 27:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 27] For in the day of trouble He will hide me in His shelter; He will conceal me under the cover of His tent; He will set me high upon a rock.

PSA 27:6.text: Then my head will be held high above my enemies around me. At His tabernacle I will offer sacrifices with shouts of joy; I will sing and make music to the LORD.
PSA 27:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 27] Then my head will be held high above my enemies around me. At His tabernacle I will offer sacrifices with shouts of joy; I will sing and make music to the LORD.

PSA 27:7.text: Hear, O LORD, my voice when I call; be merciful and answer me.
PSA 27:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 27] Hear, O LORD, my voice when I call; be merciful and answer me.

PSA 27:8.text: My heart said, “Seek His face.” Your face, O LORD, I will seek.
PSA 27:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 27 · Adultery In Heart] My heart said, “Seek His face.” Your face, O LORD, I will seek.

PSA 27:9.text: Hide not Your face from me, nor turn away Your servant in anger. You have been my helper; do not leave me or forsake me, O God of my salvation.
PSA 27:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 27] Hide not Your face from me, nor turn away Your servant in anger. You have been my helper; do not leave me or forsake me, O God of my salvation.

PSA 27:10.text: Though my father and mother forsake me, the LORD will receive me.
PSA 27:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 27 · God the Father] Though my father and mother forsake me, the LORD will receive me.

PSA 27:11.text: Teach me Your way, O LORD, and lead me on a level path, because of my oppressors.
PSA 27:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 27] Teach me Your way, O LORD, and lead me on a level path, because of my oppressors.

PSA 27:12.text: Do not hand me over to the will of my foes, for false witnesses rise up against me, breathing out violence.
PSA 27:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 27 · False Gods, False Witness] Do not hand me over to the will of my foes, for false witnesses rise up against me, breathing out violence.

PSA 27:13.text: Still I am certain to see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.
PSA 27:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 27] Still I am certain to see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.

PSA 27:14.text: Wait patiently for the LORD; be strong and courageous.   Wait patiently for the LORD!
PSA 27:14.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 27] Wait patiently for the LORD; be strong and courageous.   Wait patiently for the LORD!

PSA 28:1.text: To You, O LORD, I call; be not deaf to me, O my Rock. For if You remain silent, I will be like those descending to the Pit.
PSA 28:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 28] To You, O LORD, I call; be not deaf to me, O my Rock. For if You remain silent, I will be like those descending to the Pit.

PSA 28:2.text: Hear my cry for mercy when I call to You for help, when I lift up my hands toward Your holy sanctuary.
PSA 28:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 28 · Forgiveness, Compassion] Hear my cry for mercy when I call to You for help, when I lift up my hands toward Your holy sanctuary.

PSA 28:3.text: Do not drag me away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, who speak peace to their neighbors while malice is in their hearts.
PSA 28:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 28] Do not drag me away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, who speak peace to their neighbors while malice is in their hearts.

PSA 28:4.text: Repay them according to their deeds and for their works of evil. Repay them for what their hands have done; bring back on them what they deserve.
PSA 28:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 28] Repay them according to their deeds and for their works of evil. Repay them for what their hands have done; bring back on them what they deserve.

PSA 28:5.text: Since they show no regard for the works of the LORD or what His hands have done, He will tear them down and never rebuild them.
PSA 28:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 28] Since they show no regard for the works of the LORD or what His hands have done, He will tear them down and never rebuild them.

PSA 28:6.text: Blessed be the LORD, for He has heard my cry for mercy.
PSA 28:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 28 · Forgiveness, Compassion] Blessed be the LORD, for He has heard my cry for mercy.

PSA 28:7.text: The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts in Him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart rejoices, and I give thanks to Him with my song.
PSA 28:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 28 · Faith, Adultery In Heart] The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts in Him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart rejoices, and I give thanks to Him with my song.

PSA 28:8.text: The LORD is the strength of His people, a stronghold of salvation for His anointed.
PSA 28:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 28] The LORD is the strength of His people, a stronghold of salvation for His anointed.

PSA 28:9.text: Save Your people and bless Your inheritance; shepherd them and carry them forever.
PSA 28:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 28 · Inheritance] Save Your people and bless Your inheritance; shepherd them and carry them forever.

PSA 29:1.text: Ascribe to the LORD, O heavenly beings, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
PSA 29:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 29 · Glory] Ascribe to the LORD, O heavenly beings, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.

PSA 29:2.text: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due His name; worship the LORD in the splendor of His holiness.
PSA 29:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 29 · Glory, Holiness] Ascribe to the LORD the glory due His name; worship the LORD in the splendor of His holiness.

PSA 29:3.text: The voice of the LORD is over the waters; the God of glory thunders; the LORD is heard over many waters.
PSA 29:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 29 · Glory] The voice of the LORD is over the waters; the God of glory thunders; the LORD is heard over many waters.

PSA 29:4.text: The voice of the LORD is powerful; the voice of the LORD is majestic.
PSA 29:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 29] The voice of the LORD is powerful; the voice of the LORD is majestic.

PSA 29:5.text: The voice of the LORD breaks the cedars; the LORD shatters the cedars of Lebanon.
PSA 29:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 29] The voice of the LORD breaks the cedars; the LORD shatters the cedars of Lebanon.

PSA 29:6.text: He makes Lebanon skip like a calf, and Sirion like a young wild ox.
PSA 29:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 29] He makes Lebanon skip like a calf, and Sirion like a young wild ox.

PSA 29:7.text: The voice of the LORD strikes with flames of fire.
PSA 29:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 29] The voice of the LORD strikes with flames of fire.

PSA 29:8.text: The voice of the LORD shakes the wilderness; the LORD shakes the Wilderness of Kadesh.
PSA 29:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 29] The voice of the LORD shakes the wilderness; the LORD shakes the Wilderness of Kadesh.

PSA 29:9.text: The voice of the LORD twists the oaks and strips the forests bare. And in His temple all cry, “Glory!”
PSA 29:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 29 · Glory] The voice of the LORD twists the oaks and strips the forests bare. And in His temple all cry, “Glory!”

PSA 29:10.text: The LORD sits enthroned over the flood; the LORD is enthroned as King forever.
PSA 29:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 29] The LORD sits enthroned over the flood; the LORD is enthroned as King forever.

PSA 29:11.text: The LORD gives His people strength; the LORD blesses His people with peace.
PSA 29:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 29] The LORD gives His people strength; the LORD blesses His people with peace.

PSA 30:1.text: I will exalt You, O LORD, for You have lifted me up and have not allowed my foes to rejoice over me.
PSA 30:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 30] I will exalt You, O LORD, for You have lifted me up and have not allowed my foes to rejoice over me.

PSA 30:2.text: O LORD my God, I cried to You for help, and You healed me.
PSA 30:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 30] O LORD my God, I cried to You for help, and You healed me.

PSA 30:3.text: O LORD, You pulled me up from Sheol; You spared me from descending into the Pit.
PSA 30:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 30 · Death] O LORD, You pulled me up from Sheol; You spared me from descending into the Pit.

PSA 30:4.text: Sing to the LORD, O you His saints, and praise His holy name.
PSA 30:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 30] Sing to the LORD, O you His saints, and praise His holy name.

PSA 30:5.text: For His anger is fleeting, but His favor lasts a lifetime. Weeping may stay the night, but joy comes in the morning.
PSA 30:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 30 · Blessing] For His anger is fleeting, but His favor lasts a lifetime. Weeping may stay the night, but joy comes in the morning.

PSA 30:6.text: In prosperity I said, “I will never be shaken.”
PSA 30:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 30 · Blessing] In prosperity I said, “I will never be shaken.”

PSA 30:7.text: O LORD, You favored me; You made my mountain stand strong.   When You hid Your face, I was dismayed.
PSA 30:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 30] O LORD, You favored me; You made my mountain stand strong.   When You hid Your face, I was dismayed.

PSA 30:8.text: To You, O LORD, I called, and I begged my Lord for mercy:
PSA 30:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 30 · Forgiveness, Compassion] To You, O LORD, I called, and I begged my Lord for mercy:

PSA 30:9.text: “What gain is there in my bloodshed, in my descent to the Pit? Will the dust praise You? Will it proclaim Your faithfulness?
PSA 30:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 30 · Faith, Marital Faithfulness] “What gain is there in my bloodshed, in my descent to the Pit? Will the dust praise You? Will it proclaim Your faithfulness?

PSA 30:10.text: Hear me, O LORD, and have mercy; O LORD, be my helper.”
PSA 30:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 30 · Forgiveness, Compassion] Hear me, O LORD, and have mercy; O LORD, be my helper.”

PSA 30:11.text: You turned my mourning into dancing; You peeled off my sackcloth and clothed me with joy,
PSA 30:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 30] You turned my mourning into dancing; You peeled off my sackcloth and clothed me with joy,

PSA 30:12.text: that my heart may sing Your praises and not be silent. O LORD my God, I will give thanks forever.
PSA 30:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 30 · Adultery In Heart] that my heart may sing Your praises and not be silent. O LORD my God, I will give thanks forever.

PSA 31:1.text: In You, O LORD, I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame; save me by Your righteousness.
PSA 31:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 31] In You, O LORD, I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame; save me by Your righteousness.

PSA 31:2.text: Incline Your ear to me; come quickly to my rescue. Be my rock of refuge, the stronghold of my deliverance.
PSA 31:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 31] Incline Your ear to me; come quickly to my rescue. Be my rock of refuge, the stronghold of my deliverance.

PSA 31:3.text: For You are my rock and my fortress; lead me and guide me for the sake of Your name.
PSA 31:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 31] For You are my rock and my fortress; lead me and guide me for the sake of Your name.

PSA 31:4.text: You free me from the net laid out for me, for You are my refuge.
PSA 31:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 31] You free me from the net laid out for me, for You are my refuge.

PSA 31:5.text: Into Your hands I commit my spirit; You have redeemed me, O LORD, God of truth.
PSA 31:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 31 · Fruit of the Spirit] Into Your hands I commit my spirit; You have redeemed me, O LORD, God of truth.

PSA 31:6.text: I hate those who cling to worthless idols, but in the LORD I trust.
PSA 31:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 31 · Faith, Idolatry] I hate those who cling to worthless idols, but in the LORD I trust.

PSA 31:7.text: I will be glad and rejoice in Your loving devotion, for You have seen my affliction; You have known the anguish of my soul.
PSA 31:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 31 · Devotion] I will be glad and rejoice in Your loving devotion, for You have seen my affliction; You have known the anguish of my soul.

PSA 31:8.text: You have not delivered me to the enemy; You have set my feet in the open.
PSA 31:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 31] You have not delivered me to the enemy; You have set my feet in the open.

PSA 31:9.text: Be merciful to me, O LORD, for I am in distress; my eyes fail from sorrow, my soul and body as well.
PSA 31:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 31] Be merciful to me, O LORD, for I am in distress; my eyes fail from sorrow, my soul and body as well.

PSA 31:10.text: For my life is consumed with grief and my years with groaning; my iniquity has drained my strength, and my bones are wasting away.
PSA 31:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 31] For my life is consumed with grief and my years with groaning; my iniquity has drained my strength, and my bones are wasting away.

PSA 31:11.text: Among all my enemies I am a disgrace, and among my neighbors even more. I am dreaded by my friends— they flee when they see me on the street.
PSA 31:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 31] Among all my enemies I am a disgrace, and among my neighbors even more. I am dreaded by my friends— they flee when they see me on the street.

PSA 31:12.text: I am forgotten like a dead man, out of mind. I am like a broken vessel.
PSA 31:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 31] I am forgotten like a dead man, out of mind. I am like a broken vessel.

PSA 31:13.text: For I hear the slander of many; there is terror on every side. They conspire against me and plot to take my life.
PSA 31:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 31] For I hear the slander of many; there is terror on every side. They conspire against me and plot to take my life.

PSA 31:14.text: But I trust in You, O LORD; I say, “You are my God.”
PSA 31:14.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 31 · Faith] But I trust in You, O LORD; I say, “You are my God.”

PSA 31:15.text: My times are in Your hands; deliver me from my enemies and from those who pursue me.
PSA 31:15.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 31 · End Times] My times are in Your hands; deliver me from my enemies and from those who pursue me.

PSA 31:16.text: Make Your face shine on Your servant; save me by Your loving devotion.
PSA 31:16.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 31 · Devotion] Make Your face shine on Your servant; save me by Your loving devotion.

PSA 31:17.text: O LORD, let me not be ashamed, for I have called on You. Let the wicked be put to shame; let them lie silent in Sheol.
PSA 31:17.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 31 · Death] O LORD, let me not be ashamed, for I have called on You. Let the wicked be put to shame; let them lie silent in Sheol.

PSA 31:18.text: May lying lips be silenced— lips that speak with arrogance against the righteous, full of pride and contempt.
PSA 31:18.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 31 · Lying] May lying lips be silenced— lips that speak with arrogance against the righteous, full of pride and contempt.

PSA 31:19.text: How great is Your goodness which You have laid up for those who fear You, which You have bestowed before the sons of men on those who take refuge in You!
PSA 31:19.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 31] How great is Your goodness which You have laid up for those who fear You, which You have bestowed before the sons of men on those who take refuge in You!

PSA 31:20.text: You hide them in the secret place of Your presence from the schemes of men. You conceal them in Your shelter from accusing tongues.
PSA 31:20.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 31] You hide them in the secret place of Your presence from the schemes of men. You conceal them in Your shelter from accusing tongues.

PSA 31:21.text: Blessed be the LORD, for He has shown me His loving devotion in a city under siege.
PSA 31:21.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 31 · Devotion] Blessed be the LORD, for He has shown me His loving devotion in a city under siege.

PSA 31:22.text: In my alarm I said, “I am cut off from Your sight!” But You heard my plea for mercy when I called to You for help.
PSA 31:22.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 31 · Forgiveness, Compassion] In my alarm I said, “I am cut off from Your sight!” But You heard my plea for mercy when I called to You for help.

PSA 31:23.text: Love the LORD, all His saints. The LORD preserves the faithful, but fully repays the arrogant.
PSA 31:23.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 31 · Love, Faith] Love the LORD, all His saints. The LORD preserves the faithful, but fully repays the arrogant.

PSA 31:24.text: Be strong and courageous, all you who hope in the LORD.
PSA 31:24.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 31] Be strong and courageous, all you who hope in the LORD.

PSA 32:1.text: Blessed is he whose transgressions are forgiven, whose sins are covered.
PSA 32:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 32 · Forgiveness] Blessed is he whose transgressions are forgiven, whose sins are covered.

PSA 32:2.text: Blessed is the man whose iniquity the LORD does not count against him, in whose spirit there is no deceit.
PSA 32:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 32 · Deceit, Fruit of the Spirit] Blessed is the man whose iniquity the LORD does not count against him, in whose spirit there is no deceit.

PSA 32:3.text: When I kept silent, my bones became brittle from my groaning all day long.
PSA 32:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 32] When I kept silent, my bones became brittle from my groaning all day long.

PSA 32:4.text: For day and night Your hand was heavy upon me; my strength was drained as in the summer heat. Selah
PSA 32:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 32] For day and night Your hand was heavy upon me; my strength was drained as in the summer heat. Selah

PSA 32:5.text: Then I acknowledged my sin to You and did not hide my iniquity. I said, “I will confess my transgressions to the LORD,” and You forgave the guilt of my sin. Selah
PSA 32:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 32] Then I acknowledged my sin to You and did not hide my iniquity. I said, “I will confess my transgressions to the LORD,” and You forgave the guilt of my sin. Selah

PSA 32:6.text: Therefore let all the godly pray to You while You may be found. Surely when great waters rise, they will not come near.
PSA 32:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 32] Therefore let all the godly pray to You while You may be found. Surely when great waters rise, they will not come near.

PSA 32:7.text: You are my hiding place. You protect me from trouble; You surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah
PSA 32:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 32] You are my hiding place. You protect me from trouble; You surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah

PSA 32:8.text: I will instruct you and teach you the way you should go; I will give you counsel and watch over you.
PSA 32:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 32] I will instruct you and teach you the way you should go; I will give you counsel and watch over you.

PSA 32:9.text: Do not be like the horse or mule, which have no understanding; they must be controlled with bit and bridle to make them come to you.
PSA 32:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 32] Do not be like the horse or mule, which have no understanding; they must be controlled with bit and bridle to make them come to you.

PSA 32:10.text: Many are the sorrows of the wicked, but loving devotion surrounds him who trusts in the LORD.
PSA 32:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 32 · Faith, Devotion] Many are the sorrows of the wicked, but loving devotion surrounds him who trusts in the LORD.

PSA 32:11.text: Be glad in the LORD and rejoice, O righteous ones; shout for joy, all you upright in heart.
PSA 32:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 32 · Adultery In Heart] Be glad in the LORD and rejoice, O righteous ones; shout for joy, all you upright in heart.

PSA 33:1.text: Rejoice in the LORD, O righteous ones; it is fitting for the upright to praise Him.
PSA 33:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 33] Rejoice in the LORD, O righteous ones; it is fitting for the upright to praise Him.

PSA 33:2.text: Praise the LORD with the harp; make music to Him with ten strings.
PSA 33:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 33] Praise the LORD with the harp; make music to Him with ten strings.

PSA 33:3.text: Sing to Him a new song; play skillfully with a shout of joy.
PSA 33:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 33] Sing to Him a new song; play skillfully with a shout of joy.

PSA 33:4.text: For the word of the LORD is upright, and all His work is trustworthy.
PSA 33:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 33 · Faith] For the word of the LORD is upright, and all His work is trustworthy.

PSA 33:5.text: The LORD loves righteousness and justice; the earth is full of His loving devotion.
PSA 33:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 33 · Love, Devotion] The LORD loves righteousness and justice; the earth is full of His loving devotion.

PSA 33:6.text: By the word of the LORD the heavens were made, and all the stars by the breath of His mouth.
PSA 33:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 33] By the word of the LORD the heavens were made, and all the stars by the breath of His mouth.

PSA 33:7.text: He piles up the waters of the sea; He puts the depths into storehouses.
PSA 33:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 33] He piles up the waters of the sea; He puts the depths into storehouses.

PSA 33:8.text: Let all the earth fear the LORD; let all the people of the world revere Him.
PSA 33:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 33] Let all the earth fear the LORD; let all the people of the world revere Him.

PSA 33:9.text: For He spoke, and it came to be; He commanded, and it stood firm.
PSA 33:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 33 · God Commanded Genocide] For He spoke, and it came to be; He commanded, and it stood firm.

PSA 33:10.text: The LORD frustrates the plans of the nations; He thwarts the devices of the peoples.
PSA 33:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 33] The LORD frustrates the plans of the nations; He thwarts the devices of the peoples.

PSA 33:11.text: The counsel of the LORD stands forever, the purposes of His heart to all generations.
PSA 33:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 33 · Adultery In Heart] The counsel of the LORD stands forever, the purposes of His heart to all generations.

PSA 33:12.text: Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD, the people He has chosen as His inheritance!
PSA 33:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 33 · Election, Inheritance] Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD, the people He has chosen as His inheritance!

PSA 33:13.text: The LORD looks down from heaven; He sees all the sons of men.
PSA 33:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 33 · Heaven] The LORD looks down from heaven; He sees all the sons of men.

PSA 33:14.text: From His dwelling place He gazes on all who inhabit the earth.
PSA 33:14.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 33] From His dwelling place He gazes on all who inhabit the earth.

PSA 33:15.text: He shapes the hearts of each; He considers all their works.
PSA 33:15.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 33] He shapes the hearts of each; He considers all their works.

PSA 33:16.text: No king is saved by his vast army; no warrior is delivered by his great strength.
PSA 33:16.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 33] No king is saved by his vast army; no warrior is delivered by his great strength.

PSA 33:17.text: A horse is a vain hope for salvation; even its great strength cannot save.
PSA 33:17.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 33] A horse is a vain hope for salvation; even its great strength cannot save.

PSA 33:18.text: Surely the eyes of the LORD are on those who fear Him, on those whose hope is in His loving devotion
PSA 33:18.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 33 · Devotion] Surely the eyes of the LORD are on those who fear Him, on those whose hope is in His loving devotion

PSA 33:19.text: to deliver them from death and keep them alive in famine.
PSA 33:19.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 33 · Death] to deliver them from death and keep them alive in famine.

PSA 33:20.text: Our soul waits for the LORD; He is our help and our shield.
PSA 33:20.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 33] Our soul waits for the LORD; He is our help and our shield.

PSA 33:21.text: For our hearts rejoice in Him, since we trust in His holy name.
PSA 33:21.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 33 · Faith] For our hearts rejoice in Him, since we trust in His holy name.

PSA 33:22.text: May Your loving devotion rest on us, O LORD, as we put our hope in You.
PSA 33:22.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 33 · Devotion] May Your loving devotion rest on us, O LORD, as we put our hope in You.

PSA 34:1.text: I will bless the LORD at all times; His praise will always be on my lips.
PSA 34:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 34 · End Times] I will bless the LORD at all times; His praise will always be on my lips.

PSA 34:2.text: My soul boasts in the LORD; let the oppressed hear and rejoice.
PSA 34:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 34] My soul boasts in the LORD; let the oppressed hear and rejoice.

PSA 34:3.text: Magnify the LORD with me; let us exalt His name together.
PSA 34:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 34] Magnify the LORD with me; let us exalt His name together.

PSA 34:4.text: I sought the LORD, and He answered me; He delivered me from all my fears.
PSA 34:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 34] I sought the LORD, and He answered me; He delivered me from all my fears.

PSA 34:5.text: Those who look to Him are radiant with joy; their faces shall never be ashamed.
PSA 34:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 34] Those who look to Him are radiant with joy; their faces shall never be ashamed.

PSA 34:6.text: This poor man called out, and the LORD heard him; He saved him from all his troubles.
PSA 34:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 34] This poor man called out, and the LORD heard him; He saved him from all his troubles.

PSA 34:7.text: The angel of the LORD encamps around those who fear Him, and he delivers them.
PSA 34:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 34] The angel of the LORD encamps around those who fear Him, and he delivers them.

PSA 34:8.text: Taste and see that the LORD is good; blessed is the man who takes refuge in Him!
PSA 34:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 34] Taste and see that the LORD is good; blessed is the man who takes refuge in Him!

PSA 34:9.text: Fear the LORD, you His saints, for those who fear Him lack nothing.
PSA 34:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 34] Fear the LORD, you His saints, for those who fear Him lack nothing.

PSA 34:10.text: Young lions go lacking and hungry, but those who seek the LORD lack no good thing.
PSA 34:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 34] Young lions go lacking and hungry, but those who seek the LORD lack no good thing.

PSA 34:11.text: Come, children, listen to me; I will teach you the fear of the LORD.
PSA 34:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 34 · Children] Come, children, listen to me; I will teach you the fear of the LORD.

PSA 34:12.text: Who is the man who delights in life, who desires to see good days?
PSA 34:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 34] Who is the man who delights in life, who desires to see good days?

PSA 34:13.text: Keep your tongue from evil and your lips from deceitful speech.
PSA 34:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 34] Keep your tongue from evil and your lips from deceitful speech.

PSA 34:14.text: Turn away from evil and do good; seek peace and pursue it.
PSA 34:14.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 34] Turn away from evil and do good; seek peace and pursue it.

PSA 34:15.text: The eyes of the LORD are on the righteous, and His ears are inclined to their cry.
PSA 34:15.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 34] The eyes of the LORD are on the righteous, and His ears are inclined to their cry.

PSA 34:16.text: But the face of the LORD is against those who do evil, to wipe out all memory of them from the earth.
PSA 34:16.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 34] But the face of the LORD is against those who do evil, to wipe out all memory of them from the earth.

PSA 34:17.text: The righteous cry out, and the LORD hears; He delivers them from all their troubles.
PSA 34:17.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 34] The righteous cry out, and the LORD hears; He delivers them from all their troubles.

PSA 34:18.text: The LORD is near to the brokenhearted; He saves the contrite in spirit.
PSA 34:18.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 34 · Fruit of the Spirit] The LORD is near to the brokenhearted; He saves the contrite in spirit.

PSA 34:19.text: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the LORD delivers him from them all.
PSA 34:19.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 34] Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the LORD delivers him from them all.

PSA 34:20.text: He protects all his bones; not one of them will be broken.
PSA 34:20.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 34] He protects all his bones; not one of them will be broken.

PSA 34:21.text: Evil will slay the wicked, and the haters of the righteous will be condemned.
PSA 34:21.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 34] Evil will slay the wicked, and the haters of the righteous will be condemned.

PSA 34:22.text: The LORD redeems His servants, and none who take refuge in Him will be condemned.
PSA 34:22.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 34] The LORD redeems His servants, and none who take refuge in Him will be condemned.

PSA 35:1.text: Contend with my opponents, O LORD; fight against those who fight against me.
PSA 35:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 35] Contend with my opponents, O LORD; fight against those who fight against me.

PSA 35:2.text: Take up Your shield and buckler; arise and come to my aid.
PSA 35:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 35] Take up Your shield and buckler; arise and come to my aid.

PSA 35:3.text: Draw the spear and javelin against my pursuers; say to my soul: “I am your salvation.”
PSA 35:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 35] Draw the spear and javelin against my pursuers; say to my soul: “I am your salvation.”

PSA 35:4.text: May those who seek my life be disgraced and put to shame; may those who plan to harm me be driven back and confounded.
PSA 35:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 35] May those who seek my life be disgraced and put to shame; may those who plan to harm me be driven back and confounded.

PSA 35:5.text: May they be like chaff in the wind, as the angel of the LORD drives them away.
PSA 35:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 35] May they be like chaff in the wind, as the angel of the LORD drives them away.

PSA 35:6.text: May their path be dark and slick, as the angel of the LORD pursues.
PSA 35:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 35] May their path be dark and slick, as the angel of the LORD pursues.

PSA 35:7.text: For without cause they laid their net for me; without reason they dug a pit for my soul.
PSA 35:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 35] For without cause they laid their net for me; without reason they dug a pit for my soul.

PSA 35:8.text: May ruin befall them by surprise; may the net they hid ensnare them; may they fall into the hazard they created.
PSA 35:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 35] May ruin befall them by surprise; may the net they hid ensnare them; may they fall into the hazard they created.

PSA 35:9.text: Then my soul will rejoice in the LORD and exult in His salvation.
PSA 35:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 35] Then my soul will rejoice in the LORD and exult in His salvation.

PSA 35:10.text: All my bones will exclaim, “Who is like You, O LORD, who delivers the afflicted from the aggressor, the poor and needy from the robber?”
PSA 35:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 35] All my bones will exclaim, “Who is like You, O LORD, who delivers the afflicted from the aggressor, the poor and needy from the robber?”

PSA 35:11.text: Hostile witnesses come forward; they make charges I know nothing about.
PSA 35:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 35 · About Forgiveness] Hostile witnesses come forward; they make charges I know nothing about.

PSA 35:12.text: They repay me evil for good, to the bereavement of my soul.
PSA 35:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 35] They repay me evil for good, to the bereavement of my soul.

PSA 35:13.text: Yet when they were ill, I put on sackcloth; I humbled myself with fasting, but my prayers returned unanswered.
PSA 35:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 35 · Fasting] Yet when they were ill, I put on sackcloth; I humbled myself with fasting, but my prayers returned unanswered.

PSA 35:14.text: I paced about as for my friend or brother; I was bowed down with grief, like one mourning for his mother.
PSA 35:14.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 35 · About Forgiveness] I paced about as for my friend or brother; I was bowed down with grief, like one mourning for his mother.

PSA 35:15.text: But when I stumbled, they assembled in glee; they gathered together against me. Assailants I did not know slandered me without ceasing.
PSA 35:15.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 35] But when I stumbled, they assembled in glee; they gathered together against me. Assailants I did not know slandered me without ceasing.

PSA 35:16.text: Like godless jesters at a feast, they gnashed their teeth at me.
PSA 35:16.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 35] Like godless jesters at a feast, they gnashed their teeth at me.

PSA 35:17.text: How long, O Lord, will You look on? Rescue my soul from their ravages, my precious life from these lions.
PSA 35:17.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 35] How long, O Lord, will You look on? Rescue my soul from their ravages, my precious life from these lions.

PSA 35:18.text: Then I will give You thanks in the great assembly; I will praise You among many people.
PSA 35:18.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 35 · Church] Then I will give You thanks in the great assembly; I will praise You among many people.

PSA 35:19.text: Let not my enemies gloat over me without cause, nor those who hate me without reason wink in malice.
PSA 35:19.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 35] Let not my enemies gloat over me without cause, nor those who hate me without reason wink in malice.

PSA 35:20.text: For they do not speak peace, but they devise deceitful schemes against those who live quietly in the land.
PSA 35:20.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 35] For they do not speak peace, but they devise deceitful schemes against those who live quietly in the land.

PSA 35:21.text: They gape at me and say, “Aha, aha! Our eyes have seen!”
PSA 35:21.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 35] They gape at me and say, “Aha, aha! Our eyes have seen!”

PSA 35:22.text: O LORD, You have seen it; be not silent. O Lord, be not far from me.
PSA 35:22.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 35] O LORD, You have seen it; be not silent. O Lord, be not far from me.

PSA 35:23.text: Awake and rise to my defense, to my cause, my God and my Lord!
PSA 35:23.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 35] Awake and rise to my defense, to my cause, my God and my Lord!

PSA 35:24.text: Vindicate me by Your righteousness, O LORD my God, and do not let them gloat over me.
PSA 35:24.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 35] Vindicate me by Your righteousness, O LORD my God, and do not let them gloat over me.

PSA 35:25.text: Let them not say in their hearts, “Aha, just what we wanted!” Let them not say, “We have swallowed him up!”
PSA 35:25.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 35] Let them not say in their hearts, “Aha, just what we wanted!” Let them not say, “We have swallowed him up!”

PSA 35:26.text: May those who gloat in my distress be ashamed and confounded; may those who exalt themselves over me be clothed in shame and reproach.
PSA 35:26.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 35] May those who gloat in my distress be ashamed and confounded; may those who exalt themselves over me be clothed in shame and reproach.

PSA 35:27.text: May those who favor my vindication shout for joy and gladness; may they always say, “Exalted be the LORD who delights in His servant’s well-being.”
PSA 35:27.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 35 · Ascension, Blessing] May those who favor my vindication shout for joy and gladness; may they always say, “Exalted be the LORD who delights in His servant’s well-being.”

PSA 35:28.text: Then my tongue will proclaim Your righteousness and Your praises all day long.
PSA 35:28.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 35] Then my tongue will proclaim Your righteousness and Your praises all day long.

PSA 36:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 36 · Adultery In Heart] An oracle is in my heart regarding the transgression of the wicked man: There is no fear of God before his eyes.

PSA 36:2.text: For his eyes are too full of conceit to detect or hate his own sin.
PSA 36:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 36] For his eyes are too full of conceit to detect or hate his own sin.

PSA 36:3.text: The words of his mouth are wicked and deceitful; he has ceased to be wise and well-doing.
PSA 36:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 36] The words of his mouth are wicked and deceitful; he has ceased to be wise and well-doing.

PSA 36:4.text: Even on his bed he plots wickedness; he sets himself on a path that is not good; he fails to reject evil.
PSA 36:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 36] Even on his bed he plots wickedness; he sets himself on a path that is not good; he fails to reject evil.

PSA 36:5.text: Your loving devotion, O LORD, reaches to the heavens, Your faithfulness to the clouds.
PSA 36:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 36 · Faith, Devotion] Your loving devotion, O LORD, reaches to the heavens, Your faithfulness to the clouds.

PSA 36:6.text: Your righteousness is like the highest mountains; Your judgments are like the deepest sea. O LORD, You preserve man and beast.
PSA 36:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 36 · Antichrist] Your righteousness is like the highest mountains; Your judgments are like the deepest sea. O LORD, You preserve man and beast.

PSA 36:7.text: How precious is Your loving devotion, O God, that the children of men take refuge in the shadow of Your wings!
PSA 36:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 36 · Children, Devotion] How precious is Your loving devotion, O God, that the children of men take refuge in the shadow of Your wings!

PSA 36:8.text: They feast on the abundance of Your house, and You give them drink from Your river of delights.
PSA 36:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 36] They feast on the abundance of Your house, and You give them drink from Your river of delights.

PSA 36:9.text: For with You is the fountain of life; in Your light we see light.
PSA 36:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 36 · Light] For with You is the fountain of life; in Your light we see light.

PSA 36:10.text: Extend Your loving devotion to those who know You, and Your righteousness to the upright in heart.
PSA 36:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 36 · Adultery In Heart, Devotion] Extend Your loving devotion to those who know You, and Your righteousness to the upright in heart.

PSA 36:11.text: Let not the foot of the proud come against me, nor the hand of the wicked drive me away.
PSA 36:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 36] Let not the foot of the proud come against me, nor the hand of the wicked drive me away.

PSA 36:12.text: There the evildoers lie fallen, thrown down and unable to rise.
PSA 36:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 36] There the evildoers lie fallen, thrown down and unable to rise.

PSA 37:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 37 · Jealousy] Do not fret over those who do evil; do not envy those who do wrong.

PSA 37:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 37] For they wither quickly like grass and wilt like tender plants.

PSA 37:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 37 · Faith, Marital Faithfulness] Trust in the LORD and do good; dwell in the land and cultivate faithfulness.

PSA 37:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 37 · Adultery In Heart] Delight yourself in the LORD, and He will give you the desires of your heart.

PSA 37:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 37 · Faith] Commit your way to the LORD; trust in Him, and He will do it.

PSA 37:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 37 · Justice] He will bring forth your righteousness like the dawn, your justice like the noonday sun.

PSA 37:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 37] Be still before the LORD and wait patiently for Him; do not fret when men prosper in their ways, when they carry out wicked schemes.

PSA 37:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 37] Refrain from anger and abandon wrath; do not fret—it can only bring harm.

PSA 37:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 37] For the evildoers will be cut off, but those who hope in the LORD will inherit the land.

PSA 37:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 37] Yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more; though you look for them, they will not be found.

PSA 37:11.text: But the meek will inherit the land and delight in abundant prosperity.
PSA 37:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 37 · Blessing] But the meek will inherit the land and delight in abundant prosperity.

PSA 37:12.text: The wicked scheme against the righteous and gnash their teeth at them,
PSA 37:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 37] The wicked scheme against the righteous and gnash their teeth at them,

PSA 37:13.text: but the Lord laughs, seeing that their day is coming.
PSA 37:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 37] but the Lord laughs, seeing that their day is coming.

PSA 37:14.text: The wicked have drawn the sword and bent the bow to bring down the poor and needy, to slay those whose ways are upright.
PSA 37:14.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 37] The wicked have drawn the sword and bent the bow to bring down the poor and needy, to slay those whose ways are upright.
