PSA 37:15.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 37] But their swords will pierce their own hearts, and their bows will be broken.

PSA 37:16.text: Better is the little of the righteous than the abundance of many who are wicked.
PSA 37:16.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 37] Better is the little of the righteous than the abundance of many who are wicked.

PSA 37:17.text: For the arms of the wicked will be broken, but the LORD upholds the righteous.
PSA 37:17.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 37] For the arms of the wicked will be broken, but the LORD upholds the righteous.

PSA 37:18.text: The LORD knows the days of the blameless, and their inheritance will last forever.
PSA 37:18.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 37 · Inheritance] The LORD knows the days of the blameless, and their inheritance will last forever.

PSA 37:19.text: In the time of evil they will not be ashamed, and in the days of famine they will be satisfied.
PSA 37:19.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 37] In the time of evil they will not be ashamed, and in the days of famine they will be satisfied.

PSA 37:20.text: But the wicked and enemies of the LORD will perish like the glory of the fields. They will vanish; like smoke they will fade away.
PSA 37:20.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 37 · Glory] But the wicked and enemies of the LORD will perish like the glory of the fields. They will vanish; like smoke they will fade away.

PSA 37:21.text: The wicked borrow and do not repay, but the righteous are gracious and giving.
PSA 37:21.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 37 · Generosity] The wicked borrow and do not repay, but the righteous are gracious and giving.

PSA 37:22.text: Surely those He blesses will inherit the land, but the cursed will be destroyed.
PSA 37:22.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 37] Surely those He blesses will inherit the land, but the cursed will be destroyed.

PSA 37:23.text: The steps of a man are ordered by the LORD who takes delight in his journey.
PSA 37:23.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 37] The steps of a man are ordered by the LORD who takes delight in his journey.

PSA 37:24.text: Though he falls, he will not be overwhelmed, for the LORD is holding his hand.
PSA 37:24.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 37] Though he falls, he will not be overwhelmed, for the LORD is holding his hand.

PSA 37:25.text: I once was young and now am old, yet never have I seen the righteous abandoned or their children begging for bread.
PSA 37:25.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 37 · Children] I once was young and now am old, yet never have I seen the righteous abandoned or their children begging for bread.

PSA 37:26.text: They are ever generous and quick to lend, and their children are a blessing.
PSA 37:26.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 37 · Blessing, Children] They are ever generous and quick to lend, and their children are a blessing.

PSA 37:27.text: Turn away from evil and do good, so that you will abide forever.
PSA 37:27.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 37] Turn away from evil and do good, so that you will abide forever.

PSA 37:28.text: For the LORD loves justice and will not forsake His saints. They are preserved forever, but the offspring of the wicked will be cut off.
PSA 37:28.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 37 · Love, Children] For the LORD loves justice and will not forsake His saints. They are preserved forever, but the offspring of the wicked will be cut off.

PSA 37:29.text: The righteous will inherit the land and dwell in it forever.
PSA 37:29.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 37] The righteous will inherit the land and dwell in it forever.

PSA 37:30.text: The mouth of the righteous man utters wisdom, and his tongue speaks justice.
PSA 37:30.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 37 · Justice] The mouth of the righteous man utters wisdom, and his tongue speaks justice.

PSA 37:31.text: The law of his God is in his heart; his steps do not falter.
PSA 37:31.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 37 · Adultery In Heart] The law of his God is in his heart; his steps do not falter.

PSA 37:32.text: Though the wicked lie in wait for the righteous, and seek to slay them,
PSA 37:32.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 37] Though the wicked lie in wait for the righteous, and seek to slay them,

PSA 37:33.text: the LORD will not leave them in their power or let them be condemned under judgment.
PSA 37:33.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 37 · Judgment] the LORD will not leave them in their power or let them be condemned under judgment.

PSA 37:34.text: Wait for the LORD and keep His way, and He will raise you up to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you will see it.
PSA 37:34.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 37] Wait for the LORD and keep His way, and He will raise you up to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you will see it.

PSA 37:35.text: I have seen a wicked, ruthless man flourishing like a well-rooted native tree,
PSA 37:35.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 37] I have seen a wicked, ruthless man flourishing like a well-rooted native tree,

PSA 37:36.text: yet he passed away and was no more; though I searched, he could not be found.
PSA 37:36.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 37] yet he passed away and was no more; though I searched, he could not be found.

PSA 37:37.text: Consider the blameless and observe the upright, for posterity awaits the man of peace.
PSA 37:37.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 37] Consider the blameless and observe the upright, for posterity awaits the man of peace.

PSA 37:38.text: But the transgressors will all be destroyed; the future of the wicked will be cut off.
PSA 37:38.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 37] But the transgressors will all be destroyed; the future of the wicked will be cut off.

PSA 37:39.text: The salvation of the righteous is from the LORD; He is their stronghold in time of trouble.
PSA 37:39.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 37] The salvation of the righteous is from the LORD; He is their stronghold in time of trouble.

PSA 37:40.text: The LORD helps and delivers them; He rescues and saves them from the wicked, because they take refuge in Him.
PSA 37:40.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 37] The LORD helps and delivers them; He rescues and saves them from the wicked, because they take refuge in Him.

PSA 38:1.text: O LORD, do not rebuke me in Your anger or discipline me in Your wrath.
PSA 38:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 38] O LORD, do not rebuke me in Your anger or discipline me in Your wrath.

PSA 38:2.text: For Your arrows have pierced me deeply, and Your hand has pressed down on me.
PSA 38:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 38] For Your arrows have pierced me deeply, and Your hand has pressed down on me.

PSA 38:3.text: There is no soundness in my body because of Your anger; there is no rest in my bones because of my sin.
PSA 38:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 38] There is no soundness in my body because of Your anger; there is no rest in my bones because of my sin.

PSA 38:4.text: For my iniquities have overwhelmed me; they are a burden too heavy to bear.
PSA 38:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 38] For my iniquities have overwhelmed me; they are a burden too heavy to bear.

PSA 38:5.text: My wounds are foul and festering because of my sinful folly.
PSA 38:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 38] My wounds are foul and festering because of my sinful folly.

PSA 38:6.text: I am bent and brought low; all day long I go about mourning.
PSA 38:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 38 · About Forgiveness] I am bent and brought low; all day long I go about mourning.

PSA 38:7.text: For my loins are full of burning pain, and no soundness remains in my body.
PSA 38:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 38] For my loins are full of burning pain, and no soundness remains in my body.

PSA 38:8.text: I am numb and badly crushed; I groan in anguish of heart.
PSA 38:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 38 · Adultery In Heart] I am numb and badly crushed; I groan in anguish of heart.

PSA 38:9.text: O Lord, my every desire is before You; my groaning is not hidden from You.
PSA 38:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 38 · Lust] O Lord, my every desire is before You; my groaning is not hidden from You.

PSA 38:10.text: My heart pounds, my strength fails, and even the light of my eyes has faded.
PSA 38:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 38 · Adultery In Heart, Light] My heart pounds, my strength fails, and even the light of my eyes has faded.

PSA 38:11.text: My beloved and friends shun my disease, and my kinsmen stand at a distance.
PSA 38:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 38 · Love] My beloved and friends shun my disease, and my kinsmen stand at a distance.

PSA 38:12.text: Those who seek my life lay snares; those who wish me harm speak destruction, plotting deceit all day long.
PSA 38:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 38 · Deceit, Devote To Destruction] Those who seek my life lay snares; those who wish me harm speak destruction, plotting deceit all day long.

PSA 38:13.text: But like a deaf man, I do not hear; and like a mute man, I do not open my mouth.
PSA 38:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 38] But like a deaf man, I do not hear; and like a mute man, I do not open my mouth.

PSA 38:14.text: I am like a man who cannot hear, whose mouth offers no reply.
PSA 38:14.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 38] I am like a man who cannot hear, whose mouth offers no reply.

PSA 38:15.text: I wait for You, O LORD; You will answer, O Lord my God.
PSA 38:15.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 38] I wait for You, O LORD; You will answer, O Lord my God.

PSA 38:16.text: For I said, “Let them not gloat over me— those who taunt me when my foot slips.”
PSA 38:16.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 38] For I said, “Let them not gloat over me— those who taunt me when my foot slips.”

PSA 38:17.text: For I am ready to fall, and my pain is ever with me.
PSA 38:17.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 38] For I am ready to fall, and my pain is ever with me.

PSA 38:18.text: Yes, I confess my iniquity; I am troubled by my sin.
PSA 38:18.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 38] Yes, I confess my iniquity; I am troubled by my sin.

PSA 38:19.text: Many are my enemies without cause, and many hate me without reason.
PSA 38:19.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 38] Many are my enemies without cause, and many hate me without reason.

PSA 38:20.text: Those who repay my good with evil attack me for pursuing the good.
PSA 38:20.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 38] Those who repay my good with evil attack me for pursuing the good.

PSA 38:21.text: Do not forsake me, O LORD; be not far from me, O my God.
PSA 38:21.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 38] Do not forsake me, O LORD; be not far from me, O my God.

PSA 38:22.text: Come quickly to help me, O Lord my Savior.
PSA 38:22.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 38] Come quickly to help me, O Lord my Savior.

PSA 39:1.text: I said, “I will watch my ways so that I will not sin with my tongue; I will guard my mouth with a muzzle as long as the wicked are present.”
PSA 39:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 39] I said, “I will watch my ways so that I will not sin with my tongue; I will guard my mouth with a muzzle as long as the wicked are present.”

PSA 39:2.text: I was speechless and still; I remained silent, even from speaking good, and my sorrow was stirred.
PSA 39:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 39] I was speechless and still; I remained silent, even from speaking good, and my sorrow was stirred.

PSA 39:3.text: My heart grew hot within me; as I mused, the fire burned.   Then I spoke with my tongue:
PSA 39:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 39 · Adultery In Heart] My heart grew hot within me; as I mused, the fire burned.   Then I spoke with my tongue:

PSA 39:4.text: “Show me, O LORD, my end and the measure of my days. Let me know how fleeting my life is.
PSA 39:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 39] “Show me, O LORD, my end and the measure of my days. Let me know how fleeting my life is.

PSA 39:5.text: You, indeed, have made my days as handbreadths, and my lifetime as nothing before You. Truly each man at his best exists as but a breath. Selah
PSA 39:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 39] You, indeed, have made my days as handbreadths, and my lifetime as nothing before You. Truly each man at his best exists as but a breath. Selah

PSA 39:6.text: Surely every man goes about like a phantom; surely he bustles in vain; he heaps up riches not knowing who will haul them away.
PSA 39:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 39 · About Forgiveness] Surely every man goes about like a phantom; surely he bustles in vain; he heaps up riches not knowing who will haul them away.

PSA 39:7.text: And now, O Lord, for what do I wait? My hope is in You.
PSA 39:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 39] And now, O Lord, for what do I wait? My hope is in You.

PSA 39:8.text: Deliver me from all my transgressions; do not make me the reproach of fools.
PSA 39:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 39] Deliver me from all my transgressions; do not make me the reproach of fools.

PSA 39:9.text: I have become mute; I do not open my mouth because of what You have done.
PSA 39:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 39] I have become mute; I do not open my mouth because of what You have done.

PSA 39:10.text: Remove Your scourge from me; I am perishing by the force of Your hand.
PSA 39:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 39] Remove Your scourge from me; I am perishing by the force of Your hand.

PSA 39:11.text: You discipline and correct a man for his iniquity, consuming like a moth what he holds dear; surely each man is but a vapor. Selah
PSA 39:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 39] You discipline and correct a man for his iniquity, consuming like a moth what he holds dear; surely each man is but a vapor. Selah

PSA 39:12.text: Hear my prayer, O LORD, and give ear to my cry for help; do not be deaf to my weeping. For I am a foreigner dwelling with You, a stranger like all my fathers.
PSA 39:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 39] Hear my prayer, O LORD, and give ear to my cry for help; do not be deaf to my weeping. For I am a foreigner dwelling with You, a stranger like all my fathers.

PSA 39:13.text: Turn Your gaze away from me, that I may again be cheered before I depart and am no more.”
PSA 39:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 39] Turn Your gaze away from me, that I may again be cheered before I depart and am no more.”

PSA 40:1.text: I waited patiently for the LORD; He inclined to me and heard my cry.
PSA 40:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 40] I waited patiently for the LORD; He inclined to me and heard my cry.

PSA 40:2.text: He lifted me up from the pit of despair, out of the miry clay; He set my feet upon a rock, and made my footsteps firm.
PSA 40:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 40] He lifted me up from the pit of despair, out of the miry clay; He set my feet upon a rock, and made my footsteps firm.

PSA 40:3.text: He put a new song in my mouth, a hymn of praise to our God. Many will see and fear and put their trust in the LORD.
PSA 40:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 40 · Faith] He put a new song in my mouth, a hymn of praise to our God. Many will see and fear and put their trust in the LORD.

PSA 40:4.text: Blessed is the man who has made the LORD his trust, who has not turned to the proud, nor to those who lapse into falsehood.
PSA 40:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 40 · Faith, Falsehood] Blessed is the man who has made the LORD his trust, who has not turned to the proud, nor to those who lapse into falsehood.

PSA 40:5.text: Many, O LORD my God, are the wonders You have done, and the plans You have for us— none can compare to You— if I proclaim and declare them, they are more than I can count.
PSA 40:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 40] Many, O LORD my God, are the wonders You have done, and the plans You have for us— none can compare to You— if I proclaim and declare them, they are more than I can count.

PSA 40:6.text: Sacrifice and offering You did not desire, but my ears You have opened. Burnt offerings and sin offerings You did not require.
PSA 40:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 40 · Lust] Sacrifice and offering You did not desire, but my ears You have opened. Burnt offerings and sin offerings You did not require.

PSA 40:7.text: Then I said, “Here I am, I have come— it is written about me in the scroll:
PSA 40:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 40 · About Forgiveness] Then I said, “Here I am, I have come— it is written about me in the scroll:

PSA 40:8.text: I delight to do Your will, O my God; Your law is within my heart.”
PSA 40:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 40 · Adultery In Heart] I delight to do Your will, O my God; Your law is within my heart.”

PSA 40:9.text: I proclaim righteousness in the great assembly; behold, I do not seal my lips, as You, O LORD, do know.
PSA 40:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 40 · Church] I proclaim righteousness in the great assembly; behold, I do not seal my lips, as You, O LORD, do know.

PSA 40:10.text: I have not covered up Your righteousness in my heart; I have declared Your faithfulness and salvation; I have not concealed Your loving devotion and faithfulness from the great assembly.
PSA 40:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 40 · Faith, Adultery In Heart] I have not covered up Your righteousness in my heart; I have declared Your faithfulness and salvation; I have not concealed Your loving devotion and faithfulness from the great assembly.

PSA 40:11.text: O LORD, do not withhold Your mercy from me; Your loving devotion and faithfulness will always guard me.
PSA 40:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 40 · Forgiveness, Faith] O LORD, do not withhold Your mercy from me; Your loving devotion and faithfulness will always guard me.

PSA 40:12.text: For evils without number surround me; my sins have overtaken me, so that I cannot see. They are more than the hairs of my head, and my heart has failed within me.
PSA 40:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 40 · Adultery In Heart] For evils without number surround me; my sins have overtaken me, so that I cannot see. They are more than the hairs of my head, and my heart has failed within me.

PSA 40:13.text: Be pleased, O LORD, to deliver me; hurry, O LORD, to help me.
PSA 40:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 40] Be pleased, O LORD, to deliver me; hurry, O LORD, to help me.

PSA 40:14.text: May those who seek my life be ashamed and confounded; may those who wish me harm be repelled and humiliated.
PSA 40:14.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 40] May those who seek my life be ashamed and confounded; may those who wish me harm be repelled and humiliated.

PSA 40:15.text: May those who say to me, “Aha, aha!” be appalled at their own shame.
PSA 40:15.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 40] May those who say to me, “Aha, aha!” be appalled at their own shame.

PSA 40:16.text: May all who seek You rejoice and be glad in You; may those who love Your salvation always say, “The LORD be magnified!”
PSA 40:16.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 40 · Love] May all who seek You rejoice and be glad in You; may those who love Your salvation always say, “The LORD be magnified!”

PSA 40:17.text: But I am poor and needy; may the Lord think of me. You are my helper and deliverer; O my God, do not delay.
PSA 40:17.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 40] But I am poor and needy; may the Lord think of me. You are my helper and deliverer; O my God, do not delay.

PSA 41:1.text: Blessed is the one who cares for the poor; the LORD will deliver him in the day of trouble.
PSA 41:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 41] Blessed is the one who cares for the poor; the LORD will deliver him in the day of trouble.

PSA 41:2.text: The LORD will protect and preserve him; He will bless him in the land and refuse to surrender him to the will of his foes.
PSA 41:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 41] The LORD will protect and preserve him; He will bless him in the land and refuse to surrender him to the will of his foes.

PSA 41:3.text: The LORD will sustain him on his bed of illness and restore him from his bed of sickness.
PSA 41:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 41] The LORD will sustain him on his bed of illness and restore him from his bed of sickness.

PSA 41:4.text: I said, “O LORD, be gracious to me; heal me, for I have sinned against You.”
PSA 41:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 41] I said, “O LORD, be gracious to me; heal me, for I have sinned against You.”

PSA 41:5.text: My enemies say with malice: “When will he die and be forgotten?”
PSA 41:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 41] My enemies say with malice: “When will he die and be forgotten?”

PSA 41:6.text: My visitor speaks falsehood; he gathers slander in his heart; he goes out and spreads it abroad.
PSA 41:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 41 · Adultery In Heart, Falsehood] My visitor speaks falsehood; he gathers slander in his heart; he goes out and spreads it abroad.

PSA 41:7.text: All who hate me whisper against me; they imagine the worst for me:
PSA 41:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 41] All who hate me whisper against me; they imagine the worst for me:

PSA 41:8.text: “A vile disease has been poured into him; he will never get up from where he lies!”
PSA 41:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 41] “A vile disease has been poured into him; he will never get up from where he lies!”

PSA 41:9.text: Even my close friend whom I trusted, the one who shared my bread, has lifted up his heel against me.
PSA 41:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 41 · Faith] Even my close friend whom I trusted, the one who shared my bread, has lifted up his heel against me.

PSA 41:10.text: But You, O LORD, be gracious to me and raise me up, that I may repay them.
PSA 41:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 41] But You, O LORD, be gracious to me and raise me up, that I may repay them.

PSA 41:11.text: By this I know that You delight in me, for my enemy does not triumph over me.
PSA 41:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 41] By this I know that You delight in me, for my enemy does not triumph over me.

PSA 41:12.text: In my integrity You uphold me and set me in Your presence forever.
PSA 41:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 41] In my integrity You uphold me and set me in Your presence forever.

PSA 41:13.text: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting.   Amen and Amen.
PSA 41:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 41 · Israel] Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting.   Amen and Amen.

PSA 42:1.text: As the deer pants for streams of water, so my soul longs after You, O God.
PSA 42:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 42] As the deer pants for streams of water, so my soul longs after You, O God.

PSA 42:2.text: My soul thirsts for God, the living God. When shall I come and appear in God’s presence?
PSA 42:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 42] My soul thirsts for God, the living God. When shall I come and appear in God’s presence?

PSA 42:3.text: My tears have been my food both day and night, while men ask me all day long, “Where is your God?”
PSA 42:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 42] My tears have been my food both day and night, while men ask me all day long, “Where is your God?”

PSA 42:4.text: These things come to mind as I pour out my soul: how I walked with the multitude, leading the procession to the house of God with shouts of joy and praise.
PSA 42:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 42] These things come to mind as I pour out my soul: how I walked with the multitude, leading the procession to the house of God with shouts of joy and praise.

PSA 42:5.text: Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why the unease within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him for the salvation of His presence.
PSA 42:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 42 · Depression] Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why the unease within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him for the salvation of His presence.

PSA 42:6.text: O my God, my soul despairs within me. Therefore I remember You from the land of Jordan and the peaks of Hermon— even from Mount Mizar.
PSA 42:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 42] O my God, my soul despairs within me. Therefore I remember You from the land of Jordan and the peaks of Hermon— even from Mount Mizar.

PSA 42:7.text: Deep calls to deep in the roar of Your waterfalls; all Your breakers and waves have rolled over me.
PSA 42:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 42] Deep calls to deep in the roar of Your waterfalls; all Your breakers and waves have rolled over me.

PSA 42:8.text: The LORD decrees His loving devotion by day, and at night His song is with me as a prayer to the God of my life.
PSA 42:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 42 · Devotion] The LORD decrees His loving devotion by day, and at night His song is with me as a prayer to the God of my life.

PSA 42:9.text: I say to God my Rock, “Why have You forgotten me? Why must I walk in sorrow because of the enemy’s oppression?”
PSA 42:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 42] I say to God my Rock, “Why have You forgotten me? Why must I walk in sorrow because of the enemy’s oppression?”

PSA 42:10.text: Like the crushing of my bones, my enemies taunt me, while they say to me all day long, “Where is your God?”
PSA 42:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 42] Like the crushing of my bones, my enemies taunt me, while they say to me all day long, “Where is your God?”

PSA 42:11.text: Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why the unease within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him, my Savior and my God.
PSA 42:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 42 · Depression] Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why the unease within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him, my Savior and my God.

PSA 43:1.text: Vindicate me, O God, and plead my case against an ungodly nation; deliver me from deceitful and unjust men.
PSA 43:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 43] Vindicate me, O God, and plead my case against an ungodly nation; deliver me from deceitful and unjust men.

PSA 43:2.text: For You are the God of my refuge. Why have You rejected me? Why must I walk in sorrow because of the enemy’s oppression?
PSA 43:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 43] For You are the God of my refuge. Why have You rejected me? Why must I walk in sorrow because of the enemy’s oppression?

PSA 43:3.text: Send out Your light and Your truth; let them lead me. Let them bring me to Your holy mountain, and to the place where You dwell.
PSA 43:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 43 · Light] Send out Your light and Your truth; let them lead me. Let them bring me to Your holy mountain, and to the place where You dwell.

PSA 43:4.text: Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my greatest joy. I will praise You with the harp, O God, my God.
PSA 43:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 43] Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my greatest joy. I will praise You with the harp, O God, my God.

PSA 43:5.text: Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why the unease within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him, my Savior and my God.
PSA 43:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 43 · Depression] Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why the unease within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him, my Savior and my God.

PSA 44:1.text: We have heard with our ears, O God; our fathers have told us the work You did in their days, in the days of old.
PSA 44:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 44] We have heard with our ears, O God; our fathers have told us the work You did in their days, in the days of old.

PSA 44:2.text: With Your hand You drove out the nations and planted our fathers there; You crushed the peoples and cast them out.
PSA 44:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 44] With Your hand You drove out the nations and planted our fathers there; You crushed the peoples and cast them out.

PSA 44:3.text: For it was not by their sword that they took the land; their arm did not bring them victory. It was by Your right hand, Your arm, and the light of Your face, because You favored them.
PSA 44:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 44 · Light] For it was not by their sword that they took the land; their arm did not bring them victory. It was by Your right hand, Your arm, and the light of Your face, because You favored them.

PSA 44:4.text: You are my King, O God, who ordains victories for Jacob.
PSA 44:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 44 · Israel] You are my King, O God, who ordains victories for Jacob.

PSA 44:5.text: Through You we repel our foes; through Your name we trample our enemies.
PSA 44:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 44] Through You we repel our foes; through Your name we trample our enemies.

PSA 44:6.text: For I do not trust in my bow, nor does my sword save me.
PSA 44:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 44 · Faith] For I do not trust in my bow, nor does my sword save me.

PSA 44:7.text: For You save us from our enemies; You put those who hate us to shame.
PSA 44:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 44] For You save us from our enemies; You put those who hate us to shame.

PSA 44:8.text: In God we have boasted all day long, and Your name we will praise forever. Selah
PSA 44:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 44] In God we have boasted all day long, and Your name we will praise forever. Selah

PSA 44:9.text: But You have rejected and humbled us; You no longer go forth with our armies.
PSA 44:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 44] But You have rejected and humbled us; You no longer go forth with our armies.

PSA 44:10.text: You have made us retreat from the foe, and those who hate us have plundered us.
PSA 44:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 44] You have made us retreat from the foe, and those who hate us have plundered us.

PSA 44:11.text: You have given us up as sheep to be devoured; You have scattered us among the nations.
PSA 44:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 44] You have given us up as sheep to be devoured; You have scattered us among the nations.

PSA 44:12.text: You sell Your people for nothing; no profit do You gain from their sale.
PSA 44:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 44] You sell Your people for nothing; no profit do You gain from their sale.

PSA 44:13.text: You have made us a reproach to our neighbors, a mockery and derision to those around us.
PSA 44:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 44] You have made us a reproach to our neighbors, a mockery and derision to those around us.

PSA 44:14.text: You have made us a byword among the nations, a laughingstock among the peoples.
PSA 44:14.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 44] You have made us a byword among the nations, a laughingstock among the peoples.

PSA 44:15.text: All day long my disgrace is before me, and shame has covered my face,
PSA 44:15.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 44] All day long my disgrace is before me, and shame has covered my face,

PSA 44:16.text: at the voice of the scorner and reviler, because of the enemy, bent on revenge.
PSA 44:16.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 44] at the voice of the scorner and reviler, because of the enemy, bent on revenge.

PSA 44:17.text: All this has come upon us, though we have not forgotten You or betrayed Your covenant.
PSA 44:17.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 44 · Covenant] All this has come upon us, though we have not forgotten You or betrayed Your covenant.

PSA 44:18.text: Our hearts have not turned back; our steps have not strayed from Your path.
PSA 44:18.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 44] Our hearts have not turned back; our steps have not strayed from Your path.

PSA 44:19.text: But You have crushed us in the lair of jackals; You have covered us with deepest darkness.
PSA 44:19.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 44] But You have crushed us in the lair of jackals; You have covered us with deepest darkness.

PSA 44:20.text: If we had forgotten the name of our God or spread out our hands to a foreign god,
PSA 44:20.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 44] If we had forgotten the name of our God or spread out our hands to a foreign god,

PSA 44:21.text: would not God have discovered, since He knows the secrets of the heart?
PSA 44:21.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 44 · Adultery In Heart] would not God have discovered, since He knows the secrets of the heart?

PSA 44:22.text: Yet for Your sake we face death all day long; we are considered as sheep to be slaughtered.
PSA 44:22.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 44 · Death] Yet for Your sake we face death all day long; we are considered as sheep to be slaughtered.

PSA 44:23.text: Wake up, O Lord! Why are You sleeping? Arise! Do not reject us forever.
PSA 44:23.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 44] Wake up, O Lord! Why are You sleeping? Arise! Do not reject us forever.

PSA 44:24.text: Why do You hide Your face and forget our affliction and oppression?
PSA 44:24.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 44] Why do You hide Your face and forget our affliction and oppression?

PSA 44:25.text: For our soul has sunk to the dust; our bodies cling to the earth.
PSA 44:25.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 44] For our soul has sunk to the dust; our bodies cling to the earth.

PSA 44:26.text: Rise up; be our help! Redeem us on account of Your loving devotion.
PSA 44:26.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 44 · Devotion] Rise up; be our help! Redeem us on account of Your loving devotion.

PSA 45:1.text: My heart is stirred by a noble theme as I recite my verses to the king; my tongue is the pen of a skillful writer.
PSA 45:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 45 · Adultery In Heart] My heart is stirred by a noble theme as I recite my verses to the king; my tongue is the pen of a skillful writer.

PSA 45:2.text: You are the most handsome of men; grace has anointed your lips, since God has blessed you forever.
PSA 45:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 45 · Grace] You are the most handsome of men; grace has anointed your lips, since God has blessed you forever.

PSA 45:3.text: Strap your sword at your side, O mighty warrior; appear in your majesty and splendor.
PSA 45:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 45 · Glory] Strap your sword at your side, O mighty warrior; appear in your majesty and splendor.

PSA 45:4.text: In your splendor ride forth in victory on behalf of truth and humility and justice; may your right hand show your awesome deeds.
PSA 45:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 45 · Humility, Justice] In your splendor ride forth in victory on behalf of truth and humility and justice; may your right hand show your awesome deeds.

PSA 45:5.text: Your arrows pierce the hearts of the king’s foes; the nations fall beneath your feet.
PSA 45:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 45] Your arrows pierce the hearts of the king’s foes; the nations fall beneath your feet.

PSA 45:6.text: Your throne, O God, endures forever and ever, and justice is the scepter of Your kingdom.
PSA 45:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 45 · Justice, Kingdom of God] Your throne, O God, endures forever and ever, and justice is the scepter of Your kingdom.

PSA 45:7.text: You have loved righteousness and hated wickedness; therefore God, your God, has anointed you above your companions with the oil of joy.
PSA 45:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 45 · Love] You have loved righteousness and hated wickedness; therefore God, your God, has anointed you above your companions with the oil of joy.

PSA 45:8.text: All your garments are fragrant with myrrh and aloes and cassia; from palaces of ivory the harps make you glad.
PSA 45:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 45] All your garments are fragrant with myrrh and aloes and cassia; from palaces of ivory the harps make you glad.

PSA 45:9.text: The daughters of kings are among your honored women; the queen stands at your right hand, adorned with the gold of Ophir.
PSA 45:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 45 · Biblical Women, Heroic Women] The daughters of kings are among your honored women; the queen stands at your right hand, adorned with the gold of Ophir.

PSA 45:10.text: Listen, O daughter! Consider and incline your ear: Forget your people and your father’s house,
PSA 45:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 45 · God the Father] Listen, O daughter! Consider and incline your ear: Forget your people and your father’s house,

PSA 45:11.text: and the king will desire your beauty; bow to him, for he is your lord.
PSA 45:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 45 · Lust] and the king will desire your beauty; bow to him, for he is your lord.

PSA 45:12.text: The Daughter of Tyre will come with a gift; men of wealth will seek your favor.
PSA 45:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 45 · Blessing] The Daughter of Tyre will come with a gift; men of wealth will seek your favor.

PSA 45:13.text: All glorious is the princess in her chamber; her gown is embroidered with gold.
PSA 45:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 45] All glorious is the princess in her chamber; her gown is embroidered with gold.

PSA 45:14.text: In colorful garments she is led to the king; her virgin companions are brought before you.
PSA 45:14.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 45] In colorful garments she is led to the king; her virgin companions are brought before you.

PSA 45:15.text: They are led in with joy and gladness; they enter the palace of the king.
PSA 45:15.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 45 · Joy] They are led in with joy and gladness; they enter the palace of the king.

PSA 45:16.text: Your sons will succeed your fathers; you will make them princes throughout the land.
PSA 45:16.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 45] Your sons will succeed your fathers; you will make them princes throughout the land.

PSA 45:17.text: I will commemorate your name through all generations; therefore the nations will praise you forever and ever.
PSA 45:17.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 45] I will commemorate your name through all generations; therefore the nations will praise you forever and ever.

PSA 46:1.text: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in times of trouble.
PSA 46:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 46 · End Times] God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in times of trouble.

PSA 46:2.text: Therefore we will not fear, though the earth is transformed and the mountains are toppled into the depths of the seas,
PSA 46:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 46] Therefore we will not fear, though the earth is transformed and the mountains are toppled into the depths of the seas,

PSA 46:3.text: though their waters roar and foam and the mountains quake in the surge. Selah
PSA 46:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 46] though their waters roar and foam and the mountains quake in the surge. Selah

PSA 46:4.text: There is a river whose streams delight the city of God, the holy place where the Most High dwells.
PSA 46:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 46] There is a river whose streams delight the city of God, the holy place where the Most High dwells.

PSA 46:5.text: God is within her; she will not be moved. God will help her when morning dawns.
PSA 46:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 46] God is within her; she will not be moved. God will help her when morning dawns.

PSA 46:6.text: Nations rage, kingdoms crumble; the earth melts when He lifts His voice.
PSA 46:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 46] Nations rage, kingdoms crumble; the earth melts when He lifts His voice.

PSA 46:7.text: The LORD of Hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress. Selah
PSA 46:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 46 · Israel] The LORD of Hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress. Selah

PSA 46:8.text: Come, see the works of the LORD, who brings devastation upon the earth.
PSA 46:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 46] Come, see the works of the LORD, who brings devastation upon the earth.

PSA 46:9.text: He makes wars to cease throughout the earth; He breaks the bow and shatters the spear; He burns the shields in the fire.
PSA 46:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 46] He makes wars to cease throughout the earth; He breaks the bow and shatters the spear; He burns the shields in the fire.

PSA 46:10.text: “Be still and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted over the earth.”
PSA 46:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 46 · Ascension] “Be still and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted over the earth.”

PSA 46:11.text: The LORD of Hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress. Selah
PSA 46:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 46 · Israel] The LORD of Hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress. Selah

PSA 47:1.text: Clap your hands, all you peoples; shout unto God with a voice of triumph.
PSA 47:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 47] Clap your hands, all you peoples; shout unto God with a voice of triumph.

PSA 47:2.text: How awesome is the LORD Most High, the great King over all the earth!
PSA 47:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 47] How awesome is the LORD Most High, the great King over all the earth!

PSA 47:3.text: He subdues nations beneath us, and peoples under our feet.
PSA 47:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 47] He subdues nations beneath us, and peoples under our feet.

PSA 47:4.text: He chooses our inheritance for us, the pride of Jacob, whom He loves. Selah
PSA 47:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 47 · Love, Inheritance] He chooses our inheritance for us, the pride of Jacob, whom He loves. Selah

PSA 47:5.text: God has ascended amid shouts of joy, the LORD with the sound of the horn.
PSA 47:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 47] God has ascended amid shouts of joy, the LORD with the sound of the horn.

PSA 47:6.text: Sing praises to God, sing praises; sing praises to our King, sing praises!
PSA 47:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 47] Sing praises to God, sing praises; sing praises to our King, sing praises!

PSA 47:7.text: For God is King of all the earth; sing profound praises to Him.
PSA 47:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 47] For God is King of all the earth; sing profound praises to Him.

PSA 47:8.text: God reigns over the nations; God is seated on His holy throne.
PSA 47:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 47] God reigns over the nations; God is seated on His holy throne.

PSA 47:9.text: The nobles of the nations have assembled as the people of the God of Abraham; for the shields of the earth belong to God; He is highly exalted.
PSA 47:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 47 · Ascension] The nobles of the nations have assembled as the people of the God of Abraham; for the shields of the earth belong to God; He is highly exalted.

PSA 48:1.text: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, His holy mountain.
PSA 48:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 48] Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, His holy mountain.

PSA 48:2.text: Beautiful in loftiness, the joy of all the earth, like the peaks of Zaphon is Mount Zion, the city of the great King.
PSA 48:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 48] Beautiful in loftiness, the joy of all the earth, like the peaks of Zaphon is Mount Zion, the city of the great King.

PSA 48:3.text: God is in her citadels; He has shown Himself to be a fortress.
PSA 48:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 48] God is in her citadels; He has shown Himself to be a fortress.

PSA 48:4.text: For behold, the kings assembled; they all advanced together.
PSA 48:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 48] For behold, the kings assembled; they all advanced together.

PSA 48:5.text: They saw and were astounded; they fled in terror.
PSA 48:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 48] They saw and were astounded; they fled in terror.

PSA 48:6.text: Trembling seized them there, anguish like a woman in labor.
PSA 48:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 48] Trembling seized them there, anguish like a woman in labor.

PSA 48:7.text: With a wind from the east You wrecked the ships of Tarshish.
PSA 48:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 48] With a wind from the east You wrecked the ships of Tarshish.

PSA 48:8.text: As we have heard, so we have seen in the city of the LORD of Hosts, in the city of our God: God will establish her forever. Selah
PSA 48:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 48] As we have heard, so we have seen in the city of the LORD of Hosts, in the city of our God: God will establish her forever. Selah

PSA 48:9.text: Within Your temple, O God, we contemplate Your loving devotion.
PSA 48:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 48 · Devotion] Within Your temple, O God, we contemplate Your loving devotion.

PSA 48:10.text: Your name, O God, like Your praise, reaches to the ends of the earth; Your right hand is full of righteousness.
PSA 48:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 48] Your name, O God, like Your praise, reaches to the ends of the earth; Your right hand is full of righteousness.

PSA 48:11.text: Mount Zion is glad, the daughters of Judah rejoice, on account of Your judgments.
PSA 48:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 48] Mount Zion is glad, the daughters of Judah rejoice, on account of Your judgments.

PSA 48:12.text: March around Zion, encircle her, count her towers,
PSA 48:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 48] March around Zion, encircle her, count her towers,

PSA 48:13.text: consider her ramparts, tour her citadels, that you may tell the next generation.
PSA 48:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 48] consider her ramparts, tour her citadels, that you may tell the next generation.

PSA 48:14.text: For this God is our God forever and ever; He will be our guide even till death.
PSA 48:14.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 48 · Death] For this God is our God forever and ever; He will be our guide even till death.

PSA 49:1.text: Hear this, all you peoples; listen, all inhabitants of the world,
PSA 49:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 49] Hear this, all you peoples; listen, all inhabitants of the world,

PSA 49:2.text: both low and high, rich and poor alike.
PSA 49:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 49] both low and high, rich and poor alike.

PSA 49:3.text: My mouth will impart wisdom, and the meditation of my heart will bring understanding.
PSA 49:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 49 · Adultery In Heart] My mouth will impart wisdom, and the meditation of my heart will bring understanding.

PSA 49:4.text: I will incline my ear to a proverb; I will express my riddle with the harp:
PSA 49:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 49] I will incline my ear to a proverb; I will express my riddle with the harp:

PSA 49:5.text: Why should I fear in times of trouble, when wicked usurpers surround me?
PSA 49:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 49 · End Times] Why should I fear in times of trouble, when wicked usurpers surround me?

PSA 49:6.text: They trust in their wealth and boast in their great riches.
PSA 49:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 49 · Faith] They trust in their wealth and boast in their great riches.

PSA 49:7.text: No man can possibly redeem his brother or pay his ransom to God.
PSA 49:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 49] No man can possibly redeem his brother or pay his ransom to God.

PSA 49:8.text: For the redemption of his soul is costly, and never can payment suffice,
PSA 49:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 49] For the redemption of his soul is costly, and never can payment suffice,

PSA 49:9.text: that he should live on forever and not see decay.
PSA 49:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 49] that he should live on forever and not see decay.

PSA 49:10.text: For it is clear that wise men die, and the foolish and the senseless both perish and leave their wealth to others.
PSA 49:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 49] For it is clear that wise men die, and the foolish and the senseless both perish and leave their wealth to others.

PSA 49:11.text: Their graves are their eternal homes— their dwellings for endless generations— even though their lands were their namesakes.
PSA 49:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 49 · Eternal Life] Their graves are their eternal homes— their dwellings for endless generations— even though their lands were their namesakes.

PSA 49:12.text: But a man, despite his wealth, cannot endure; he is like the beasts that perish.
PSA 49:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 49] But a man, despite his wealth, cannot endure; he is like the beasts that perish.

PSA 49:13.text: This is the fate of the self-confident and their followers who endorse their sayings. Selah
PSA 49:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 49] This is the fate of the self-confident and their followers who endorse their sayings. Selah

PSA 49:14.text: Like sheep they are destined for Sheol. Death will be their shepherd. The upright will rule them in the morning, and their form will decay in Sheol, far from their lofty abode.
PSA 49:14.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 49 · Death] Like sheep they are destined for Sheol. Death will be their shepherd. The upright will rule them in the morning, and their form will decay in Sheol, far from their lofty abode.

PSA 49:15.text: But God will redeem my life from Sheol, for He will surely take me to Himself. Selah
PSA 49:15.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 49 · Death] But God will redeem my life from Sheol, for He will surely take me to Himself. Selah

PSA 49:16.text: Do not be amazed when a man grows rich, when the splendor of his house increases.
PSA 49:16.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 49] Do not be amazed when a man grows rich, when the splendor of his house increases.

PSA 49:17.text: For when he dies, he will carry nothing away; his abundance will not follow him down.
PSA 49:17.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 49] For when he dies, he will carry nothing away; his abundance will not follow him down.

PSA 49:18.text: Though in his lifetime he blesses his soul— and men praise you when you prosper—
PSA 49:18.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 49] Though in his lifetime he blesses his soul— and men praise you when you prosper—

PSA 49:19.text: he will join the generation of his fathers, who will never see the light of day.
PSA 49:19.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 49 · Light] he will join the generation of his fathers, who will never see the light of day.

PSA 49:20.text: A man who has riches without understanding is like the beasts that perish.
PSA 49:20.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 49] A man who has riches without understanding is like the beasts that perish.

PSA 50:1.text: The Mighty One, God the LORD, speaks and summons the earth from where the sun rises to where it sets.
PSA 50:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 50] The Mighty One, God the LORD, speaks and summons the earth from where the sun rises to where it sets.

PSA 50:2.text: From Zion, perfect in beauty, God shines forth.
PSA 50:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 50] From Zion, perfect in beauty, God shines forth.

PSA 50:3.text: Our God approaches and will not be silent! Consuming fire precedes Him, and a tempest rages around Him.
PSA 50:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 50] Our God approaches and will not be silent! Consuming fire precedes Him, and a tempest rages around Him.

PSA 50:4.text: He summons the heavens above, and the earth, that He may judge His people:
PSA 50:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 50] He summons the heavens above, and the earth, that He may judge His people:

PSA 50:5.text: “Gather to Me My saints, who made a covenant with Me by sacrifice.”
PSA 50:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 50 · Covenant] “Gather to Me My saints, who made a covenant with Me by sacrifice.”

PSA 50:6.text: And the heavens proclaim His righteousness, for God Himself is Judge. Selah
PSA 50:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 50] And the heavens proclaim His righteousness, for God Himself is Judge. Selah

PSA 50:7.text: “Hear, O My people, and I will speak, O Israel, and I will testify against you: I am God, your God.
PSA 50:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 50 · Israel] “Hear, O My people, and I will speak, O Israel, and I will testify against you: I am God, your God.

PSA 50:8.text: I do not rebuke you for your sacrifices, and your burnt offerings are ever before Me.
PSA 50:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 50] I do not rebuke you for your sacrifices, and your burnt offerings are ever before Me.

PSA 50:9.text: I have no need for a bull from your stall or goats from your pens,
PSA 50:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 50] I have no need for a bull from your stall or goats from your pens,

PSA 50:10.text: for every beast of the forest is Mine— the cattle on a thousand hills.
PSA 50:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 50 · Antichrist] for every beast of the forest is Mine— the cattle on a thousand hills.

PSA 50:11.text: I know every bird in the mountains, and the creatures of the field are Mine.
PSA 50:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 50] I know every bird in the mountains, and the creatures of the field are Mine.

PSA 50:12.text: If I were hungry, I would not tell you, for the world is Mine, and the fullness thereof.
PSA 50:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 50] If I were hungry, I would not tell you, for the world is Mine, and the fullness thereof.

PSA 50:13.text: Do I eat the flesh of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?
PSA 50:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 50] Do I eat the flesh of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?

PSA 50:14.text: Sacrifice a thank offering to God, and fulfill your vows to the Most High.
PSA 50:14.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 50] Sacrifice a thank offering to God, and fulfill your vows to the Most High.

PSA 50:15.text: Call upon Me in the day of trouble; I will deliver you, and you will honor Me.”
PSA 50:15.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 50] Call upon Me in the day of trouble; I will deliver you, and you will honor Me.”

PSA 50:16.text: To the wicked, however, God says, “What right have you to recite My statutes and to bear My covenant on your lips?
PSA 50:16.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 50 · Covenant] To the wicked, however, God says, “What right have you to recite My statutes and to bear My covenant on your lips?

PSA 50:17.text: For you hate My instruction and cast My words behind you.
PSA 50:17.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 50] For you hate My instruction and cast My words behind you.

PSA 50:18.text: When you see a thief, you befriend him, and throw in your lot with adulterers.

PSA 51:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 51 · David's Prayer of Repentance (Psalm 51)] Wash me clean of my iniquity and cleanse me from my sin.

PSA 51:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 51 · David's Prayer of Repentance (Psalm 51)] For I know my transgressions, and my sin is always before me.

PSA 51:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 51 · David's Prayer of Repentance (Psalm 51)] Against You, You only, have I sinned and done what is evil in Your sight, so that You may be proved right when You speak and blameless when You judge.

PSA 51:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 51 · David's Prayer of Repentance (Psalm 51)] Surely I was brought forth in iniquity; I was sinful when my mother conceived me.

PSA 51:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 51 · David's Prayer of Repentance (Psalm 51)] Surely You desire truth in the inmost being; You teach me wisdom in the inmost place.

PSA 51:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 51 · David's Prayer of Repentance (Psalm 51)] Purify me with hyssop, and I will be clean; wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.

PSA 51:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 51 · David's Prayer of Repentance (Psalm 51)] Let me hear joy and gladness; let the bones You have crushed rejoice.

PSA 51:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 51 · David's Prayer of Repentance (Psalm 51)] Hide Your face from my sins and blot out all my iniquities.

PSA 51:10.text: Create in me a clean heart, O God, and renew a right spirit within me.
PSA 51:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 51 · David's Prayer of Repentance (Psalm 51)] Create in me a clean heart, O God, and renew a right spirit within me.

PSA 51:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 51 · David's Prayer of Repentance (Psalm 51)] Cast me not away from Your presence; take not Your Holy Spirit from me.

PSA 51:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 51 · David's Prayer of Repentance (Psalm 51)] Restore to me the joy of Your salvation, and sustain me with a willing spirit.

PSA 51:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 51 · David's Prayer of Repentance (Psalm 51)] Then I will teach transgressors Your ways, and sinners will return to You.

PSA 51:14.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 51 · David's Prayer of Repentance (Psalm 51)] Deliver me from bloodguilt, O God, the God of my salvation, and my tongue will sing of Your righteousness.

PSA 51:15.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 51 · David's Prayer of Repentance (Psalm 51)] O Lord, open my lips, and my mouth will declare Your praise.

PSA 51:16.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 51 · David's Prayer of Repentance (Psalm 51)] For You do not delight in sacrifice, or I would bring it; You take no pleasure in burnt offerings.

PSA 51:17.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 51 · David's Prayer of Repentance (Psalm 51)] The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit; a broken and a contrite heart, O God, You will not despise.

PSA 51:18.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 51 · David's Prayer of Repentance (Psalm 51)] In Your good pleasure, cause Zion to prosper; build up the walls of Jerusalem.

PSA 51:19.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 51 · David's Prayer of Repentance (Psalm 51)] Then You will delight in righteous sacrifices, in whole burnt offerings; then bulls will be offered on Your altar.

PSA 52:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 52 · Devotion] Why do you boast of evil, O mighty man? The loving devotion of God endures all day long.

PSA 52:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 52 · Deceit, Devote To Destruction] Your tongue devises destruction like a sharpened razor, O worker of deceit.

PSA 52:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 52] Surely God will bring you down to everlasting ruin; He will snatch you up and tear you away from your tent; He will uproot you from the land of the living. Selah

PSA 53:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 53] All have turned away, they have together become corrupt; there is no one who does good, not even one.

PSA 53:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 53] Will the workers of iniquity never learn?   They devour my people like bread; they refuse to call upon God.

PSA 54:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 54] Save me, O God, by Your name, and vindicate me by Your might!

PSA 54:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 54] Hear my prayer, O God; listen to the words of my mouth.

PSA 54:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 54] For strangers rise up against me, and ruthless men seek my life— men with no regard for God. Selah

PSA 54:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 54] Surely God is my helper; the Lord is the sustainer of my soul.

PSA 54:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 54] Freely I will sacrifice to You; I will praise Your name, O LORD, for it is good.

PSA 54:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 54] For He has delivered me from every trouble, and my eyes have stared down my foes.

PSA 55:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 55] Listen to my prayer, O God, and do not ignore my plea.

PSA 55:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 55] Attend to me and answer me. I am restless in my complaint, and distraught

PSA 55:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 55] How far away I would flee! In the wilderness I would remain. Selah

PSA 55:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 55] I would hurry to my shelter, far from this raging tempest.”

PSA 55:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 55 · Deceit, Devote To Destruction] Destruction is within; oppression and deceit never leave the streets.

PSA 55:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 55] For it is not an enemy who insults me; that I could endure. It is not a foe who rises against me; from him I could hide.

PSA 55:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 55] But it is you, a man like myself, my companion and close friend.

PSA 55:14.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 55 · Fellowship] We shared sweet fellowship together; we walked with the crowd into the house of God.

PSA 55:15.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 55 · Death] Let death seize them by surprise; let them go down to Sheol alive, for evil is with them in their homes.

PSA 55:16.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 55] But I call to God, and the LORD saves me.

PSA 55:18.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 55] He redeems my soul in peace from the battle waged against me, even though many oppose me.

PSA 55:19.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 55] God will hear and humiliate them— the One enthroned for the ages— Selah because they do not change and they have no fear of God.

PSA 55:22.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 55] Cast your burden upon the LORD and He will sustain you; He will never let the righteous be shaken.

PSA 56:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 56] In spite of such sin, will they escape? In Your anger, O God, cast down the nations.
