PSA 59:1.text: Deliver me from my enemies, O my God; protect me from those who rise against me.
PSA 59:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 59] Deliver me from my enemies, O my God; protect me from those who rise against me.

PSA 59:2.text: Deliver me from workers of iniquity, and save me from men of bloodshed.
PSA 59:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 59] Deliver me from workers of iniquity, and save me from men of bloodshed.

PSA 59:3.text: See how they lie in wait for me. Fierce men conspire against me for no transgression or sin of my own, O LORD.
PSA 59:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 59] See how they lie in wait for me. Fierce men conspire against me for no transgression or sin of my own, O LORD.

PSA 59:4.text: For no fault of my own, they move swiftly to attack me. Arise to help me, and take notice.
PSA 59:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 59] For no fault of my own, they move swiftly to attack me. Arise to help me, and take notice.

PSA 59:5.text: O LORD God of Hosts, the God of Israel, rouse Yourself to punish all the nations; show no mercy to the wicked traitors. Selah
PSA 59:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 59 · Forgiveness, Compassion] O LORD God of Hosts, the God of Israel, rouse Yourself to punish all the nations; show no mercy to the wicked traitors. Selah

PSA 59:6.text: They return in the evening, snarling like dogs and prowling around the city.
PSA 59:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 59] They return in the evening, snarling like dogs and prowling around the city.

PSA 59:7.text: See what they spew from their mouths— sharp words from their lips: “For who can hear us?”
PSA 59:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 59] See what they spew from their mouths— sharp words from their lips: “For who can hear us?”

PSA 59:8.text: But You, O LORD, laugh at them; You scoff at all the nations.
PSA 59:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 59] But You, O LORD, laugh at them; You scoff at all the nations.

PSA 59:9.text: I will keep watch for You, O my strength, because You, O God, are my fortress.
PSA 59:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 59] I will keep watch for You, O my strength, because You, O God, are my fortress.

PSA 59:10.text: My God of loving devotion will come to meet me; God will let me stare down my foes.
PSA 59:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 59 · Devotion] My God of loving devotion will come to meet me; God will let me stare down my foes.

PSA 59:11.text: Do not kill them, or my people will forget. Scatter them by Your power, and bring them down, O Lord, our shield.
PSA 59:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 59] Do not kill them, or my people will forget. Scatter them by Your power, and bring them down, O Lord, our shield.

PSA 59:12.text: By the sins of their mouths and the words of their lips, let them be trapped in their pride, in the curses and lies they utter.
PSA 59:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 59] By the sins of their mouths and the words of their lips, let them be trapped in their pride, in the curses and lies they utter.

PSA 59:13.text: Consume them in wrath; consume them till they are no more, so it may be known to the ends of the earth that God rules over Jacob. Selah
PSA 59:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 59 · Israel] Consume them in wrath; consume them till they are no more, so it may be known to the ends of the earth that God rules over Jacob. Selah

PSA 59:14.text: They return in the evening, snarling like dogs and prowling around the city.
PSA 59:14.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 59] They return in the evening, snarling like dogs and prowling around the city.

PSA 59:15.text: They scavenge for food, and growl if they are not satisfied.
PSA 59:15.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 59] They scavenge for food, and growl if they are not satisfied.

PSA 59:16.text: But I will sing of Your strength and proclaim Your loving devotion in the morning. For You are my fortress, my refuge in times of trouble.
PSA 59:16.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 59 · Devotion, End Times] But I will sing of Your strength and proclaim Your loving devotion in the morning. For You are my fortress, my refuge in times of trouble.

PSA 59:17.text: To You, O my strength, I sing praises, for You, O God, are my fortress, my God of loving devotion.
PSA 59:17.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 59 · Devotion] To You, O my strength, I sing praises, for You, O God, are my fortress, my God of loving devotion.

PSA 60:1.text: You have rejected us, O God; You have broken us; You have been angry; restore us!
PSA 60:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 60] You have rejected us, O God; You have broken us; You have been angry; restore us!

PSA 60:2.text: You have shaken the land and torn it open. Heal its fractures, for it is quaking.
PSA 60:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 60] You have shaken the land and torn it open. Heal its fractures, for it is quaking.

PSA 60:3.text: You have shown Your people hardship; we are staggered from the wine You made us drink.
PSA 60:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 60] You have shown Your people hardship; we are staggered from the wine You made us drink.

PSA 60:4.text: You have raised a banner for those who fear You, that they may flee the bow. Selah
PSA 60:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 60] You have raised a banner for those who fear You, that they may flee the bow. Selah

PSA 60:5.text: Respond and save us with Your right hand, that Your beloved may be delivered.
PSA 60:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 60 · Love] Respond and save us with Your right hand, that Your beloved may be delivered.

PSA 60:6.text: God has spoken from His sanctuary: “I will triumph! I will parcel out Shechem and apportion the Valley of Succoth.
PSA 60:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 60] God has spoken from His sanctuary: “I will triumph! I will parcel out Shechem and apportion the Valley of Succoth.

PSA 60:7.text: Gilead is Mine, and Manasseh is Mine; Ephraim is My helmet, Judah is My scepter.
PSA 60:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 60] Gilead is Mine, and Manasseh is Mine; Ephraim is My helmet, Judah is My scepter.

PSA 60:8.text: Moab is My washbasin; upon Edom I toss My sandal; over Philistia I shout in triumph.”
PSA 60:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 60] Moab is My washbasin; upon Edom I toss My sandal; over Philistia I shout in triumph.”

PSA 60:9.text: Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?
PSA 60:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 60] Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?

PSA 60:10.text: Have You not rejected us, O God? Will You no longer march out, O God, with our armies?
PSA 60:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 60] Have You not rejected us, O God? Will You no longer march out, O God, with our armies?

PSA 60:11.text: Give us aid against the enemy, for the help of man is worthless.
PSA 60:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 60] Give us aid against the enemy, for the help of man is worthless.

PSA 60:12.text: With God we will perform with valor, and He will trample our enemies.
PSA 60:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 60] With God we will perform with valor, and He will trample our enemies.

PSA 61:1.text: Hear my cry, O God; attend to my prayer.
PSA 61:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 61] Hear my cry, O God; attend to my prayer.

PSA 61:2.text: From the ends of the earth I call out to You whenever my heart is faint. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
PSA 61:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 61 · Adultery In Heart] From the ends of the earth I call out to You whenever my heart is faint. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.

PSA 61:3.text: For You have been my refuge, a tower of strength against the enemy.
PSA 61:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 61] For You have been my refuge, a tower of strength against the enemy.

PSA 61:4.text: Let me dwell in Your tent forever and take refuge in the shelter of Your wings. Selah
PSA 61:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 61] Let me dwell in Your tent forever and take refuge in the shelter of Your wings. Selah

PSA 61:5.text: For You have heard my vows, O God; You have given me the inheritance reserved for those who fear Your name.
PSA 61:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 61 · Inheritance] For You have heard my vows, O God; You have given me the inheritance reserved for those who fear Your name.

PSA 61:6.text: Increase the days of the king’s life; may his years span many generations.
PSA 61:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 61] Increase the days of the king’s life; may his years span many generations.

PSA 61:7.text: May he sit enthroned in God’s presence forever; appoint Your loving devotion and Your faithfulness to guard him.
PSA 61:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 61 · Faith, Devotion] May he sit enthroned in God’s presence forever; appoint Your loving devotion and Your faithfulness to guard him.

PSA 61:8.text: Then I will ever sing praise to Your name and fulfill my vows day by day.
PSA 61:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 61] Then I will ever sing praise to Your name and fulfill my vows day by day.

PSA 62:1.text: In God alone my soul finds rest; my salvation comes from Him.
PSA 62:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 62] In God alone my soul finds rest; my salvation comes from Him.

PSA 62:2.text: He alone is my rock and my salvation. He is my fortress; I will never be shaken.
PSA 62:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 62] He alone is my rock and my salvation. He is my fortress; I will never be shaken.

PSA 62:3.text: How long will you threaten a man? Will all of you throw him down like a leaning wall or a tottering fence?
PSA 62:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 62] How long will you threaten a man? Will all of you throw him down like a leaning wall or a tottering fence?

PSA 62:4.text: They fully intend to cast him down from his lofty perch; they delight in lies; with their mouths they bless, but inwardly they curse. Selah
PSA 62:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 62 · Curse God] They fully intend to cast him down from his lofty perch; they delight in lies; with their mouths they bless, but inwardly they curse. Selah

PSA 62:5.text: Rest in God alone, O my soul, for my hope comes from Him.
PSA 62:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 62] Rest in God alone, O my soul, for my hope comes from Him.

PSA 62:6.text: He alone is my rock and my salvation; He is my fortress; I will not be shaken.
PSA 62:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 62] He alone is my rock and my salvation; He is my fortress; I will not be shaken.

PSA 62:7.text: My salvation and my honor rest on God, my strong rock; my refuge is in God.
PSA 62:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 62] My salvation and my honor rest on God, my strong rock; my refuge is in God.

PSA 62:8.text: Trust in Him at all times, O people; pour out your hearts before Him. God is our refuge. Selah
PSA 62:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 62 · Faith, End Times] Trust in Him at all times, O people; pour out your hearts before Him. God is our refuge. Selah

PSA 62:9.text: Lowborn men are but a vapor, the exalted but a lie. Weighed on the scale, they go up; together they are but a vapor.
PSA 62:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 62 · Ascension] Lowborn men are but a vapor, the exalted but a lie. Weighed on the scale, they go up; together they are but a vapor.

PSA 62:10.text: Place no trust in extortion, or false hope in stolen goods. If your riches increase, do not set your heart upon them.
PSA 62:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 62 · Faith, Adultery In Heart] Place no trust in extortion, or false hope in stolen goods. If your riches increase, do not set your heart upon them.

PSA 62:11.text: God has spoken once; I have heard this twice: that power belongs to God,
PSA 62:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 62] God has spoken once; I have heard this twice: that power belongs to God,

PSA 62:12.text: and loving devotion to You, O Lord. For You will repay each man according to his deeds.
PSA 62:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 62 · Devotion] and loving devotion to You, O Lord. For You will repay each man according to his deeds.

PSA 63:1.text: O God, You are my God. Earnestly I seek You; my soul thirsts for You. My body yearns for You in a dry and weary land without water.
PSA 63:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 63] O God, You are my God. Earnestly I seek You; my soul thirsts for You. My body yearns for You in a dry and weary land without water.

PSA 63:2.text: So I have seen You in the sanctuary and beheld Your power and glory.
PSA 63:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 63 · Glory] So I have seen You in the sanctuary and beheld Your power and glory.

PSA 63:3.text: Because Your loving devotion is better than life, my lips will glorify You.
PSA 63:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 63 · Devotion] Because Your loving devotion is better than life, my lips will glorify You.

PSA 63:4.text: So I will bless You as long as I live; in Your name I will lift my hands.
PSA 63:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 63] So I will bless You as long as I live; in Your name I will lift my hands.

PSA 63:5.text: My soul is satisfied as with the richest of foods; with joyful lips my mouth will praise You.
PSA 63:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 63] My soul is satisfied as with the richest of foods; with joyful lips my mouth will praise You.

PSA 63:6.text: When I remember You on my bed, I think of You through the watches of the night.
PSA 63:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 63] When I remember You on my bed, I think of You through the watches of the night.

PSA 63:7.text: For You are my help; I will sing for joy in the shadow of Your wings.
PSA 63:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 63] For You are my help; I will sing for joy in the shadow of Your wings.

PSA 63:8.text: My soul clings to You; Your right hand upholds me.
PSA 63:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 63] My soul clings to You; Your right hand upholds me.

PSA 63:9.text: But those who seek my life to destroy it will go into the depths of the earth.
PSA 63:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 63 · Destroy Canaan, Destroy Canaanites] But those who seek my life to destroy it will go into the depths of the earth.

PSA 63:10.text: They will fall to the power of the sword; they will become a portion for foxes.
PSA 63:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 63 · Inheritance] They will fall to the power of the sword; they will become a portion for foxes.

PSA 63:11.text: But the king will rejoice in God; all who swear by Him will exult, for the mouths of liars will be shut.
PSA 63:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 63] But the king will rejoice in God; all who swear by Him will exult, for the mouths of liars will be shut.

PSA 64:1.text: Hear, O God, my voice of complaint; preserve my life from dread of the enemy.
PSA 64:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 64 · Fear] Hear, O God, my voice of complaint; preserve my life from dread of the enemy.

PSA 64:2.text: Hide me from the scheming of the wicked, from the mob of workers of iniquity,
PSA 64:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 64] Hide me from the scheming of the wicked, from the mob of workers of iniquity,

PSA 64:3.text: who sharpen their tongues like swords and aim their bitter words like arrows,
PSA 64:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 64] who sharpen their tongues like swords and aim their bitter words like arrows,

PSA 64:4.text: ambushing the innocent in seclusion, shooting suddenly, without fear.
PSA 64:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 64] ambushing the innocent in seclusion, shooting suddenly, without fear.

PSA 64:5.text: They hold fast to their evil purpose; they speak of hiding their snares. “Who will see them?” they say.
PSA 64:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 64] They hold fast to their evil purpose; they speak of hiding their snares. “Who will see them?” they say.

PSA 64:6.text: They devise injustice and say, “We have perfected a secret plan.” For the inner man and the heart are mysterious.
PSA 64:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 64 · Adultery In Heart] They devise injustice and say, “We have perfected a secret plan.” For the inner man and the heart are mysterious.

PSA 64:7.text: But God will shoot them with arrows; suddenly they will be wounded.
PSA 64:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 64] But God will shoot them with arrows; suddenly they will be wounded.

PSA 64:8.text: They will be made to stumble, their own tongues turned against them. All who see will shake their heads.
PSA 64:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 64] They will be made to stumble, their own tongues turned against them. All who see will shake their heads.

PSA 64:9.text: Then all mankind will fear and proclaim the work of God; so they will ponder what He has done.
PSA 64:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 64] Then all mankind will fear and proclaim the work of God; so they will ponder what He has done.

PSA 64:10.text: Let the righteous rejoice in the LORD and take refuge in Him; let all the upright in heart exult.
PSA 64:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 64 · Adultery In Heart] Let the righteous rejoice in the LORD and take refuge in Him; let all the upright in heart exult.

PSA 65:1.text: Praise awaits You, O God, in Zion; to You our vows will be fulfilled.
PSA 65:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 65] Praise awaits You, O God, in Zion; to You our vows will be fulfilled.

PSA 65:2.text: O You who listen to prayer, all people will come to You.
PSA 65:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 65] O You who listen to prayer, all people will come to You.

PSA 65:3.text: When iniquities prevail against me, You atone for our transgressions.
PSA 65:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 65] When iniquities prevail against me, You atone for our transgressions.

PSA 65:4.text: Blessed is the one You choose and bring near to dwell in Your courts! We are filled with the goodness of Your house, the holiness of Your temple.
PSA 65:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 65 · Holiness] Blessed is the one You choose and bring near to dwell in Your courts! We are filled with the goodness of Your house, the holiness of Your temple.

PSA 65:5.text: With awesome deeds of righteousness You answer us, O God of our salvation, the hope of all the ends of the earth and of the farthest seas.
PSA 65:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 65] With awesome deeds of righteousness You answer us, O God of our salvation, the hope of all the ends of the earth and of the farthest seas.

PSA 65:6.text: You formed the mountains by Your power, having girded Yourself with might.
PSA 65:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 65] You formed the mountains by Your power, having girded Yourself with might.

PSA 65:7.text: You stilled the roaring of the seas, the pounding of their waves, and the tumult of the nations.
PSA 65:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 65] You stilled the roaring of the seas, the pounding of their waves, and the tumult of the nations.

PSA 65:8.text: Those who live far away fear Your wonders; You make the dawn and sunset shout for joy.
PSA 65:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 65] Those who live far away fear Your wonders; You make the dawn and sunset shout for joy.

PSA 65:9.text: You attend to the earth and water it; with abundance You enrich it. The streams of God are full of water, for You prepare our grain by providing for the earth.
PSA 65:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 65] You attend to the earth and water it; with abundance You enrich it. The streams of God are full of water, for You prepare our grain by providing for the earth.

PSA 65:10.text: You soak its furrows and level its ridges; You soften it with showers and bless its growth.
PSA 65:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 65] You soak its furrows and level its ridges; You soften it with showers and bless its growth.

PSA 65:11.text: You crown the year with Your bounty, and Your paths overflow with plenty.
PSA 65:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 65] You crown the year with Your bounty, and Your paths overflow with plenty.

PSA 65:12.text: The pastures of the wilderness overflow; the hills are robed with joy.
PSA 65:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 65] The pastures of the wilderness overflow; the hills are robed with joy.

PSA 65:13.text: The pastures are clothed with flocks, and the valleys are decked with grain. They shout in triumph; indeed, they sing.
PSA 65:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 65] The pastures are clothed with flocks, and the valleys are decked with grain. They shout in triumph; indeed, they sing.

PSA 66:1.text: Make a joyful noise to God, all the earth!
PSA 66:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 66] Make a joyful noise to God, all the earth!

PSA 66:2.text: Sing the glory of His name; make His praise glorious.
PSA 66:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 66 · Glory] Sing the glory of His name; make His praise glorious.

PSA 66:3.text: Say to God, “How awesome are Your deeds! So great is Your power that Your enemies cower before You.
PSA 66:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 66] Say to God, “How awesome are Your deeds! So great is Your power that Your enemies cower before You.

PSA 66:4.text: All the earth bows down to You; they sing praise to You; they sing praise to Your name.” Selah
PSA 66:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 66] All the earth bows down to You; they sing praise to You; they sing praise to Your name.” Selah

PSA 66:5.text: Come and see the works of God; how awesome are His deeds toward mankind.
PSA 66:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 66] Come and see the works of God; how awesome are His deeds toward mankind.

PSA 66:6.text: He turned the sea into dry land; they passed through the waters on foot; there we rejoiced in Him.
PSA 66:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 66] He turned the sea into dry land; they passed through the waters on foot; there we rejoiced in Him.

PSA 66:7.text: He rules forever by His power; His eyes watch the nations. Do not let the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah
PSA 66:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 66] He rules forever by His power; His eyes watch the nations. Do not let the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah

PSA 66:8.text: Bless our God, O peoples; let the sound of His praise be heard.
PSA 66:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 66] Bless our God, O peoples; let the sound of His praise be heard.

PSA 66:9.text: He preserves our lives and keeps our feet from slipping.
PSA 66:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 66] He preserves our lives and keeps our feet from slipping.

PSA 66:10.text: For You, O God, have tested us; You have refined us like silver.
PSA 66:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 66] For You, O God, have tested us; You have refined us like silver.

PSA 66:11.text: You led us into the net; You laid burdens on our backs.
PSA 66:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 66] You led us into the net; You laid burdens on our backs.

PSA 66:12.text: You let men ride over our heads; we went through fire and water, but You brought us into abundance.
PSA 66:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 66] You let men ride over our heads; we went through fire and water, but You brought us into abundance.

PSA 66:13.text: I will enter Your house with burnt offerings; I will fulfill my vows to You—
PSA 66:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 66] I will enter Your house with burnt offerings; I will fulfill my vows to You—

PSA 66:14.text: the vows that my lips promised and my mouth spoke in my distress.
PSA 66:14.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 66] the vows that my lips promised and my mouth spoke in my distress.

PSA 66:15.text: I will offer You fatlings as burnt offerings, with the fragrant smoke of rams; I will offer bulls and goats. Selah
PSA 66:15.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 66] I will offer You fatlings as burnt offerings, with the fragrant smoke of rams; I will offer bulls and goats. Selah

PSA 66:16.text: Come and listen, all you who fear God, and I will declare what He has done for me.
PSA 66:16.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 66] Come and listen, all you who fear God, and I will declare what He has done for me.

PSA 66:17.text: I cried out to Him with my mouth and praised Him with my tongue.
PSA 66:17.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 66] I cried out to Him with my mouth and praised Him with my tongue.

PSA 66:18.text: If I had cherished iniquity in my heart, the Lord would not have listened.
PSA 66:18.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 66 · Adultery In Heart] If I had cherished iniquity in my heart, the Lord would not have listened.

PSA 66:19.text: But God has surely heard; He has attended to the sound of my prayer.
PSA 66:19.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 66] But God has surely heard; He has attended to the sound of my prayer.

PSA 66:20.text: Blessed be God, who has not rejected my prayer or withheld from me His loving devotion!
PSA 66:20.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 66 · Devotion] Blessed be God, who has not rejected my prayer or withheld from me His loving devotion!

PSA 67:1.text: May God be gracious to us and bless us, and cause His face to shine upon us, Selah
PSA 67:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 67] May God be gracious to us and bless us, and cause His face to shine upon us, Selah

PSA 67:2.text: that Your ways may be known on earth, Your salvation among all nations.
PSA 67:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 67] that Your ways may be known on earth, Your salvation among all nations.

PSA 67:3.text: Let the peoples praise You, O God; let all the peoples praise You.
PSA 67:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 67] Let the peoples praise You, O God; let all the peoples praise You.

PSA 67:4.text: Let the nations be glad and sing for joy, for You judge the peoples justly and lead the nations of the earth. Selah
PSA 67:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 67] Let the nations be glad and sing for joy, for You judge the peoples justly and lead the nations of the earth. Selah

PSA 67:5.text: Let the peoples praise You, O God; let all the peoples praise You.
PSA 67:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 67] Let the peoples praise You, O God; let all the peoples praise You.

PSA 67:6.text: The earth has yielded its harvest; God, our God, blesses us.
PSA 67:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 67] The earth has yielded its harvest; God, our God, blesses us.

PSA 67:7.text: God blesses us, that all the ends of the earth shall fear Him.
PSA 67:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 67] God blesses us, that all the ends of the earth shall fear Him.

PSA 68:1.text: God arises. His enemies are scattered, and those who hate Him flee His presence.
PSA 68:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 68] God arises. His enemies are scattered, and those who hate Him flee His presence.

PSA 68:2.text: As smoke is blown away, You will drive them out; as wax melts before the fire, the wicked will perish in the presence of God.
PSA 68:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 68] As smoke is blown away, You will drive them out; as wax melts before the fire, the wicked will perish in the presence of God.

PSA 68:3.text: But the righteous will be glad and rejoice before God; they will celebrate with joy.
PSA 68:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 68] But the righteous will be glad and rejoice before God; they will celebrate with joy.

PSA 68:4.text: Sing to God! Sing praises to His name. Exalt Him who rides on the clouds— His name is the LORD— and rejoice before Him.
PSA 68:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 68] Sing to God! Sing praises to His name. Exalt Him who rides on the clouds— His name is the LORD— and rejoice before Him.

PSA 68:5.text: A father of the fatherless, and a defender of the widows, is God in His holy habitation.
PSA 68:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 68 · God the Father] A father of the fatherless, and a defender of the widows, is God in His holy habitation.

PSA 68:6.text: God settles the lonely in families; He leads the prisoners out to prosperity, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.
PSA 68:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 68 · Blessing] God settles the lonely in families; He leads the prisoners out to prosperity, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.

PSA 68:7.text: O God, when You went out before Your people, when You marched through the wasteland, Selah
PSA 68:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 68] O God, when You went out before Your people, when You marched through the wasteland, Selah

PSA 68:8.text: the earth shook and the heavens poured down rain before God, the One on Sinai, before God, the God of Israel.
PSA 68:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 68 · Israel] the earth shook and the heavens poured down rain before God, the One on Sinai, before God, the God of Israel.

PSA 68:9.text: You sent abundant rain, O God; You refreshed Your weary inheritance.
PSA 68:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 68 · Inheritance] You sent abundant rain, O God; You refreshed Your weary inheritance.

PSA 68:10.text: Your flock settled therein; O God, from Your bounty You provided for the poor.
PSA 68:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 68] Your flock settled therein; O God, from Your bounty You provided for the poor.

PSA 68:11.text: The Lord gives the command; a great company of women proclaim it:
PSA 68:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 68 · Biblical Women, Heroic Women] The Lord gives the command; a great company of women proclaim it:

PSA 68:12.text: “Kings and their armies flee in haste; she who waits at home divides the plunder.
PSA 68:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 68] “Kings and their armies flee in haste; she who waits at home divides the plunder.

PSA 68:13.text: Though you lie down among the sheepfolds, the wings of the dove are covered with silver, and her feathers with shimmering gold.”
PSA 68:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 68] Though you lie down among the sheepfolds, the wings of the dove are covered with silver, and her feathers with shimmering gold.”

PSA 68:14.text: When the Almighty scattered the kings in the land, it was like the snow falling on Zalmon.
PSA 68:14.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 68] When the Almighty scattered the kings in the land, it was like the snow falling on Zalmon.

PSA 68:15.text: A mountain of God is Mount Bashan; a mountain of many peaks is Mount Bashan.
PSA 68:15.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 68] A mountain of God is Mount Bashan; a mountain of many peaks is Mount Bashan.

PSA 68:16.text: Why do you gaze in envy, O mountains of many peaks? This is the mountain God chose for His dwelling, where the LORD will surely dwell forever.
PSA 68:16.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 68 · Jealousy] Why do you gaze in envy, O mountains of many peaks? This is the mountain God chose for His dwelling, where the LORD will surely dwell forever.

PSA 68:17.text: The chariots of God are tens of thousands— thousands of thousands are they; the Lord is in His sanctuary as He was at Sinai.
PSA 68:17.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 68] The chariots of God are tens of thousands— thousands of thousands are they; the Lord is in His sanctuary as He was at Sinai.

PSA 68:18.text: You have ascended on high; You have led captives away. You have received gifts from men, even from the rebellious, that the LORD God may dwell there.
PSA 68:18.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 68] You have ascended on high; You have led captives away. You have received gifts from men, even from the rebellious, that the LORD God may dwell there.

PSA 68:19.text: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burden, the God of our salvation. Selah
PSA 68:19.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 68] Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burden, the God of our salvation. Selah

PSA 68:20.text: Our God is a God of deliverance; the Lord GOD is our rescuer from death.
PSA 68:20.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 68 · Death] Our God is a God of deliverance; the Lord GOD is our rescuer from death.

PSA 68:21.text: Surely God will crush the heads of His enemies, the hairy crowns of those who persist in guilty ways.
PSA 68:21.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 68] Surely God will crush the heads of His enemies, the hairy crowns of those who persist in guilty ways.

PSA 68:22.text: The Lord said, “I will retrieve them from Bashan, I will bring them up from the depths of the sea,
PSA 68:22.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 68] The Lord said, “I will retrieve them from Bashan, I will bring them up from the depths of the sea,

PSA 68:23.text: that your foot may be dipped in the blood of your foes— the tongues of your dogs in the same.”
PSA 68:23.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 68] that your foot may be dipped in the blood of your foes— the tongues of your dogs in the same.”

PSA 68:24.text: They have seen Your procession, O God— the march of my God and King into the sanctuary.
PSA 68:24.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 68] They have seen Your procession, O God— the march of my God and King into the sanctuary.

PSA 68:25.text: The singers lead the way, the musicians follow after, among the maidens playing tambourines.
PSA 68:25.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 68] The singers lead the way, the musicians follow after, among the maidens playing tambourines.

PSA 68:26.text: Bless God in the great congregation; bless the LORD from the fountain of Israel.
PSA 68:26.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 68 · Israel] Bless God in the great congregation; bless the LORD from the fountain of Israel.

PSA 68:27.text: There is Benjamin, the youngest, ruling them, the princes of Judah in their company, the princes of Zebulun and of Naphtali.
PSA 68:27.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 68] There is Benjamin, the youngest, ruling them, the princes of Judah in their company, the princes of Zebulun and of Naphtali.

PSA 68:28.text: Summon Your power, O God; show Your strength, O God, which You have exerted on our behalf.
PSA 68:28.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 68] Summon Your power, O God; show Your strength, O God, which You have exerted on our behalf.

PSA 68:29.text: Because of Your temple at Jerusalem kings will bring You gifts.
PSA 68:29.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 68] Because of Your temple at Jerusalem kings will bring You gifts.

PSA 68:30.text: Rebuke the beast in the reeds, the herd of bulls among the calves of the nations, until it submits, bringing bars of silver. Scatter the nations who delight in war.
PSA 68:30.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 68 · Antichrist] Rebuke the beast in the reeds, the herd of bulls among the calves of the nations, until it submits, bringing bars of silver. Scatter the nations who delight in war.

PSA 68:31.text: Envoys will arrive from Egypt; Cush will stretch out her hands to God.
PSA 68:31.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 68] Envoys will arrive from Egypt; Cush will stretch out her hands to God.

PSA 68:32.text: Sing to God, O kingdoms of the earth; sing praises to the Lord— Selah
PSA 68:32.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 68] Sing to God, O kingdoms of the earth; sing praises to the Lord— Selah

PSA 68:33.text: to Him who rides upon the highest heavens of old; behold, His mighty voice resounds.
PSA 68:33.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 68] to Him who rides upon the highest heavens of old; behold, His mighty voice resounds.

PSA 68:34.text: Ascribe the power to God, whose majesty is over Israel, whose strength is in the skies.
PSA 68:34.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 68 · Glory, Israel] Ascribe the power to God, whose majesty is over Israel, whose strength is in the skies.

PSA 68:35.text: O God, You are awesome in Your sanctuary; the God of Israel Himself gives strength and power to His people.   Blessed be God!
PSA 68:35.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 68 · Israel] O God, You are awesome in Your sanctuary; the God of Israel Himself gives strength and power to His people.   Blessed be God!

PSA 69:1.text: Save me, O God, for the waters are up to my neck.
PSA 69:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 69] Save me, O God, for the waters are up to my neck.

PSA 69:2.text: I have sunk into the miry depths, where there is no footing; I have drifted into deep waters, where the flood engulfs me.
PSA 69:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 69] I have sunk into the miry depths, where there is no footing; I have drifted into deep waters, where the flood engulfs me.

PSA 69:3.text: I am weary from my crying; my throat is parched. My eyes fail, looking for my God.
PSA 69:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 69] I am weary from my crying; my throat is parched. My eyes fail, looking for my God.

PSA 69:4.text: Those who hate me without cause outnumber the hairs of my head; many are those who would destroy me— my enemies for no reason. Though I did not steal, I must repay.
PSA 69:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 69 · Destroy Canaan, Destroy Canaanites] Those who hate me without cause outnumber the hairs of my head; many are those who would destroy me— my enemies for no reason. Though I did not steal, I must repay.

PSA 69:5.text: You know my folly, O God, and my guilt is not hidden from You.
PSA 69:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 69] You know my folly, O God, and my guilt is not hidden from You.

PSA 69:6.text: May those who hope in You not be ashamed through me, O Lord GOD of Hosts; may those who seek You not be dishonored through me, O God of Israel.
PSA 69:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 69 · Israel] May those who hope in You not be ashamed through me, O Lord GOD of Hosts; may those who seek You not be dishonored through me, O God of Israel.

PSA 69:7.text: For I have endured scorn for Your sake, and shame has covered my face.
PSA 69:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 69] For I have endured scorn for Your sake, and shame has covered my face.

PSA 69:8.text: I have become a stranger to my brothers and a foreigner to my mother’s sons,
PSA 69:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 69] I have become a stranger to my brothers and a foreigner to my mother’s sons,

PSA 69:9.text: because zeal for Your house has consumed me, and the insults of those who insult You have fallen on me.
PSA 69:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 69] because zeal for Your house has consumed me, and the insults of those who insult You have fallen on me.

PSA 69:10.text: I wept and fasted, but it brought me reproach.
PSA 69:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 69] I wept and fasted, but it brought me reproach.

PSA 69:11.text: I made sackcloth my clothing, and I was sport to them.
PSA 69:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 69] I made sackcloth my clothing, and I was sport to them.

PSA 69:12.text: Those who sit at the gate mock me, and I am the song of drunkards.
PSA 69:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 69] Those who sit at the gate mock me, and I am the song of drunkards.

PSA 69:13.text: But my prayer to You, O LORD, is for a time of favor. In Your abundant loving devotion, O God, answer me with Your sure salvation.
PSA 69:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 69 · Blessing, Devotion] But my prayer to You, O LORD, is for a time of favor. In Your abundant loving devotion, O God, answer me with Your sure salvation.

PSA 69:14.text: Rescue me from the mire and do not let me sink; deliver me from my foes and out of the deep waters.
PSA 69:14.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 69] Rescue me from the mire and do not let me sink; deliver me from my foes and out of the deep waters.

PSA 69:15.text: Do not let the floods engulf me or the depths swallow me up; let not the Pit close its mouth over me.
PSA 69:15.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 69] Do not let the floods engulf me or the depths swallow me up; let not the Pit close its mouth over me.

PSA 69:16.text: Answer me, O LORD, for Your loving devotion is good; turn to me in keeping with Your great compassion.
PSA 69:16.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 69 · Compassion, Devotion] Answer me, O LORD, for Your loving devotion is good; turn to me in keeping with Your great compassion.

PSA 69:17.text: Hide not Your face from Your servant, for I am in distress. Answer me quickly!
PSA 69:17.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 69] Hide not Your face from Your servant, for I am in distress. Answer me quickly!

PSA 69:18.text: Draw near to my soul and redeem me; ransom me because of my foes.
PSA 69:18.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 69] Draw near to my soul and redeem me; ransom me because of my foes.

PSA 69:19.text: You know my reproach, my shame and disgrace. All my adversaries are before You.
PSA 69:19.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 69] You know my reproach, my shame and disgrace. All my adversaries are before You.

PSA 69:20.text: Insults have broken my heart, and I am in despair. I looked for sympathy, but there was none, for comforters, but I found no one.
PSA 69:20.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 69 · Adultery In Heart] Insults have broken my heart, and I am in despair. I looked for sympathy, but there was none, for comforters, but I found no one.

PSA 69:21.text: They poisoned my food with gall and gave me vinegar to quench my thirst.
PSA 69:21.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 69] They poisoned my food with gall and gave me vinegar to quench my thirst.

PSA 69:22.text: May their table become a snare; may it be a retribution and a trap.
PSA 69:22.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 69] May their table become a snare; may it be a retribution and a trap.

PSA 69:23.text: May their eyes be darkened so they cannot see, and their backs be bent forever.
PSA 69:23.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 69] May their eyes be darkened so they cannot see, and their backs be bent forever.

PSA 69:24.text: Pour out Your wrath upon them, and let Your burning anger overtake them.
PSA 69:24.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 69] Pour out Your wrath upon them, and let Your burning anger overtake them.

PSA 69:25.text: May their place be deserted; let there be no one to dwell in their tents.
PSA 69:25.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 69] May their place be deserted; let there be no one to dwell in their tents.

PSA 69:26.text: For they persecute the one You struck and recount the pain of those You wounded.
PSA 69:26.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 69] For they persecute the one You struck and recount the pain of those You wounded.

PSA 69:27.text: Add iniquity to their iniquity; let them not share in Your righteousness.
PSA 69:27.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 69] Add iniquity to their iniquity; let them not share in Your righteousness.

PSA 69:28.text: May they be blotted out of the Book of Life and not listed with the righteous.
PSA 69:28.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 69] May they be blotted out of the Book of Life and not listed with the righteous.

PSA 69:29.text: But I am in pain and distress; let Your salvation protect me, O God.
PSA 69:29.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 69] But I am in pain and distress; let Your salvation protect me, O God.

PSA 69:30.text: I will praise God’s name in song and exalt Him with thanksgiving.
PSA 69:30.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 69 · Gratitude] I will praise God’s name in song and exalt Him with thanksgiving.

PSA 69:31.text: And this will please the LORD more than an ox, more than a bull with horns and hooves.
PSA 69:31.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 69] And this will please the LORD more than an ox, more than a bull with horns and hooves.

PSA 69:32.text: The humble will see and rejoice. You who seek God, let your hearts be revived!
PSA 69:32.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 69] The humble will see and rejoice. You who seek God, let your hearts be revived!

PSA 69:33.text: For the LORD listens to the needy and does not despise His captive people.
PSA 69:33.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 69] For the LORD listens to the needy and does not despise His captive people.

PSA 69:34.text: Let heaven and earth praise Him, the seas and everything that moves in them.
PSA 69:34.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 69 · Heaven] Let heaven and earth praise Him, the seas and everything that moves in them.

PSA 69:35.text: For God will save Zion and rebuild the cities of Judah, that they may dwell there and possess it.
PSA 69:35.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 69] For God will save Zion and rebuild the cities of Judah, that they may dwell there and possess it.

PSA 69:36.text: The descendants of His servants will inherit it, and those who love His name will settle in it.
PSA 69:36.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 69 · Love] The descendants of His servants will inherit it, and those who love His name will settle in it.

PSA 70:1.text: Make haste, O God, to deliver me! Hurry, O LORD, to help me!
PSA 70:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 70] Make haste, O God, to deliver me! Hurry, O LORD, to help me!

PSA 70:2.text: May those who seek my life be ashamed and confounded; may those who wish me harm be repelled and humiliated.
PSA 70:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 70] May those who seek my life be ashamed and confounded; may those who wish me harm be repelled and humiliated.

PSA 70:3.text: May those who say, “Aha, aha!” retreat because of their shame.
PSA 70:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 70] May those who say, “Aha, aha!” retreat because of their shame.

PSA 70:4.text: May all who seek You rejoice and be glad in You; may those who love Your salvation always say, “Let God be magnified!”
PSA 70:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 70 · Love] May all who seek You rejoice and be glad in You; may those who love Your salvation always say, “Let God be magnified!”

PSA 70:5.text: But I am poor and needy; hurry to me, O God. You are my help and my deliverer; O LORD, do not delay.
PSA 70:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 70] But I am poor and needy; hurry to me, O God. You are my help and my deliverer; O LORD, do not delay.

PSA 71:1.text: In You, O LORD, I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame.
PSA 71:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 71] In You, O LORD, I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame.

PSA 71:2.text: In Your justice, rescue and deliver me; incline Your ear and save me.
PSA 71:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 71 · Justice] In Your justice, rescue and deliver me; incline Your ear and save me.

PSA 71:3.text: Be my rock of refuge, where I can always go. Give the command to save me, for You are my rock and my fortress.
PSA 71:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 71] Be my rock of refuge, where I can always go. Give the command to save me, for You are my rock and my fortress.

PSA 71:4.text: Deliver me, O my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the grasp of the unjust and ruthless.
PSA 71:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 71] Deliver me, O my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the grasp of the unjust and ruthless.

PSA 71:5.text: For You are my hope, O Lord GOD, my confidence from my youth.
PSA 71:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 71 · Assurance] For You are my hope, O Lord GOD, my confidence from my youth.

PSA 71:6.text: I have leaned on You since birth; You pulled me from my mother’s womb. My praise is always for You.
PSA 71:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 71] I have leaned on You since birth; You pulled me from my mother’s womb. My praise is always for You.

PSA 71:7.text: I have become a portent to many, but You are my strong refuge.
PSA 71:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 71] I have become a portent to many, but You are my strong refuge.

PSA 71:8.text: My mouth is filled with Your praise and with Your splendor all day long.
PSA 71:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 71] My mouth is filled with Your praise and with Your splendor all day long.

PSA 71:9.text: Do not discard me in my old age; do not forsake me when my strength fails.
PSA 71:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 71] Do not discard me in my old age; do not forsake me when my strength fails.

PSA 71:10.text: For my enemies speak against me, and those who lie in wait for my life conspire,
PSA 71:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 71] For my enemies speak against me, and those who lie in wait for my life conspire,

PSA 71:11.text: saying, “God has forsaken him; pursue him and seize him, for there is no one to rescue him.”
PSA 71:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 71] saying, “God has forsaken him; pursue him and seize him, for there is no one to rescue him.”

PSA 71:12.text: Be not far from me, O God. Hurry, O my God, to help me.
PSA 71:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 71] Be not far from me, O God. Hurry, O my God, to help me.

PSA 71:13.text: May the accusers of my soul be ashamed and consumed; may those who seek my harm be covered with scorn and disgrace.
PSA 71:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 71] May the accusers of my soul be ashamed and consumed; may those who seek my harm be covered with scorn and disgrace.

PSA 71:14.text: But I will always hope and will praise You more and more.
PSA 71:14.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 71] But I will always hope and will praise You more and more.

PSA 71:15.text: My mouth will declare Your righteousness and Your salvation all day long, though I cannot know their full measure.
PSA 71:15.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 71] My mouth will declare Your righteousness and Your salvation all day long, though I cannot know their full measure.

PSA 71:16.text: I will enter in the strength of the Lord GOD; I will proclaim Your righteousness—Yours alone.
PSA 71:16.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 71] I will enter in the strength of the Lord GOD; I will proclaim Your righteousness—Yours alone.

PSA 71:17.text: O God, You have taught me from my youth, and to this day I proclaim Your marvelous deeds.
PSA 71:17.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 71] O God, You have taught me from my youth, and to this day I proclaim Your marvelous deeds.

PSA 71:18.text: Even when I am old and gray, do not forsake me, O God, until I proclaim Your power to the next generation, Your might to all who are to come.
PSA 71:18.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 71] Even when I am old and gray, do not forsake me, O God, until I proclaim Your power to the next generation, Your might to all who are to come.

PSA 71:19.text: Your righteousness reaches to the heavens, O God, You who have done great things. Who, O God, is like You?
PSA 71:19.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 71] Your righteousness reaches to the heavens, O God, You who have done great things. Who, O God, is like You?

PSA 71:20.text: Though You have shown me many troubles and misfortunes, You will revive me once again. Even from the depths of the earth You will bring me back up.
PSA 71:20.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 71] Though You have shown me many troubles and misfortunes, You will revive me once again. Even from the depths of the earth You will bring me back up.

PSA 71:21.text: You will increase my honor and comfort me once again.
PSA 71:21.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 71 · Comfort] You will increase my honor and comfort me once again.

PSA 71:22.text: So I will praise You with the harp for Your faithfulness, O my God; I will sing praise to You with the lyre, O Holy One of Israel.
PSA 71:22.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 71 · Faith, Israel] So I will praise You with the harp for Your faithfulness, O my God; I will sing praise to You with the lyre, O Holy One of Israel.

PSA 71:23.text: When I sing praise to You my lips will shout for joy, along with my soul, which You have redeemed.
PSA 71:23.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 71] When I sing praise to You my lips will shout for joy, along with my soul, which You have redeemed.

PSA 71:24.text: My tongue will indeed proclaim Your righteousness all day long, for those who seek my harm are disgraced and confounded.
PSA 71:24.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 71] My tongue will indeed proclaim Your righteousness all day long, for those who seek my harm are disgraced and confounded.

PSA 72:1.text: Endow the king with Your justice, O God, and the son of the king with Your righteousness.
PSA 72:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 72 · Justice] Endow the king with Your justice, O God, and the son of the king with Your righteousness.

PSA 72:2.text: May he judge Your people with righteousness and Your afflicted with justice.
PSA 72:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 72 · Justice] May he judge Your people with righteousness and Your afflicted with justice.

PSA 72:3.text: May the mountains bring peace to the people, and the hills bring righteousness.
PSA 72:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 72] May the mountains bring peace to the people, and the hills bring righteousness.

PSA 72:4.text: May he vindicate the afflicted among the people; may he save the children of the needy and crush the oppressor.
PSA 72:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 72 · Children] May he vindicate the afflicted among the people; may he save the children of the needy and crush the oppressor.

PSA 72:5.text: May they fear him as long as the sun shines, as long as the moon remains, through all generations.
PSA 72:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 72] May they fear him as long as the sun shines, as long as the moon remains, through all generations.

PSA 72:6.text: May he be like rain that falls on freshly cut grass, like spring showers that water the earth.
PSA 72:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 72] May he be like rain that falls on freshly cut grass, like spring showers that water the earth.

PSA 72:7.text: May the righteous flourish in his days and prosperity abound, until the moon is no more.
PSA 72:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 72 · Blessing] May the righteous flourish in his days and prosperity abound, until the moon is no more.

PSA 72:8.text: May he rule from sea to sea, and from the Euphrates to the ends of the earth.
PSA 72:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 72] May he rule from sea to sea, and from the Euphrates to the ends of the earth.

PSA 72:9.text: May the nomads bow before him, and his enemies lick the dust.
PSA 72:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 72] May the nomads bow before him, and his enemies lick the dust.

PSA 72:10.text: May the kings of Tarshish and distant shores bring tribute; may the kings of Sheba and Seba offer gifts.
PSA 72:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 72] May the kings of Tarshish and distant shores bring tribute; may the kings of Sheba and Seba offer gifts.

PSA 72:11.text: May all kings bow down to him and all nations serve him.
PSA 72:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 72] May all kings bow down to him and all nations serve him.

PSA 72:12.text: For he will deliver the needy who cry out and the afflicted who have no helper.
PSA 72:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 72] For he will deliver the needy who cry out and the afflicted who have no helper.

PSA 72:13.text: He will take pity on the poor and needy and save the lives of the oppressed.
PSA 72:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 72 · Compassion] He will take pity on the poor and needy and save the lives of the oppressed.

PSA 72:14.text: He will redeem them from oppression and violence, for their blood is precious in his sight.
PSA 72:14.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 72] He will redeem them from oppression and violence, for their blood is precious in his sight.

PSA 72:15.text: Long may he live! May gold from Sheba be given him. May people ever pray for him; may they bless him all day long.
PSA 72:15.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 72] Long may he live! May gold from Sheba be given him. May people ever pray for him; may they bless him all day long.

PSA 72:16.text: May there be an abundance of grain in the land; may it sway atop the hills. May its fruit trees flourish like the forests of Lebanon, and its people like the grass of the field.
PSA 72:16.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 72 · Fruit of the Spirit] May there be an abundance of grain in the land; may it sway atop the hills. May its fruit trees flourish like the forests of Lebanon, and its people like the grass of the field.

PSA 72:17.text: May his name endure forever; may his name continue as long as the sun shines. In him may all nations be blessed; may they call him blessed.
PSA 72:17.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 72] May his name endure forever; may his name continue as long as the sun shines. In him may all nations be blessed; may they call him blessed.

PSA 72:18.text: Blessed be the LORD God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.
PSA 72:18.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 72 · Israel] Blessed be the LORD God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.

PSA 72:19.text: And blessed be His glorious name forever; may all the earth be filled with His glory.   Amen and amen.
PSA 72:19.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 72 · Glory] And blessed be His glorious name forever; may all the earth be filled with His glory.   Amen and amen.

PSA 72:20.text: Thus conclude the prayers of David son of Jesse.
PSA 72:20.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 72] Thus conclude the prayers of David son of Jesse.

PSA 73:1.text: Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.
PSA 73:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 73 · Adultery In Heart, Israel] Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.

PSA 73:2.text: But as for me, my feet had almost stumbled; my steps had nearly slipped.
PSA 73:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 73] But as for me, my feet had almost stumbled; my steps had nearly slipped.

PSA 73:3.text: For I envied the arrogant when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
PSA 73:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 73 · Blessing] For I envied the arrogant when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

PSA 73:4.text: They have no struggle in their death; their bodies are well-fed.
PSA 73:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 73 · Death] They have no struggle in their death; their bodies are well-fed.

PSA 73:5.text: They are free of the burdens others carry; they are not afflicted like other men.
PSA 73:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 73] They are free of the burdens others carry; they are not afflicted like other men.

PSA 73:6.text: Therefore pride is their necklace; a garment of violence covers them.
PSA 73:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 73] Therefore pride is their necklace; a garment of violence covers them.

PSA 73:7.text: From their prosperity proceeds iniquity; the imaginations of their hearts run wild.
PSA 73:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 73 · Blessing] From their prosperity proceeds iniquity; the imaginations of their hearts run wild.

PSA 73:8.text: They mock and speak with malice; with arrogance they threaten oppression.
PSA 73:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 73] They mock and speak with malice; with arrogance they threaten oppression.

PSA 73:9.text: They set their mouths against the heavens, and their tongues strut across the earth.
PSA 73:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 73] They set their mouths against the heavens, and their tongues strut across the earth.

PSA 73:10.text: So their people return to this place and drink up waters in abundance.
PSA 73:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 73] So their people return to this place and drink up waters in abundance.

PSA 73:11.text: The wicked say, “How can God know? Does the Most High have knowledge?”
PSA 73:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 73] The wicked say, “How can God know? Does the Most High have knowledge?”

PSA 73:12.text: Behold, these are the wicked— always carefree as they increase their wealth.
PSA 73:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 73] Behold, these are the wicked— always carefree as they increase their wealth.

PSA 73:13.text: Surely in vain I have kept my heart pure; in innocence I have washed my hands.
PSA 73:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 73 · Adultery In Heart] Surely in vain I have kept my heart pure; in innocence I have washed my hands.

PSA 73:14.text: For I am afflicted all day long and punished every morning.
PSA 73:14.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 73] For I am afflicted all day long and punished every morning.

PSA 73:15.text: If I had said, “I will speak this way,” then I would have betrayed Your children.
PSA 73:15.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 73 · Children] If I had said, “I will speak this way,” then I would have betrayed Your children.

PSA 73:16.text: When I tried to understand all this, it was troublesome in my sight
PSA 73:16.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 73] When I tried to understand all this, it was troublesome in my sight

PSA 73:17.text: until I entered God’s sanctuary; then I discerned their end.
PSA 73:17.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 73] until I entered God’s sanctuary; then I discerned their end.

PSA 73:18.text: Surely You set them on slick ground; You cast them down into ruin.
PSA 73:18.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 73] Surely You set them on slick ground; You cast them down into ruin.

PSA 73:19.text: How suddenly they are laid waste, completely swept away by terrors!
PSA 73:19.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 73] How suddenly they are laid waste, completely swept away by terrors!

PSA 73:20.text: Like one waking from a dream, so You, O Lord, awaken and despise their form.
PSA 73:20.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 73] Like one waking from a dream, so You, O Lord, awaken and despise their form.

PSA 73:21.text: When my heart was grieved and I was pierced within,
PSA 73:21.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 73 · Adultery In Heart] When my heart was grieved and I was pierced within,

PSA 73:22.text: I was senseless and ignorant; I was a brute beast before You.
PSA 73:22.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 73 · Antichrist] I was senseless and ignorant; I was a brute beast before You.

PSA 73:23.text: Yet I am always with You; You hold my right hand.
PSA 73:23.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 73] Yet I am always with You; You hold my right hand.

PSA 73:24.text: You guide me with Your counsel, and later receive me in glory.
PSA 73:24.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 73 · Glory] You guide me with Your counsel, and later receive me in glory.

PSA 73:25.text: Whom have I in heaven but You? And on earth I desire no one besides You.
PSA 73:25.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 73 · Heaven, Lust] Whom have I in heaven but You? And on earth I desire no one besides You.

PSA 73:26.text: My flesh and my heart may fail, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
PSA 73:26.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 73 · Adultery In Heart, Inheritance] My flesh and my heart may fail, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.

PSA 73:27.text: Those far from You will surely perish; You destroy all who are unfaithful to You.
PSA 73:27.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 73 · Faith, Destroy Canaan] Those far from You will surely perish; You destroy all who are unfaithful to You.

PSA 73:28.text: But as for me, it is good to draw near to God. I have made the Lord GOD my refuge, that I may proclaim all Your works.
PSA 73:28.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 73] But as for me, it is good to draw near to God. I have made the Lord GOD my refuge, that I may proclaim all Your works.

PSA 74:1.text: Why have You rejected us forever, O God? Why does Your anger smolder against the sheep of Your pasture?
PSA 74:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 74] Why have You rejected us forever, O God? Why does Your anger smolder against the sheep of Your pasture?

PSA 74:2.text: Remember Your congregation, which You purchased long ago and redeemed as the tribe of Your inheritance— Mount Zion where You dwell.
PSA 74:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 74 · Inheritance] Remember Your congregation, which You purchased long ago and redeemed as the tribe of Your inheritance— Mount Zion where You dwell.

PSA 74:3.text: Turn Your steps to the everlasting ruins, to everything in the sanctuary the enemy has destroyed.
PSA 74:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 74] Turn Your steps to the everlasting ruins, to everything in the sanctuary the enemy has destroyed.

PSA 74:4.text: Your foes have roared within Your meeting place; they have unfurled their banners as signs,
PSA 74:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 74] Your foes have roared within Your meeting place; they have unfurled their banners as signs,

PSA 74:5.text: like men wielding axes in a thicket of trees
PSA 74:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 74] like men wielding axes in a thicket of trees

PSA 74:6.text: and smashing all the carvings with hatchets and picks.
PSA 74:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 74] and smashing all the carvings with hatchets and picks.

PSA 74:7.text: They have burned Your sanctuary to the ground; they have defiled the dwelling place of Your Name.
PSA 74:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 74] They have burned Your sanctuary to the ground; they have defiled the dwelling place of Your Name.

PSA 74:8.text: They said in their hearts, “We will crush them completely.” They burned down every place where God met us in the land.
PSA 74:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 74] They said in their hearts, “We will crush them completely.” They burned down every place where God met us in the land.

PSA 74:9.text: There are no signs for us to see. There is no longer any prophet. And none of us knows how long this will last.
PSA 74:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 74] There are no signs for us to see. There is no longer any prophet. And none of us knows how long this will last.

PSA 74:10.text: How long, O God, will the enemy taunt You? Will the foe revile Your name forever?
PSA 74:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 74] How long, O God, will the enemy taunt You? Will the foe revile Your name forever?

PSA 74:11.text: Why do You withdraw Your strong right hand? Stretch it out to destroy them!
PSA 74:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 74 · Destroy Canaan, Destroy Canaanites] Why do You withdraw Your strong right hand? Stretch it out to destroy them!

PSA 74:12.text: Yet God is my King from ancient times, working salvation on the earth.
PSA 74:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 74 · End Times] Yet God is my King from ancient times, working salvation on the earth.

PSA 74:13.text: You divided the sea by Your strength; You smashed the heads of the dragons of the sea;
PSA 74:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 74] You divided the sea by Your strength; You smashed the heads of the dragons of the sea;

PSA 74:14.text: You crushed the heads of Leviathan; You fed him to the creatures of the desert.
PSA 74:14.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 74] You crushed the heads of Leviathan; You fed him to the creatures of the desert.

PSA 74:15.text: You broke open the fountain and the flood; You dried up the ever-flowing rivers.
PSA 74:15.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 74] You broke open the fountain and the flood; You dried up the ever-flowing rivers.

PSA 74:16.text: The day is Yours, and also the night; You established the moon and the sun.
PSA 74:16.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 74] The day is Yours, and also the night; You established the moon and the sun.

PSA 74:17.text: You set all the boundaries of the earth; You made the summer and winter.
PSA 74:17.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 74] You set all the boundaries of the earth; You made the summer and winter.

PSA 74:18.text: Remember how the enemy has mocked You, O LORD, how a foolish people has spurned Your name.
PSA 74:18.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 74] Remember how the enemy has mocked You, O LORD, how a foolish people has spurned Your name.

PSA 74:19.text: Do not deliver the soul of Your dove to beasts; do not forget the lives of Your afflicted forever.
PSA 74:19.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 74] Do not deliver the soul of Your dove to beasts; do not forget the lives of Your afflicted forever.

PSA 74:20.text: Consider Your covenant, for haunts of violence fill the dark places of the land.
PSA 74:20.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 74 · Covenant] Consider Your covenant, for haunts of violence fill the dark places of the land.

PSA 74:21.text: Do not let the oppressed retreat in shame; may the poor and needy praise Your name.
PSA 74:21.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 74] Do not let the oppressed retreat in shame; may the poor and needy praise Your name.

PSA 74:22.text: Rise up, O God; defend Your cause! Remember how the fool mocks You all day long.
PSA 74:22.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 74] Rise up, O God; defend Your cause! Remember how the fool mocks You all day long.

PSA 74:23.text: Do not disregard the clamor of Your adversaries, the uproar of Your enemies that ascends continually.
PSA 74:23.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 74] Do not disregard the clamor of Your adversaries, the uproar of Your enemies that ascends continually.

PSA 75:1.text: We give thanks to You, O God; we give thanks, for Your Name is near. The people declare Your wondrous works.
PSA 75:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 75] We give thanks to You, O God; we give thanks, for Your Name is near. The people declare Your wondrous works.

PSA 75:2.text: “When I choose a time, I will judge fairly.
PSA 75:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 75] “When I choose a time, I will judge fairly.

PSA 75:3.text: When the earth and all its dwellers quake, it is I who bear up its pillars. Selah
PSA 75:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 75] When the earth and all its dwellers quake, it is I who bear up its pillars. Selah

PSA 75:4.text: I say to the proud, ‘Do not boast,’ and to the wicked, ‘Do not lift up your horn.
PSA 75:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 75] I say to the proud, ‘Do not boast,’ and to the wicked, ‘Do not lift up your horn.

PSA 75:5.text: Do not lift up your horn against heaven or speak with an outstretched neck.’”
PSA 75:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 75 · Heaven] Do not lift up your horn against heaven or speak with an outstretched neck.’”

PSA 75:6.text: For exaltation comes neither from east nor west, nor out of the desert,
PSA 75:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 75] For exaltation comes neither from east nor west, nor out of the desert,

PSA 75:7.text: but it is God who judges; He brings down one and exalts another.
PSA 75:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 75] but it is God who judges; He brings down one and exalts another.

PSA 75:8.text: For a cup is in the hand of the LORD, full of foaming wine mixed with spices. He pours from His cup, and all the wicked of the earth drink it down to the dregs.
PSA 75:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 75] For a cup is in the hand of the LORD, full of foaming wine mixed with spices. He pours from His cup, and all the wicked of the earth drink it down to the dregs.

PSA 75:9.text: But I will proclaim Him forever; I will sing praise to the God of Jacob.
PSA 75:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 75 · Israel] But I will proclaim Him forever; I will sing praise to the God of Jacob.

PSA 75:10.text: “All the horns of the wicked I will cut off, but the horns of the righteous will be exalted.”
PSA 75:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 75 · Ascension] “All the horns of the wicked I will cut off, but the horns of the righteous will be exalted.”

PSA 76:1.text: God is known in Judah; His name is great in Israel.
PSA 76:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 76 · Israel] God is known in Judah; His name is great in Israel.

PSA 76:2.text: His tent is in Salem, His dwelling place in Zion.
PSA 76:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 76] His tent is in Salem, His dwelling place in Zion.

PSA 76:3.text: There He shattered the flaming arrows, the shield and sword and weapons of war. Selah
PSA 76:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 76] There He shattered the flaming arrows, the shield and sword and weapons of war. Selah

PSA 76:4.text: You are resplendent with light, more majestic than mountains filled with game.
PSA 76:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 76 · Light] You are resplendent with light, more majestic than mountains filled with game.

PSA 76:5.text: The valiant lie plundered; they sleep their last sleep. No men of might could lift a hand.
PSA 76:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 76] The valiant lie plundered; they sleep their last sleep. No men of might could lift a hand.

PSA 76:6.text: At Your rebuke, O God of Jacob, both horse and rider lie stunned.
PSA 76:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 76 · Israel] At Your rebuke, O God of Jacob, both horse and rider lie stunned.

PSA 76:7.text: You alone are to be feared. When You are angry, who can stand before You?
PSA 76:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 76] You alone are to be feared. When You are angry, who can stand before You?

PSA 76:8.text: From heaven You pronounced judgment, and the earth feared and was still
PSA 76:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 76 · Heaven, Judgment] From heaven You pronounced judgment, and the earth feared and was still

PSA 76:9.text: when God rose up to judge, to save all the lowly of the earth. Selah
PSA 76:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 76] when God rose up to judge, to save all the lowly of the earth. Selah

PSA 76:10.text: Even the wrath of man shall praise You; with the survivors of wrath You will clothe Yourself.
PSA 76:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 76] Even the wrath of man shall praise You; with the survivors of wrath You will clothe Yourself.

PSA 76:11.text: Make and fulfill your vows to the LORD your God; let all the neighboring lands bring tribute to Him who is to be feared.
PSA 76:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 76] Make and fulfill your vows to the LORD your God; let all the neighboring lands bring tribute to Him who is to be feared.

PSA 76:12.text: He breaks the spirits of princes; He is feared by the kings of the earth.
PSA 76:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 76] He breaks the spirits of princes; He is feared by the kings of the earth.

PSA 77:1.text: I cried out to God; I cried aloud to God to hear me.
PSA 77:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 77] I cried out to God; I cried aloud to God to hear me.

PSA 77:2.text: In the day of trouble I sought the Lord; through the night my outstretched hands did not grow weary; my soul refused to be comforted.
PSA 77:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 77] In the day of trouble I sought the Lord; through the night my outstretched hands did not grow weary; my soul refused to be comforted.

PSA 77:3.text: I remembered You, O God, and I groaned; I mused and my spirit grew faint. Selah
PSA 77:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 77 · Fruit of the Spirit] I remembered You, O God, and I groaned; I mused and my spirit grew faint. Selah

PSA 77:4.text: You have kept my eyes from closing; I am too troubled to speak.
PSA 77:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 77] You have kept my eyes from closing; I am too troubled to speak.

PSA 77:5.text: I considered the days of old, the years long in the past.
PSA 77:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 77] I considered the days of old, the years long in the past.

PSA 77:6.text: At night I remembered my song; in my heart I mused, and my spirit pondered:
PSA 77:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 77 · Adultery In Heart, Fruit of the Spirit] At night I remembered my song; in my heart I mused, and my spirit pondered:

PSA 77:7.text: “Will the Lord spurn us forever and never show His favor again?
PSA 77:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 77 · Blessing] “Will the Lord spurn us forever and never show His favor again?

PSA 77:8.text: Is His loving devotion gone forever? Has His promise failed for all time?
PSA 77:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 77 · Covenant, Devotion] Is His loving devotion gone forever? Has His promise failed for all time?

PSA 77:9.text: Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has His anger shut off His compassion?” Selah
PSA 77:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 77 · Compassion] Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has His anger shut off His compassion?” Selah

PSA 77:10.text: So I said, “I am grieved that the right hand of the Most High has changed.”
PSA 77:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 77] So I said, “I am grieved that the right hand of the Most High has changed.”

PSA 77:11.text: I will remember the works of the LORD; yes, I will remember Your wonders of old.
PSA 77:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 77] I will remember the works of the LORD; yes, I will remember Your wonders of old.

PSA 77:12.text: I will reflect on all You have done and ponder Your mighty deeds.
PSA 77:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 77] I will reflect on all You have done and ponder Your mighty deeds.

PSA 77:13.text: Your way, O God, is holy. What god is so great as our God?
PSA 77:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 77] Your way, O God, is holy. What god is so great as our God?

PSA 77:14.text: You are the God who works wonders; You display Your strength among the peoples.
PSA 77:14.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 77] You are the God who works wonders; You display Your strength among the peoples.

PSA 77:15.text: With power You redeemed Your people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah
PSA 77:15.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 77 · Israel] With power You redeemed Your people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah

PSA 77:16.text: The waters saw You, O God; the waters saw You and swirled; even the depths were shaken.
PSA 77:16.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 77] The waters saw You, O God; the waters saw You and swirled; even the depths were shaken.

PSA 77:17.text: The clouds poured down water; the skies resounded with thunder; Your arrows flashed back and forth.
PSA 77:17.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 77] The clouds poured down water; the skies resounded with thunder; Your arrows flashed back and forth.

PSA 77:18.text: Your thunder resounded in the whirlwind; the lightning lit up the world; the earth trembled and quaked.
PSA 77:18.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 77] Your thunder resounded in the whirlwind; the lightning lit up the world; the earth trembled and quaked.

PSA 77:19.text: Your path led through the sea, Your way through the mighty waters, but Your footprints were not to be found.
PSA 77:19.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 77] Your path led through the sea, Your way through the mighty waters, but Your footprints were not to be found.

PSA 77:20.text: You led Your people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
PSA 77:20.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 77] You led Your people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.

PSA 78:1.text: Give ear, O my people, to my instruction; listen to the words of my mouth.
PSA 78:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78] Give ear, O my people, to my instruction; listen to the words of my mouth.

PSA 78:2.text: I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things hidden from the beginning,
PSA 78:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78] I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things hidden from the beginning,

PSA 78:3.text: that we have heard and known and our fathers have relayed to us.
PSA 78:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78] that we have heard and known and our fathers have relayed to us.

PSA 78:4.text: We will not hide them from their children, but will declare to the next generation the praises of the LORD and His might, and the wonders He has performed.
PSA 78:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78 · Children] We will not hide them from their children, but will declare to the next generation the praises of the LORD and His might, and the wonders He has performed.

PSA 78:5.text: For He established a testimony in Jacob and appointed a law in Israel, which He commanded our fathers to teach to their children,
PSA 78:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78 · Children, God Commanded Genocide] For He established a testimony in Jacob and appointed a law in Israel, which He commanded our fathers to teach to their children,

PSA 78:6.text: that the coming generation would know them— even children yet to be born— to arise and tell their own children
PSA 78:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78 · Children] that the coming generation would know them— even children yet to be born— to arise and tell their own children

PSA 78:7.text: that they should put their confidence in God, not forgetting His works, but keeping His commandments.
PSA 78:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78 · Assurance, Law] that they should put their confidence in God, not forgetting His works, but keeping His commandments.

PSA 78:8.text: Then they will not be like their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation, whose heart was not loyal, whose spirit was not faithful to God.
PSA 78:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78 · Faith, Adultery In Heart] Then they will not be like their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation, whose heart was not loyal, whose spirit was not faithful to God.

PSA 78:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78] The archers of Ephraim turned back on the day of battle.
