PSA 78:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78 · Covenant] They failed to keep God’s covenant and refused to live by His law.

PSA 78:11.text: They forgot what He had done, the wonders He had shown them.
PSA 78:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78] They forgot what He had done, the wonders He had shown them.

PSA 78:12.text: He worked wonders before their fathers in the land of Egypt, in the region of Zoan.
PSA 78:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78] He worked wonders before their fathers in the land of Egypt, in the region of Zoan.

PSA 78:13.text: He split the sea and brought them through; He set the waters upright like a wall.
PSA 78:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78] He split the sea and brought them through; He set the waters upright like a wall.

PSA 78:14.text: He led them with a cloud by day and with a light of fire all night.
PSA 78:14.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78 · Light] He led them with a cloud by day and with a light of fire all night.

PSA 78:15.text: He split the rocks in the wilderness and gave them drink as abundant as the seas.
PSA 78:15.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78] He split the rocks in the wilderness and gave them drink as abundant as the seas.

PSA 78:16.text: He brought streams from the stone and made water flow down like rivers.
PSA 78:16.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78] He brought streams from the stone and made water flow down like rivers.

PSA 78:17.text: But they continued to sin against Him, rebelling in the desert against the Most High.
PSA 78:17.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78] But they continued to sin against Him, rebelling in the desert against the Most High.

PSA 78:18.text: They willfully tested God by demanding the food they craved.
PSA 78:18.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78] They willfully tested God by demanding the food they craved.

PSA 78:19.text: They spoke against God, saying, “Can God really prepare a table in the wilderness?
PSA 78:19.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78] They spoke against God, saying, “Can God really prepare a table in the wilderness?

PSA 78:20.text: When He struck the rock, water gushed out and torrents raged. But can He also give bread or supply His people with meat?”
PSA 78:20.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78] When He struck the rock, water gushed out and torrents raged. But can He also give bread or supply His people with meat?”

PSA 78:21.text: Therefore the LORD heard and was filled with wrath; so a fire was kindled against Jacob, and His anger flared against Israel,
PSA 78:21.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78 · Israel] Therefore the LORD heard and was filled with wrath; so a fire was kindled against Jacob, and His anger flared against Israel,

PSA 78:22.text: because they did not believe God or rely on His salvation.
PSA 78:22.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78 · Faith] because they did not believe God or rely on His salvation.

PSA 78:23.text: Yet He commanded the clouds above and opened the doors of the heavens.
PSA 78:23.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78 · God Commanded Genocide] Yet He commanded the clouds above and opened the doors of the heavens.

PSA 78:24.text: He rained down manna for them to eat; He gave them grain from heaven.
PSA 78:24.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78 · Heaven] He rained down manna for them to eat; He gave them grain from heaven.

PSA 78:25.text: Man ate the bread of angels; He sent them food in abundance.
PSA 78:25.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78 · Angels] Man ate the bread of angels; He sent them food in abundance.

PSA 78:26.text: He stirred the east wind from the heavens and drove the south wind by His might.
PSA 78:26.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78] He stirred the east wind from the heavens and drove the south wind by His might.

PSA 78:27.text: He rained meat on them like dust, and winged birds like the sand of the sea.
PSA 78:27.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78] He rained meat on them like dust, and winged birds like the sand of the sea.

PSA 78:28.text: He felled them in the midst of their camp, all around their dwellings.
PSA 78:28.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78] He felled them in the midst of their camp, all around their dwellings.

PSA 78:29.text: So they ate and were well filled, for He gave them what they craved.
PSA 78:29.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78] So they ate and were well filled, for He gave them what they craved.

PSA 78:30.text: Yet before they had filled their desire, with the food still in their mouths,
PSA 78:30.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78 · Lust] Yet before they had filled their desire, with the food still in their mouths,

PSA 78:31.text: God’s anger flared against them, and He put to death their strongest and subdued the young men of Israel.
PSA 78:31.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78 · Death, Israel] God’s anger flared against them, and He put to death their strongest and subdued the young men of Israel.

PSA 78:32.text: In spite of all this, they kept on sinning; despite His wonderful works, they did not believe.
PSA 78:32.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78 · Faith] In spite of all this, they kept on sinning; despite His wonderful works, they did not believe.

PSA 78:33.text: So He ended their days in futility, and their years in sudden terror.
PSA 78:33.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78] So He ended their days in futility, and their years in sudden terror.

PSA 78:34.text: When He slew them, they would seek Him; they repented and searched for God.
PSA 78:34.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78] When He slew them, they would seek Him; they repented and searched for God.

PSA 78:35.text: And they remembered that God was their Rock, that God Most High was their Redeemer.
PSA 78:35.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78] And they remembered that God was their Rock, that God Most High was their Redeemer.

PSA 78:36.text: But they deceived Him with their mouths, and lied to Him with their tongues.
PSA 78:36.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78] But they deceived Him with their mouths, and lied to Him with their tongues.

PSA 78:37.text: Their hearts were disloyal to Him, and they were unfaithful to His covenant.
PSA 78:37.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78 · Faith, Covenant] Their hearts were disloyal to Him, and they were unfaithful to His covenant.

PSA 78:38.text: And yet He was compassionate; He forgave their iniquity and did not destroy them. He often restrained His anger and did not unleash His full wrath.
PSA 78:38.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78 · Destroy Canaan, Destroy Canaanites] And yet He was compassionate; He forgave their iniquity and did not destroy them. He often restrained His anger and did not unleash His full wrath.

PSA 78:39.text: He remembered that they were but flesh, a passing breeze that does not return.
PSA 78:39.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78] He remembered that they were but flesh, a passing breeze that does not return.

PSA 78:40.text: How often they disobeyed Him in the wilderness and grieved Him in the desert!
PSA 78:40.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78] How often they disobeyed Him in the wilderness and grieved Him in the desert!

PSA 78:41.text: Again and again they tested God and provoked the Holy One of Israel.
PSA 78:41.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78 · Israel] Again and again they tested God and provoked the Holy One of Israel.

PSA 78:42.text: They did not remember His power— the day He redeemed them from the adversary,
PSA 78:42.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78] They did not remember His power— the day He redeemed them from the adversary,

PSA 78:43.text: when He performed His signs in Egypt and His wonders in the fields of Zoan.
PSA 78:43.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78] when He performed His signs in Egypt and His wonders in the fields of Zoan.

PSA 78:44.text: He turned their rivers to blood, and from their streams they could not drink.
PSA 78:44.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78] He turned their rivers to blood, and from their streams they could not drink.

PSA 78:45.text: He sent swarms of flies that devoured them, and frogs that devastated them.
PSA 78:45.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78] He sent swarms of flies that devoured them, and frogs that devastated them.

PSA 78:46.text: He gave their crops to the grasshopper, the fruit of their labor to the locust.
PSA 78:46.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78 · Fruit of the Spirit] He gave their crops to the grasshopper, the fruit of their labor to the locust.

PSA 78:47.text: He killed their vines with hailstones and their sycamore-figs with sleet.
PSA 78:47.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78] He killed their vines with hailstones and their sycamore-figs with sleet.

PSA 78:48.text: He abandoned their cattle to the hail and their livestock to bolts of lightning.
PSA 78:48.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78] He abandoned their cattle to the hail and their livestock to bolts of lightning.

PSA 78:49.text: He unleashed His fury against them, wrath, indignation, and calamity— a band of destroying angels.
PSA 78:49.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78 · Angels] He unleashed His fury against them, wrath, indignation, and calamity— a band of destroying angels.

PSA 78:50.text: He cleared a path for His anger; He did not spare them from death but delivered their lives to the plague.
PSA 78:50.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78 · Death] He cleared a path for His anger; He did not spare them from death but delivered their lives to the plague.

PSA 78:51.text: He struck all the firstborn of Egypt, the virility in the tents of Ham.
PSA 78:51.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78] He struck all the firstborn of Egypt, the virility in the tents of Ham.

PSA 78:52.text: He led out His people like sheep and guided them like a flock in the wilderness.
PSA 78:52.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78] He led out His people like sheep and guided them like a flock in the wilderness.

PSA 78:53.text: He led them safely, so they did not fear, but the sea engulfed their enemies.
PSA 78:53.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78] He led them safely, so they did not fear, but the sea engulfed their enemies.

PSA 78:54.text: He brought them to His holy land, to the mountain His right hand had acquired.
PSA 78:54.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78] He brought them to His holy land, to the mountain His right hand had acquired.

PSA 78:55.text: He drove out nations before them and apportioned their inheritance; He settled the tribes of Israel in their tents.
PSA 78:55.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78 · Inheritance, Israel] He drove out nations before them and apportioned their inheritance; He settled the tribes of Israel in their tents.

PSA 78:56.text: But they tested and disobeyed God Most High, for they did not keep His decrees.
PSA 78:56.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78] But they tested and disobeyed God Most High, for they did not keep His decrees.

PSA 78:57.text: They turned back and were faithless like their fathers, twisted like a faulty bow.
PSA 78:57.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78 · Faith] They turned back and were faithless like their fathers, twisted like a faulty bow.

PSA 78:58.text: They enraged Him with their high places and provoked His jealousy with their idols.
PSA 78:58.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78 · Idolatry, Idols] They enraged Him with their high places and provoked His jealousy with their idols.

PSA 78:59.text: On hearing it, God was furious and rejected Israel completely.
PSA 78:59.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78 · Israel] On hearing it, God was furious and rejected Israel completely.

PSA 78:60.text: He abandoned the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent He had pitched among men.
PSA 78:60.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78] He abandoned the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent He had pitched among men.

PSA 78:61.text: He delivered His strength to captivity, and His splendor to the hand of the adversary.
PSA 78:61.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78] He delivered His strength to captivity, and His splendor to the hand of the adversary.

PSA 78:62.text: He surrendered His people to the sword because He was enraged by His heritage.
PSA 78:62.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78] He surrendered His people to the sword because He was enraged by His heritage.

PSA 78:63.text: Fire consumed His young men, and their maidens were left without wedding songs.
PSA 78:63.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78] Fire consumed His young men, and their maidens were left without wedding songs.

PSA 78:64.text: His priests fell by the sword, but their widows could not lament.
PSA 78:64.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78] His priests fell by the sword, but their widows could not lament.

PSA 78:65.text: Then the Lord awoke as from sleep, like a mighty warrior overcome by wine.
PSA 78:65.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78] Then the Lord awoke as from sleep, like a mighty warrior overcome by wine.

PSA 78:66.text: He beat back His foes; He put them to everlasting shame.
PSA 78:66.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78] He beat back His foes; He put them to everlasting shame.

PSA 78:67.text: He rejected the tent of Joseph and refused the tribe of Ephraim.
PSA 78:67.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78] He rejected the tent of Joseph and refused the tribe of Ephraim.

PSA 78:68.text: But He chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion, which He loved.
PSA 78:68.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78 · Love] But He chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion, which He loved.

PSA 78:69.text: He built His sanctuary like the heights, like the earth He has established forever.
PSA 78:69.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78] He built His sanctuary like the heights, like the earth He has established forever.

PSA 78:70.text: He chose David His servant and took him from the sheepfolds;
PSA 78:70.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78] He chose David His servant and took him from the sheepfolds;

PSA 78:71.text: from tending the ewes He brought him to be shepherd of His people Jacob, of Israel His inheritance.
PSA 78:71.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78 · Inheritance, Israel] from tending the ewes He brought him to be shepherd of His people Jacob, of Israel His inheritance.

PSA 78:72.text: So David shepherded them with integrity of heart and guided them with skillful hands.
PSA 78:72.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 78 · Adultery In Heart] So David shepherded them with integrity of heart and guided them with skillful hands.

PSA 79:1.text: The nations, O God, have invaded Your inheritance; they have defiled Your holy temple and reduced Jerusalem to rubble.
PSA 79:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 79 · Inheritance] The nations, O God, have invaded Your inheritance; they have defiled Your holy temple and reduced Jerusalem to rubble.

PSA 79:2.text: They have given the corpses of Your servants as food to the birds of the air, the flesh of Your saints to the beasts of the earth.
PSA 79:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 79] They have given the corpses of Your servants as food to the birds of the air, the flesh of Your saints to the beasts of the earth.

PSA 79:3.text: They have poured out their blood like water all around Jerusalem, and there is no one to bury the dead.
PSA 79:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 79] They have poured out their blood like water all around Jerusalem, and there is no one to bury the dead.

PSA 79:4.text: We have become a reproach to our neighbors, a scorn and derision to those around us.
PSA 79:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 79] We have become a reproach to our neighbors, a scorn and derision to those around us.

PSA 79:5.text: How long, O LORD? Will You be angry forever? Will Your jealousy burn like fire?
PSA 79:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 79 · Jealousy] How long, O LORD? Will You be angry forever? Will Your jealousy burn like fire?

PSA 79:6.text: Pour out Your wrath on the nations that do not acknowledge You, on the kingdoms that refuse to call on Your name,
PSA 79:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 79] Pour out Your wrath on the nations that do not acknowledge You, on the kingdoms that refuse to call on Your name,

PSA 79:7.text: for they have devoured Jacob and devastated his homeland.
PSA 79:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 79 · Israel] for they have devoured Jacob and devastated his homeland.

PSA 79:8.text: Do not hold past sins against us; let Your compassion come quickly, for we are brought low.
PSA 79:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 79 · Compassion] Do not hold past sins against us; let Your compassion come quickly, for we are brought low.

PSA 79:9.text: Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of Your name; deliver us and atone for our sins, for the sake of Your name.
PSA 79:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 79 · Glory] Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of Your name; deliver us and atone for our sins, for the sake of Your name.

PSA 79:10.text: Why should the nations ask, “Where is their God?” Before our eyes, make known among the nations Your vengeance for the bloodshed of Your servants.
PSA 79:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 79] Why should the nations ask, “Where is their God?” Before our eyes, make known among the nations Your vengeance for the bloodshed of Your servants.

PSA 79:11.text: May the groans of the captives reach You; by the strength of Your arm preserve those condemned to death.
PSA 79:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 79 · Death] May the groans of the captives reach You; by the strength of Your arm preserve those condemned to death.

PSA 79:12.text: Pay back into the laps of our neighbors sevenfold the reproach they hurled at You, O Lord.
PSA 79:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 79] Pay back into the laps of our neighbors sevenfold the reproach they hurled at You, O Lord.

PSA 79:13.text: Then we Your people, the sheep of Your pasture, will thank You forever; from generation to generation we will declare Your praise.
PSA 79:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 79] Then we Your people, the sheep of Your pasture, will thank You forever; from generation to generation we will declare Your praise.

PSA 80:1.text: Hear us, O Shepherd of Israel, who leads Joseph like a flock; You who sit enthroned between the cherubim, shine forth
PSA 80:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 80 · Israel] Hear us, O Shepherd of Israel, who leads Joseph like a flock; You who sit enthroned between the cherubim, shine forth

PSA 80:2.text: before Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh. Rally Your mighty power and come to save us.
PSA 80:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 80] before Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh. Rally Your mighty power and come to save us.

PSA 80:3.text: Restore us, O God, and cause Your face to shine upon us, that we may be saved.
PSA 80:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 80] Restore us, O God, and cause Your face to shine upon us, that we may be saved.

PSA 80:4.text: O LORD God of Hosts, how long will Your anger smolder against the prayers of Your people?
PSA 80:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 80] O LORD God of Hosts, how long will Your anger smolder against the prayers of Your people?

PSA 80:5.text: You fed them with the bread of tears and made them drink the full measure of their tears.
PSA 80:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 80] You fed them with the bread of tears and made them drink the full measure of their tears.

PSA 80:6.text: You make us contend with our neighbors; our enemies mock us.
PSA 80:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 80] You make us contend with our neighbors; our enemies mock us.

PSA 80:7.text: Restore us, O God of Hosts, and cause Your face to shine upon us, that we may be saved.
PSA 80:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 80] Restore us, O God of Hosts, and cause Your face to shine upon us, that we may be saved.

PSA 80:8.text: You uprooted a vine from Egypt; You drove out the nations and transplanted it.
PSA 80:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 80] You uprooted a vine from Egypt; You drove out the nations and transplanted it.

PSA 80:9.text: You cleared the ground for it, and it took root and filled the land.
PSA 80:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 80] You cleared the ground for it, and it took root and filled the land.

PSA 80:10.text: The mountains were covered by its shade, and the mighty cedars with its branches.
PSA 80:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 80] The mountains were covered by its shade, and the mighty cedars with its branches.

PSA 80:11.text: It sent out its branches to the Sea, and its shoots toward the River.
PSA 80:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 80] It sent out its branches to the Sea, and its shoots toward the River.

PSA 80:12.text: Why have You broken down its walls, so that all who pass by pick its fruit?
PSA 80:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 80 · Fruit of the Spirit] Why have You broken down its walls, so that all who pass by pick its fruit?

PSA 80:13.text: The boar from the forest ravages it, and the creatures of the field feed upon it.
PSA 80:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 80] The boar from the forest ravages it, and the creatures of the field feed upon it.

PSA 80:14.text: Return, O God of Hosts, we pray! Look down from heaven and see! Attend to this vine—
PSA 80:14.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 80 · Heaven] Return, O God of Hosts, we pray! Look down from heaven and see! Attend to this vine—

PSA 80:15.text: the root Your right hand has planted, the son You have raised up for Yourself.
PSA 80:15.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 80] the root Your right hand has planted, the son You have raised up for Yourself.

PSA 80:16.text: Your vine has been cut down and burned; they perish at the rebuke of Your countenance.
PSA 80:16.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 80] Your vine has been cut down and burned; they perish at the rebuke of Your countenance.

PSA 80:17.text: Let Your hand be upon the man at Your right hand, on the son of man You have raised up for Yourself.
PSA 80:17.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 80] Let Your hand be upon the man at Your right hand, on the son of man You have raised up for Yourself.

PSA 80:18.text: Then we will not turn away from You; revive us, and we will call on Your name.
PSA 80:18.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 80] Then we will not turn away from You; revive us, and we will call on Your name.

PSA 80:19.text: Restore us, O LORD God of Hosts; cause Your face to shine upon us, that we may be saved.
PSA 80:19.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 80] Restore us, O LORD God of Hosts; cause Your face to shine upon us, that we may be saved.

PSA 81:1.text: Sing for joy to God our strength; make a joyful noise to the God of Jacob.
PSA 81:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 81 · Israel] Sing for joy to God our strength; make a joyful noise to the God of Jacob.

PSA 81:2.text: Lift up a song, strike the tambourine, play the sweet-sounding harp and lyre.
PSA 81:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 81] Lift up a song, strike the tambourine, play the sweet-sounding harp and lyre.

PSA 81:3.text: Sound the ram’s horn at the New Moon, and at the full moon on the day of our Feast.
PSA 81:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 81] Sound the ram’s horn at the New Moon, and at the full moon on the day of our Feast.

PSA 81:4.text: For this is a statute for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob.
PSA 81:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 81 · Israel] For this is a statute for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob.

PSA 81:5.text: He ordained it as a testimony for Joseph when he went out over the land of Egypt, where I heard an unfamiliar language:
PSA 81:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 81] He ordained it as a testimony for Joseph when he went out over the land of Egypt, where I heard an unfamiliar language:

PSA 81:6.text: “I relieved his shoulder of the burden; his hands were freed from the basket.
PSA 81:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 81] “I relieved his shoulder of the burden; his hands were freed from the basket.

PSA 81:7.text: You called out in distress, and I rescued you; I answered you from the cloud of thunder; I tested you at the waters of Meribah. Selah
PSA 81:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 81] You called out in distress, and I rescued you; I answered you from the cloud of thunder; I tested you at the waters of Meribah. Selah

PSA 81:8.text: Hear, O My people, and I will warn you: O Israel, if only you would listen to Me!
PSA 81:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 81 · Israel] Hear, O My people, and I will warn you: O Israel, if only you would listen to Me!

PSA 81:9.text: There must be no strange god among you, nor shall you bow to a foreign god.
PSA 81:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 81] There must be no strange god among you, nor shall you bow to a foreign god.

PSA 81:10.text: I am the LORD your God, who brought you up out of Egypt. Open wide your mouth, and I will fill it.
PSA 81:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 81] I am the LORD your God, who brought you up out of Egypt. Open wide your mouth, and I will fill it.

PSA 81:11.text: But My people would not listen to Me, and Israel would not obey Me.
PSA 81:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 81 · Israel] But My people would not listen to Me, and Israel would not obey Me.

PSA 81:12.text: So I gave them up to their stubborn hearts to follow their own devices.
PSA 81:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 81] So I gave them up to their stubborn hearts to follow their own devices.

PSA 81:13.text: If only My people would listen to Me, if Israel would follow My ways,
PSA 81:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 81 · Israel] If only My people would listen to Me, if Israel would follow My ways,

PSA 81:14.text: how soon I would subdue their enemies and turn My hand against their foes!
PSA 81:14.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 81] how soon I would subdue their enemies and turn My hand against their foes!

PSA 81:15.text: Those who hate the LORD would feign obedience, and their doom would last forever.
PSA 81:15.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 81] Those who hate the LORD would feign obedience, and their doom would last forever.

PSA 81:16.text: But I would feed you the finest wheat; with honey from the rock I would satisfy you.”
PSA 81:16.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 81] But I would feed you the finest wheat; with honey from the rock I would satisfy you.”

PSA 82:1.text: God presides in the divine assembly; He renders judgment among the gods:
PSA 82:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 82 · Church, Judgment] God presides in the divine assembly; He renders judgment among the gods:

PSA 82:2.text: “How long will you judge unjustly and show partiality to the wicked? Selah
PSA 82:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 82] “How long will you judge unjustly and show partiality to the wicked? Selah

PSA 82:3.text: Defend the cause of the weak and fatherless; uphold the rights of the afflicted and oppressed.
PSA 82:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 82] Defend the cause of the weak and fatherless; uphold the rights of the afflicted and oppressed.

PSA 82:4.text: Rescue the weak and needy; save them from the hand of the wicked.
PSA 82:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 82] Rescue the weak and needy; save them from the hand of the wicked.

PSA 82:5.text: They do not know or understand; they wander in the darkness; all the foundations of the earth are shaken.
PSA 82:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 82] They do not know or understand; they wander in the darkness; all the foundations of the earth are shaken.

PSA 82:6.text: I have said, ‘You are gods; you are all sons of the Most High.’
PSA 82:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 82] I have said, ‘You are gods; you are all sons of the Most High.’

PSA 82:7.text: But like mortals you will die, and like rulers you will fall.”
PSA 82:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 82] But like mortals you will die, and like rulers you will fall.”

PSA 82:8.text: Arise, O God, judge the earth, for all the nations are Your inheritance.
PSA 82:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 82 · Inheritance] Arise, O God, judge the earth, for all the nations are Your inheritance.

PSA 83:1.text: O God, be not silent; be not speechless; be not still, O God.
PSA 83:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 83] O God, be not silent; be not speechless; be not still, O God.

PSA 83:2.text: See how Your enemies rage, how Your foes have reared their heads.
PSA 83:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 83] See how Your enemies rage, how Your foes have reared their heads.

PSA 83:3.text: With cunning they scheme against Your people and conspire against those You cherish,
PSA 83:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 83] With cunning they scheme against Your people and conspire against those You cherish,

PSA 83:4.text: saying, “Come, let us erase them as a nation; may the name of Israel be remembered no more.”
PSA 83:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 83 · Israel] saying, “Come, let us erase them as a nation; may the name of Israel be remembered no more.”

PSA 83:5.text: For with one mind they plot together, they form an alliance against You—
PSA 83:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 83] For with one mind they plot together, they form an alliance against You—

PSA 83:6.text: the tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites, of Moab and the Hagrites,
PSA 83:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 83] the tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites, of Moab and the Hagrites,

PSA 83:7.text: of Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek, of Philistia with the people of Tyre.
PSA 83:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 83] of Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek, of Philistia with the people of Tyre.

PSA 83:8.text: Even Assyria has joined them, lending strength to the sons of Lot. Selah
PSA 83:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 83] Even Assyria has joined them, lending strength to the sons of Lot. Selah

PSA 83:9.text: Do to them as You did to Midian, as to Sisera and Jabin at the River Kishon,
PSA 83:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 83] Do to them as You did to Midian, as to Sisera and Jabin at the River Kishon,

PSA 83:10.text: who perished at Endor and became like dung on the ground.
PSA 83:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 83] who perished at Endor and became like dung on the ground.

PSA 83:11.text: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb, and all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,
PSA 83:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 83] Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb, and all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,

PSA 83:12.text: who said, “Let us possess for ourselves the pastures of God.”
PSA 83:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 83] who said, “Let us possess for ourselves the pastures of God.”

PSA 83:13.text: Make them like tumbleweed, O my God, like chaff before the wind.
PSA 83:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 83] Make them like tumbleweed, O my God, like chaff before the wind.

PSA 83:14.text: As fire consumes a forest, as a flame sets the mountains ablaze,
PSA 83:14.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 83] As fire consumes a forest, as a flame sets the mountains ablaze,

PSA 83:15.text: so pursue them with Your tempest, and terrify them with Your storm.
PSA 83:15.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 83] so pursue them with Your tempest, and terrify them with Your storm.

PSA 83:16.text: Cover their faces with shame, that they may seek Your name, O LORD.
PSA 83:16.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 83] Cover their faces with shame, that they may seek Your name, O LORD.

PSA 83:17.text: May they be ever ashamed and terrified; may they perish in disgrace.
PSA 83:17.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 83] May they be ever ashamed and terrified; may they perish in disgrace.

PSA 83:18.text: May they know that You alone, whose name is the LORD, are Most High over all the earth.
PSA 83:18.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 83] May they know that You alone, whose name is the LORD, are Most High over all the earth.

PSA 84:1.text: How lovely is Your dwelling place, O LORD of Hosts!
PSA 84:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 84 · Love] How lovely is Your dwelling place, O LORD of Hosts!

PSA 84:2.text: My soul longs, even faints, for the courts of the LORD; my heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.
PSA 84:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 84 · Adultery In Heart] My soul longs, even faints, for the courts of the LORD; my heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.

PSA 84:3.text: Even the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she places her young near Your altars, O LORD of Hosts, my King and my God.
PSA 84:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 84] Even the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she places her young near Your altars, O LORD of Hosts, my King and my God.

PSA 84:4.text: How blessed are those who dwell in Your house! They are ever praising You. Selah
PSA 84:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 84 · Beatitudes] How blessed are those who dwell in Your house! They are ever praising You. Selah

PSA 84:5.text: Blessed are those whose strength is in You, whose hearts are set on pilgrimage.
PSA 84:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 84 · Beatitudes] Blessed are those whose strength is in You, whose hearts are set on pilgrimage.

PSA 84:6.text: As they pass through the Valley of Baca, they make it a place of springs; even the autumn rain covers it with pools.
PSA 84:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 84] As they pass through the Valley of Baca, they make it a place of springs; even the autumn rain covers it with pools.

PSA 84:7.text: They go from strength to strength, until each appears before God in Zion.
PSA 84:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 84] They go from strength to strength, until each appears before God in Zion.

PSA 84:8.text: O LORD God of Hosts, hear my prayer; give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah
PSA 84:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 84 · Israel] O LORD God of Hosts, hear my prayer; give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah

PSA 84:9.text: Take notice of our shield, O God, and look with favor on the face of Your anointed.
PSA 84:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 84 · Blessing] Take notice of our shield, O God, and look with favor on the face of Your anointed.

PSA 84:10.text: For better is one day in Your courts than a thousand elsewhere. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God than dwell in the tents of the wicked.
PSA 84:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 84] For better is one day in Your courts than a thousand elsewhere. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God than dwell in the tents of the wicked.

PSA 84:11.text: For the LORD God is a sun and a shield; the LORD gives grace and glory; He withholds no good thing from those who walk with integrity.
PSA 84:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 84 · Glory, Grace] For the LORD God is a sun and a shield; the LORD gives grace and glory; He withholds no good thing from those who walk with integrity.

PSA 84:12.text: O LORD of Hosts, how blessed is the man who trusts in You!
PSA 84:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 84 · Faith] O LORD of Hosts, how blessed is the man who trusts in You!

PSA 85:1.text: You showed favor to Your land, O LORD; You restored Jacob from captivity.
PSA 85:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 85 · Blessing, Israel] You showed favor to Your land, O LORD; You restored Jacob from captivity.

PSA 85:2.text: You forgave the iniquity of Your people; You covered all their sin. Selah
PSA 85:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 85] You forgave the iniquity of Your people; You covered all their sin. Selah

PSA 85:3.text: You withheld all Your fury; You turned from Your burning anger.
PSA 85:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 85] You withheld all Your fury; You turned from Your burning anger.

PSA 85:4.text: Restore us, O God of our salvation, and put away Your displeasure toward us.
PSA 85:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 85] Restore us, O God of our salvation, and put away Your displeasure toward us.

PSA 85:5.text: Will You be angry with us forever? Will You draw out Your anger to all generations?
PSA 85:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 85] Will You be angry with us forever? Will You draw out Your anger to all generations?

PSA 85:6.text: Will You not revive us again, that Your people may rejoice in You?
PSA 85:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 85] Will You not revive us again, that Your people may rejoice in You?

PSA 85:7.text: Show us Your loving devotion, O LORD, and grant us Your salvation.
PSA 85:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 85 · Devotion] Show us Your loving devotion, O LORD, and grant us Your salvation.

PSA 85:8.text: I will listen to what God the LORD will say; for He will surely speak peace to His people and His saints; He will not let them return to folly.
PSA 85:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 85] I will listen to what God the LORD will say; for He will surely speak peace to His people and His saints; He will not let them return to folly.

PSA 85:9.text: Surely His salvation is near to those who fear Him, that His glory may dwell in our land.
PSA 85:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 85 · Glory] Surely His salvation is near to those who fear Him, that His glory may dwell in our land.

PSA 85:10.text: Loving devotion and faithfulness have joined together; righteousness and peace have kissed.
PSA 85:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 85 · Faith, Devotion] Loving devotion and faithfulness have joined together; righteousness and peace have kissed.

PSA 85:11.text: Faithfulness sprouts from the earth, and righteousness looks down from heaven.
PSA 85:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 85 · Faith, Heaven] Faithfulness sprouts from the earth, and righteousness looks down from heaven.

PSA 85:12.text: The LORD will indeed provide what is good, and our land will yield its increase.
PSA 85:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 85] The LORD will indeed provide what is good, and our land will yield its increase.

PSA 85:13.text: Righteousness will go before Him to prepare the way for His steps.
PSA 85:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 85] Righteousness will go before Him to prepare the way for His steps.

PSA 86:1.text: Incline Your ear, O LORD, and answer me, for I am poor and needy.
PSA 86:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 86] Incline Your ear, O LORD, and answer me, for I am poor and needy.

PSA 86:2.text: Preserve my soul, for I am godly. You are my God; save Your servant who trusts in You.
PSA 86:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 86 · Faith] Preserve my soul, for I am godly. You are my God; save Your servant who trusts in You.

PSA 86:3.text: Be merciful to me, O Lord, for I call to You all day long.
PSA 86:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 86] Be merciful to me, O Lord, for I call to You all day long.

PSA 86:4.text: Bring joy to Your servant, for to You, O Lord, I lift up my soul.
PSA 86:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 86] Bring joy to Your servant, for to You, O Lord, I lift up my soul.

PSA 86:5.text: For You, O Lord, are kind and forgiving, rich in loving devotion to all who call on You.
PSA 86:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 86 · Forgiveness, Devotion] For You, O Lord, are kind and forgiving, rich in loving devotion to all who call on You.

PSA 86:6.text: Hear my prayer, O LORD, and attend to my plea for mercy.
PSA 86:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 86 · Forgiveness, Compassion] Hear my prayer, O LORD, and attend to my plea for mercy.

PSA 86:7.text: In the day of my distress I call on You, because You answer me.
PSA 86:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 86] In the day of my distress I call on You, because You answer me.

PSA 86:8.text: O Lord, there is none like You among the gods, nor any works like Yours.
PSA 86:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 86] O Lord, there is none like You among the gods, nor any works like Yours.

PSA 86:9.text: All the nations You have made will come and bow before You, O Lord, and they will glorify Your name.
PSA 86:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 86] All the nations You have made will come and bow before You, O Lord, and they will glorify Your name.

PSA 86:10.text: For You are great and perform wonders; You alone are God.
PSA 86:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 86] For You are great and perform wonders; You alone are God.

PSA 86:11.text: Teach me Your way, O LORD, that I may walk in Your truth. Give me an undivided heart, that I may fear Your name.
PSA 86:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 86 · Adultery In Heart] Teach me Your way, O LORD, that I may walk in Your truth. Give me an undivided heart, that I may fear Your name.

PSA 86:12.text: I will praise You, O Lord my God, with all my heart; I will glorify Your name forever.
PSA 86:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 86 · Adultery In Heart] I will praise You, O Lord my God, with all my heart; I will glorify Your name forever.

PSA 86:13.text: For great is Your loving devotion to me; You have delivered me from the depths of Sheol.
PSA 86:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 86 · Death, Devotion] For great is Your loving devotion to me; You have delivered me from the depths of Sheol.

PSA 86:14.text: The arrogant rise against me, O God; a band of ruthless men seeks my life, with no regard for You.
PSA 86:14.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 86] The arrogant rise against me, O God; a band of ruthless men seeks my life, with no regard for You.

PSA 86:15.text: But You, O Lord, are a compassionate and gracious God, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion and faithfulness.
PSA 86:15.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 86 · Faith, Devotion] But You, O Lord, are a compassionate and gracious God, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion and faithfulness.

PSA 86:16.text: Turn to me and have mercy; grant Your strength to Your servant; save the son of Your maidservant.
PSA 86:16.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 86 · Forgiveness, Compassion] Turn to me and have mercy; grant Your strength to Your servant; save the son of Your maidservant.

PSA 86:17.text: Show me a sign of Your goodness, that my enemies may see and be ashamed; for You, O LORD, have helped me and comforted me.
PSA 86:17.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 86] Show me a sign of Your goodness, that my enemies may see and be ashamed; for You, O LORD, have helped me and comforted me.

PSA 87:1.text: He has founded His city on the holy mountains.
PSA 87:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 87] He has founded His city on the holy mountains.

PSA 87:2.text: The LORD loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.
PSA 87:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 87 · Love, Israel] The LORD loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.

PSA 87:3.text: Glorious things are ascribed to you, O city of God. Selah
PSA 87:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 87] Glorious things are ascribed to you, O city of God. Selah

PSA 87:4.text: “I will mention Rahab and Babylon among those who know Me— along with Philistia, Tyre, and Cush— when I say, ‘This one was born in Zion.’”
PSA 87:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 87] “I will mention Rahab and Babylon among those who know Me— along with Philistia, Tyre, and Cush— when I say, ‘This one was born in Zion.’”

PSA 87:5.text: And it will be said of Zion: “This one and that one were born in her, and the Most High Himself will establish her.”
PSA 87:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 87] And it will be said of Zion: “This one and that one were born in her, and the Most High Himself will establish her.”

PSA 87:6.text: The LORD will record in the register of the peoples: “This one was born in Zion.” Selah
PSA 87:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 87] The LORD will record in the register of the peoples: “This one was born in Zion.” Selah

PSA 87:7.text: Singers and pipers will proclaim, “All my springs of joy are in You.”
PSA 87:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 87] Singers and pipers will proclaim, “All my springs of joy are in You.”

PSA 88:1.text: O LORD, the God of my salvation, day and night I cry out before You.
PSA 88:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 88] O LORD, the God of my salvation, day and night I cry out before You.

PSA 88:2.text: May my prayer come before You; incline Your ear to my cry.
PSA 88:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 88] May my prayer come before You; incline Your ear to my cry.

PSA 88:3.text: For my soul is full of troubles, and my life draws near to Sheol.
PSA 88:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 88 · Death] For my soul is full of troubles, and my life draws near to Sheol.

PSA 88:4.text: I am counted among those descending to the Pit. I am like a man without strength.
PSA 88:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 88] I am counted among those descending to the Pit. I am like a man without strength.

PSA 88:5.text: I am forsaken among the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom You remember no more, who are cut off from Your care.
PSA 88:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 88 · Death] I am forsaken among the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom You remember no more, who are cut off from Your care.

PSA 88:6.text: You have laid me in the lowest Pit, in the darkest of the depths.
PSA 88:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 88] You have laid me in the lowest Pit, in the darkest of the depths.

PSA 88:7.text: Your wrath weighs heavily upon me; all Your waves have submerged me. Selah
PSA 88:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 88] Your wrath weighs heavily upon me; all Your waves have submerged me. Selah

PSA 88:8.text: You have removed my friends from me; You have made me repulsive to them; I am confined and cannot escape.
PSA 88:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 88] You have removed my friends from me; You have made me repulsive to them; I am confined and cannot escape.

PSA 88:9.text: My eyes grow dim with grief. I call to You daily, O LORD; I spread out my hands to You.
PSA 88:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 88] My eyes grow dim with grief. I call to You daily, O LORD; I spread out my hands to You.

PSA 88:10.text: Do You work wonders for the dead? Do departed spirits rise up to praise You? Selah
PSA 88:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 88] Do You work wonders for the dead? Do departed spirits rise up to praise You? Selah

PSA 88:11.text: Can Your loving devotion be proclaimed in the grave, Your faithfulness in Abaddon?
PSA 88:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 88 · Faith, Death] Can Your loving devotion be proclaimed in the grave, Your faithfulness in Abaddon?

PSA 88:12.text: Will Your wonders be known in the darkness, or Your righteousness in the land of oblivion?
PSA 88:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 88] Will Your wonders be known in the darkness, or Your righteousness in the land of oblivion?

PSA 88:13.text: But to You, O LORD, I cry for help; in the morning my prayer comes before You.
PSA 88:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 88] But to You, O LORD, I cry for help; in the morning my prayer comes before You.

PSA 88:14.text: Why, O LORD, do You reject me? Why do You hide Your face from me?
PSA 88:14.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 88] Why, O LORD, do You reject me? Why do You hide Your face from me?

PSA 88:15.text: From my youth I was afflicted and near death. I have borne Your terrors; I am in despair.
PSA 88:15.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 88 · Death] From my youth I was afflicted and near death. I have borne Your terrors; I am in despair.

PSA 88:16.text: Your wrath has swept over me; Your terrors have destroyed me.
PSA 88:16.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 88] Your wrath has swept over me; Your terrors have destroyed me.

PSA 88:17.text: All day long they engulf me like water; they enclose me on every side.
PSA 88:17.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 88] All day long they engulf me like water; they enclose me on every side.

PSA 88:18.text: You have removed my beloved and my friend; darkness is my closest companion.
PSA 88:18.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 88 · Love] You have removed my beloved and my friend; darkness is my closest companion.

PSA 89:1.text: I will sing of the loving devotion of the LORD forever; with my mouth I will proclaim Your faithfulness to all generations.
PSA 89:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 89 · Faith, Devotion] I will sing of the loving devotion of the LORD forever; with my mouth I will proclaim Your faithfulness to all generations.

PSA 89:2.text: For I have said, “Loving devotion is built up forever; in the heavens You establish Your faithfulness.”
PSA 89:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 89 · Faith, Devotion] For I have said, “Loving devotion is built up forever; in the heavens You establish Your faithfulness.”

PSA 89:3.text: You said, “I have made a covenant with My chosen one, I have sworn to David My servant:
PSA 89:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 89 · Covenant, Election] You said, “I have made a covenant with My chosen one, I have sworn to David My servant:

PSA 89:4.text: ‘I will establish your offspring forever and build up your throne for all generations.’” Selah
PSA 89:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 89 · Children] ‘I will establish your offspring forever and build up your throne for all generations.’” Selah

PSA 89:5.text: The heavens praise Your wonders, O LORD— Your faithfulness as well— in the assembly of the holy ones.
PSA 89:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 89 · Faith, Church] The heavens praise Your wonders, O LORD— Your faithfulness as well— in the assembly of the holy ones.

PSA 89:6.text: For who in the skies can compare with the LORD? Who among the heavenly beings is like the LORD?
PSA 89:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 89] For who in the skies can compare with the LORD? Who among the heavenly beings is like the LORD?

PSA 89:7.text: In the council of the holy ones, God is greatly feared, and awesome above all who surround Him.
PSA 89:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 89] In the council of the holy ones, God is greatly feared, and awesome above all who surround Him.

PSA 89:8.text: O LORD God of Hosts, who is like You? O mighty LORD, Your faithfulness surrounds You.
PSA 89:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 89 · Faith, Marital Faithfulness] O LORD God of Hosts, who is like You? O mighty LORD, Your faithfulness surrounds You.

PSA 89:9.text: You rule the raging sea; when its waves mount up, You still them.
PSA 89:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 89] You rule the raging sea; when its waves mount up, You still them.

PSA 89:10.text: You crushed Rahab like a carcass; You scattered Your enemies with Your mighty arm.
PSA 89:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 89] You crushed Rahab like a carcass; You scattered Your enemies with Your mighty arm.

PSA 89:11.text: The heavens are Yours, and also the earth. The earth and its fullness You founded.
PSA 89:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 89] The heavens are Yours, and also the earth. The earth and its fullness You founded.

PSA 89:12.text: North and south You created; Tabor and Hermon shout for joy at Your name.
PSA 89:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 89] North and south You created; Tabor and Hermon shout for joy at Your name.

PSA 89:13.text: Mighty is Your arm; strong is Your hand. Your right hand is exalted.
PSA 89:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 89 · Ascension] Mighty is Your arm; strong is Your hand. Your right hand is exalted.

PSA 89:14.text: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of Your throne; loving devotion and faithfulness go before You.
PSA 89:14.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 89 · Faith, Devotion] Righteousness and justice are the foundation of Your throne; loving devotion and faithfulness go before You.

PSA 89:15.text: Blessed are those who know the joyful sound, who walk, O LORD, in the light of Your presence.
PSA 89:15.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 89 · Beatitudes, Light] Blessed are those who know the joyful sound, who walk, O LORD, in the light of Your presence.

PSA 89:16.text: They rejoice in Your name all day long, and in Your righteousness they exult.
PSA 89:16.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 89] They rejoice in Your name all day long, and in Your righteousness they exult.

PSA 89:17.text: For You are the glory of their strength, and by Your favor our horn is exalted.
PSA 89:17.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 89 · Ascension, Blessing] For You are the glory of their strength, and by Your favor our horn is exalted.

PSA 89:18.text: Surely our shield belongs to the LORD, and our king to the Holy One of Israel.
PSA 89:18.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 89 · Israel] Surely our shield belongs to the LORD, and our king to the Holy One of Israel.

PSA 89:19.text: You once spoke in a vision; to Your godly ones You said, “I have bestowed help on a warrior; I have exalted one chosen from the people.
PSA 89:19.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 89 · Ascension, Election] You once spoke in a vision; to Your godly ones You said, “I have bestowed help on a warrior; I have exalted one chosen from the people.

PSA 89:20.text: I have found My servant David; with My sacred oil I have anointed him.
PSA 89:20.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 89] I have found My servant David; with My sacred oil I have anointed him.

PSA 89:21.text: My hand will sustain him; surely My arm will strengthen him.
PSA 89:21.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 89] My hand will sustain him; surely My arm will strengthen him.

PSA 89:22.text: No enemy will exact tribute; no wicked man will oppress him.
PSA 89:22.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 89] No enemy will exact tribute; no wicked man will oppress him.

PSA 89:23.text: I will crush his foes before him and strike down those who hate him.
PSA 89:23.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 89] I will crush his foes before him and strike down those who hate him.

PSA 89:24.text: My faithfulness and loving devotion will be with him, and through My name his horn will be exalted.
PSA 89:24.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 89 · Faith, Ascension] My faithfulness and loving devotion will be with him, and through My name his horn will be exalted.

PSA 89:25.text: I will set his hand over the sea, and his right hand upon the rivers.
PSA 89:25.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 89] I will set his hand over the sea, and his right hand upon the rivers.

PSA 89:26.text: He will call to Me, ‘You are my Father, my God, the Rock of my salvation.’
PSA 89:26.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 89 · God the Father] He will call to Me, ‘You are my Father, my God, the Rock of my salvation.’

PSA 89:27.text: I will indeed appoint him as My firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.
PSA 89:27.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 89] I will indeed appoint him as My firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.

PSA 89:28.text: I will forever preserve My loving devotion for him, and My covenant with him will stand fast.
PSA 89:28.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 89 · Covenant, Devotion] I will forever preserve My loving devotion for him, and My covenant with him will stand fast.

PSA 89:29.text: I will establish his line forever, his throne as long as the heavens endure.
PSA 89:29.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 89] I will establish his line forever, his throne as long as the heavens endure.

PSA 89:30.text: If his sons forsake My law and do not walk in My judgments,

PSA 89:47.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 89] Remember the briefness of my lifespan! For what futility You have created all men!

PSA 90:1.text: Lord, You have been our dwelling place through all generations.
PSA 90:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 90] Lord, You have been our dwelling place through all generations.

PSA 90:2.text: Before the mountains were born or You brought forth the earth and the world, from everlasting to everlasting You are God.
PSA 90:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 90] Before the mountains were born or You brought forth the earth and the world, from everlasting to everlasting You are God.

PSA 90:3.text: You return man to dust, saying, “Return, O sons of mortals.”
PSA 90:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 90] You return man to dust, saying, “Return, O sons of mortals.”

PSA 90:4.text: For in Your sight a thousand years are but a day that passes, or a watch of the night.
PSA 90:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 90] For in Your sight a thousand years are but a day that passes, or a watch of the night.

PSA 90:5.text: You whisk them away in their sleep; they are like the new grass of the morning—
PSA 90:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 90] You whisk them away in their sleep; they are like the new grass of the morning—

PSA 90:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 90] in the morning it springs up new, but by evening it fades and withers.

PSA 90:7.text: For we are consumed by Your anger and terrified by Your wrath.
PSA 90:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 90] For we are consumed by Your anger and terrified by Your wrath.

PSA 90:8.text: You have set our iniquities before You, our secret sins in the light of Your presence.
PSA 90:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 90 · Light] You have set our iniquities before You, our secret sins in the light of Your presence.

PSA 90:9.text: For all our days decline in Your fury; we finish our years with a sigh.
PSA 90:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 90] For all our days decline in Your fury; we finish our years with a sigh.

PSA 90:10.text: The length of our days is seventy years— or eighty if we are strong— yet their pride is but labor and sorrow, for they quickly pass, and we fly away.
PSA 90:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 90] The length of our days is seventy years— or eighty if we are strong— yet their pride is but labor and sorrow, for they quickly pass, and we fly away.

PSA 90:11.text: Who knows the power of Your anger? Your wrath matches the fear You are due.
PSA 90:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 90] Who knows the power of Your anger? Your wrath matches the fear You are due.

PSA 90:12.text: So teach us to number our days, that we may present a heart of wisdom.
PSA 90:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 90 · Adultery In Heart] So teach us to number our days, that we may present a heart of wisdom.

PSA 90:13.text: Return, O LORD! How long will it be? Have compassion on Your servants.
PSA 90:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 90 · Compassion] Return, O LORD! How long will it be? Have compassion on Your servants.

PSA 90:14.text: Satisfy us in the morning with Your loving devotion, that we may sing for joy and be glad all our days.
PSA 90:14.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 90 · Devotion] Satisfy us in the morning with Your loving devotion, that we may sing for joy and be glad all our days.

PSA 90:15.text: Make us glad for as many days as You have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen evil.
PSA 90:15.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 90] Make us glad for as many days as You have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen evil.

PSA 90:16.text: May Your work be shown to Your servants, and Your splendor to their children.
PSA 90:16.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 90 · Children] May Your work be shown to Your servants, and Your splendor to their children.

PSA 90:17.text: May the favor of the Lord our God rest upon us; establish for us the work of our hands— yes, establish the work of our hands!
PSA 90:17.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 90 · Blessing] May the favor of the Lord our God rest upon us; establish for us the work of our hands— yes, establish the work of our hands!

PSA 91:1.text: He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High will abide in the shadow of the Almighty.
PSA 91:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 91] He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High will abide in the shadow of the Almighty.

PSA 91:2.text: I will say to the LORD, “You are my refuge and my fortress, my God, in whom I trust.”
PSA 91:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 91 · Faith] I will say to the LORD, “You are my refuge and my fortress, my God, in whom I trust.”

PSA 91:3.text: Surely He will deliver you from the snare of the fowler, and from the deadly plague.
PSA 91:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 91] Surely He will deliver you from the snare of the fowler, and from the deadly plague.

PSA 91:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 91 · Faith, Marital Faithfulness] He will cover you with His feathers; under His wings you will find refuge; His faithfulness is a shield and rampart.

PSA 91:5.text: You will not fear the terror of the night, nor the arrow that flies by day,
PSA 91:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 91] You will not fear the terror of the night, nor the arrow that flies by day,

PSA 91:6.text: nor the pestilence that stalks in the darkness, nor the calamity that destroys at noon.
PSA 91:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 91] nor the pestilence that stalks in the darkness, nor the calamity that destroys at noon.

PSA 91:7.text: Though a thousand may fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand, no harm will come near you.
PSA 91:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 91] Though a thousand may fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand, no harm will come near you.

PSA 91:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 91 · False Witness] You will only see it with your eyes and witness the punishment of the wicked.

PSA 91:9.text: Because you have made the LORD your dwelling— my refuge, the Most High—
PSA 91:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 91] Because you have made the LORD your dwelling— my refuge, the Most High—

PSA 91:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 91] no evil will befall you, no plague will approach your tent.

PSA 91:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 91 · Angels] For He will command His angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways.

PSA 91:12.text: They will lift you up in their hands, so that you will not strike your foot against a stone.
PSA 91:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 91] They will lift you up in their hands, so that you will not strike your foot against a stone.

PSA 91:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 91] You will tread on the lion and cobra; you will trample the young lion and serpent.

PSA 91:16.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 91] With long life I will satisfy him and show him My salvation.”

PSA 92:1.text: It is good to praise the LORD, and to sing praises to Your name, O Most High,

PSA 92:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 92 · Faith, Devotion] to proclaim Your loving devotion in the morning and Your faithfulness at night

PSA 92:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 92] For You, O LORD, have made me glad by Your deeds; I sing for joy at the works of Your hands.

PSA 92:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 92] that though the wicked sprout like grass, and all evildoers flourish, they will be forever destroyed.

PSA 92:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 92 · Ascension] But You have exalted my horn like that of a wild ox; with fine oil I have been anointed.

PSA 92:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 92] The righteous will flourish like a palm tree, and grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

PSA 92:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 92] Planted in the house of the LORD, they will flourish in the courts of our God.

PSA 92:15.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 92] to proclaim, “The LORD is upright; He is my Rock, and in Him there is no unrighteousness.”

PSA 93:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 93] Your throne was established long ago; You are from all eternity.

PSA 93:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 93] The floodwaters have risen, O LORD; the rivers have raised their voice; the seas lift up their pounding waves.

PSA 93:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 93] Above the roar of many waters— the mighty breakers of the sea— the LORD on high is majestic.

PSA 94:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 94] O LORD, God of vengeance, O God of vengeance, shine forth.

PSA 94:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 94] Rise up, O Judge of the earth; render a reward to the proud.

PSA 94:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 94] How long will the wicked, O LORD, how long will the wicked exult?

PSA 94:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 94] They pour out arrogant words; all workers of iniquity boast.

PSA 94:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 94] They crush Your people, O LORD; they oppress Your heritage.

PSA 94:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 94] They kill the widow and the foreigner; they murder the fatherless.

PSA 94:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 94 · Israel] They say, “The LORD does not see; the God of Jacob pays no heed.”

PSA 94:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 94] Take notice, O senseless among the people! O fools, when will you be wise?

PSA 94:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 94] He who affixed the ear, can He not hear? He who formed the eye, can He not see?

PSA 94:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 94] He who admonishes the nations, does He not discipline? He who teaches man, does He lack knowledge?

PSA 94:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 94] The LORD knows the thoughts of man, that they are futile.

PSA 94:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 94] to grant him relief from days of trouble, until a pit is dug for the wicked.

PSA 94:14.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 94] For the LORD will not forsake His people; He will never abandon His heritage.

PSA 94:15.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 94 · Adultery In Heart, Judgment] Surely judgment will again be righteous, and all the upright in heart will follow it.

PSA 94:16.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 94] Who will rise up for me against the wicked? Who will stand for me against the workers of iniquity?

PSA 94:17.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 94] Unless the LORD had been my helper, I would soon have dwelt in the abode of silence.

PSA 94:18.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 94 · Devotion] If I say, “My foot is slipping,” Your loving devotion, O LORD, supports me.
