PSA 104:15.text: wine that gladdens the heart of man, oil that makes his face to shine, and bread that sustains his heart.
PSA 104:15.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 104 · Adultery In Heart] wine that gladdens the heart of man, oil that makes his face to shine, and bread that sustains his heart.

PSA 104:16.text: The trees of the LORD have their fill, the cedars of Lebanon that He planted,
PSA 104:16.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 104] The trees of the LORD have their fill, the cedars of Lebanon that He planted,

PSA 104:17.text: where the birds build their nests; the stork makes her home in the cypresses.
PSA 104:17.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 104] where the birds build their nests; the stork makes her home in the cypresses.

PSA 104:18.text: The high mountains are for the wild goats, the cliffs a refuge for the rock badgers.
PSA 104:18.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 104] The high mountains are for the wild goats, the cliffs a refuge for the rock badgers.

PSA 104:19.text: He made the moon to mark the seasons; the sun knows when to set.
PSA 104:19.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 104] He made the moon to mark the seasons; the sun knows when to set.

PSA 104:20.text: You bring darkness, and it becomes night, when all the beasts of the forest prowl.
PSA 104:20.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 104] You bring darkness, and it becomes night, when all the beasts of the forest prowl.

PSA 104:21.text: The young lions roar for their prey and seek their food from God.
PSA 104:21.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 104] The young lions roar for their prey and seek their food from God.

PSA 104:22.text: The sun rises, and they withdraw; they lie down in their dens.
PSA 104:22.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 104] The sun rises, and they withdraw; they lie down in their dens.

PSA 104:23.text: Man goes forth to his work and to his labor until evening.
PSA 104:23.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 104] Man goes forth to his work and to his labor until evening.

PSA 104:24.text: How many are Your works, O LORD! In wisdom You have made them all; the earth is full of Your creatures.
PSA 104:24.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 104] How many are Your works, O LORD! In wisdom You have made them all; the earth is full of Your creatures.

PSA 104:25.text: Here is the sea, vast and wide, teeming with creatures beyond number, living things both great and small.
PSA 104:25.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 104] Here is the sea, vast and wide, teeming with creatures beyond number, living things both great and small.

PSA 104:26.text: There the ships pass, and Leviathan, which You formed to frolic there.
PSA 104:26.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 104] There the ships pass, and Leviathan, which You formed to frolic there.

PSA 104:27.text: All creatures look to You to give them their food in due season.
PSA 104:27.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 104] All creatures look to You to give them their food in due season.

PSA 104:28.text: When You give it to them, they gather it up; when You open Your hand, they are satisfied with good things.
PSA 104:28.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 104] When You give it to them, they gather it up; when You open Your hand, they are satisfied with good things.

PSA 104:29.text: When You hide Your face, they are terrified; when You take away their breath, they die and return to dust.
PSA 104:29.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 104] When You hide Your face, they are terrified; when You take away their breath, they die and return to dust.

PSA 104:30.text: When You send Your Spirit, they are created, and You renew the face of the earth.
PSA 104:30.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 104 · Fruit of the Spirit] When You send Your Spirit, they are created, and You renew the face of the earth.

PSA 104:31.text: May the glory of the LORD endure forever; may the LORD rejoice in His works.
PSA 104:31.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 104 · Glory] May the glory of the LORD endure forever; may the LORD rejoice in His works.

PSA 104:32.text: He looks on the earth, and it trembles; He touches the mountains, and they smolder.
PSA 104:32.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 104] He looks on the earth, and it trembles; He touches the mountains, and they smolder.

PSA 104:33.text: I will sing to the LORD all my life; I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.
PSA 104:33.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 104] I will sing to the LORD all my life; I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.

PSA 104:34.text: May my meditation be pleasing to Him, for I rejoice in the LORD.
PSA 104:34.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 104] May my meditation be pleasing to Him, for I rejoice in the LORD.

PSA 104:35.text: May sinners vanish from the earth and the wicked be no more.   Bless the LORD, O my soul.   Hallelujah!
PSA 104:35.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 104] May sinners vanish from the earth and the wicked be no more.   Bless the LORD, O my soul.   Hallelujah!

PSA 105:1.text: Give thanks to the LORD, call upon His name; make known His deeds among the nations.
PSA 105:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 105] Give thanks to the LORD, call upon His name; make known His deeds among the nations.

PSA 105:2.text: Sing to Him, sing praises to Him; tell of all His wonders.
PSA 105:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 105] Sing to Him, sing praises to Him; tell of all His wonders.

PSA 105:3.text: Glory in His holy name; let the hearts of those who seek the LORD rejoice.
PSA 105:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 105 · Glory] Glory in His holy name; let the hearts of those who seek the LORD rejoice.

PSA 105:4.text: Seek out the LORD and His strength; seek His face always.
PSA 105:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 105] Seek out the LORD and His strength; seek His face always.

PSA 105:5.text: Remember the wonders He has done, His marvels, and the judgments He has pronounced,
PSA 105:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 105] Remember the wonders He has done, His marvels, and the judgments He has pronounced,

PSA 105:6.text: O offspring of His servant Abraham, O sons of Jacob, His chosen ones.
PSA 105:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 105 · Children, Election] O offspring of His servant Abraham, O sons of Jacob, His chosen ones.

PSA 105:7.text: He is the LORD our God; His judgments carry throughout the earth.
PSA 105:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 105] He is the LORD our God; His judgments carry throughout the earth.

PSA 105:8.text: He remembers His covenant forever, the word He ordained for a thousand generations—
PSA 105:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 105 · Covenant] He remembers His covenant forever, the word He ordained for a thousand generations—

PSA 105:9.text: the covenant He made with Abraham, and the oath He swore to Isaac.
PSA 105:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 105 · Covenant] the covenant He made with Abraham, and the oath He swore to Isaac.

PSA 105:10.text: He confirmed it to Jacob as a decree, to Israel as an everlasting covenant:
PSA 105:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 105 · Covenant, Israel] He confirmed it to Jacob as a decree, to Israel as an everlasting covenant:

PSA 105:11.text: “I will give you the land of Canaan as the portion of your inheritance.”
PSA 105:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 105 · Conquest Of Canaan, Destroy Canaan] “I will give you the land of Canaan as the portion of your inheritance.”

PSA 105:12.text: When they were few in number, few indeed, and strangers in the land,
PSA 105:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 105] When they were few in number, few indeed, and strangers in the land,

PSA 105:13.text: they wandered from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another.
PSA 105:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 105 · Kingdom of God] they wandered from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another.

PSA 105:14.text: He let no man oppress them; He rebuked kings on their behalf:
PSA 105:14.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 105] He let no man oppress them; He rebuked kings on their behalf:

PSA 105:15.text: “Do not touch My anointed ones! Do no harm to My prophets!”
PSA 105:15.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 105] “Do not touch My anointed ones! Do no harm to My prophets!”

PSA 105:16.text: He called down famine on the land and cut off all their supplies of food.
PSA 105:16.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 105] He called down famine on the land and cut off all their supplies of food.

PSA 105:17.text: He sent a man before them— Joseph, sold as a slave.
PSA 105:17.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 105] He sent a man before them— Joseph, sold as a slave.

PSA 105:18.text: They bruised his feet with shackles and placed his neck in irons,
PSA 105:18.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 105] They bruised his feet with shackles and placed his neck in irons,

PSA 105:19.text: until his prediction came true and the word of the LORD proved him right.
PSA 105:19.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 105] until his prediction came true and the word of the LORD proved him right.

PSA 105:20.text: The king sent and released him; the ruler of peoples set him free.
PSA 105:20.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 105] The king sent and released him; the ruler of peoples set him free.

PSA 105:21.text: He made him master of his household, ruler over all his substance,
PSA 105:21.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 105 · Family] He made him master of his household, ruler over all his substance,

PSA 105:22.text: to instruct his princes as he pleased and teach his elders wisdom.
PSA 105:22.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 105 · Leadership] to instruct his princes as he pleased and teach his elders wisdom.

PSA 105:23.text: Then Israel entered Egypt; Jacob dwelt in the land of Ham.
PSA 105:23.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 105 · Israel] Then Israel entered Egypt; Jacob dwelt in the land of Ham.

PSA 105:24.text: And the LORD made His people very fruitful, more numerous than their foes,
PSA 105:24.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 105] And the LORD made His people very fruitful, more numerous than their foes,

PSA 105:25.text: whose hearts He turned to hate His people, to conspire against His servants.
PSA 105:25.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 105] whose hearts He turned to hate His people, to conspire against His servants.

PSA 105:26.text: He sent Moses His servant, and Aaron, whom He had chosen.
PSA 105:26.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 105 · Election] He sent Moses His servant, and Aaron, whom He had chosen.

PSA 105:27.text: They performed His miraculous signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.
PSA 105:27.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 105] They performed His miraculous signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.

PSA 105:28.text: He sent darkness, and it became dark— yet they defied His words.
PSA 105:28.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 105] He sent darkness, and it became dark— yet they defied His words.

PSA 105:29.text: He turned their waters to blood and caused their fish to die.
PSA 105:29.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 105] He turned their waters to blood and caused their fish to die.

PSA 105:30.text: Their land teemed with frogs, even in their royal chambers.
PSA 105:30.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 105] Their land teemed with frogs, even in their royal chambers.

PSA 105:31.text: He spoke, and insects swarmed— gnats throughout their country.
PSA 105:31.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 105] He spoke, and insects swarmed— gnats throughout their country.

PSA 105:32.text: He gave them hail for rain, with lightning throughout their land.
PSA 105:32.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 105] He gave them hail for rain, with lightning throughout their land.

PSA 105:33.text: He struck their vines and fig trees and shattered the trees of their country.
PSA 105:33.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 105] He struck their vines and fig trees and shattered the trees of their country.

PSA 105:34.text: He spoke, and the locusts came— young locusts without number.
PSA 105:34.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 105] He spoke, and the locusts came— young locusts without number.

PSA 105:35.text: They devoured every plant in their land and consumed the produce of their soil.
PSA 105:35.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 105] They devoured every plant in their land and consumed the produce of their soil.

PSA 105:36.text: Then He struck all the firstborn in their land, the firstfruits of all their vigor.
PSA 105:36.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 105] Then He struck all the firstborn in their land, the firstfruits of all their vigor.

PSA 105:37.text: He brought Israel out with silver and gold, and none among His tribes stumbled.
PSA 105:37.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 105 · Israel] He brought Israel out with silver and gold, and none among His tribes stumbled.

PSA 105:38.text: Egypt was glad when they departed, for the dread of Israel had fallen on them.
PSA 105:38.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 105 · Fear, Israel] Egypt was glad when they departed, for the dread of Israel had fallen on them.

PSA 105:39.text: He spread a cloud as a covering and a fire to light up the night.
PSA 105:39.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 105 · Light] He spread a cloud as a covering and a fire to light up the night.

PSA 105:40.text: They asked, and He brought quail and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.
PSA 105:40.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 105 · Heaven] They asked, and He brought quail and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.

PSA 105:41.text: He opened a rock, and water gushed out; it flowed like a river in the desert.
PSA 105:41.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 105] He opened a rock, and water gushed out; it flowed like a river in the desert.

PSA 105:42.text: For He remembered His holy promise to Abraham His servant.
PSA 105:42.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 105 · Covenant] For He remembered His holy promise to Abraham His servant.

PSA 105:43.text: He brought forth His people with rejoicing, His chosen with shouts of joy.
PSA 105:43.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 105 · Election, Joy] He brought forth His people with rejoicing, His chosen with shouts of joy.

PSA 105:44.text: He gave them the lands of the nations, that they might inherit the fruit of others’ labor,
PSA 105:44.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 105 · Fruit of the Spirit] He gave them the lands of the nations, that they might inherit the fruit of others’ labor,

PSA 105:45.text: that they might keep His statutes and obey His laws.   Hallelujah!
PSA 105:45.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 105] that they might keep His statutes and obey His laws.   Hallelujah!

PSA 106:1.text: Hallelujah!   Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 106:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 106 · Devotion] Hallelujah!   Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.

PSA 106:2.text: Who can describe the mighty acts of the LORD or fully proclaim His praise?
PSA 106:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 106] Who can describe the mighty acts of the LORD or fully proclaim His praise?

PSA 106:3.text: Blessed are those who uphold justice, who practice righteousness at all times.
PSA 106:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 106 · Beatitudes, End Times] Blessed are those who uphold justice, who practice righteousness at all times.

PSA 106:4.text: Remember me, O LORD, in Your favor to Your people; visit me with Your salvation,
PSA 106:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 106 · Blessing] Remember me, O LORD, in Your favor to Your people; visit me with Your salvation,

PSA 106:5.text: that I may see the prosperity of Your chosen ones, and rejoice in the gladness of Your nation, and give glory with Your inheritance.
PSA 106:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 106 · Blessing, Election] that I may see the prosperity of Your chosen ones, and rejoice in the gladness of Your nation, and give glory with Your inheritance.

PSA 106:6.text: We have sinned like our fathers; we have done wrong and acted wickedly.
PSA 106:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 106] We have sinned like our fathers; we have done wrong and acted wickedly.

PSA 106:7.text: Our fathers in Egypt did not grasp Your wonders or remember Your abundant kindness; but they rebelled by the sea, there at the Red Sea.
PSA 106:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 106 · Grace] Our fathers in Egypt did not grasp Your wonders or remember Your abundant kindness; but they rebelled by the sea, there at the Red Sea.

PSA 106:8.text: Yet He saved them for the sake of His name, to make His power known.
PSA 106:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 106] Yet He saved them for the sake of His name, to make His power known.

PSA 106:9.text: He rebuked the Red Sea, and it dried up; He led them through the depths as through a desert.
PSA 106:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 106] He rebuked the Red Sea, and it dried up; He led them through the depths as through a desert.

PSA 106:10.text: He saved them from the hand that hated them; He redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
PSA 106:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 106] He saved them from the hand that hated them; He redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.

PSA 106:11.text: The waters covered their foes; not one of them remained.
PSA 106:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 106] The waters covered their foes; not one of them remained.

PSA 106:12.text: Then they believed His promises and sang His praise.
PSA 106:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 106 · Faith] Then they believed His promises and sang His praise.

PSA 106:13.text: Yet they soon forgot His works and failed to wait for His counsel.
PSA 106:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 106] Yet they soon forgot His works and failed to wait for His counsel.

PSA 106:14.text: They craved intensely in the wilderness and tested God in the desert.
PSA 106:14.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 106] They craved intensely in the wilderness and tested God in the desert.

PSA 106:15.text: So He granted their request, but sent a wasting disease upon them.
PSA 106:15.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 106] So He granted their request, but sent a wasting disease upon them.

PSA 106:16.text: In the camp they envied Moses, as well as Aaron, the holy one of the LORD.
PSA 106:16.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 106] In the camp they envied Moses, as well as Aaron, the holy one of the LORD.

PSA 106:17.text: The earth opened up and swallowed Dathan; it covered the assembly of Abiram.
PSA 106:17.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 106 · Church] The earth opened up and swallowed Dathan; it covered the assembly of Abiram.

PSA 106:18.text: Then fire blazed through their company; flames consumed the wicked.
PSA 106:18.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 106] Then fire blazed through their company; flames consumed the wicked.

PSA 106:19.text: At Horeb they made a calf and worshiped a molten image.
PSA 106:19.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 106 · Graven Image] At Horeb they made a calf and worshiped a molten image.

PSA 106:20.text: They exchanged their Glory for the image of a grass-eating ox.
PSA 106:20.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 106 · Glory, Graven Image] They exchanged their Glory for the image of a grass-eating ox.

PSA 106:21.text: They forgot God their Savior, who did great things in Egypt,
PSA 106:21.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 106] They forgot God their Savior, who did great things in Egypt,

PSA 106:22.text: wondrous works in the land of Ham, and awesome deeds by the Red Sea.
PSA 106:22.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 106] wondrous works in the land of Ham, and awesome deeds by the Red Sea.

PSA 106:23.text: So He said He would destroy them— had not Moses His chosen one stood before Him in the breach to divert His wrath from destroying them.
PSA 106:23.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 106 · Destroy Canaan, Destroy Canaanites] So He said He would destroy them— had not Moses His chosen one stood before Him in the breach to divert His wrath from destroying them.

PSA 106:24.text: They despised the pleasant land; they did not believe His promise.
PSA 106:24.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 106 · Faith, Covenant] They despised the pleasant land; they did not believe His promise.

PSA 106:25.text: They grumbled in their tents and did not listen to the voice of the LORD.
PSA 106:25.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 106] They grumbled in their tents and did not listen to the voice of the LORD.

PSA 106:26.text: So He raised His hand and swore to cast them down in the wilderness,
PSA 106:26.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 106] So He raised His hand and swore to cast them down in the wilderness,

PSA 106:27.text: to disperse their offspring among the nations and scatter them throughout the lands.
PSA 106:27.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 106 · Children] to disperse their offspring among the nations and scatter them throughout the lands.

PSA 106:28.text: They yoked themselves to Baal of Peor and ate sacrifices offered to lifeless gods.
PSA 106:28.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 106] They yoked themselves to Baal of Peor and ate sacrifices offered to lifeless gods.

PSA 106:29.text: So they provoked the LORD to anger with their deeds, and a plague broke out among them.
PSA 106:29.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 106] So they provoked the LORD to anger with their deeds, and a plague broke out among them.

PSA 106:30.text: But Phinehas stood and intervened, and the plague was restrained.
PSA 106:30.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 106] But Phinehas stood and intervened, and the plague was restrained.

PSA 106:31.text: It was credited to him as righteousness for endless generations to come.
PSA 106:31.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 106] It was credited to him as righteousness for endless generations to come.

PSA 106:32.text: At the waters of Meribah they angered the LORD, and trouble came to Moses because of them.
PSA 106:32.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 106] At the waters of Meribah they angered the LORD, and trouble came to Moses because of them.

PSA 106:33.text: For they rebelled against His Spirit, and Moses spoke rashly with his lips.
PSA 106:33.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 106 · Fruit of the Spirit] For they rebelled against His Spirit, and Moses spoke rashly with his lips.

PSA 106:34.text: They did not destroy the peoples as the LORD had commanded them,
PSA 106:34.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 106 · Destroy Canaan, Destroy Canaanites] They did not destroy the peoples as the LORD had commanded them,

PSA 106:35.text: but they mingled with the nations and adopted their customs.
PSA 106:35.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 106] but they mingled with the nations and adopted their customs.

PSA 106:36.text: They worshiped their idols, which became a snare to them.
PSA 106:36.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 106 · Idolatry, Idols] They worshiped their idols, which became a snare to them.

PSA 106:37.text: They sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons.
PSA 106:37.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 106 · Demons] They sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons.

PSA 106:38.text: They shed innocent blood— the blood of their sons and daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan, and the land was polluted with blood.
PSA 106:38.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 106 · Conquest Of Canaan, Destroy Canaan] They shed innocent blood— the blood of their sons and daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan, and the land was polluted with blood.

PSA 106:39.text: They defiled themselves by their actions and prostituted themselves by their deeds.
PSA 106:39.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 106] They defiled themselves by their actions and prostituted themselves by their deeds.

PSA 106:40.text: So the anger of the LORD burned against His people, and He abhorred His own inheritance.
PSA 106:40.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 106 · Inheritance] So the anger of the LORD burned against His people, and He abhorred His own inheritance.

PSA 106:41.text: He delivered them into the hand of the nations, and those who hated them ruled over them.
PSA 106:41.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 106] He delivered them into the hand of the nations, and those who hated them ruled over them.

PSA 106:42.text: Their enemies oppressed them, and subdued them under their hand.
PSA 106:42.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 106] Their enemies oppressed them, and subdued them under their hand.

PSA 106:43.text: Many times He rescued them, but they were bent on rebellion and sank down in their iniquity.
PSA 106:43.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 106 · End Times] Many times He rescued them, but they were bent on rebellion and sank down in their iniquity.

PSA 106:44.text: Nevertheless He heard their cry; He took note of their distress.
PSA 106:44.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 106] Nevertheless He heard their cry; He took note of their distress.

PSA 106:45.text: And He remembered His covenant with them, and relented by the abundance of His loving devotion.
PSA 106:45.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 106 · Covenant, Devotion] And He remembered His covenant with them, and relented by the abundance of His loving devotion.

PSA 106:46.text: He made them objects of compassion to all who held them captive.
PSA 106:46.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 106 · Compassion] He made them objects of compassion to all who held them captive.

PSA 106:47.text: Save us, O LORD our God, and gather us from the nations, that we may give thanks to Your holy name, that we may glory in Your praise.
PSA 106:47.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 106 · Glory] Save us, O LORD our God, and gather us from the nations, that we may give thanks to Your holy name, that we may glory in Your praise.

PSA 106:48.text: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting.   Let all the people say, “Amen!”   Hallelujah!
PSA 106:48.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 106 · Israel] Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting.   Let all the people say, “Amen!”   Hallelujah!

PSA 107:1.text: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 107:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 107 · Devotion] Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.

PSA 107:2.text: Let the redeemed of the LORD say so, whom He has redeemed from the hand of the enemy
PSA 107:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 107] Let the redeemed of the LORD say so, whom He has redeemed from the hand of the enemy

PSA 107:3.text: and gathered from the lands, from east and west, from north and south.
PSA 107:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 107] and gathered from the lands, from east and west, from north and south.

PSA 107:4.text: Some wandered in desert wastelands, finding no path to a city in which to dwell.
PSA 107:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 107] Some wandered in desert wastelands, finding no path to a city in which to dwell.

PSA 107:5.text: They were hungry and thirsty; their soul fainted within them.
PSA 107:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 107] They were hungry and thirsty; their soul fainted within them.

PSA 107:6.text: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He delivered them from their distress.
PSA 107:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 107] Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He delivered them from their distress.

PSA 107:7.text: He led them on a straight path to reach a city where they could live.
PSA 107:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 107] He led them on a straight path to reach a city where they could live.

PSA 107:8.text: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.
PSA 107:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 107 · Devotion] Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.

PSA 107:9.text: For He satisfies the thirsty and fills the hungry with good things.
PSA 107:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 107] For He satisfies the thirsty and fills the hungry with good things.

PSA 107:10.text: Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, prisoners in affliction and chains,

PSA 107:11.text: because they rebelled against the words of God and despised the counsel of the Most High.
PSA 107:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 107] because they rebelled against the words of God and despised the counsel of the Most High.

PSA 107:12.text: He humbled their hearts with hard labor; they stumbled, and there was no one to help.
PSA 107:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 107] He humbled their hearts with hard labor; they stumbled, and there was no one to help.

PSA 107:13.text: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He saved them from their distress.
PSA 107:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 107] Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He saved them from their distress.

PSA 107:14.text: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death and broke away their chains.
PSA 107:14.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 107 · Death] He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death and broke away their chains.

PSA 107:15.text: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.
PSA 107:15.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 107 · Devotion] Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.

PSA 107:16.text: For He has broken down the gates of bronze and cut through the bars of iron.
PSA 107:16.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 107] For He has broken down the gates of bronze and cut through the bars of iron.

PSA 107:17.text: Fools, in their rebellious ways, and through their iniquities, suffered affliction.
PSA 107:17.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 107] Fools, in their rebellious ways, and through their iniquities, suffered affliction.

PSA 107:18.text: They loathed all food and drew near to the gates of death.
PSA 107:18.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 107 · Death] They loathed all food and drew near to the gates of death.

PSA 107:19.text: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He saved them from their distress.
PSA 107:19.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 107] Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He saved them from their distress.

PSA 107:20.text: He sent forth His word and healed them; He rescued them from the Pit.
PSA 107:20.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 107] He sent forth His word and healed them; He rescued them from the Pit.

PSA 107:21.text: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.
PSA 107:21.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 107 · Devotion] Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.

PSA 107:22.text: Let them offer sacrifices of thanksgiving and declare His works with rejoicing.
PSA 107:22.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 107 · Gratitude, Joy] Let them offer sacrifices of thanksgiving and declare His works with rejoicing.

PSA 107:23.text: Others went out to sea in ships, conducting trade on the mighty waters.
PSA 107:23.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 107] Others went out to sea in ships, conducting trade on the mighty waters.

PSA 107:24.text: They saw the works of the LORD, and His wonders in the deep.
PSA 107:24.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 107] They saw the works of the LORD, and His wonders in the deep.

PSA 107:25.text: For He spoke and raised a tempest that lifted the waves of the sea.
PSA 107:25.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 107] For He spoke and raised a tempest that lifted the waves of the sea.

PSA 107:26.text: They mounted up to the heavens, then sunk to the depths; their courage melted in their anguish.
PSA 107:26.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 107] They mounted up to the heavens, then sunk to the depths; their courage melted in their anguish.

PSA 107:27.text: They reeled and staggered like drunkards, and all their skill was useless.
PSA 107:27.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 107] They reeled and staggered like drunkards, and all their skill was useless.

PSA 107:28.text: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He brought them out of their distress.
PSA 107:28.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 107] Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He brought them out of their distress.

PSA 107:29.text: He calmed the storm to a whisper, and the waves of the sea were hushed.
PSA 107:29.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 107] He calmed the storm to a whisper, and the waves of the sea were hushed.

PSA 107:30.text: They rejoiced in the silence, and He guided them to the harbor they desired.
PSA 107:30.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 107] They rejoiced in the silence, and He guided them to the harbor they desired.

PSA 107:31.text: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.
PSA 107:31.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 107 · Devotion] Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.

PSA 107:32.text: Let them exalt Him in the assembly of the people and praise Him in the council of the elders.
PSA 107:32.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 107 · Church, Leadership] Let them exalt Him in the assembly of the people and praise Him in the council of the elders.

PSA 107:33.text: He turns rivers into deserts, springs of water into thirsty ground,
PSA 107:33.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 107] He turns rivers into deserts, springs of water into thirsty ground,

PSA 107:34.text: and fruitful land into fields of salt, because of the wickedness of its dwellers.
PSA 107:34.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 107] and fruitful land into fields of salt, because of the wickedness of its dwellers.

PSA 107:35.text: He turns a desert into pools of water and a dry land into flowing springs.
PSA 107:35.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 107] He turns a desert into pools of water and a dry land into flowing springs.

PSA 107:36.text: He causes the hungry to settle there, that they may establish a city in which to dwell.
PSA 107:36.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 107] He causes the hungry to settle there, that they may establish a city in which to dwell.

PSA 107:37.text: They sow fields and plant vineyards that yield a fruitful harvest.
PSA 107:37.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 107] They sow fields and plant vineyards that yield a fruitful harvest.

PSA 107:38.text: He blesses them, and they multiply greatly; He does not let their herds diminish.
PSA 107:38.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 107] He blesses them, and they multiply greatly; He does not let their herds diminish.

PSA 107:39.text: When they are decreased and humbled by oppression, evil, and sorrow,
PSA 107:39.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 107] When they are decreased and humbled by oppression, evil, and sorrow,

PSA 107:40.text: He pours out contempt on the nobles and makes them wander in a trackless wasteland.
PSA 107:40.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 107] He pours out contempt on the nobles and makes them wander in a trackless wasteland.

PSA 107:41.text: But He lifts the needy from affliction and increases their families like flocks.
PSA 107:41.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 107] But He lifts the needy from affliction and increases their families like flocks.

PSA 107:42.text: The upright see and rejoice, and all iniquity shuts its mouth.
PSA 107:42.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 107] The upright see and rejoice, and all iniquity shuts its mouth.

PSA 107:43.text: Let him who is wise pay heed to these things and consider the loving devotion of the LORD.
PSA 107:43.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 107 · Devotion] Let him who is wise pay heed to these things and consider the loving devotion of the LORD.

PSA 108:1.text: My heart is steadfast, O God; I will sing and make music with all my being.
PSA 108:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 108 · Adultery In Heart] My heart is steadfast, O God; I will sing and make music with all my being.

PSA 108:2.text: Awake, O harp and lyre! I will awaken the dawn.
PSA 108:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 108] Awake, O harp and lyre! I will awaken the dawn.

PSA 108:3.text: I will praise You, O LORD, among the nations; I will sing Your praises among the peoples.
PSA 108:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 108] I will praise You, O LORD, among the nations; I will sing Your praises among the peoples.

PSA 108:4.text: For Your loving devotion extends beyond the heavens, and Your faithfulness reaches to the clouds.
PSA 108:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 108 · Faith, Devotion] For Your loving devotion extends beyond the heavens, and Your faithfulness reaches to the clouds.

PSA 108:5.text: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; may Your glory cover all the earth.
PSA 108:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 108 · Ascension, Glory] Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; may Your glory cover all the earth.

PSA 108:6.text: Respond and save us with Your right hand, that Your beloved may be delivered.
PSA 108:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 108 · Love] Respond and save us with Your right hand, that Your beloved may be delivered.

PSA 108:7.text: God has spoken from His sanctuary: “I will triumph! I will parcel out Shechem and apportion the Valley of Succoth.
PSA 108:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 108] God has spoken from His sanctuary: “I will triumph! I will parcel out Shechem and apportion the Valley of Succoth.

PSA 108:8.text: Gilead is Mine, and Manasseh is Mine; Ephraim is My helmet, Judah is My scepter.
PSA 108:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 108] Gilead is Mine, and Manasseh is Mine; Ephraim is My helmet, Judah is My scepter.

PSA 108:9.text: Moab is My washbasin; upon Edom I toss My sandal; over Philistia I shout in triumph.”
PSA 108:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 108] Moab is My washbasin; upon Edom I toss My sandal; over Philistia I shout in triumph.”

PSA 108:10.text: Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?
PSA 108:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 108] Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?

PSA 108:11.text: Have You not rejected us, O God? Will You no longer march out, O God, with our armies?
PSA 108:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 108] Have You not rejected us, O God? Will You no longer march out, O God, with our armies?

PSA 108:12.text: Give us aid against the enemy, for the help of man is worthless.
PSA 108:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 108] Give us aid against the enemy, for the help of man is worthless.

PSA 108:13.text: With God we will perform with valor, and He will trample our enemies.
PSA 108:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 108] With God we will perform with valor, and He will trample our enemies.

PSA 109:1.text: O God of my praise, be not silent.
PSA 109:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 109] O God of my praise, be not silent.

PSA 109:2.text: For wicked and deceitful mouths open against me; they speak against me with lying tongues.
PSA 109:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 109 · Lying] For wicked and deceitful mouths open against me; they speak against me with lying tongues.

PSA 109:3.text: They surround me with hateful words and attack me without cause.
PSA 109:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 109] They surround me with hateful words and attack me without cause.

PSA 109:4.text: In return for my love they accuse me, but I am a man of prayer.
PSA 109:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 109 · Love] In return for my love they accuse me, but I am a man of prayer.

PSA 109:5.text: They repay me evil for good, and hatred for my love.
PSA 109:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 109 · Love] They repay me evil for good, and hatred for my love.

PSA 109:6.text: Set over him a wicked man; let an accuser stand at his right hand.
PSA 109:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 109] Set over him a wicked man; let an accuser stand at his right hand.

PSA 109:7.text: When he is tried, let him be found guilty, and may his prayer be regarded as sin.
PSA 109:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 109] When he is tried, let him be found guilty, and may his prayer be regarded as sin.

PSA 109:8.text: May his days be few; may another take his position.
PSA 109:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 109] May his days be few; may another take his position.

PSA 109:9.text: May his children be fatherless and his wife a widow.
PSA 109:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 109 · Children] May his children be fatherless and his wife a widow.

PSA 109:10.text: May his children wander as beggars, seeking sustenance far from their ruined homes.
PSA 109:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 109 · Children] May his children wander as beggars, seeking sustenance far from their ruined homes.

PSA 109:11.text: May the creditor seize all he owns, and strangers plunder the fruits of his labor.
PSA 109:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 109] May the creditor seize all he owns, and strangers plunder the fruits of his labor.

PSA 109:12.text: May there be no one to extend kindness to him, and no one to favor his fatherless children.
PSA 109:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 109 · Blessing, Children] May there be no one to extend kindness to him, and no one to favor his fatherless children.

PSA 109:13.text: May his descendants be cut off; may their name be blotted out from the next generation.
PSA 109:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 109] May his descendants be cut off; may their name be blotted out from the next generation.

PSA 109:14.text: May the iniquity of his fathers be remembered before the LORD, and the sin of his mother never be blotted out.
PSA 109:14.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 109] May the iniquity of his fathers be remembered before the LORD, and the sin of his mother never be blotted out.

PSA 109:15.text: May their sins always remain before the LORD, that He may cut off their memory from the earth.
PSA 109:15.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 109] May their sins always remain before the LORD, that He may cut off their memory from the earth.

PSA 109:16.text: For he never thought to show kindness, but pursued the poor and needy and brokenhearted, even to their death.
PSA 109:16.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 109 · Death, Grace] For he never thought to show kindness, but pursued the poor and needy and brokenhearted, even to their death.

PSA 109:17.text: The cursing that he loved, may it fall on him; the blessing in which he refused to delight, may it be far from him.
PSA 109:17.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 109 · Love, Blessing] The cursing that he loved, may it fall on him; the blessing in which he refused to delight, may it be far from him.

PSA 109:18.text: The cursing that he wore like a coat, may it soak into his body like water, and into his bones like oil.
PSA 109:18.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 109] The cursing that he wore like a coat, may it soak into his body like water, and into his bones like oil.

PSA 109:19.text: May it be like a robe wrapped about him, like a belt tied forever around him.
PSA 109:19.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 109 · About Forgiveness] May it be like a robe wrapped about him, like a belt tied forever around him.

PSA 109:20.text: May this be the LORD’s reward to my accusers, to those who speak evil against me.
PSA 109:20.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 109] May this be the LORD’s reward to my accusers, to those who speak evil against me.

PSA 109:21.text: But You, O GOD, the Lord, deal kindly with me for the sake of Your name; deliver me by the goodness of Your loving devotion.
PSA 109:21.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 109 · Devotion] But You, O GOD, the Lord, deal kindly with me for the sake of Your name; deliver me by the goodness of Your loving devotion.

PSA 109:22.text: For I am poor and needy; my heart is wounded within me.
PSA 109:22.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 109 · Adultery In Heart] For I am poor and needy; my heart is wounded within me.

PSA 109:23.text: I am fading away like a lengthening shadow; I am shaken off like a locust.
PSA 109:23.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 109] I am fading away like a lengthening shadow; I am shaken off like a locust.

PSA 109:24.text: My knees are weak from fasting, and my body grows lean and gaunt.
PSA 109:24.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 109 · Fasting] My knees are weak from fasting, and my body grows lean and gaunt.

PSA 109:25.text: I am an object of scorn to my accusers; when they see me, they shake their heads.
PSA 109:25.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 109] I am an object of scorn to my accusers; when they see me, they shake their heads.

PSA 109:26.text: Help me, O LORD my God; save me according to Your loving devotion.
PSA 109:26.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 109 · Devotion] Help me, O LORD my God; save me according to Your loving devotion.

PSA 109:27.text: Let them know that this is Your hand, that You, O LORD, have done it.
PSA 109:27.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 109] Let them know that this is Your hand, that You, O LORD, have done it.

PSA 109:28.text: Though they curse, You will bless. When they rise up, they will be put to shame, but Your servant will rejoice.
PSA 109:28.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 109 · Curse God] Though they curse, You will bless. When they rise up, they will be put to shame, but Your servant will rejoice.

PSA 109:29.text: May my accusers be clothed with disgrace; may they wear their shame like a robe.
PSA 109:29.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 109] May my accusers be clothed with disgrace; may they wear their shame like a robe.

PSA 109:30.text: With my mouth I will thank the LORD profusely; I will praise Him in the presence of many.
PSA 109:30.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 109] With my mouth I will thank the LORD profusely; I will praise Him in the presence of many.

PSA 109:31.text: For He stands at the right hand of the needy one, to save him from the condemners of his soul.
PSA 109:31.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 109] For He stands at the right hand of the needy one, to save him from the condemners of his soul.

PSA 110:1.text: The LORD said to my Lord: “Sit at My right hand until I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet.”
PSA 110:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 110] The LORD said to my Lord: “Sit at My right hand until I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet.”

PSA 110:2.text: The LORD extends Your mighty scepter from Zion: “Rule in the midst of Your enemies.”
PSA 110:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 110] The LORD extends Your mighty scepter from Zion: “Rule in the midst of Your enemies.”

PSA 110:3.text: Your people shall be willing on Your day of battle. Arrayed in holy splendor, from the womb of the dawn, to You belongs the dew of Your youth.
PSA 110:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 110] Your people shall be willing on Your day of battle. Arrayed in holy splendor, from the womb of the dawn, to You belongs the dew of Your youth.

PSA 110:4.text: The LORD has sworn and will not change His mind: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”
PSA 110:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 110] The LORD has sworn and will not change His mind: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”

PSA 110:5.text: The Lord is at Your right hand; He will crush kings in the day of His wrath.
PSA 110:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 110] The Lord is at Your right hand; He will crush kings in the day of His wrath.

PSA 110:6.text: He will judge the nations, heaping up the dead; He will crush the leaders far and wide.
PSA 110:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 110] He will judge the nations, heaping up the dead; He will crush the leaders far and wide.

PSA 110:7.text: He will drink from the brook by the road; therefore He will lift up His head.
PSA 110:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 110] He will drink from the brook by the road; therefore He will lift up His head.

PSA 111:1.text: Hallelujah!   I will give thanks to the LORD with all my heart in the council of the upright and in the assembly.
PSA 111:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 111 · Adultery In Heart, Church] Hallelujah!   I will give thanks to the LORD with all my heart in the council of the upright and in the assembly.

PSA 111:2.text: Great are the works of the LORD; they are pondered by all who delight in them.
PSA 111:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 111] Great are the works of the LORD; they are pondered by all who delight in them.

PSA 111:3.text: Splendid and majestic is His work; His righteousness endures forever.
PSA 111:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 111] Splendid and majestic is His work; His righteousness endures forever.

PSA 111:4.text: He has caused His wonders to be remembered; the LORD is gracious and compassionate.
PSA 111:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 111] He has caused His wonders to be remembered; the LORD is gracious and compassionate.

PSA 111:5.text: He provides food for those who fear Him; He remembers His covenant forever.
PSA 111:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 111 · Covenant] He provides food for those who fear Him; He remembers His covenant forever.

PSA 111:6.text: He has shown His people the power of His works by giving them the inheritance of the nations.
PSA 111:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 111 · Generosity, Inheritance] He has shown His people the power of His works by giving them the inheritance of the nations.

PSA 111:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 111 · Faith, Justice] The works of His hands are truth and justice; all His precepts are trustworthy.

PSA 111:8.text: They are upheld forever and ever, enacted in truth and uprightness.
PSA 111:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 111] They are upheld forever and ever, enacted in truth and uprightness.

PSA 111:9.text: He has sent redemption to His people; He has ordained His covenant forever; holy and awesome is His name.
PSA 111:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 111 · Covenant] He has sent redemption to His people; He has ordained His covenant forever; holy and awesome is His name.

PSA 111:10.text: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom; all who follow His precepts gain rich understanding.   His praise endures forever!
PSA 111:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 111] The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom; all who follow His precepts gain rich understanding.   His praise endures forever!

PSA 112:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 112 · Law] Hallelujah!   Blessed is the man who fears the LORD, who greatly delights in His commandments.

PSA 112:2.text: His descendants will be mighty in the land; the generation of the upright will be blessed.
PSA 112:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 112] His descendants will be mighty in the land; the generation of the upright will be blessed.

PSA 112:3.text: Wealth and riches are in his house, and his righteousness endures forever.
PSA 112:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 112] Wealth and riches are in his house, and his righteousness endures forever.

PSA 112:4.text: Light dawns in the darkness for the upright— for the gracious, compassionate, and righteous.
PSA 112:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 112 · Light] Light dawns in the darkness for the upright— for the gracious, compassionate, and righteous.

PSA 112:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 112 · Justice] It is well with the man who is generous and lends freely, whose affairs are guided by justice.

PSA 112:6.text: Surely he will never be shaken; the righteous man will be remembered forever.
PSA 112:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 112] Surely he will never be shaken; the righteous man will be remembered forever.

PSA 112:7.text: He does not fear bad news; his heart is steadfast, trusting in the LORD.
PSA 112:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 112 · Faith, Adultery In Heart] He does not fear bad news; his heart is steadfast, trusting in the LORD.

PSA 112:8.text: His heart is assured; he does not fear, until he looks in triumph on his foes.
PSA 112:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 112 · Adultery In Heart] His heart is assured; he does not fear, until he looks in triumph on his foes.

PSA 112:9.text: He has scattered abroad his gifts to the poor; his righteousness endures forever; his horn will be lifted high in honor.
PSA 112:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 112] He has scattered abroad his gifts to the poor; his righteousness endures forever; his horn will be lifted high in honor.

PSA 112:10.text: The wicked man will see and be grieved; he will gnash his teeth and waste away; the desires of the wicked will perish.
PSA 112:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 112] The wicked man will see and be grieved; he will gnash his teeth and waste away; the desires of the wicked will perish.

PSA 113:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 113] Blessed be the name of the LORD both now and forevermore.

PSA 113:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 113 · Ascension, Glory] The LORD is exalted over all the nations, His glory above the heavens.

PSA 113:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 113] Who is like the LORD our God, the One enthroned on high?
