PSA 113:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 113] He humbles Himself to behold the heavens and the earth.

PSA 113:7.text: He raises the poor from the dust and lifts the needy from the dump
PSA 113:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 113] He raises the poor from the dust and lifts the needy from the dump

PSA 113:8.text: to seat them with nobles, with the princes of His people.
PSA 113:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 113] to seat them with nobles, with the princes of His people.

PSA 113:9.text: He settles the barren woman in her home as a joyful mother to her children.   Hallelujah!
PSA 113:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 113 · Children] He settles the barren woman in her home as a joyful mother to her children.   Hallelujah!

PSA 114:1.text: When Israel departed from Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of foreign tongue,
PSA 114:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 114 · Israel] When Israel departed from Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of foreign tongue,

PSA 114:2.text: Judah became God’s sanctuary, and Israel His dominion.
PSA 114:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 114 · Israel] Judah became God’s sanctuary, and Israel His dominion.

PSA 114:3.text: The sea observed and fled; the Jordan turned back;
PSA 114:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 114] The sea observed and fled; the Jordan turned back;

PSA 114:4.text: the mountains skipped like rams, the hills like lambs.
PSA 114:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 114] the mountains skipped like rams, the hills like lambs.

PSA 114:5.text: Why was it, O sea, that you fled, O Jordan, that you turned back,
PSA 114:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 114] Why was it, O sea, that you fled, O Jordan, that you turned back,

PSA 114:6.text: O mountains, that you skipped like rams, O hills, like lambs?
PSA 114:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 114] O mountains, that you skipped like rams, O hills, like lambs?

PSA 114:7.text: Tremble, O earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob,
PSA 114:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 114 · Israel] Tremble, O earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob,

PSA 114:8.text: who turned the rock into a pool, the flint into a fountain of water!
PSA 114:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 114] who turned the rock into a pool, the flint into a fountain of water!

PSA 115:1.text: Not to us, O LORD, not to us, but to Your name be the glory, because of Your loving devotion, because of Your faithfulness.
PSA 115:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 115 · Faith, Devotion] Not to us, O LORD, not to us, but to Your name be the glory, because of Your loving devotion, because of Your faithfulness.

PSA 115:2.text: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God?”
PSA 115:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 115] Why should the nations say, “Where is their God?”

PSA 115:3.text: Our God is in heaven; He does as He pleases.
PSA 115:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 115 · Heaven] Our God is in heaven; He does as He pleases.

PSA 115:4.text: Their idols are silver and gold, made by the hands of men.
PSA 115:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 115 · Idolatry, Idols] Their idols are silver and gold, made by the hands of men.

PSA 115:5.text: They have mouths, but cannot speak; they have eyes, but cannot see;
PSA 115:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 115] They have mouths, but cannot speak; they have eyes, but cannot see;

PSA 115:6.text: they have ears, but cannot hear; they have noses, but cannot smell;
PSA 115:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 115] they have ears, but cannot hear; they have noses, but cannot smell;

PSA 115:7.text: they have hands, but cannot feel; they have feet, but cannot walk; they cannot even clear their throats.
PSA 115:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 115] they have hands, but cannot feel; they have feet, but cannot walk; they cannot even clear their throats.

PSA 115:8.text: Those who make them become like them, as do all who trust in them.
PSA 115:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 115 · Faith] Those who make them become like them, as do all who trust in them.

PSA 115:9.text: O Israel, trust in the LORD! He is their help and shield.
PSA 115:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 115 · Faith, Israel] O Israel, trust in the LORD! He is their help and shield.

PSA 115:10.text: O house of Aaron, trust in the LORD! He is their help and shield.
PSA 115:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 115 · Faith] O house of Aaron, trust in the LORD! He is their help and shield.

PSA 115:11.text: You who fear the LORD, trust in the LORD! He is their help and shield.
PSA 115:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 115 · Faith] You who fear the LORD, trust in the LORD! He is their help and shield.

PSA 115:12.text: The LORD is mindful of us; He will bless us. He will bless the house of Israel; He will bless the house of Aaron;
PSA 115:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 115 · Israel] The LORD is mindful of us; He will bless us. He will bless the house of Israel; He will bless the house of Aaron;

PSA 115:13.text: He will bless those who fear the LORD— small and great alike.
PSA 115:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 115] He will bless those who fear the LORD— small and great alike.

PSA 115:14.text: May the LORD give you increase, both you and your children.
PSA 115:14.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 115 · Children] May the LORD give you increase, both you and your children.

PSA 115:15.text: May you be blessed by the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.
PSA 115:15.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 115 · Creation, Heaven] May you be blessed by the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.

PSA 115:16.text: The highest heavens belong to the LORD, but the earth He has given to mankind.
PSA 115:16.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 115] The highest heavens belong to the LORD, but the earth He has given to mankind.

PSA 115:17.text: It is not the dead who praise the LORD, nor any who descend into silence.
PSA 115:17.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 115] It is not the dead who praise the LORD, nor any who descend into silence.

PSA 115:18.text: But it is we who will bless the LORD, both now and forevermore.   Hallelujah!
PSA 115:18.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 115] But it is we who will bless the LORD, both now and forevermore.   Hallelujah!

PSA 116:1.text: I love the LORD, for He has heard my voice— my appeal for mercy.
PSA 116:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 116 · Forgiveness, Love] I love the LORD, for He has heard my voice— my appeal for mercy.

PSA 116:2.text: Because He has inclined His ear to me, I will call on Him as long as I live.
PSA 116:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 116] Because He has inclined His ear to me, I will call on Him as long as I live.

PSA 116:3.text: The ropes of death entangled me; the anguish of Sheol overcame me; I was confronted by trouble and sorrow.
PSA 116:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 116 · Death] The ropes of death entangled me; the anguish of Sheol overcame me; I was confronted by trouble and sorrow.

PSA 116:4.text: Then I called on the name of the LORD: “O LORD, deliver my soul!”
PSA 116:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 116] Then I called on the name of the LORD: “O LORD, deliver my soul!”

PSA 116:5.text: The LORD is gracious and righteous; our God is full of compassion.
PSA 116:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 116 · Compassion] The LORD is gracious and righteous; our God is full of compassion.

PSA 116:6.text: The LORD preserves the simplehearted; I was helpless, and He saved me.
PSA 116:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 116] The LORD preserves the simplehearted; I was helpless, and He saved me.

PSA 116:7.text: Return to your rest, O my soul, for the LORD has been good to you.
PSA 116:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 116] Return to your rest, O my soul, for the LORD has been good to you.

PSA 116:8.text: For You have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling.
PSA 116:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 116 · Death] For You have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling.

PSA 116:9.text: I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.
PSA 116:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 116] I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.

PSA 116:10.text: I believed, therefore I said, “I am greatly afflicted.”
PSA 116:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 116 · Faith] I believed, therefore I said, “I am greatly afflicted.”

PSA 116:11.text: In my alarm I said, “All men are liars!”
PSA 116:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 116] In my alarm I said, “All men are liars!”

PSA 116:12.text: How can I repay the LORD for all His goodness to me?
PSA 116:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 116] How can I repay the LORD for all His goodness to me?

PSA 116:13.text: I will lift the cup of salvation and call on the name of the LORD.
PSA 116:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 116] I will lift the cup of salvation and call on the name of the LORD.

PSA 116:14.text: I will fulfill my vows to the LORD in the presence of all His people.
PSA 116:14.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 116] I will fulfill my vows to the LORD in the presence of all His people.

PSA 116:15.text: Precious in the sight of the LORD is the death of His saints.
PSA 116:15.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 116 · Death] Precious in the sight of the LORD is the death of His saints.

PSA 116:16.text: Truly, O LORD, I am Your servant; I am Your servant, the son of Your maidservant; You have broken my bonds.
PSA 116:16.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 116] Truly, O LORD, I am Your servant; I am Your servant, the son of Your maidservant; You have broken my bonds.

PSA 116:17.text: I will offer to You a sacrifice of thanksgiving and call on the name of the LORD.
PSA 116:17.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 116 · Gratitude] I will offer to You a sacrifice of thanksgiving and call on the name of the LORD.

PSA 116:18.text: I will fulfill my vows to the LORD in the presence of all His people,
PSA 116:18.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 116] I will fulfill my vows to the LORD in the presence of all His people,

PSA 116:19.text: in the courts of the LORD’s house, in your midst, O Jerusalem.   Hallelujah!
PSA 116:19.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 116] in the courts of the LORD’s house, in your midst, O Jerusalem.   Hallelujah!

PSA 117:1.text: Praise the LORD, all you nations! Extol Him, all you peoples!
PSA 117:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 117] Praise the LORD, all you nations! Extol Him, all you peoples!

PSA 117:2.text: For great is His loving devotion toward us, and the faithfulness of the LORD endures forever.   Hallelujah!
PSA 117:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 117 · Faith, Devotion] For great is His loving devotion toward us, and the faithfulness of the LORD endures forever.   Hallelujah!

PSA 118:1.text: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 118:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 118 · Devotion] Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.

PSA 118:2.text: Let Israel say, “His loving devotion endures forever.”
PSA 118:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 118 · Devotion, Israel] Let Israel say, “His loving devotion endures forever.”

PSA 118:3.text: Let the house of Aaron say, “His loving devotion endures forever.”
PSA 118:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 118 · Devotion] Let the house of Aaron say, “His loving devotion endures forever.”

PSA 118:4.text: Let those who fear the LORD say, “His loving devotion endures forever.”
PSA 118:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 118 · Devotion] Let those who fear the LORD say, “His loving devotion endures forever.”

PSA 118:5.text: In my distress I called to the LORD, and He answered and set me free.
PSA 118:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 118] In my distress I called to the LORD, and He answered and set me free.

PSA 118:6.text: The LORD is on my side; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
PSA 118:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 118] The LORD is on my side; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

PSA 118:7.text: The LORD is on my side; He is my helper. Therefore I will look in triumph on those who hate me.
PSA 118:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 118] The LORD is on my side; He is my helper. Therefore I will look in triumph on those who hate me.

PSA 118:8.text: It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in man.
PSA 118:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 118 · Faith] It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in man.

PSA 118:9.text: It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in princes.
PSA 118:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 118 · Faith] It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in princes.

PSA 118:10.text: All the nations surrounded me, but in the name of the LORD I cut them off.
PSA 118:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 118] All the nations surrounded me, but in the name of the LORD I cut them off.

PSA 118:11.text: They surrounded me on every side, but in the name of the LORD I cut them off.
PSA 118:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 118] They surrounded me on every side, but in the name of the LORD I cut them off.

PSA 118:12.text: They swarmed around me like bees, but they were extinguished like burning thorns; in the name of the LORD I cut them off.
PSA 118:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 118] They swarmed around me like bees, but they were extinguished like burning thorns; in the name of the LORD I cut them off.

PSA 118:13.text: I was pushed so hard I was falling, but the LORD helped me.
PSA 118:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 118] I was pushed so hard I was falling, but the LORD helped me.

PSA 118:14.text: The LORD is my strength and my song, and He has become my salvation.
PSA 118:14.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 118] The LORD is my strength and my song, and He has become my salvation.

PSA 118:15.text: Shouts of joy and salvation resound in the tents of the righteous: “The right hand of the LORD performs with valor!
PSA 118:15.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 118] Shouts of joy and salvation resound in the tents of the righteous: “The right hand of the LORD performs with valor!

PSA 118:16.text: The right hand of the LORD is exalted! The right hand of the LORD performs with valor!”
PSA 118:16.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 118 · Ascension] The right hand of the LORD is exalted! The right hand of the LORD performs with valor!”

PSA 118:17.text: I will not die, but I will live and proclaim what the LORD has done.
PSA 118:17.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 118] I will not die, but I will live and proclaim what the LORD has done.

PSA 118:18.text: The LORD disciplined me severely, but He has not given me over to death.
PSA 118:18.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 118 · Death] The LORD disciplined me severely, but He has not given me over to death.

PSA 118:19.text: Open to me the gates of righteousness, that I may enter and give thanks to the LORD.
PSA 118:19.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 118] Open to me the gates of righteousness, that I may enter and give thanks to the LORD.

PSA 118:20.text: This is the gate of the LORD; the righteous shall enter through it.
PSA 118:20.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 118] This is the gate of the LORD; the righteous shall enter through it.

PSA 118:21.text: I will give You thanks, for You have answered me, and You have become my salvation.
PSA 118:21.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 118] I will give You thanks, for You have answered me, and You have become my salvation.

PSA 118:22.text: The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.
PSA 118:22.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 118] The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.

PSA 118:23.text: This is from the LORD, and it is marvelous in our eyes.
PSA 118:23.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 118] This is from the LORD, and it is marvelous in our eyes.

PSA 118:24.text: This is the day that the LORD has made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
PSA 118:24.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 118] This is the day that the LORD has made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.

PSA 118:25.text: O LORD, save us, we pray. We beseech You, O LORD, cause us to prosper!
PSA 118:25.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 118] O LORD, save us, we pray. We beseech You, O LORD, cause us to prosper!

PSA 118:26.text: Blessed is he who comes in the name of the LORD. From the house of the LORD we bless you.
PSA 118:26.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 118] Blessed is he who comes in the name of the LORD. From the house of the LORD we bless you.

PSA 118:27.text: The LORD is God; He has made His light to shine upon us. Bind the festal sacrifice with cords to the horns of the altar.
PSA 118:27.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 118 · Light] The LORD is God; He has made His light to shine upon us. Bind the festal sacrifice with cords to the horns of the altar.

PSA 118:28.text: You are my God, and I will give You thanks. You are my God, and I will exalt You.
PSA 118:28.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 118] You are my God, and I will give You thanks. You are my God, and I will exalt You.

PSA 118:29.text: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 118:29.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 118 · Devotion] Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.

PSA 119:1.text: Blessed are those whose way is blameless, who walk in the Law of the LORD.
PSA 119:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Beatitudes] Blessed are those whose way is blameless, who walk in the Law of the LORD.

PSA 119:2.text: Blessed are those who keep His testimonies and seek Him with all their heart.
PSA 119:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Adultery In Heart, Beatitudes] Blessed are those who keep His testimonies and seek Him with all their heart.

PSA 119:3.text: They do no iniquity; they walk in His ways.
PSA 119:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] They do no iniquity; they walk in His ways.

PSA 119:4.text: You have ordained Your precepts, that we should keep them diligently.
PSA 119:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] You have ordained Your precepts, that we should keep them diligently.

PSA 119:5.text: Oh, that my ways were committed to keeping Your statutes!
PSA 119:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] Oh, that my ways were committed to keeping Your statutes!

PSA 119:6.text: Then I would not be ashamed when I consider all Your commandments.
PSA 119:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Law] Then I would not be ashamed when I consider all Your commandments.

PSA 119:7.text: I will praise You with an upright heart when I learn Your righteous judgments.
PSA 119:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Adultery In Heart] I will praise You with an upright heart when I learn Your righteous judgments.

PSA 119:8.text: I will keep Your statutes; do not utterly forsake me.
PSA 119:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] I will keep Your statutes; do not utterly forsake me.

PSA 119:9.text: How can a young man keep his way pure? By guarding it according to Your word.
PSA 119:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] How can a young man keep his way pure? By guarding it according to Your word.

PSA 119:10.text: With all my heart I have sought You; do not let me stray from Your commandments.
PSA 119:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Adultery In Heart, Law] With all my heart I have sought You; do not let me stray from Your commandments.

PSA 119:11.text: I have hidden Your word in my heart that I might not sin against You.
PSA 119:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Adultery In Heart] I have hidden Your word in my heart that I might not sin against You.

PSA 119:12.text: Blessed are You, O LORD; teach me Your statutes.
PSA 119:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Beatitudes] Blessed are You, O LORD; teach me Your statutes.

PSA 119:13.text: With my lips I proclaim all the judgments of Your mouth.
PSA 119:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] With my lips I proclaim all the judgments of Your mouth.

PSA 119:14.text: I rejoice in the way of Your testimonies as much as in all riches.
PSA 119:14.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] I rejoice in the way of Your testimonies as much as in all riches.

PSA 119:15.text: I will meditate on Your precepts and regard Your ways.
PSA 119:15.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] I will meditate on Your precepts and regard Your ways.

PSA 119:16.text: I will delight in Your statutes; I will not forget Your word.
PSA 119:16.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] I will delight in Your statutes; I will not forget Your word.

PSA 119:17.text: Deal bountifully with Your servant, that I may live and keep Your word.
PSA 119:17.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] Deal bountifully with Your servant, that I may live and keep Your word.

PSA 119:18.text: Open my eyes that I may see wondrous things from Your law.
PSA 119:18.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] Open my eyes that I may see wondrous things from Your law.

PSA 119:19.text: I am a stranger on the earth; do not hide Your commandments from me.
PSA 119:19.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Law] I am a stranger on the earth; do not hide Your commandments from me.

PSA 119:20.text: My soul is consumed with longing for Your judgments at all times.
PSA 119:20.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · End Times] My soul is consumed with longing for Your judgments at all times.

PSA 119:21.text: You rebuke the arrogant— the cursed who stray from Your commandments.
PSA 119:21.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Law] You rebuke the arrogant— the cursed who stray from Your commandments.

PSA 119:22.text: Remove my scorn and contempt, for I have kept Your testimonies.
PSA 119:22.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] Remove my scorn and contempt, for I have kept Your testimonies.

PSA 119:23.text: Though rulers sit and slander me, Your servant meditates on Your statutes.
PSA 119:23.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] Though rulers sit and slander me, Your servant meditates on Your statutes.

PSA 119:24.text: Your testimonies are indeed my delight; they are my counselors.
PSA 119:24.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] Your testimonies are indeed my delight; they are my counselors.

PSA 119:25.text: My soul cleaves to the dust; revive me according to Your word.
PSA 119:25.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] My soul cleaves to the dust; revive me according to Your word.

PSA 119:26.text: I recounted my ways, and You answered me; teach me Your statutes.
PSA 119:26.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] I recounted my ways, and You answered me; teach me Your statutes.

PSA 119:27.text: Make clear to me the way of Your precepts; then I will meditate on Your wonders.
PSA 119:27.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] Make clear to me the way of Your precepts; then I will meditate on Your wonders.

PSA 119:28.text: My soul melts with sorrow; strengthen me according to Your word.
PSA 119:28.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] My soul melts with sorrow; strengthen me according to Your word.

PSA 119:29.text: Remove me from the path of deceit and graciously grant me Your law.
PSA 119:29.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Deceit] Remove me from the path of deceit and graciously grant me Your law.

PSA 119:30.text: I have chosen the way of truth; I have set Your ordinances before me.
PSA 119:30.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Election] I have chosen the way of truth; I have set Your ordinances before me.

PSA 119:31.text: I cling to Your testimonies, O LORD; let me not be put to shame.
PSA 119:31.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] I cling to Your testimonies, O LORD; let me not be put to shame.

PSA 119:32.text: I run in the path of Your commandments, for You will enlarge my heart.
PSA 119:32.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Adultery In Heart, Law] I run in the path of Your commandments, for You will enlarge my heart.

PSA 119:33.text: Teach me, O LORD, the way of Your statutes, and I will keep them to the end.
PSA 119:33.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] Teach me, O LORD, the way of Your statutes, and I will keep them to the end.

PSA 119:34.text: Give me understanding that I may obey Your law, and follow it with all my heart.
PSA 119:34.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Adultery In Heart] Give me understanding that I may obey Your law, and follow it with all my heart.

PSA 119:35.text: Direct me in the path of Your commandments, for there I find delight.
PSA 119:35.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Law] Direct me in the path of Your commandments, for there I find delight.

PSA 119:36.text: Turn my heart to Your testimonies and not to covetous gain.
PSA 119:36.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Adultery In Heart] Turn my heart to Your testimonies and not to covetous gain.

PSA 119:37.text: Turn my eyes away from worthless things; revive me with Your word.
PSA 119:37.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] Turn my eyes away from worthless things; revive me with Your word.

PSA 119:38.text: Establish Your word to Your servant, to produce reverence for You.
PSA 119:38.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] Establish Your word to Your servant, to produce reverence for You.

PSA 119:39.text: Turn away the disgrace I dread, for Your judgments are good.
PSA 119:39.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Fear] Turn away the disgrace I dread, for Your judgments are good.

PSA 119:40.text: How I long for Your precepts! Revive me in Your righteousness.
PSA 119:40.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] How I long for Your precepts! Revive me in Your righteousness.

PSA 119:41.text: May Your loving devotion come to me, O LORD, Your salvation, according to Your promise.
PSA 119:41.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Covenant, Devotion] May Your loving devotion come to me, O LORD, Your salvation, according to Your promise.

PSA 119:42.text: Then I can answer him who taunts, for I trust in Your word.
PSA 119:42.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Faith] Then I can answer him who taunts, for I trust in Your word.

PSA 119:43.text: Never take Your word of truth from my mouth, for I hope in Your judgments.
PSA 119:43.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] Never take Your word of truth from my mouth, for I hope in Your judgments.

PSA 119:44.text: I will always obey Your law, forever and ever.
PSA 119:44.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] I will always obey Your law, forever and ever.

PSA 119:45.text: And I will walk in freedom, for I have sought Your precepts.
PSA 119:45.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Freedom] And I will walk in freedom, for I have sought Your precepts.

PSA 119:46.text: I will speak of Your testimonies before kings, and I will not be ashamed.
PSA 119:46.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] I will speak of Your testimonies before kings, and I will not be ashamed.

PSA 119:47.text: I delight in Your commandments because I love them.
PSA 119:47.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Love, Law] I delight in Your commandments because I love them.

PSA 119:48.text: I lift up my hands to Your commandments, which I love, and I meditate on Your statutes.
PSA 119:48.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Love, Law] I lift up my hands to Your commandments, which I love, and I meditate on Your statutes.

PSA 119:49.text: Remember Your word to Your servant, upon which You have given me hope.
PSA 119:49.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] Remember Your word to Your servant, upon which You have given me hope.

PSA 119:50.text: This is my comfort in affliction, that Your promise has given me life.
PSA 119:50.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Comfort, Covenant] This is my comfort in affliction, that Your promise has given me life.

PSA 119:51.text: The arrogant utterly deride me, but I do not turn from Your law.
PSA 119:51.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] The arrogant utterly deride me, but I do not turn from Your law.

PSA 119:52.text: I remember Your judgments of old, O LORD, and in them I find comfort.
PSA 119:52.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Comfort] I remember Your judgments of old, O LORD, and in them I find comfort.

PSA 119:53.text: Rage has taken hold of me because of the wicked who reject Your law.
PSA 119:53.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] Rage has taken hold of me because of the wicked who reject Your law.

PSA 119:54.text: Your statutes are songs to me in the house of my pilgrimage.
PSA 119:54.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] Your statutes are songs to me in the house of my pilgrimage.

PSA 119:55.text: In the night, O LORD, I remember Your name, that I may keep Your law.
PSA 119:55.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] In the night, O LORD, I remember Your name, that I may keep Your law.

PSA 119:56.text: This is my practice, for I obey Your precepts.
PSA 119:56.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] This is my practice, for I obey Your precepts.

PSA 119:57.text: The LORD is my portion; I have promised to keep Your words.
PSA 119:57.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Inheritance] The LORD is my portion; I have promised to keep Your words.

PSA 119:58.text: I have sought Your face with all my heart; be gracious to me according to Your promise.
PSA 119:58.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Adultery In Heart, Covenant] I have sought Your face with all my heart; be gracious to me according to Your promise.

PSA 119:59.text: I considered my ways and turned my steps to Your testimonies.
PSA 119:59.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] I considered my ways and turned my steps to Your testimonies.

PSA 119:60.text: I hurried without hesitating to keep Your commandments.
PSA 119:60.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Law] I hurried without hesitating to keep Your commandments.

PSA 119:61.text: Though the ropes of the wicked bind me, I do not forget Your law.
PSA 119:61.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] Though the ropes of the wicked bind me, I do not forget Your law.

PSA 119:62.text: At midnight I rise to give You thanks for Your righteous judgments.
PSA 119:62.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] At midnight I rise to give You thanks for Your righteous judgments.

PSA 119:63.text: I am a friend to all who fear You, and to those who keep Your precepts.
PSA 119:63.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] I am a friend to all who fear You, and to those who keep Your precepts.

PSA 119:64.text: The earth is filled with Your loving devotion, O LORD; teach me Your statutes.
PSA 119:64.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Devotion] The earth is filled with Your loving devotion, O LORD; teach me Your statutes.

PSA 119:65.text: You are good to Your servant, O LORD, according to Your word.
PSA 119:65.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] You are good to Your servant, O LORD, according to Your word.

PSA 119:66.text: Teach me good judgment and knowledge, for I believe in Your commandments.
PSA 119:66.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Faith, Judgment] Teach me good judgment and knowledge, for I believe in Your commandments.

PSA 119:67.text: Before I was afflicted, I went astray; but now I keep Your word.
PSA 119:67.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] Before I was afflicted, I went astray; but now I keep Your word.

PSA 119:68.text: You are good, and You do what is good; teach me Your statutes.
PSA 119:68.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] You are good, and You do what is good; teach me Your statutes.

PSA 119:69.text: Though the arrogant have smeared me with lies, I keep Your precepts with all my heart.
PSA 119:69.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Adultery In Heart] Though the arrogant have smeared me with lies, I keep Your precepts with all my heart.

PSA 119:70.text: Their hearts are hard and callous, but I delight in Your law.
PSA 119:70.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] Their hearts are hard and callous, but I delight in Your law.

PSA 119:71.text: It was good for me to be afflicted, that I might learn Your statutes.
PSA 119:71.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] It was good for me to be afflicted, that I might learn Your statutes.

PSA 119:72.text: The law from Your mouth is more precious to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver.
PSA 119:72.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] The law from Your mouth is more precious to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver.

PSA 119:73.text: Your hands have made me and fashioned me; give me understanding to learn Your commandments.
PSA 119:73.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Law] Your hands have made me and fashioned me; give me understanding to learn Your commandments.

PSA 119:74.text: May those who fear You see me and rejoice, for I have hoped in Your word.
PSA 119:74.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] May those who fear You see me and rejoice, for I have hoped in Your word.

PSA 119:75.text: I know, O LORD, that Your judgments are righteous, and that in faithfulness You have afflicted me.
PSA 119:75.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Faith, Marital Faithfulness] I know, O LORD, that Your judgments are righteous, and that in faithfulness You have afflicted me.

PSA 119:76.text: May Your loving devotion comfort me, I pray, according to Your promise to Your servant.
PSA 119:76.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Comfort, Covenant] May Your loving devotion comfort me, I pray, according to Your promise to Your servant.

PSA 119:77.text: May Your compassion come to me, that I may live, for Your law is my delight.
PSA 119:77.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Compassion] May Your compassion come to me, that I may live, for Your law is my delight.

PSA 119:78.text: May the arrogant be put to shame for subverting me with a lie; I will meditate on Your precepts.
PSA 119:78.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] May the arrogant be put to shame for subverting me with a lie; I will meditate on Your precepts.

PSA 119:79.text: May those who fear You turn to me, those who know Your testimonies.
PSA 119:79.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] May those who fear You turn to me, those who know Your testimonies.

PSA 119:80.text: May my heart be blameless in Your statutes, that I may not be put to shame.
PSA 119:80.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Adultery In Heart] May my heart be blameless in Your statutes, that I may not be put to shame.

PSA 119:81.text: My soul faints for Your salvation; I wait for Your word.
PSA 119:81.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] My soul faints for Your salvation; I wait for Your word.

PSA 119:82.text: My eyes fail, looking for Your promise; I ask, “When will You comfort me?”
PSA 119:82.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Comfort, Covenant] My eyes fail, looking for Your promise; I ask, “When will You comfort me?”

PSA 119:83.text: Though I am like a wineskin dried up by smoke, I do not forget Your statutes.
PSA 119:83.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] Though I am like a wineskin dried up by smoke, I do not forget Your statutes.

PSA 119:84.text: How many days must Your servant wait? When will You execute judgment on my persecutors?
PSA 119:84.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Judgment] How many days must Your servant wait? When will You execute judgment on my persecutors?

PSA 119:85.text: The arrogant have dug pits for me in violation of Your law.
PSA 119:85.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] The arrogant have dug pits for me in violation of Your law.

PSA 119:86.text: All Your commandments are faithful; I am persecuted without cause—help me!
PSA 119:86.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Faith, Law] All Your commandments are faithful; I am persecuted without cause—help me!

PSA 119:87.text: They almost wiped me from the earth, but I have not forsaken Your precepts.
PSA 119:87.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] They almost wiped me from the earth, but I have not forsaken Your precepts.

PSA 119:88.text: Revive me according to Your loving devotion, that I may obey the testimony of Your mouth.
PSA 119:88.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Devotion] Revive me according to Your loving devotion, that I may obey the testimony of Your mouth.

PSA 119:89.text: Your word, O LORD, is everlasting; it is firmly fixed in the heavens.
PSA 119:89.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] Your word, O LORD, is everlasting; it is firmly fixed in the heavens.

PSA 119:90.text: Your faithfulness continues through all generations; You established the earth, and it endures.
PSA 119:90.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Faith, Marital Faithfulness] Your faithfulness continues through all generations; You established the earth, and it endures.

PSA 119:91.text: Your ordinances stand to this day, for all things are servants to You.
PSA 119:91.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] Your ordinances stand to this day, for all things are servants to You.

PSA 119:92.text: If Your law had not been my delight, then I would have perished in my affliction.
PSA 119:92.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] If Your law had not been my delight, then I would have perished in my affliction.

PSA 119:93.text: I will never forget Your precepts, for by them You have revived me.
PSA 119:93.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] I will never forget Your precepts, for by them You have revived me.

PSA 119:94.text: I am Yours; save me, for I have sought Your precepts.
PSA 119:94.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] I am Yours; save me, for I have sought Your precepts.

PSA 119:95.text: The wicked wait to destroy me, but I will ponder Your testimonies.
PSA 119:95.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Destroy Canaan, Destroy Canaanites] The wicked wait to destroy me, but I will ponder Your testimonies.

PSA 119:96.text: I have seen a limit to all perfection, but Your commandment is without limit.
PSA 119:96.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] I have seen a limit to all perfection, but Your commandment is without limit.

PSA 119:97.text: Oh, how I love Your law! All day long it is my meditation.
PSA 119:97.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Love] Oh, how I love Your law! All day long it is my meditation.

PSA 119:98.text: Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for they are always with me.
PSA 119:98.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Law] Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for they are always with me.

PSA 119:99.text: I have more insight than all my teachers, for Your testimonies are my meditation.
PSA 119:99.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] I have more insight than all my teachers, for Your testimonies are my meditation.

PSA 119:100.text: I discern more than the elders, for I obey Your precepts.
PSA 119:100.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Leadership] I discern more than the elders, for I obey Your precepts.

PSA 119:101.text: I have kept my feet from every evil path, that I may keep Your word.
PSA 119:101.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] I have kept my feet from every evil path, that I may keep Your word.

PSA 119:102.text: I have not departed from Your ordinances, for You Yourself have taught me.
PSA 119:102.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] I have not departed from Your ordinances, for You Yourself have taught me.

PSA 119:103.text: How sweet are Your words to my taste— sweeter than honey in my mouth!
PSA 119:103.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] How sweet are Your words to my taste— sweeter than honey in my mouth!

PSA 119:104.text: I gain understanding from Your precepts; therefore I hate every false way.
PSA 119:104.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · False Gods, False Witness] I gain understanding from Your precepts; therefore I hate every false way.

PSA 119:105.text: Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.
PSA 119:105.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Light] Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.

PSA 119:106.text: I have sworn and confirmed that I will keep Your righteous judgments.
PSA 119:106.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] I have sworn and confirmed that I will keep Your righteous judgments.

PSA 119:107.text: I am severely afflicted, O LORD; revive me through Your word.
PSA 119:107.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] I am severely afflicted, O LORD; revive me through Your word.

PSA 119:108.text: Accept the freewill offerings of my mouth, O LORD, and teach me Your judgments.
PSA 119:108.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] Accept the freewill offerings of my mouth, O LORD, and teach me Your judgments.

PSA 119:109.text: I constantly take my life in my hands, yet I do not forget Your law.
PSA 119:109.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] I constantly take my life in my hands, yet I do not forget Your law.

PSA 119:110.text: The wicked have set a snare for me, but I have not strayed from Your precepts.
PSA 119:110.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] The wicked have set a snare for me, but I have not strayed from Your precepts.

PSA 119:111.text: Your testimonies are my heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.
PSA 119:111.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Adultery In Heart] Your testimonies are my heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.

PSA 119:112.text: I have inclined my heart to perform Your statutes, even to the very end.
PSA 119:112.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Adultery In Heart] I have inclined my heart to perform Your statutes, even to the very end.

PSA 119:113.text: The double-minded I despise, but Your law I love.
PSA 119:113.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Love] The double-minded I despise, but Your law I love.

PSA 119:114.text: You are my hiding place and my shield; I put my hope in Your word.
PSA 119:114.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] You are my hiding place and my shield; I put my hope in Your word.

PSA 119:115.text: Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may obey the commandments of my God.
PSA 119:115.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Law] Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may obey the commandments of my God.

PSA 119:116.text: Sustain me as You promised, that I may live; let me not be ashamed of my hope.
PSA 119:116.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] Sustain me as You promised, that I may live; let me not be ashamed of my hope.

PSA 119:117.text: Uphold me, and I will be saved, that I may always regard Your statutes.
PSA 119:117.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] Uphold me, and I will be saved, that I may always regard Your statutes.

PSA 119:118.text: You reject all who stray from Your statutes, for their deceitfulness is in vain.
PSA 119:118.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] You reject all who stray from Your statutes, for their deceitfulness is in vain.

PSA 119:119.text: All the wicked on earth You discard like dross; therefore I love Your testimonies.
PSA 119:119.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Love] All the wicked on earth You discard like dross; therefore I love Your testimonies.

PSA 119:120.text: My flesh trembles in awe of You; I stand in fear of Your judgments.
PSA 119:120.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] My flesh trembles in awe of You; I stand in fear of Your judgments.

PSA 119:121.text: I have done what is just and right; do not leave me to my oppressors.
PSA 119:121.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] I have done what is just and right; do not leave me to my oppressors.

PSA 119:122.text: Ensure Your servant’s well-being; do not let the arrogant oppress me.
PSA 119:122.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] Ensure Your servant’s well-being; do not let the arrogant oppress me.

PSA 119:123.text: My eyes fail, looking for Your salvation, and for Your righteous promise.
PSA 119:123.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Covenant] My eyes fail, looking for Your salvation, and for Your righteous promise.

PSA 119:124.text: Deal with Your servant according to Your loving devotion, and teach me Your statutes.
PSA 119:124.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Devotion] Deal with Your servant according to Your loving devotion, and teach me Your statutes.

PSA 119:125.text: I am Your servant; give me understanding, that I may know Your testimonies.
PSA 119:125.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] I am Your servant; give me understanding, that I may know Your testimonies.

PSA 119:126.text: It is time for the LORD to act, for they have broken Your law.
PSA 119:126.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] It is time for the LORD to act, for they have broken Your law.

PSA 119:127.text: Therefore I love Your commandments more than gold, even the purest gold.
PSA 119:127.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Love, Law] Therefore I love Your commandments more than gold, even the purest gold.

PSA 119:128.text: Therefore I admire all Your precepts and hate every false way.
PSA 119:128.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · False Gods, False Witness] Therefore I admire all Your precepts and hate every false way.

PSA 119:129.text: Wonderful are Your testimonies; therefore I obey them.
PSA 119:129.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] Wonderful are Your testimonies; therefore I obey them.

PSA 119:130.text: The unfolding of Your words gives light; it informs the simple.
PSA 119:130.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Light] The unfolding of Your words gives light; it informs the simple.

PSA 119:131.text: I open my mouth and pant, longing for Your commandments.
PSA 119:131.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Law] I open my mouth and pant, longing for Your commandments.

PSA 119:132.text: Turn to me and show me mercy, as You do to those who love Your name.
PSA 119:132.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Forgiveness, Love] Turn to me and show me mercy, as You do to those who love Your name.

PSA 119:133.text: Order my steps in Your word; let no sin rule over me.
PSA 119:133.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] Order my steps in Your word; let no sin rule over me.

PSA 119:134.text: Redeem me from the oppression of man, that I may keep Your precepts.
PSA 119:134.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] Redeem me from the oppression of man, that I may keep Your precepts.

PSA 119:135.text: Make Your face shine upon Your servant, and teach me Your statutes.
PSA 119:135.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] Make Your face shine upon Your servant, and teach me Your statutes.

PSA 119:136.text: My eyes shed streams of tears because Your law is not obeyed.
PSA 119:136.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] My eyes shed streams of tears because Your law is not obeyed.

PSA 119:137.text: Righteous are You, O LORD, and upright are Your judgments.
PSA 119:137.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] Righteous are You, O LORD, and upright are Your judgments.

PSA 119:138.text: The testimonies You have laid down are righteous and altogether faithful.
PSA 119:138.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Faith] The testimonies You have laid down are righteous and altogether faithful.

PSA 119:139.text: My zeal has consumed me because my foes forget Your words.
PSA 119:139.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] My zeal has consumed me because my foes forget Your words.

PSA 119:140.text: Your promise is completely pure; therefore Your servant loves it.
PSA 119:140.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Love, Covenant] Your promise is completely pure; therefore Your servant loves it.

PSA 119:141.text: I am lowly and despised, but I do not forget Your precepts.
PSA 119:141.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] I am lowly and despised, but I do not forget Your precepts.

PSA 119:142.text: Your righteousness is everlasting and Your law is true.
PSA 119:142.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] Your righteousness is everlasting and Your law is true.

PSA 119:143.text: Trouble and distress have found me, but Your commandments are my delight.
PSA 119:143.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Law] Trouble and distress have found me, but Your commandments are my delight.

PSA 119:144.text: Your testimonies are righteous forever. Give me understanding, that I may live.
PSA 119:144.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] Your testimonies are righteous forever. Give me understanding, that I may live.

PSA 119:145.text: I call with all my heart; answer me, O LORD! I will obey Your statutes.
PSA 119:145.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Adultery In Heart] I call with all my heart; answer me, O LORD! I will obey Your statutes.

PSA 119:146.text: I call to You; save me, that I may keep Your testimonies.
PSA 119:146.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] I call to You; save me, that I may keep Your testimonies.

PSA 119:147.text: I rise before dawn and cry for help; in Your word I have put my hope.
PSA 119:147.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] I rise before dawn and cry for help; in Your word I have put my hope.

PSA 119:148.text: My eyes anticipate the watches of night, that I may meditate on Your word.
PSA 119:148.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] My eyes anticipate the watches of night, that I may meditate on Your word.

PSA 119:149.text: Hear my voice, O LORD, according to Your loving devotion; give me life according to Your justice.
PSA 119:149.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Devotion, Justice] Hear my voice, O LORD, according to Your loving devotion; give me life according to Your justice.

PSA 119:150.text: Those who follow after wickedness draw near; they are far from Your law.
PSA 119:150.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] Those who follow after wickedness draw near; they are far from Your law.

PSA 119:151.text: You are near, O LORD, and all Your commandments are true.
PSA 119:151.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Law] You are near, O LORD, and all Your commandments are true.

PSA 119:152.text: Long ago I learned from Your testimonies that You have established them forever.
PSA 119:152.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] Long ago I learned from Your testimonies that You have established them forever.

PSA 119:153.text: Look upon my affliction and rescue me, for I have not forgotten Your law.
PSA 119:153.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] Look upon my affliction and rescue me, for I have not forgotten Your law.

PSA 119:154.text: Defend my cause and redeem me; revive me according to Your word.
PSA 119:154.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] Defend my cause and redeem me; revive me according to Your word.

PSA 119:155.text: Salvation is far from the wicked because they do not seek Your statutes.
PSA 119:155.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] Salvation is far from the wicked because they do not seek Your statutes.

PSA 119:156.text: Great are Your mercies, O LORD; revive me according to Your ordinances.
PSA 119:156.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] Great are Your mercies, O LORD; revive me according to Your ordinances.

PSA 119:157.text: Though my persecutors and foes are many, I have not turned from Your testimonies.
PSA 119:157.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] Though my persecutors and foes are many, I have not turned from Your testimonies.

PSA 119:158.text: I look on the faithless with loathing because they do not keep Your word.
PSA 119:158.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Faith] I look on the faithless with loathing because they do not keep Your word.

PSA 119:159.text: Consider how I love Your precepts, O LORD; give me life according to Your loving devotion.
PSA 119:159.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Love, Devotion] Consider how I love Your precepts, O LORD; give me life according to Your loving devotion.

PSA 119:160.text: The entirety of Your word is truth, and all Your righteous judgments endure forever.
PSA 119:160.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] The entirety of Your word is truth, and all Your righteous judgments endure forever.

PSA 119:161.text: Rulers persecute me without cause, but my heart fears only Your word.
PSA 119:161.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Adultery In Heart] Rulers persecute me without cause, but my heart fears only Your word.

PSA 119:162.text: I rejoice in Your promise like one who finds great spoil.
PSA 119:162.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Covenant] I rejoice in Your promise like one who finds great spoil.

PSA 119:163.text: I hate and abhor falsehood, but Your law I love.
PSA 119:163.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Love, Falsehood] I hate and abhor falsehood, but Your law I love.

PSA 119:164.text: Seven times a day I praise You for Your righteous judgments.
PSA 119:164.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · End Times] Seven times a day I praise You for Your righteous judgments.

PSA 119:165.text: Abundant peace belongs to those who love Your law; nothing can make them stumble.
PSA 119:165.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Love] Abundant peace belongs to those who love Your law; nothing can make them stumble.

PSA 119:166.text: I wait for Your salvation, O LORD, and I carry out Your commandments.
PSA 119:166.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Law] I wait for Your salvation, O LORD, and I carry out Your commandments.

PSA 119:167.text: I obey Your testimonies and love them greatly.
PSA 119:167.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Love] I obey Your testimonies and love them greatly.

PSA 119:168.text: I obey Your precepts and Your testimonies, for all my ways are before You.
PSA 119:168.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] I obey Your precepts and Your testimonies, for all my ways are before You.

PSA 119:169.text: May my cry come before You, O LORD; give me understanding according to Your word.
PSA 119:169.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] May my cry come before You, O LORD; give me understanding according to Your word.

PSA 119:170.text: May my plea come before You; rescue me according to Your promise.
PSA 119:170.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Covenant] May my plea come before You; rescue me according to Your promise.

PSA 119:171.text: My lips pour forth praise, for You teach me Your statutes.
PSA 119:171.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] My lips pour forth praise, for You teach me Your statutes.

PSA 119:172.text: My tongue sings of Your word, for all Your commandments are righteous.
PSA 119:172.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Law] My tongue sings of Your word, for all Your commandments are righteous.

PSA 119:173.text: May Your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen Your precepts.
PSA 119:173.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Election] May Your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen Your precepts.

PSA 119:174.text: I long for Your salvation, O LORD, and Your law is my delight.
PSA 119:174.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] I long for Your salvation, O LORD, and Your law is my delight.

PSA 119:175.text: Let me live to praise You; may Your judgments sustain me.
PSA 119:175.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119] Let me live to praise You; may Your judgments sustain me.

PSA 119:176.text: I have strayed like a lost sheep; seek Your servant, for I have not forgotten Your commandments.
PSA 119:176.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 119 · Law] I have strayed like a lost sheep; seek Your servant, for I have not forgotten Your commandments.

PSA 120:1.text: In my distress I cried to the LORD, and He answered me.
PSA 120:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 120] In my distress I cried to the LORD, and He answered me.

PSA 120:2.text: Deliver my soul, O LORD, from lying lips and a deceitful tongue.
PSA 120:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 120 · Lying] Deliver my soul, O LORD, from lying lips and a deceitful tongue.

PSA 120:3.text: What will He do to you, and what will be added to you, O deceitful tongue?
PSA 120:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 120] What will He do to you, and what will be added to you, O deceitful tongue?

PSA 120:4.text: Sharp arrows will come from the warrior, with burning coals of the broom tree!
PSA 120:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 120] Sharp arrows will come from the warrior, with burning coals of the broom tree!

PSA 120:5.text: Woe to me that I dwell in Meshech, that I live among the tents of Kedar!
PSA 120:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 120] Woe to me that I dwell in Meshech, that I live among the tents of Kedar!

PSA 120:6.text: Too long have I dwelt among those who hate peace.
PSA 120:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 120] Too long have I dwelt among those who hate peace.

PSA 120:7.text: I am in favor of peace; but when I speak, they want war.
PSA 120:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 120 · Blessing] I am in favor of peace; but when I speak, they want war.

PSA 121:1.text: I lift up my eyes to the hills. From where does my help come?
PSA 121:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 121] I lift up my eyes to the hills. From where does my help come?

PSA 121:2.text: My help comes from the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.
PSA 121:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 121 · Creation, Heaven] My help comes from the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.

PSA 121:3.text: He will not allow your foot to slip; your Protector will not slumber.
PSA 121:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 121] He will not allow your foot to slip; your Protector will not slumber.

PSA 121:4.text: Behold, the Protector of Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.
PSA 121:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 121 · Israel] Behold, the Protector of Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.

PSA 121:5.text: The LORD is your keeper; the LORD is the shade on your right hand.
PSA 121:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 121] The LORD is your keeper; the LORD is the shade on your right hand.

PSA 121:6.text: The sun will not strike you by day, nor the moon by night.
PSA 121:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 121] The sun will not strike you by day, nor the moon by night.

PSA 121:7.text: The LORD will guard you from all evil; He will preserve your soul.
PSA 121:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 121] The LORD will guard you from all evil; He will preserve your soul.

PSA 121:8.text: The LORD will watch over your coming and going, both now and forevermore.
PSA 121:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 121] The LORD will watch over your coming and going, both now and forevermore.

PSA 122:1.text: I was glad when they said to me, “Let us go to the house of the LORD.”
PSA 122:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 122] I was glad when they said to me, “Let us go to the house of the LORD.”

PSA 122:2.text: Our feet are standing in your gates, O Jerusalem.
PSA 122:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 122] Our feet are standing in your gates, O Jerusalem.

PSA 122:3.text: Jerusalem is built up as a city united together,
PSA 122:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 122] Jerusalem is built up as a city united together,

PSA 122:4.text: where the tribes go up, the tribes of the LORD, as a testimony for Israel, to give thanks to the name of the LORD.
PSA 122:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 122 · Israel] where the tribes go up, the tribes of the LORD, as a testimony for Israel, to give thanks to the name of the LORD.

PSA 122:5.text: For there the thrones of judgment stand, the thrones of the house of David.
PSA 122:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 122 · Judgment] For there the thrones of judgment stand, the thrones of the house of David.

PSA 122:6.text: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: “May those who love you prosper.
PSA 122:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 122 · Love] Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: “May those who love you prosper.

PSA 122:7.text: May there be peace within your walls, and prosperity inside your fortresses.”
PSA 122:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 122 · Blessing] May there be peace within your walls, and prosperity inside your fortresses.”

PSA 122:8.text: For the sake of my brothers and friends, I will say, “Peace be within you.”
PSA 122:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 122] For the sake of my brothers and friends, I will say, “Peace be within you.”

PSA 122:9.text: For the sake of the house of the LORD our God, I will seek your prosperity.
PSA 122:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 122 · Blessing] For the sake of the house of the LORD our God, I will seek your prosperity.

PSA 123:1.text: I lift up my eyes to You, the One enthroned in heaven.
PSA 123:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 123 · Heaven] I lift up my eyes to You, the One enthroned in heaven.

PSA 123:2.text: As the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maidservant look to the hand of her mistress, so our eyes are on the LORD our God until He shows us mercy.
PSA 123:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 123 · Forgiveness, Compassion] As the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maidservant look to the hand of her mistress, so our eyes are on the LORD our God until He shows us mercy.

PSA 123:3.text: Have mercy on us, O LORD, have mercy, for we have endured much contempt.
PSA 123:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 123 · Forgiveness, Compassion] Have mercy on us, O LORD, have mercy, for we have endured much contempt.

PSA 123:4.text: We have endured much scorn from the arrogant, much contempt from the proud.
PSA 123:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 123] We have endured much scorn from the arrogant, much contempt from the proud.

PSA 124:1.text: If the LORD had not been on our side— let Israel now declare—
PSA 124:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 124 · Israel] If the LORD had not been on our side— let Israel now declare—

PSA 124:2.text: if the LORD had not been on our side when men attacked us,
PSA 124:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 124] if the LORD had not been on our side when men attacked us,

PSA 124:3.text: when their anger flared against us, then they would have swallowed us alive,
PSA 124:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 124] when their anger flared against us, then they would have swallowed us alive,

PSA 124:4.text: then the floods would have engulfed us, then the torrent would have overwhelmed us,
PSA 124:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 124] then the floods would have engulfed us, then the torrent would have overwhelmed us,

PSA 124:5.text: then the raging waters would have swept us away.
PSA 124:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 124] then the raging waters would have swept us away.

PSA 124:6.text: Blessed be the LORD, who has not given us as prey to their teeth.
PSA 124:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 124] Blessed be the LORD, who has not given us as prey to their teeth.

PSA 124:7.text: We have escaped like a bird from the snare of the fowler; the net is torn, and we have slipped away.
PSA 124:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 124] We have escaped like a bird from the snare of the fowler; the net is torn, and we have slipped away.

PSA 124:8.text: Our help is in the name of the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.
PSA 124:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 124 · Creation, Heaven] Our help is in the name of the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.

PSA 125:1.text: Those who trust in the LORD are like Mount Zion. It cannot be moved; it abides forever.
PSA 125:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 125 · Faith] Those who trust in the LORD are like Mount Zion. It cannot be moved; it abides forever.

PSA 125:2.text: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the LORD surrounds His people, both now and forevermore.
PSA 125:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 125] As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the LORD surrounds His people, both now and forevermore.

PSA 125:3.text: For the scepter of the wicked will not rest upon the land allotted to the righteous, so that the righteous will not put forth their hands to injustice.
PSA 125:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 125] For the scepter of the wicked will not rest upon the land allotted to the righteous, so that the righteous will not put forth their hands to injustice.

PSA 125:4.text: Do good, O LORD, to those who are good, and to the upright in heart.
PSA 125:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 125 · Adultery In Heart] Do good, O LORD, to those who are good, and to the upright in heart.

PSA 125:5.text: But those who turn to crooked ways the LORD will banish with the evildoers.   Peace be upon Israel.
PSA 125:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 125 · Israel] But those who turn to crooked ways the LORD will banish with the evildoers.   Peace be upon Israel.

PSA 126:1.text: When the LORD restored the captives of Zion, we were like dreamers.
PSA 126:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 126] When the LORD restored the captives of Zion, we were like dreamers.

PSA 126:2.text: Then our mouths were filled with laughter, our tongues with shouts of joy. Then it was said among the nations, “The LORD has done great things for them.”
PSA 126:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 126] Then our mouths were filled with laughter, our tongues with shouts of joy. Then it was said among the nations, “The LORD has done great things for them.”

PSA 126:3.text: The LORD has done great things for us; we are filled with joy.
PSA 126:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 126] The LORD has done great things for us; we are filled with joy.

PSA 126:4.text: Restore our captives, O LORD, like streams in the Negev.
PSA 126:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 126] Restore our captives, O LORD, like streams in the Negev.

PSA 126:5.text: Those who sow in tears will reap with shouts of joy.
PSA 126:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 126] Those who sow in tears will reap with shouts of joy.

PSA 126:6.text: He who goes out weeping, bearing a trail of seed, will surely return with shouts of joy, carrying sheaves of grain.
PSA 126:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 126] He who goes out weeping, bearing a trail of seed, will surely return with shouts of joy, carrying sheaves of grain.

PSA 127:1.text: Unless the LORD builds the house, its builders labor in vain; unless the LORD protects the city, its watchmen stand guard in vain.
PSA 127:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 127] Unless the LORD builds the house, its builders labor in vain; unless the LORD protects the city, its watchmen stand guard in vain.

PSA 127:2.text: In vain you rise early and stay up late, toiling for bread to eat— for He gives sleep to His beloved.
PSA 127:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 127 · Love] In vain you rise early and stay up late, toiling for bread to eat— for He gives sleep to His beloved.

PSA 127:3.text: Children are indeed a heritage from the LORD, and the fruit of the womb is His reward.
PSA 127:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 127 · Children, Fruit of the Spirit] Children are indeed a heritage from the LORD, and the fruit of the womb is His reward.

PSA 127:4.text: Like arrows in the hand of a warrior, so are children born in one’s youth.
PSA 127:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 127 · Children] Like arrows in the hand of a warrior, so are children born in one’s youth.

PSA 127:5.text: Blessed is the man whose quiver is full of them. He will not be put to shame when he confronts the enemies at the gate.
PSA 127:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 127] Blessed is the man whose quiver is full of them. He will not be put to shame when he confronts the enemies at the gate.

PSA 128:1.text: Blessed are all who fear the LORD, who walk in His ways!
PSA 128:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 128 · Beatitudes] Blessed are all who fear the LORD, who walk in His ways!

PSA 128:2.text: For when you eat the fruit of your labor, blessings and prosperity will be yours.
PSA 128:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 128 · Blessing, Fruit of the Spirit] For when you eat the fruit of your labor, blessings and prosperity will be yours.

PSA 128:3.text: Your wife will be like a fruitful vine flourishing within your house, your sons like olive shoots sitting around your table.
PSA 128:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 128] Your wife will be like a fruitful vine flourishing within your house, your sons like olive shoots sitting around your table.

PSA 128:4.text: In this way indeed shall blessing come to the man who fears the LORD.
PSA 128:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 128 · Blessing] In this way indeed shall blessing come to the man who fears the LORD.

PSA 128:5.text: May the LORD bless you from Zion, that you may see the prosperity of Jerusalem all the days of your life,
PSA 128:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 128 · Blessing] May the LORD bless you from Zion, that you may see the prosperity of Jerusalem all the days of your life,

PSA 128:6.text: that you may see your children’s children.   Peace be upon Israel!
PSA 128:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 128 · Children, Israel] that you may see your children’s children.   Peace be upon Israel!

PSA 129:1.text: Many a time they have persecuted me from my youth— let Israel now declare—
PSA 129:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 129 · Israel] Many a time they have persecuted me from my youth— let Israel now declare—

PSA 129:2.text: many a time they have persecuted me from my youth, but they have not prevailed against me.
PSA 129:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 129] many a time they have persecuted me from my youth, but they have not prevailed against me.

PSA 129:3.text: The plowmen plowed over my back; they made their furrows long.
PSA 129:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 129] The plowmen plowed over my back; they made their furrows long.

PSA 129:4.text: The LORD is righteous; He has cut me from the cords of the wicked.
PSA 129:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 129] The LORD is righteous; He has cut me from the cords of the wicked.

PSA 129:5.text: May all who hate Zion be turned back in shame.
PSA 129:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 129] May all who hate Zion be turned back in shame.

PSA 129:6.text: May they be like grass on the rooftops, which withers before it can grow,
PSA 129:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 129] May they be like grass on the rooftops, which withers before it can grow,

PSA 129:7.text: unable to fill the hands of the reaper, or the arms of the binder of sheaves.
PSA 129:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 129] unable to fill the hands of the reaper, or the arms of the binder of sheaves.

PSA 129:8.text: May none who pass by say to them, “The blessing of the LORD be on you; we bless you in the name of the LORD.”
PSA 129:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 129 · Blessing] May none who pass by say to them, “The blessing of the LORD be on you; we bless you in the name of the LORD.”

PSA 130:1.text: Out of the depths I cry to You, O LORD!
PSA 130:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 130] Out of the depths I cry to You, O LORD!

PSA 130:2.text: O Lord, hear my voice; let Your ears be attentive to my plea for mercy.
PSA 130:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 130 · Forgiveness, Compassion] O Lord, hear my voice; let Your ears be attentive to my plea for mercy.

PSA 130:3.text: If You, O LORD, kept track of iniquities, then who, O Lord, could stand?
PSA 130:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 130] If You, O LORD, kept track of iniquities, then who, O Lord, could stand?

PSA 130:4.text: But with You there is forgiveness, so that You may be feared.
PSA 130:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 130 · Forgiveness, About Forgiveness] But with You there is forgiveness, so that You may be feared.

PSA 130:5.text: I wait for the LORD; my soul does wait, and in His word I put my hope.
PSA 130:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 130] I wait for the LORD; my soul does wait, and in His word I put my hope.

PSA 130:6.text: My soul waits for the Lord more than watchmen wait for the morning— more than watchmen wait for the morning.
PSA 130:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 130] My soul waits for the Lord more than watchmen wait for the morning— more than watchmen wait for the morning.

PSA 130:7.text: O Israel, put your hope in the LORD, for with the LORD is loving devotion, and with Him is redemption in abundance.
PSA 130:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 130 · Devotion, Israel] O Israel, put your hope in the LORD, for with the LORD is loving devotion, and with Him is redemption in abundance.

PSA 130:8.text: And He will redeem Israel from all iniquity.
PSA 130:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 130 · Israel] And He will redeem Israel from all iniquity.

PSA 131:1.text: My heart is not proud, O LORD, my eyes are not haughty. I do not aspire to great things or matters too lofty for me.
PSA 131:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 131 · Adultery In Heart] My heart is not proud, O LORD, my eyes are not haughty. I do not aspire to great things or matters too lofty for me.

PSA 131:2.text: Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul; like a weaned child with his mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me.
PSA 131:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 131] Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul; like a weaned child with his mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me.

PSA 131:3.text: O Israel, put your hope in the LORD, both now and forevermore.
PSA 131:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 131 · Israel] O Israel, put your hope in the LORD, both now and forevermore.

PSA 132:1.text: O LORD, remember on behalf of David all the hardships he endured,
PSA 132:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 132] O LORD, remember on behalf of David all the hardships he endured,

PSA 132:2.text: how he swore an oath to the LORD, and vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob:
PSA 132:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 132 · Israel] how he swore an oath to the LORD, and vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob:

PSA 132:3.text: “I will not enter my house or get into my bed,
PSA 132:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 132] “I will not enter my house or get into my bed,

PSA 132:4.text: I will not give sleep to my eyes or slumber to my eyelids,
PSA 132:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 132] I will not give sleep to my eyes or slumber to my eyelids,

PSA 132:5.text: until I find a place for the LORD, a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob.”
PSA 132:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 132 · Israel] until I find a place for the LORD, a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob.”

PSA 132:6.text: We heard that the ark was in Ephrathah; we found it in the fields of Jaar.
PSA 132:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 132] We heard that the ark was in Ephrathah; we found it in the fields of Jaar.

PSA 132:7.text: Let us go to His dwelling place; let us worship at His footstool.
PSA 132:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 132] Let us go to His dwelling place; let us worship at His footstool.

PSA 132:8.text: Arise, O LORD, to Your resting place, You and the ark of Your strength.
PSA 132:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 132] Arise, O LORD, to Your resting place, You and the ark of Your strength.

PSA 132:9.text: May Your priests be clothed with righteousness, and Your saints shout for joy.
PSA 132:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 132] May Your priests be clothed with righteousness, and Your saints shout for joy.

PSA 132:10.text: For the sake of Your servant David, do not reject Your anointed one.
PSA 132:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 132] For the sake of Your servant David, do not reject Your anointed one.

PSA 132:11.text: The LORD swore an oath to David, a promise He will not revoke: “One of your descendants I will place on your throne.
PSA 132:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 132 · Covenant] The LORD swore an oath to David, a promise He will not revoke: “One of your descendants I will place on your throne.

PSA 132:12.text: If your sons keep My covenant and the testimony I will teach them, then their sons will also sit on your throne forever and ever.”
PSA 132:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 132 · Covenant] If your sons keep My covenant and the testimony I will teach them, then their sons will also sit on your throne forever and ever.”

PSA 132:13.text: For the LORD has chosen Zion; He has desired it for His home:
PSA 132:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 132 · Election] For the LORD has chosen Zion; He has desired it for His home:

PSA 132:14.text: “This is My resting place forever and ever; here I will dwell, for I have desired this home.
PSA 132:14.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 132] “This is My resting place forever and ever; here I will dwell, for I have desired this home.

PSA 132:15.text: I will bless her with abundant provisions; I will satisfy her poor with bread.
PSA 132:15.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 132] I will bless her with abundant provisions; I will satisfy her poor with bread.

PSA 132:16.text: I will clothe her priests with salvation, and her saints will sing out in joy.
PSA 132:16.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 132] I will clothe her priests with salvation, and her saints will sing out in joy.

PSA 132:17.text: There I will make a horn grow for David; I have prepared a lamp for My anointed one.
PSA 132:17.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 132 · Light] There I will make a horn grow for David; I have prepared a lamp for My anointed one.

PSA 132:18.text: I will clothe his enemies with shame, but the crown upon him will gleam.”
PSA 132:18.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 132] I will clothe his enemies with shame, but the crown upon him will gleam.”

PSA 133:1.text: Behold, how good and pleasant it is when brothers live together in harmony!
PSA 133:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 133] Behold, how good and pleasant it is when brothers live together in harmony!

PSA 133:2.text: It is like fine oil on the head, running down on the beard, running down Aaron’s beard over the collar of his robes.
PSA 133:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 133] It is like fine oil on the head, running down on the beard, running down Aaron’s beard over the collar of his robes.

PSA 133:3.text: It is like the dew of Hermon falling on the mountains of Zion. For there the LORD has bestowed the blessing of life forevermore.
PSA 133:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 133 · Blessing] It is like the dew of Hermon falling on the mountains of Zion. For there the LORD has bestowed the blessing of life forevermore.

PSA 134:1.text: Come, bless the LORD, all you servants of the LORD who serve by night in the house of the LORD!
PSA 134:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 134] Come, bless the LORD, all you servants of the LORD who serve by night in the house of the LORD!

PSA 134:2.text: Lift up your hands to the sanctuary and bless the LORD!
PSA 134:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 134] Lift up your hands to the sanctuary and bless the LORD!

PSA 134:3.text: May the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth, bless you from Zion.
PSA 134:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 134 · Creation, Heaven] May the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth, bless you from Zion.

PSA 135:1.text: Hallelujah!   Praise the name of the LORD. Give praise, O servants of the LORD,
PSA 135:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 135] Hallelujah!   Praise the name of the LORD. Give praise, O servants of the LORD,
