PSA 135:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 135] who stand in the house of the LORD, in the courts of the house of our God.

PSA 135:3.text: Hallelujah, for the LORD is good; sing praises to His name, for it is lovely.
PSA 135:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 135 · Love] Hallelujah, for the LORD is good; sing praises to His name, for it is lovely.

PSA 135:4.text: For the LORD has chosen Jacob as His own, Israel as His treasured possession.
PSA 135:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 135 · Election, Israel] For the LORD has chosen Jacob as His own, Israel as His treasured possession.

PSA 135:5.text: For I know that the LORD is great; our Lord is above all gods.
PSA 135:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 135] For I know that the LORD is great; our Lord is above all gods.

PSA 135:6.text: The LORD does all that pleases Him in the heavens and on the earth, in the seas and in all their depths.
PSA 135:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 135] The LORD does all that pleases Him in the heavens and on the earth, in the seas and in all their depths.

PSA 135:7.text: He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth. He generates the lightning with the rain and brings forth the wind from His storehouses.
PSA 135:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 135] He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth. He generates the lightning with the rain and brings forth the wind from His storehouses.

PSA 135:8.text: He struck down the firstborn of Egypt, of both man and beast.
PSA 135:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 135 · Antichrist] He struck down the firstborn of Egypt, of both man and beast.

PSA 135:9.text: He sent signs and wonders into your midst, O Egypt, against Pharaoh and all his servants.
PSA 135:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 135] He sent signs and wonders into your midst, O Egypt, against Pharaoh and all his servants.

PSA 135:10.text: He struck down many nations and slaughtered mighty kings:
PSA 135:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 135] He struck down many nations and slaughtered mighty kings:

PSA 135:11.text: Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kings of Canaan.
PSA 135:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 135 · Conquest Of Canaan, Destroy Canaan] Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kings of Canaan.

PSA 135:12.text: He gave their land as an inheritance, as a heritage to His people Israel.
PSA 135:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 135 · Inheritance, Israel] He gave their land as an inheritance, as a heritage to His people Israel.

PSA 135:13.text: Your name, O LORD, endures forever, Your renown, O LORD, through all generations.
PSA 135:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 135] Your name, O LORD, endures forever, Your renown, O LORD, through all generations.

PSA 135:14.text: For the LORD will vindicate His people and will have compassion on His servants.
PSA 135:14.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 135 · Compassion] For the LORD will vindicate His people and will have compassion on His servants.

PSA 135:15.text: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, made by the hands of men.
PSA 135:15.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 135 · Idolatry, Idols] The idols of the nations are silver and gold, made by the hands of men.

PSA 135:16.text: They have mouths, but cannot speak; they have eyes, but cannot see;
PSA 135:16.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 135] They have mouths, but cannot speak; they have eyes, but cannot see;

PSA 135:17.text: they have ears, but cannot hear; nor is there breath in their mouths.
PSA 135:17.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 135] they have ears, but cannot hear; nor is there breath in their mouths.

PSA 135:18.text: Those who make them become like them, as do all who trust in them.
PSA 135:18.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 135 · Faith] Those who make them become like them, as do all who trust in them.

PSA 135:19.text: O house of Israel, bless the LORD; O house of Aaron, bless the LORD;
PSA 135:19.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 135 · Israel] O house of Israel, bless the LORD; O house of Aaron, bless the LORD;

PSA 135:20.text: O house of Levi, bless the LORD; you who fear the LORD, bless the LORD!
PSA 135:20.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 135] O house of Levi, bless the LORD; you who fear the LORD, bless the LORD!

PSA 135:21.text: Blessed be the LORD from Zion— He who dwells in Jerusalem.   Hallelujah!
PSA 135:21.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 135] Blessed be the LORD from Zion— He who dwells in Jerusalem.   Hallelujah!

PSA 136:1.text: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good. His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 136:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 136 · Devotion] Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good. His loving devotion endures forever.

PSA 136:2.text: Give thanks to the God of gods. His loving devotion endures forever.

PSA 136:3.text: Give thanks to the Lord of lords. His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 136:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 136 · Devotion] Give thanks to the Lord of lords. His loving devotion endures forever.

PSA 136:4.text: He alone does great wonders. His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 136:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 136 · Devotion] He alone does great wonders. His loving devotion endures forever.

PSA 136:5.text: By His insight He made the heavens. His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 136:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 136 · Devotion] By His insight He made the heavens. His loving devotion endures forever.

PSA 136:6.text: He spread out the earth upon the waters. His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 136:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 136 · Devotion] He spread out the earth upon the waters. His loving devotion endures forever.

PSA 136:7.text: He made the great lights— His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 136:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 136 · Devotion] He made the great lights— His loving devotion endures forever.

PSA 136:8.text: the sun to rule the day, His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 136:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 136 · Devotion] the sun to rule the day, His loving devotion endures forever.

PSA 136:9.text: the moon and stars to govern the night. His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 136:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 136 · Devotion] the moon and stars to govern the night. His loving devotion endures forever.

PSA 136:10.text: He struck down the firstborn of Egypt His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 136:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 136 · Devotion] He struck down the firstborn of Egypt His loving devotion endures forever.

PSA 136:11.text: and brought Israel out from among them His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 136:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 136 · Devotion, Israel] and brought Israel out from among them His loving devotion endures forever.

PSA 136:12.text: with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm. His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 136:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 136 · Devotion] with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm. His loving devotion endures forever.

PSA 136:13.text: He divided the Red Sea in two His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 136:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 136 · Devotion] He divided the Red Sea in two His loving devotion endures forever.

PSA 136:14.text: and led Israel through the midst, His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 136:14.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 136 · Devotion, Israel] and led Israel through the midst, His loving devotion endures forever.

PSA 136:15.text: but swept Pharaoh and his army into the Red Sea. His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 136:15.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 136 · Devotion] but swept Pharaoh and his army into the Red Sea. His loving devotion endures forever.

PSA 136:16.text: He led His people through the wilderness. His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 136:16.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 136 · Devotion] He led His people through the wilderness. His loving devotion endures forever.

PSA 136:17.text: He struck down great kings His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 136:17.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 136 · Devotion] He struck down great kings His loving devotion endures forever.

PSA 136:18.text: and slaughtered mighty kings— His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 136:18.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 136 · Devotion] and slaughtered mighty kings— His loving devotion endures forever.

PSA 136:19.text: Sihon king of the Amorites His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 136:19.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 136 · Devotion] Sihon king of the Amorites His loving devotion endures forever.

PSA 136:20.text: and Og king of Bashan— His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 136:20.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 136 · Devotion] and Og king of Bashan— His loving devotion endures forever.

PSA 136:21.text: and He gave their land as an inheritance, His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 136:21.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 136 · Devotion, Inheritance] and He gave their land as an inheritance, His loving devotion endures forever.

PSA 136:22.text: a heritage to His servant Israel. His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 136:22.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 136 · Devotion, Israel] a heritage to His servant Israel. His loving devotion endures forever.

PSA 136:23.text: He remembered us in our low estate His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 136:23.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 136 · Devotion] He remembered us in our low estate His loving devotion endures forever.

PSA 136:24.text: and freed us from our enemies. His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 136:24.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 136 · Devotion] and freed us from our enemies. His loving devotion endures forever.

PSA 136:25.text: He gives food to every creature. His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 136:25.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 136 · Devotion] He gives food to every creature. His loving devotion endures forever.

PSA 136:26.text: Give thanks to the God of heaven! His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 136:26.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 136 · Devotion, Heaven] Give thanks to the God of heaven! His loving devotion endures forever.

PSA 137:1.text: By the rivers of Babylon we sat and wept when we remembered Zion.
PSA 137:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 137] By the rivers of Babylon we sat and wept when we remembered Zion.

PSA 137:2.text: There on the willows we hung our harps,
PSA 137:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 137] There on the willows we hung our harps,

PSA 137:3.text: for there our captors requested a song; our tormentors demanded songs of joy:   “Sing us a song of Zion.”
PSA 137:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 137] for there our captors requested a song; our tormentors demanded songs of joy:   “Sing us a song of Zion.”

PSA 137:4.text: How can we sing a song of the LORD in a foreign land?
PSA 137:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 137] How can we sing a song of the LORD in a foreign land?

PSA 137:5.text: If I forget you, O Jerusalem, may my right hand cease to function.
PSA 137:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 137] If I forget you, O Jerusalem, may my right hand cease to function.

PSA 137:6.text: May my tongue cling to the roof of my mouth if I do not remember you, if I do not exalt Jerusalem as my greatest joy!
PSA 137:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 137] May my tongue cling to the roof of my mouth if I do not remember you, if I do not exalt Jerusalem as my greatest joy!

PSA 137:7.text: Remember, O LORD, the sons of Edom on the day Jerusalem fell: “Destroy it,” they said, “tear it down to its foundations!”
PSA 137:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 137 · Destroy Canaan, Destroy Canaanites] Remember, O LORD, the sons of Edom on the day Jerusalem fell: “Destroy it,” they said, “tear it down to its foundations!”

PSA 137:8.text: O Daughter of Babylon, doomed to destruction, blessed is he who repays you as you have done to us.
PSA 137:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 137 · Devote To Destruction] O Daughter of Babylon, doomed to destruction, blessed is he who repays you as you have done to us.

PSA 137:9.text: Blessed is he who seizes your infants and dashes them against the rocks.
PSA 137:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 137] Blessed is he who seizes your infants and dashes them against the rocks.

PSA 138:1.text: I give You thanks with all my heart; before the gods I sing Your praises.
PSA 138:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 138 · Adultery In Heart] I give You thanks with all my heart; before the gods I sing Your praises.

PSA 138:2.text: I bow down toward Your holy temple and give thanks to Your name for Your loving devotion and Your faithfulness; You have exalted Your name and Your word above all else.
PSA 138:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 138 · Faith, Ascension] I bow down toward Your holy temple and give thanks to Your name for Your loving devotion and Your faithfulness; You have exalted Your name and Your word above all else.

PSA 138:3.text: On the day I called, You answered me; You emboldened me and strengthened my soul.
PSA 138:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 138] On the day I called, You answered me; You emboldened me and strengthened my soul.

PSA 138:4.text: All the kings of the earth will give You thanks, O LORD, when they hear the words of Your mouth.
PSA 138:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 138] All the kings of the earth will give You thanks, O LORD, when they hear the words of Your mouth.

PSA 138:5.text: They will sing of the ways of the LORD, for the glory of the LORD is great.
PSA 138:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 138 · Glory] They will sing of the ways of the LORD, for the glory of the LORD is great.

PSA 138:6.text: Though the LORD is on high, He attends to the lowly; but the proud He knows from afar.
PSA 138:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 138] Though the LORD is on high, He attends to the lowly; but the proud He knows from afar.

PSA 138:7.text: If I walk in the midst of trouble, You preserve me from the anger of my foes; You extend Your hand, and Your right hand saves me.
PSA 138:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 138] If I walk in the midst of trouble, You preserve me from the anger of my foes; You extend Your hand, and Your right hand saves me.

PSA 138:8.text: The LORD will fulfill His purpose for me.   O LORD, Your loving devotion endures forever— do not abandon the works of Your hands.
PSA 138:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 138 · Devotion] The LORD will fulfill His purpose for me.   O LORD, Your loving devotion endures forever— do not abandon the works of Your hands.

PSA 139:1.text: O LORD, You have searched me and known me.
PSA 139:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 139] O LORD, You have searched me and known me.

PSA 139:2.text: You know when I sit and when I rise; You understand my thoughts from afar.
PSA 139:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 139] You know when I sit and when I rise; You understand my thoughts from afar.

PSA 139:3.text: You search out my path and my lying down; You are aware of all my ways.
PSA 139:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 139 · Lying] You search out my path and my lying down; You are aware of all my ways.

PSA 139:4.text: Even before a word is on my tongue, You know all about it, O LORD.
PSA 139:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 139 · About Forgiveness] Even before a word is on my tongue, You know all about it, O LORD.

PSA 139:5.text: You hem me in behind and before; You have laid Your hand upon me.
PSA 139:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 139] You hem me in behind and before; You have laid Your hand upon me.

PSA 139:6.text: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me, too lofty for me to attain.
PSA 139:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 139] Such knowledge is too wonderful for me, too lofty for me to attain.

PSA 139:7.text: Where can I go to escape Your Spirit? Where can I flee from Your presence?
PSA 139:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 139 · Fruit of the Spirit] Where can I go to escape Your Spirit? Where can I flee from Your presence?

PSA 139:8.text: If I ascend to the heavens, You are there; if I make my bed in Sheol, You are there.
PSA 139:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 139 · Death] If I ascend to the heavens, You are there; if I make my bed in Sheol, You are there.

PSA 139:9.text: If I rise on the wings of the dawn, if I settle by the farthest sea,
PSA 139:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 139] If I rise on the wings of the dawn, if I settle by the farthest sea,

PSA 139:10.text: even there Your hand will guide me; Your right hand will hold me fast.
PSA 139:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 139] even there Your hand will guide me; Your right hand will hold me fast.

PSA 139:11.text: If I say, “Surely the darkness will hide me, and the light become night around me”—
PSA 139:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 139 · Light] If I say, “Surely the darkness will hide me, and the light become night around me”—

PSA 139:12.text: even the darkness is not dark to You, but the night shines like the day, for darkness is as light to You.
PSA 139:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 139 · Light] even the darkness is not dark to You, but the night shines like the day, for darkness is as light to You.

PSA 139:13.text: For You formed my inmost being; You knit me together in my mother’s womb.
PSA 139:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 139] For You formed my inmost being; You knit me together in my mother’s womb.

PSA 139:14.text: I praise You, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Marvelous are Your works, and I know this very well.
PSA 139:14.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 139] I praise You, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Marvelous are Your works, and I know this very well.

PSA 139:15.text: My frame was not hidden from You when I was made in secret, when I was woven together in the depths of the earth.
PSA 139:15.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 139] My frame was not hidden from You when I was made in secret, when I was woven together in the depths of the earth.

PSA 139:16.text: Your eyes saw my unformed body; all my days were written in Your book and ordained for me before one of them came to be.
PSA 139:16.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 139] Your eyes saw my unformed body; all my days were written in Your book and ordained for me before one of them came to be.

PSA 139:17.text: How precious to me are Your thoughts, O God, how vast is their sum!
PSA 139:17.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 139] How precious to me are Your thoughts, O God, how vast is their sum!

PSA 139:18.text: If I were to count them, they would outnumber the grains of sand; and when I awake, I am still with You.
PSA 139:18.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 139] If I were to count them, they would outnumber the grains of sand; and when I awake, I am still with You.

PSA 139:19.text: O God, that You would slay the wicked— away from me, you bloodthirsty men—
PSA 139:19.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 139] O God, that You would slay the wicked— away from me, you bloodthirsty men—

PSA 139:20.text: who speak of You deceitfully; Your enemies take Your name in vain.
PSA 139:20.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 139] who speak of You deceitfully; Your enemies take Your name in vain.

PSA 139:21.text: Do I not hate those who hate You, O LORD, and detest those who rise against You?
PSA 139:21.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 139] Do I not hate those who hate You, O LORD, and detest those who rise against You?

PSA 139:22.text: I hate them with perfect hatred; I count them as my enemies.
PSA 139:22.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 139] I hate them with perfect hatred; I count them as my enemies.

PSA 139:23.text: Search me, O God, and know my heart; test me and know my concerns.
PSA 139:23.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 139 · Adultery In Heart] Search me, O God, and know my heart; test me and know my concerns.

PSA 139:24.text: See if there is any offensive way in me; lead me in the way everlasting.
PSA 139:24.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 139] See if there is any offensive way in me; lead me in the way everlasting.

PSA 140:1.text: Rescue me, O LORD, from evil men. Protect me from men of violence,
PSA 140:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 140] Rescue me, O LORD, from evil men. Protect me from men of violence,

PSA 140:2.text: who devise evil in their hearts and stir up war all day long.
PSA 140:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 140] who devise evil in their hearts and stir up war all day long.

PSA 140:3.text: They sharpen their tongues like snakes; the venom of vipers is on their lips. Selah
PSA 140:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 140] They sharpen their tongues like snakes; the venom of vipers is on their lips. Selah

PSA 140:4.text: Guard me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked. Keep me safe from men of violence who scheme to make me stumble.
PSA 140:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 140] Guard me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked. Keep me safe from men of violence who scheme to make me stumble.

PSA 140:5.text: The proud hide a snare for me; the cords of their net are spread along the path, and lures are set out for me. Selah
PSA 140:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 140] The proud hide a snare for me; the cords of their net are spread along the path, and lures are set out for me. Selah

PSA 140:6.text: I say to the LORD, “You are my God.” Hear, O LORD, my cry for help.
PSA 140:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 140] I say to the LORD, “You are my God.” Hear, O LORD, my cry for help.

PSA 140:7.text: O GOD the Lord, the strength of my salvation, You shield my head in the day of battle.
PSA 140:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 140] O GOD the Lord, the strength of my salvation, You shield my head in the day of battle.

PSA 140:8.text: Grant not, O LORD, the desires of the wicked; do not promote their evil plans, lest they be exalted. Selah
PSA 140:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 140 · Ascension] Grant not, O LORD, the desires of the wicked; do not promote their evil plans, lest they be exalted. Selah

PSA 140:9.text: May the heads of those who surround me be covered in the trouble their lips have caused.
PSA 140:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 140] May the heads of those who surround me be covered in the trouble their lips have caused.

PSA 140:10.text: May burning coals fall on them; may they be thrown into the fire, into the miry pits, never to rise again.
PSA 140:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 140] May burning coals fall on them; may they be thrown into the fire, into the miry pits, never to rise again.

PSA 140:11.text: May no slanderer be established in the land; may calamity hunt down the man of violence.
PSA 140:11.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 140] May no slanderer be established in the land; may calamity hunt down the man of violence.

PSA 140:12.text: I know that the LORD upholds justice for the poor and defends the cause of the needy.
PSA 140:12.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 140 · Justice] I know that the LORD upholds justice for the poor and defends the cause of the needy.

PSA 140:13.text: Surely the righteous will praise Your name; the upright will dwell in Your presence.
PSA 140:13.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 140] Surely the righteous will praise Your name; the upright will dwell in Your presence.

PSA 141:1.text: I call upon You, O LORD; come quickly to me. Hear my voice when I call to You.
PSA 141:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 141] I call upon You, O LORD; come quickly to me. Hear my voice when I call to You.

PSA 141:2.text: May my prayer be set before You like incense, my uplifted hands like the evening offering.
PSA 141:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 141] May my prayer be set before You like incense, my uplifted hands like the evening offering.

PSA 141:3.text: Set a guard, O LORD, over my mouth; keep watch at the door of my lips.
PSA 141:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 141] Set a guard, O LORD, over my mouth; keep watch at the door of my lips.

PSA 141:4.text: Do not let my heart be drawn to any evil thing or take part in works of wickedness with men who do iniquity; let me not feast on their delicacies.
PSA 141:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 141 · Adultery In Heart] Do not let my heart be drawn to any evil thing or take part in works of wickedness with men who do iniquity; let me not feast on their delicacies.

PSA 141:5.text: Let the righteous man strike me; let his rebuke be an act of loving devotion. It is oil for my head; let me not refuse it. For my prayer is ever against the deeds of the wicked.
PSA 141:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 141 · Devotion] Let the righteous man strike me; let his rebuke be an act of loving devotion. It is oil for my head; let me not refuse it. For my prayer is ever against the deeds of the wicked.

PSA 141:6.text: When their rulers are thrown down from the cliffs, the people will listen to my words, for they are pleasant.
PSA 141:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 141] When their rulers are thrown down from the cliffs, the people will listen to my words, for they are pleasant.

PSA 141:7.text: As when one plows and breaks up the soil, so our bones have been scattered at the mouth of Sheol.
PSA 141:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 141 · Death] As when one plows and breaks up the soil, so our bones have been scattered at the mouth of Sheol.

PSA 141:8.text: But my eyes are fixed on You, O GOD the Lord. In You I seek refuge; do not leave my soul defenseless.
PSA 141:8.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 141] But my eyes are fixed on You, O GOD the Lord. In You I seek refuge; do not leave my soul defenseless.

PSA 141:9.text: Keep me from the snares they have laid for me, and from the lures of evildoers.
PSA 141:9.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 141] Keep me from the snares they have laid for me, and from the lures of evildoers.

PSA 141:10.text: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, while I pass by in safety.
PSA 141:10.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 141] Let the wicked fall into their own nets, while I pass by in safety.

PSA 142:1.text: I cry aloud to the LORD; I lift my voice to the LORD for mercy.
PSA 142:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 142 · Forgiveness, Compassion] I cry aloud to the LORD; I lift my voice to the LORD for mercy.

PSA 142:2.text: I pour out my complaint before Him; I reveal my trouble to Him.
PSA 142:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 142] I pour out my complaint before Him; I reveal my trouble to Him.

PSA 142:3.text: Although my spirit grows faint within me, You know my way. Along the path I travel they have hidden a snare for me.
PSA 142:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 142 · Fruit of the Spirit] Although my spirit grows faint within me, You know my way. Along the path I travel they have hidden a snare for me.

PSA 142:4.text: Look to my right and see; no one attends to me. There is no refuge for me; no one cares for my soul.
PSA 142:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 142] Look to my right and see; no one attends to me. There is no refuge for me; no one cares for my soul.

PSA 142:5.text: I cry to You, O LORD: “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”
PSA 142:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 142 · Inheritance] I cry to You, O LORD: “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”

PSA 142:6.text: Listen to my cry, for I am brought quite low. Rescue me from my pursuers, for they are too strong for me.
PSA 142:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 142] Listen to my cry, for I am brought quite low. Rescue me from my pursuers, for they are too strong for me.

PSA 142:7.text: Free my soul from prison, that I may praise Your name. The righteous will gather around me because of Your goodness to me.
PSA 142:7.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 142] Free my soul from prison, that I may praise Your name. The righteous will gather around me because of Your goodness to me.

PSA 143:1.text: O LORD, hear my prayer. In Your faithfulness, give ear to my plea; in Your righteousness, answer me.
PSA 143:1.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 143 · Faith, Marital Faithfulness] O LORD, hear my prayer. In Your faithfulness, give ear to my plea; in Your righteousness, answer me.

PSA 143:2.text: Do not bring Your servant into judgment, for no one alive is righteous before You.
PSA 143:2.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 143 · Judgment] Do not bring Your servant into judgment, for no one alive is righteous before You.

PSA 143:3.text: For the enemy has pursued my soul, crushing my life to the ground, making me dwell in darkness like those long since dead.
PSA 143:3.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 143] For the enemy has pursued my soul, crushing my life to the ground, making me dwell in darkness like those long since dead.

PSA 143:4.text: My spirit grows faint within me; my heart is dismayed inside me.
PSA 143:4.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 143 · Adultery In Heart, Fruit of the Spirit] My spirit grows faint within me; my heart is dismayed inside me.

PSA 143:5.text: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all Your works; I consider the work of Your hands.
PSA 143:5.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 143] I remember the days of old; I meditate on all Your works; I consider the work of Your hands.

PSA 143:6.text: I stretch out my hands to You; my soul thirsts for You like a parched land. Selah
PSA 143:6.bm25Text: [Psalms · Chapter 143] I stretch out my hands to You; my soul thirsts for You like a parched land. Selah

ROM 4:23.text: Now the words “it was credited to him” were written not only for Abraham,
ROM 4:23.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 4] Now the words “it was credited to him” were written not only for Abraham,

ROM 4:24.text: but also for us, to whom righteousness will be credited—for us who believe in Him who raised Jesus our Lord from the dead.
ROM 4:24.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 4 · Faith, Jesus Christ] but also for us, to whom righteousness will be credited—for us who believe in Him who raised Jesus our Lord from the dead.

ROM 4:25.text: He was delivered over to death for our trespasses and was raised to life for our justification.
ROM 4:25.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 4 · Death] He was delivered over to death for our trespasses and was raised to life for our justification.

ROM 5:1.text: Therefore, since we have been justified through faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ,
ROM 5:1.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 5 · Faith, Body of Christ] Therefore, since we have been justified through faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ,

ROM 5:2.text: through whom we have gained access by faith into this grace in which we stand. And we rejoice in the hope of the glory of God.
ROM 5:2.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 5 · Faith, Glory] through whom we have gained access by faith into this grace in which we stand. And we rejoice in the hope of the glory of God.

ROM 5:3.text: Not only that, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, because we know that suffering produces perseverance;
ROM 5:3.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 5] Not only that, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, because we know that suffering produces perseverance;

ROM 5:4.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 5] perseverance, character; and character, hope.

ROM 5:5.text: And hope does not disappoint us, because God has poured out His love into our hearts through the Holy Spirit, whom He has given us.
ROM 5:5.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 5 · Love, Fruit of the Spirit] And hope does not disappoint us, because God has poured out His love into our hearts through the Holy Spirit, whom He has given us.

ROM 5:6.text: For at just the right time, while we were still powerless, Christ died for the ungodly.
ROM 5:6.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 5 · Body of Christ, Jesus Christ] For at just the right time, while we were still powerless, Christ died for the ungodly.

ROM 5:7.text: Very rarely will anyone die for a righteous man, though for a good man someone might possibly dare to die.
ROM 5:7.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 5] Very rarely will anyone die for a righteous man, though for a good man someone might possibly dare to die.

ROM 5:8.text: But God proves His love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us.
ROM 5:8.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 5 · Love, Body of Christ] But God proves His love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us.

ROM 5:9.text: Therefore, since we have now been justified by His blood, how much more shall we be saved from wrath through Him!
ROM 5:9.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 5] Therefore, since we have now been justified by His blood, how much more shall we be saved from wrath through Him!

ROM 5:10.text: For if, when we were enemies of God, we were reconciled to Him through the death of His Son, how much more, having been reconciled, shall we be saved through His life!
ROM 5:10.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 5 · Death] For if, when we were enemies of God, we were reconciled to Him through the death of His Son, how much more, having been reconciled, shall we be saved through His life!

ROM 5:11.text: Not only that, but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received reconciliation.
ROM 5:11.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 5 · Atonement, Body of Christ] Not only that, but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received reconciliation.

ROM 5:12.text: Therefore, just as sin entered the world through one man, and death through sin, so also death was passed on to all men, because all sinned.
ROM 5:12.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 5 · Death] Therefore, just as sin entered the world through one man, and death through sin, so also death was passed on to all men, because all sinned.

ROM 5:13.text: For sin was in the world before the law was given; but sin is not taken into account when there is no law.
ROM 5:13.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 5] For sin was in the world before the law was given; but sin is not taken into account when there is no law.

ROM 5:14.text: Nevertheless, death reigned from Adam until Moses, even over those who did not sin in the way that Adam transgressed. He is a pattern of the One to come.
ROM 5:14.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 5 · Death] Nevertheless, death reigned from Adam until Moses, even over those who did not sin in the way that Adam transgressed. He is a pattern of the One to come.

ROM 5:15.text: But the gift is not like the trespass. For if the many died by the trespass of the one man, how much more did God’s grace and the gift that came by the grace of the one man, Jesus Christ, abound to the many!
ROM 5:15.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 5 · Body of Christ, Grace] But the gift is not like the trespass. For if the many died by the trespass of the one man, how much more did God’s grace and the gift that came by the grace of the one man, Jesus Christ, abound to the many!

ROM 5:16.text: Again, the gift is not like the result of the one man’s sin: The judgment that followed one sin brought condemnation, but the gift that followed many trespasses brought justification.
ROM 5:16.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 5 · Judgment] Again, the gift is not like the result of the one man’s sin: The judgment that followed one sin brought condemnation, but the gift that followed many trespasses brought justification.

ROM 5:17.text: For if, by the trespass of the one man, death reigned through that one man, how much more will those who receive an abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one man, Jesus Christ!
ROM 5:17.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 5 · Body of Christ, Death] For if, by the trespass of the one man, death reigned through that one man, how much more will those who receive an abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one man, Jesus Christ!

ROM 5:18.text: So then, just as one trespass brought condemnation for all men, so also one act of righteousness brought justification and life for all men.
ROM 5:18.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 5] So then, just as one trespass brought condemnation for all men, so also one act of righteousness brought justification and life for all men.

ROM 5:19.text: For just as through the disobedience of the one man the many were made sinners, so also through the obedience of the one man the many will be made righteous.
ROM 5:19.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 5] For just as through the disobedience of the one man the many were made sinners, so also through the obedience of the one man the many will be made righteous.

ROM 5:20.text: The law came in so that the trespass would increase; but where sin increased, grace increased all the more,
ROM 5:20.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 5 · Grace] The law came in so that the trespass would increase; but where sin increased, grace increased all the more,

ROM 5:21.text: so that, just as sin reigned in death, so also grace might reign through righteousness to bring eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
ROM 5:21.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 5 · Body of Christ, Death] so that, just as sin reigned in death, so also grace might reign through righteousness to bring eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

ROM 6:1.text: What then shall we say? Shall we continue in sin so that grace may increase?
ROM 6:1.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 6 · Grace] What then shall we say? Shall we continue in sin so that grace may increase?

ROM 6:2.text: Certainly not! How can we who died to sin live in it any longer?
ROM 6:2.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 6] Certainly not! How can we who died to sin live in it any longer?

ROM 6:3.text: Or aren’t you aware that all of us who were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into His death?
ROM 6:3.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 6 · Body of Christ, Death] Or aren’t you aware that all of us who were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into His death?

ROM 6:4.text: We were therefore buried with Him through baptism into death, in order that, just as Christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the Father, we too may walk in newness of life.
ROM 6:4.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 6 · Baptism, Body of Christ] We were therefore buried with Him through baptism into death, in order that, just as Christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the Father, we too may walk in newness of life.

ROM 6:5.text: For if we have been united with Him like this in His death, we will certainly also be united with Him in His resurrection.
ROM 6:5.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 6 · Death] For if we have been united with Him like this in His death, we will certainly also be united with Him in His resurrection.

ROM 6:6.text: We know that our old self was crucified with Him so that the body of sin might be rendered powerless, that we should no longer be slaves to sin.
ROM 6:6.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 6] We know that our old self was crucified with Him so that the body of sin might be rendered powerless, that we should no longer be slaves to sin.

ROM 6:7.text: For anyone who has died has been freed from sin.
ROM 6:7.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 6] For anyone who has died has been freed from sin.

ROM 6:8.text: Now if we died with Christ, we believe that we will also live with Him.
ROM 6:8.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 6 · Faith, Body of Christ] Now if we died with Christ, we believe that we will also live with Him.

ROM 6:9.text: For we know that since Christ was raised from the dead, He cannot die again; death no longer has dominion over Him.
ROM 6:9.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 6 · Body of Christ, Death] For we know that since Christ was raised from the dead, He cannot die again; death no longer has dominion over Him.

ROM 6:10.text: The death He died, He died to sin once for all; but the life He lives, He lives to God.
ROM 6:10.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 6 · Death] The death He died, He died to sin once for all; but the life He lives, He lives to God.

ROM 6:11.text: So you too must count yourselves dead to sin, but alive to God in Christ Jesus.
ROM 6:11.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 6 · Body of Christ, Jesus Christ] So you too must count yourselves dead to sin, but alive to God in Christ Jesus.

ROM 6:12.text: Therefore do not let sin reign in your mortal body so that you obey its desires.
ROM 6:12.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 6] Therefore do not let sin reign in your mortal body so that you obey its desires.

ROM 6:13.text: Do not present the parts of your body to sin as instruments of wickedness, but present yourselves to God as those who have been brought from death to life; and present the parts of your body to Him as instruments of righteousness.
ROM 6:13.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 6 · Death] Do not present the parts of your body to sin as instruments of wickedness, but present yourselves to God as those who have been brought from death to life; and present the parts of your body to Him as instruments of righteousness.

ROM 6:14.text: For sin shall not be your master, because you are not under law, but under grace.
ROM 6:14.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 6 · Grace] For sin shall not be your master, because you are not under law, but under grace.

ROM 6:15.text: What then? Shall we sin because we are not under law, but under grace? Certainly not!
ROM 6:15.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 6 · Grace] What then? Shall we sin because we are not under law, but under grace? Certainly not!

ROM 6:16.text: Do you not know that when you offer yourselves as obedient slaves, you are slaves to the one you obey, whether you are slaves to sin leading to death, or to obedience leading to righteousness?
ROM 6:16.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 6 · Death] Do you not know that when you offer yourselves as obedient slaves, you are slaves to the one you obey, whether you are slaves to sin leading to death, or to obedience leading to righteousness?

ROM 6:17.text: But thanks be to God that, though you once were slaves to sin, you wholeheartedly obeyed the form of teaching to which you were committed.
ROM 6:17.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 6] But thanks be to God that, though you once were slaves to sin, you wholeheartedly obeyed the form of teaching to which you were committed.

ROM 6:18.text: You have been set free from sin and have become slaves to righteousness.
ROM 6:18.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 6] You have been set free from sin and have become slaves to righteousness.

ROM 6:19.text: I am speaking in human terms because of the weakness of your flesh. Just as you used to offer the parts of your body in slavery to impurity and to escalating wickedness, so now offer them in slavery to righteousness leading to holiness.
ROM 6:19.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 6 · Holiness] I am speaking in human terms because of the weakness of your flesh. Just as you used to offer the parts of your body in slavery to impurity and to escalating wickedness, so now offer them in slavery to righteousness leading to holiness.

ROM 6:20.text: For when you were slaves to sin, you were free of obligation to righteousness.
ROM 6:20.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 6] For when you were slaves to sin, you were free of obligation to righteousness.

ROM 6:21.text: What fruit did you reap at that time from the things of which you are now ashamed? The outcome of those things is death.
ROM 6:21.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 6 · Death, Fruit of the Spirit] What fruit did you reap at that time from the things of which you are now ashamed? The outcome of those things is death.

ROM 6:22.text: But now that you have been set free from sin and have become slaves to God, the fruit you reap leads to holiness, and the outcome is eternal life.
ROM 6:22.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 6 · Eternal Life, Fruit of the Spirit] But now that you have been set free from sin and have become slaves to God, the fruit you reap leads to holiness, and the outcome is eternal life.

ROM 6:23.text: For the wages of sin is death, but the gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.
ROM 6:23.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 6 · Body of Christ, Death] For the wages of sin is death, but the gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.

ROM 7:1.text: Do you not know, brothers (for I am speaking to those who know the law), that the law has authority over a man only as long as he lives?
ROM 7:1.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 7] Do you not know, brothers (for I am speaking to those who know the law), that the law has authority over a man only as long as he lives?

ROM 7:2.text: For instance, a married woman is bound by law to her husband as long as he lives. But if her husband dies, she is released from the law of marriage.
ROM 7:2.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 7 · Marriage] For instance, a married woman is bound by law to her husband as long as he lives. But if her husband dies, she is released from the law of marriage.

ROM 7:3.text: So then, if she is joined to another man while her husband is still alive, she is called an adulteress; but if her husband dies, she is free from that law and is not an adulteress, even if she marries another man.
ROM 7:3.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 7] So then, if she is joined to another man while her husband is still alive, she is called an adulteress; but if her husband dies, she is free from that law and is not an adulteress, even if she marries another man.

ROM 7:4.text: Therefore, my brothers, you also died to the law through the body of Christ, that you might belong to another, to Him who was raised from the dead, in order that we might bear fruit to God.
ROM 7:4.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 7 · Body of Christ, Fruit of the Spirit] Therefore, my brothers, you also died to the law through the body of Christ, that you might belong to another, to Him who was raised from the dead, in order that we might bear fruit to God.

ROM 7:5.text: For when we lived according to the flesh, the sinful passions aroused by the law were at work in our bodies, bearing fruit for death.
ROM 7:5.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 7 · Death, Fruit of the Spirit] For when we lived according to the flesh, the sinful passions aroused by the law were at work in our bodies, bearing fruit for death.

ROM 7:6.text: But now, having died to what bound us, we have been released from the law, so that we serve in the new way of the Spirit, and not in the old way of the written code.
ROM 7:6.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 7 · Fruit of the Spirit] But now, having died to what bound us, we have been released from the law, so that we serve in the new way of the Spirit, and not in the old way of the written code.

ROM 7:7.text: What then shall we say? Is the law sin? Certainly not! Indeed, I would not have been mindful of sin if not for the law. For I would not have been aware of coveting if the law had not said, “Do not covet.”
ROM 7:7.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 7] What then shall we say? Is the law sin? Certainly not! Indeed, I would not have been mindful of sin if not for the law. For I would not have been aware of coveting if the law had not said, “Do not covet.”

ROM 7:8.text: But sin, seizing its opportunity through the commandment, produced in me every kind of covetous desire. For apart from the law, sin is dead.
ROM 7:8.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 7 · Lust] But sin, seizing its opportunity through the commandment, produced in me every kind of covetous desire. For apart from the law, sin is dead.

ROM 7:9.text: Once I was alive apart from the law; but when the commandment came, sin sprang to life and I died.
ROM 7:9.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 7] Once I was alive apart from the law; but when the commandment came, sin sprang to life and I died.

ROM 7:10.text: So I discovered that the very commandment that was meant to bring life actually brought death.
ROM 7:10.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 7 · Death] So I discovered that the very commandment that was meant to bring life actually brought death.

ROM 7:11.text: For sin, seizing its opportunity through the commandment, deceived me and through the commandment put me to death.
ROM 7:11.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 7 · Death] For sin, seizing its opportunity through the commandment, deceived me and through the commandment put me to death.

ROM 7:12.text: So then, the law is holy, and the commandment is holy, righteous, and good.
ROM 7:12.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 7] So then, the law is holy, and the commandment is holy, righteous, and good.

ROM 7:13.text: Did that which is good, then, become death to me? Certainly not! But in order that sin might be exposed as sin, it produced death in me through what was good, so that through the commandment sin might become utterly sinful.
ROM 7:13.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 7 · Death] Did that which is good, then, become death to me? Certainly not! But in order that sin might be exposed as sin, it produced death in me through what was good, so that through the commandment sin might become utterly sinful.

ROM 7:14.text: We know that the law is spiritual; but I am unspiritual, sold as a slave to sin.
ROM 7:14.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 7] We know that the law is spiritual; but I am unspiritual, sold as a slave to sin.

ROM 7:15.text: I do not understand what I do. For what I want to do, I do not do. But what I hate, I do.
ROM 7:15.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 7] I do not understand what I do. For what I want to do, I do not do. But what I hate, I do.

ROM 7:16.text: And if I do what I do not want to do, I admit that the law is good.
ROM 7:16.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 7] And if I do what I do not want to do, I admit that the law is good.

ROM 7:17.text: In that case, it is no longer I who do it, but it is sin living in me that does it.
ROM 7:17.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 7] In that case, it is no longer I who do it, but it is sin living in me that does it.

ROM 7:18.text: I know that nothing good lives in me, that is, in my flesh; for I have the desire to do what is good, but I cannot carry it out.
ROM 7:18.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 7 · Lust] I know that nothing good lives in me, that is, in my flesh; for I have the desire to do what is good, but I cannot carry it out.

ROM 7:19.text: For I do not do the good I want to do. Instead, I keep on doing the evil I do not want to do.
ROM 7:19.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 7] For I do not do the good I want to do. Instead, I keep on doing the evil I do not want to do.

ROM 7:20.text: And if I do what I do not want, it is no longer I who do it, but it is sin living in me that does it.
ROM 7:20.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 7] And if I do what I do not want, it is no longer I who do it, but it is sin living in me that does it.

ROM 7:21.text: So this is the principle I have discovered: When I want to do good, evil is right there with me.
ROM 7:21.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 7] So this is the principle I have discovered: When I want to do good, evil is right there with me.

ROM 7:22.text: For in my inner being I delight in God’s law.
ROM 7:22.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 7] For in my inner being I delight in God’s law.

ROM 7:23.text: But I see another law at work in my body, warring against the law of my mind and holding me captive to the law of sin that dwells within me.
ROM 7:23.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 7] But I see another law at work in my body, warring against the law of my mind and holding me captive to the law of sin that dwells within me.

ROM 7:24.text: What a wretched man I am! Who will rescue me from this body of death?
ROM 7:24.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 7 · Death] What a wretched man I am! Who will rescue me from this body of death?

ROM 7:25.text: Thanks be to God, through Jesus Christ our Lord!  So then, with my mind I serve the law of God, but with my flesh I serve the law of sin.
ROM 7:25.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 7 · Body of Christ, Jesus Christ] Thanks be to God, through Jesus Christ our Lord!  So then, with my mind I serve the law of God, but with my flesh I serve the law of sin.

ROM 8:1.text: Therefore, there is now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus.
ROM 8:1.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 8 · Body of Christ, Jesus Christ] Therefore, there is now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus.

ROM 8:2.text: For in Christ Jesus the law of the Spirit of life set you free from the law of sin and death.
ROM 8:2.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 8 · Covenant, Body of Christ] For in Christ Jesus the law of the Spirit of life set you free from the law of sin and death.

ROM 8:3.text: For what the law was powerless to do in that it was weakened by the flesh, God did by sending His own Son in the likeness of sinful man, as an offering for sin. He thus condemned sin in the flesh,
ROM 8:3.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 8 · Covenant] For what the law was powerless to do in that it was weakened by the flesh, God did by sending His own Son in the likeness of sinful man, as an offering for sin. He thus condemned sin in the flesh,

ROM 8:4.text: so that the righteous standard of the law might be fulfilled in us, who do not walk according to the flesh but according to the Spirit.
ROM 8:4.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 8 · Covenant, Fruit of the Spirit] so that the righteous standard of the law might be fulfilled in us, who do not walk according to the flesh but according to the Spirit.

ROM 8:5.text: Those who live according to the flesh set their minds on the things of the flesh; but those who live according to the Spirit set their minds on the things of the Spirit.
ROM 8:5.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 8 · Fruit of the Spirit] Those who live according to the flesh set their minds on the things of the flesh; but those who live according to the Spirit set their minds on the things of the Spirit.

ROM 8:6.text: The mind of the flesh is death, but the mind of the Spirit is life and peace,
ROM 8:6.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 8 · Death, Fruit of the Spirit] The mind of the flesh is death, but the mind of the Spirit is life and peace,

ROM 8:7.text: because the mind of the flesh is hostile to God: It does not submit to God’s law, nor can it do so.
ROM 8:7.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 8 · Covenant] because the mind of the flesh is hostile to God: It does not submit to God’s law, nor can it do so.

ROM 8:8.text: Those controlled by the flesh cannot please God.
ROM 8:8.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 8] Those controlled by the flesh cannot please God.

ROM 8:9.text: You, however, are controlled not by the flesh, but by the Spirit, if the Spirit of God lives in you. And if anyone does not have the Spirit of Christ, he does not belong to Christ.
ROM 8:9.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 8 · Body of Christ, Fruit of the Spirit] You, however, are controlled not by the flesh, but by the Spirit, if the Spirit of God lives in you. And if anyone does not have the Spirit of Christ, he does not belong to Christ.

ROM 8:10.text: But if Christ is in you, your body is dead because of sin, yet your spirit is alive because of righteousness.
ROM 8:10.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 8 · Body of Christ, Fruit of the Spirit] But if Christ is in you, your body is dead because of sin, yet your spirit is alive because of righteousness.

ROM 8:11.text: And if the Spirit of Him who raised Jesus from the dead is living in you, He who raised Christ Jesus from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through His Spirit, who lives in you.
ROM 8:11.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 8 · Body of Christ, Fruit of the Spirit] And if the Spirit of Him who raised Jesus from the dead is living in you, He who raised Christ Jesus from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through His Spirit, who lives in you.

ROM 8:12.text: Therefore, brothers, we have an obligation, but it is not to the flesh, to live according to it.
ROM 8:12.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 8] Therefore, brothers, we have an obligation, but it is not to the flesh, to live according to it.

ROM 8:13.text: For if you live according to the flesh, you will die; but if by the Spirit you put to death the deeds of the body, you will live.
ROM 8:13.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 8 · Death, Fruit of the Spirit] For if you live according to the flesh, you will die; but if by the Spirit you put to death the deeds of the body, you will live.

ROM 8:14.text: For all who are led by the Spirit of God are sons of God.
ROM 8:14.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 8 · Adoption, Fruit of the Spirit] For all who are led by the Spirit of God are sons of God.

ROM 8:15.text: For you did not receive a spirit of slavery that returns you to fear, but you received the Spirit of sonship, by whom we cry, “Abba! Father!”
ROM 8:15.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 8 · Fruit of the Spirit, God the Father] For you did not receive a spirit of slavery that returns you to fear, but you received the Spirit of sonship, by whom we cry, “Abba! Father!”

ROM 8:16.text: The Spirit Himself testifies with our spirit that we are God’s children.
ROM 8:16.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 8 · Children, Fruit of the Spirit] The Spirit Himself testifies with our spirit that we are God’s children.

ROM 8:17.text: And if we are children, then we are heirs: heirs of God and co-heirs with Christ—if indeed we suffer with Him, so that we may also be glorified with Him.
ROM 8:17.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 8 · Adoption, Body of Christ] And if we are children, then we are heirs: heirs of God and co-heirs with Christ—if indeed we suffer with Him, so that we may also be glorified with Him.

ROM 8:18.text: I consider that our present sufferings are not comparable to the glory that will be revealed in us.
ROM 8:18.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 8 · Glory] I consider that our present sufferings are not comparable to the glory that will be revealed in us.

ROM 8:19.text: The creation waits in eager expectation for the revelation of the sons of God.
ROM 8:19.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 8 · Adoption, Creation] The creation waits in eager expectation for the revelation of the sons of God.

ROM 8:20.text: For the creation was subjected to futility, not by its own will, but because of the One who subjected it, in hope
ROM 8:20.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 8 · Creation] For the creation was subjected to futility, not by its own will, but because of the One who subjected it, in hope

ROM 8:21.text: that the creation itself will be set free from its bondage to decay and brought into the glorious freedom of the children of God.
ROM 8:21.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 8 · Children, Creation] that the creation itself will be set free from its bondage to decay and brought into the glorious freedom of the children of God.

ROM 8:22.text: We know that the whole creation has been groaning together in the pains of childbirth until the present time.
ROM 8:22.bm25Text: [Romans · Chapter 8 · Creation] We know that the whole creation has been groaning together in the pains of childbirth until the present time.
