ZEP 2:4.bm25Text: [Zephaniah · Chapter 2] For Gaza will be abandoned, and Ashkelon left in ruins. Ashdod will be driven out at noon, and Ekron will be uprooted.

ZEP 2:5.text: Woe to the dwellers of the seacoast, O nation of the Cherethites! The word of the LORD is against you, O Canaan, land of the Philistines: “I will destroy you, and no one will be left.”
ZEP 2:5.bm25Text: [Zephaniah · Chapter 2 · Conquest Of Canaan, Destroy Canaan] Woe to the dwellers of the seacoast, O nation of the Cherethites! The word of the LORD is against you, O Canaan, land of the Philistines: “I will destroy you, and no one will be left.”

ZEP 2:6.text: So the seacoast will become a land of pastures, with wells for shepherds and folds for sheep.
ZEP 2:6.bm25Text: [Zephaniah · Chapter 2] So the seacoast will become a land of pastures, with wells for shepherds and folds for sheep.

ZEP 2:7.text: The coast will belong to the remnant of the house of Judah; there they will find pasture. They will lie down in the evening among the houses of Ashkelon, for the LORD their God will attend to them and restore their captives.
ZEP 2:7.bm25Text: [Zephaniah · Chapter 2] The coast will belong to the remnant of the house of Judah; there they will find pasture. They will lie down in the evening among the houses of Ashkelon, for the LORD their God will attend to them and restore their captives.

ZEP 2:8.text: “I have heard the reproach of Moab and the insults of the Ammonites, who have taunted My people and threatened their borders.
ZEP 2:8.bm25Text: [Zephaniah · Chapter 2] “I have heard the reproach of Moab and the insults of the Ammonites, who have taunted My people and threatened their borders.

ZEP 2:9.text: Therefore, as surely as I live,” declares the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, “surely Moab will be like Sodom and the Ammonites like Gomorrah— a place of weeds and salt pits, a perpetual wasteland. The remnant of My people will plunder them; the remainder of My nation will dispossess them.”
ZEP 2:9.bm25Text: [Zephaniah · Chapter 2 · Israel] Therefore, as surely as I live,” declares the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, “surely Moab will be like Sodom and the Ammonites like Gomorrah— a place of weeds and salt pits, a perpetual wasteland. The remnant of My people will plunder them; the remainder of My nation will dispossess them.”

ZEP 2:10.text: This they shall have in return for their pride, for taunting and mocking the people of the LORD of Hosts.
ZEP 2:10.bm25Text: [Zephaniah · Chapter 2] This they shall have in return for their pride, for taunting and mocking the people of the LORD of Hosts.

ZEP 2:11.text: The LORD will be terrifying to them when He starves all the gods of the earth. Then the nations of every shore will bow in worship to Him, each in its own place.
ZEP 2:11.bm25Text: [Zephaniah · Chapter 2] The LORD will be terrifying to them when He starves all the gods of the earth. Then the nations of every shore will bow in worship to Him, each in its own place.

ZEP 2:12.text: “You too, O Cushites, will be slain by My sword.”
ZEP 2:12.bm25Text: [Zephaniah · Chapter 2] “You too, O Cushites, will be slain by My sword.”

ZEP 2:13.text: And He will stretch out His hand against the north and destroy Assyria; He will make Nineveh a desolation, as dry as a desert.
ZEP 2:13.bm25Text: [Zephaniah · Chapter 2 · Destroy Canaan, Destroy Canaanites] And He will stretch out His hand against the north and destroy Assyria; He will make Nineveh a desolation, as dry as a desert.

ZEP 2:14.text: Herds will lie down in her midst, creatures of every kind. Both the desert owl and screech owl will roost atop her pillars. Their calls will sound from the window, but desolation will lie on the threshold, for He will expose the beams of cedar.
ZEP 2:14.bm25Text: [Zephaniah · Chapter 2] Herds will lie down in her midst, creatures of every kind. Both the desert owl and screech owl will roost atop her pillars. Their calls will sound from the window, but desolation will lie on the threshold, for He will expose the beams of cedar.

ZEP 2:15.text: This carefree city that dwells securely, that thinks to herself: “I am it, and there is none besides me,” what a ruin she has become, a resting place for beasts. Everyone who passes by her hisses and shakes his fist.
ZEP 2:15.bm25Text: [Zephaniah · Chapter 2] This carefree city that dwells securely, that thinks to herself: “I am it, and there is none besides me,” what a ruin she has become, a resting place for beasts. Everyone who passes by her hisses and shakes his fist.

ZEP 3:1.text: Woe to the city of oppressors, rebellious and defiled!
ZEP 3:1.bm25Text: [Zephaniah · Chapter 3] Woe to the city of oppressors, rebellious and defiled!

ZEP 3:2.text: She heeded no voice; she accepted no correction. She does not trust in the LORD; she has not drawn near to her God.
ZEP 3:2.bm25Text: [Zephaniah · Chapter 3 · Faith] She heeded no voice; she accepted no correction. She does not trust in the LORD; she has not drawn near to her God.

ZEP 3:3.text: Her princes are roaring lions; her judges are evening wolves, leaving nothing for the morning.
ZEP 3:3.bm25Text: [Zephaniah · Chapter 3] Her princes are roaring lions; her judges are evening wolves, leaving nothing for the morning.

ZEP 3:4.text: Her prophets are reckless, faithless men. Her priests profane the sanctuary; they do violence to the law.
ZEP 3:4.bm25Text: [Zephaniah · Chapter 3 · Faith] Her prophets are reckless, faithless men. Her priests profane the sanctuary; they do violence to the law.

ZEP 3:5.text: The LORD within her is righteous; He does no wrong. He applies His justice morning by morning; He does not fail at dawn, yet the unjust know no shame.
ZEP 3:5.bm25Text: [Zephaniah · Chapter 3 · Justice] The LORD within her is righteous; He does no wrong. He applies His justice morning by morning; He does not fail at dawn, yet the unjust know no shame.

ZEP 3:6.text: “I have cut off the nations; their corner towers are destroyed. I have made their streets deserted with no one to pass through. Their cities are laid waste, with no man, no inhabitant.
ZEP 3:6.bm25Text: [Zephaniah · Chapter 3] “I have cut off the nations; their corner towers are destroyed. I have made their streets deserted with no one to pass through. Their cities are laid waste, with no man, no inhabitant.

ZEP 3:7.text: I said, ‘Surely you will fear Me and accept correction.’ Then her dwelling place would not be cut off despite all for which I punished her. But they rose early to corrupt all their deeds.
ZEP 3:7.bm25Text: [Zephaniah · Chapter 3] I said, ‘Surely you will fear Me and accept correction.’ Then her dwelling place would not be cut off despite all for which I punished her. But they rose early to corrupt all their deeds.

ZEP 3:8.text: Therefore wait for Me,” declares the LORD, “until the day I rise to testify. For My decision is to gather nations, to assemble kingdoms, to pour out upon them My indignation— all My burning anger. For all the earth will be consumed by the fire of My jealousy.
ZEP 3:8.bm25Text: [Zephaniah · Chapter 3 · Jealousy] Therefore wait for Me,” declares the LORD, “until the day I rise to testify. For My decision is to gather nations, to assemble kingdoms, to pour out upon them My indignation— all My burning anger. For all the earth will be consumed by the fire of My jealousy.

ZEP 3:9.text: For then I will restore pure lips to the peoples, that all may call upon the name of the LORD and serve Him shoulder to shoulder.
ZEP 3:9.bm25Text: [Zephaniah · Chapter 3] For then I will restore pure lips to the peoples, that all may call upon the name of the LORD and serve Him shoulder to shoulder.

ZEP 3:10.text: From beyond the rivers of Cush My worshipers, My scattered people, will bring Me an offering.
ZEP 3:10.bm25Text: [Zephaniah · Chapter 3] From beyond the rivers of Cush My worshipers, My scattered people, will bring Me an offering.

ZEP 3:11.text: On that day you will not be put to shame for any of the deeds by which you have transgressed against Me. For then I will remove from among you those who rejoice in their pride, and you will never again be haughty on My holy mountain.
ZEP 3:11.bm25Text: [Zephaniah · Chapter 3] On that day you will not be put to shame for any of the deeds by which you have transgressed against Me. For then I will remove from among you those who rejoice in their pride, and you will never again be haughty on My holy mountain.

ZEP 3:12.text: But I will leave within you a meek and humble people, and they will trust in the name of the LORD.
ZEP 3:12.bm25Text: [Zephaniah · Chapter 3 · Faith] But I will leave within you a meek and humble people, and they will trust in the name of the LORD.

ZEP 3:13.text: The remnant of Israel will no longer do wrong or speak lies, nor will a deceitful tongue be found in their mouths. But they will feed and lie down, with no one to make them tremble.”
ZEP 3:13.bm25Text: [Zephaniah · Chapter 3 · Israel] The remnant of Israel will no longer do wrong or speak lies, nor will a deceitful tongue be found in their mouths. But they will feed and lie down, with no one to make them tremble.”

ZEP 3:14.text: Sing for joy, O Daughter of Zion; shout aloud, O Israel! Be glad and rejoice with all your heart, O Daughter of Jerusalem!
ZEP 3:14.bm25Text: [Zephaniah · Chapter 3 · Adultery In Heart, Israel] Sing for joy, O Daughter of Zion; shout aloud, O Israel! Be glad and rejoice with all your heart, O Daughter of Jerusalem!

ZEP 3:15.text: The LORD has taken away your punishment; He has turned back your enemy. Israel’s King, the LORD, is among you; no longer will you fear any harm.
ZEP 3:15.bm25Text: [Zephaniah · Chapter 3 · Israel] The LORD has taken away your punishment; He has turned back your enemy. Israel’s King, the LORD, is among you; no longer will you fear any harm.

ZEP 3:16.text: On that day they will say to Jerusalem: “Do not fear, O Zion; do not let your hands fall limp.
ZEP 3:16.bm25Text: [Zephaniah · Chapter 3] On that day they will say to Jerusalem: “Do not fear, O Zion; do not let your hands fall limp.

ZEP 3:17.text: The LORD your God is among you; He is mighty to save. He will rejoice over you with gladness; He will quiet you with His love; He will rejoice over you with singing.”
ZEP 3:17.bm25Text: [Zephaniah · Chapter 3 · Love, Joy] The LORD your God is among you; He is mighty to save. He will rejoice over you with gladness; He will quiet you with His love; He will rejoice over you with singing.”

ZEP 3:18.text: “I will gather those among you who grieve over the appointed feasts, so that you will no longer suffer reproach.
ZEP 3:18.bm25Text: [Zephaniah · Chapter 3] “I will gather those among you who grieve over the appointed feasts, so that you will no longer suffer reproach.

ZEP 3:19.text: Behold, at that time, I will deal with all who afflict you. I will save the lame and gather the scattered; and I will appoint praise and fame for the disgraced throughout the earth.
ZEP 3:19.bm25Text: [Zephaniah · Chapter 3] Behold, at that time, I will deal with all who afflict you. I will save the lame and gather the scattered; and I will appoint praise and fame for the disgraced throughout the earth.

ZEP 3:20.text: At that time I will bring you in; yes, at that time I will gather you. For I will give you fame and praise among all the peoples of the earth when I restore your captives before your very eyes,” says the LORD.
ZEP 3:20.bm25Text: [Zephaniah · Chapter 3] At that time I will bring you in; yes, at that time I will gather you. For I will give you fame and praise among all the peoples of the earth when I restore your captives before your very eyes,” says the LORD.
